Finally, wash your clothes and take a bath, and you will be completely clean.
10On the eighth day you must bring to the priest two rams and a year-old female lamb that have nothing wrong with them; also bring 300 milliliters of olive oil and 3 kilograms of your finest flour mixed with oil. 11Then the priest will present you and your offerings to me at the entrance to my sacred tent. 12There he will offer one of the rams, together with the oil, as a sacrifice to make things right. He will also lift them up to show that they are dedicated to me. 13This sacrifice is very holy. It belongs to the priest and must be killed in the same place where animals are killed as sacrifices for sins and as sacrifices to please me.
14The priest will smear some of the blood from this sacrifice on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot. 15He will then pour some of the olive oil into the palm of his left hand, 16dip a finger of his right hand into the oil, and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred tent. 17Next, the priest will smear some of the oil on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot, 18-20and he will pour the rest of the oil from his palm on your head. Then he will offer the other two animals—one as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me, together with a grain sacrifice. After this you will be completely clean.
21If you are poor and cannot afford to offer this much, you may offer a ram as a sacrifice to make things right, together with 300 milliliters of olive oil and one kilogram of flour mixed with oil as a grain sacrifice. The priest will then lift these up to dedicate them to me. 22Depending on what you can afford, you must also offer either two doves or two pigeons, one as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me. 23The priest will offer these to me in front of the sacred tent on the eighth day.
24-25The priest will kill this ram for the sacrifice to make things right, and he will lift it up with the olive oil in dedication to me. Then he will smear some of the blood on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot.
26The priest will pour some of the olive oil into the palm of his left hand, 27then dip a finger of his right hand in the oil and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred tent. 28He will smear some of the oil on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot, just as he did with the blood of the sacrifice to make things right. 29-31And he will pour the rest of the oil from his palm on your head.
Then, depending on what you can afford, he will offer either the doves or the pigeons together with the grain sacrifice. One of the birds is the sacrifice for sin, and the other is the sacrifice to please me. After this you will be completely clean.
32These are the things you must do if you have leprosy and cannot afford the usual sacrifices to make you clean.
When There Is Mildew in a House
33The Lord told Moses and Aaron to say to the people:
34After I have given you the land of Canaan as your permanent possession, here is what you must do, if I ever put mildew on the walls of any of your homes. 35First, you must say to a priest, “I think there is mildew on the wall of my house.”
36The priest will reply, “Empty the house before I inspect it, or else everything in it will be unclean.”
37If the priest discovers greenish or reddish spots that go deeper than the surface of the walls, 38he will have the house closed for seven days. 39Then he will return and check to see if the mildew has spread. 40-41If so, he will order someone to scrape the plaster from the walls, remove the stones covered with mildew, then haul everything off and dump it in an unclean place outside the town. 42Afterwards the wall must be repaired with new stones and fresh plaster.
43If the mildew appears a second time, 44the priest will come and say, “This house is unclean. It's covered with mildew that can't be removed.” 45Then he will have the house torn down and every bit of wood, stone, and plaster hauled off to an unclean place outside the town. 46Meanwhile, if any of you entered the house while it was closed, you will be unclean until evening. 47And if you either slept or ate in the house, you must wash your clothes.
48On the other hand, if the priest discovers that mildew hasn't reappeared after the house was newly plastered, he will say, “This house is clean—the mildew has gone.” 49Then, to show that the house is now clean, he will get two birds, a stick of cedar wood, a piece of red yarn, and a branch from a hyssop plant and bring them to the house. 50He will kill one of the birds over a clay pot of spring water 51-52and let its blood drain into the pot. Then he will dip the cedar, the hyssop, the yarn, and the other bird into the mixture of blood and water. Next, he will sprinkle the house seven times with the mixture, then the house will be completely clean. 53Finally, he will release the bird and let it fly away, ending the ceremony for purifying the house.
54-57These are the things you must do if you discover that you are unclean because of an itch or a sore, or that your clothing or house is unclean because of mildew.
translation_text:
Ɔda Bubo Bute Bekyuli Bani Na Ɔlɛgyie Ɔ́ba-ma
1Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, 2“Amɛni ndi ɔda bubo bute ukyuli ɔni na ɔlɛgyie úwi-nwu na ɔlɛ ɔmmɔ ɔ́ba-nwu.” Na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Si béti ukyuli ɔmmɔ bábatina ɔkpane ni, 3ɔlɛka ɔkpane ɔmmɔ usie kesii kani na ɔlɛne ɔmmɔ ɔkya kesii kani na Israelƒuɔ belie mmɔ kama na utásia-nwu anu ɔnu na mmɔ. Na si ukyuli ɔmmɔ ɔlɛgyie ɔmmɔ ɔ́sa ni, 4ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔsu ukyuli ɔmmɔ na beti baasɛ babuni inyɔ bani neeese lɛlɔ ku kegyikɛ ku lɛdiku ligyiedi ku hisope na beti babla-nwu sɛɛn bɔbla ɔdi ɔmmɔ. 5Na mmɔ na ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔya na badu baasɛ bammɔ kemmo unwi na kayaa na ntu buni ku ketubui kemmo eli. 6Na ɔkpane ɔmmɔ uti aasɛ unyɔdi ɔni bátadu mmɔ ku sida kegyikɛ ku kɔdi kugyiedi kɔmmɔ ku hisope ɔnyina ɔkya ketubui kani kemmo na ntu ku ubugya ɔmmɔ uwi mmɔ kemmo. 7Na ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔkuna ntu bɔmmɔ uwi ukyuli ɔni na ɔɔbla lɛlɔ bɔbla sɛɛn ɔdi ɔmmɔ teete mmɔ maatɛ na ubo kudu ute bɔti ka ɔlɛ ɔmmɔ ɔ́sa na ɔƒɛni amu use sɛɛn. Na ɔmmɔ kama na ɔnyonu aasɛ ku ngba ɔmmɔ na uveyi ɔtɔlɔ uteesie alakpi akɔ.
8“Na ukyuli ɔni na baabla lɛlɔ bɔbla sɛɛn ɔdi ɔmmɔ teete ɔlɛka ɔƒɔ nwuna adala na ukpeyi lili na ɔkpi ntu na ɔmmɔ ɔɔtina ka ɔ́bla sɛɛn. Na ɔmmɔ kama ɔkana utéduo nwuna badi akɔ. Nsu ɔdi ka ɔka kevoma bulie emeyi maatɛ asa. 9Na limeyi maatɛdi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ na ɔlɛka ukpeyi lili ku nwuna ukwi ku nwuna lɛnungya ku linwini biala na nwuna ɔlɔna kesii biala. Na ɔmmɔ kama ɔƒɔ nwuna adala na ɔkpi na ɔbla sɛɛn.
10“Na limeyi maanedi lɛlɔ ni, ɔlɛka ɔwia baƒonu bagyani inyɔ ku koƒonu kuledi kunwi kɔni náƒɔ lɛkwa linwi na kútasɔ kesii kadi ku ɔlaaƒɔ lɛɛƒɛɛ klo klo ɛku ku kakɛ ɔni básala ku nnɔ ku nnɔ ɔsii bamba unwi. 11Na ɔkpane ɔni mɔɔbla ɔdi ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔkpanku ukyuli ɔni na ɔɔbla ɔdi ɔmmɔ teete ku akpala ammɔ ƒui usienku Unwoti Adi Kevo kammɔ kayakun.
12“Ɔmmɔ kama ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔdubuti koƒonu ubi ɔgyani unwi ubunku nnɔ ɔsii na uti ɔbla kɔtɔ bukpi akpala. Na ɔdubɔkɔliku-nya katɔ ɔtina-mi aani ala ani na bákɔliku katɔ bébo kudu. 13Na ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔlɛka ɔdu koƒonu kɔmmɔ na kesii kani nse kedee na baadú likpidi bɔkyiɛ akpala ku akpala bɔkyula ƒui ebuo. Na aani likpidi lili buvele akpala kalɛ ni, kɔtɔ bukpi akpala lɛnɔ adi ɔkpane ɔmmɔ adi na ese kedee geen. 14Na kɔtɔ bukpi ebuo ɔmmɔ ubugya ni, ɔlɛka ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔbla-nwu ɔdi utu ukyuli ɔni na baabla sɛɛn bɔbla ɔdi ɔmmɔ teete mmɔ kɔdianu kɔtu kawɔlɔkɔ ku nwuna kɔdianu kɔnu ku kɔdianu ɔgba animigya. 15Na ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔdubuti nnɔmii bɔmmɔ bɔdi uwi anwu ɔlati nwuna kɔmiinu kɔnu lɛkɔkɔ 16na uti nwuna kɔdianu lɛnimi lideedi lɛni nsiaku lɛnimigya ɔkya nnɔmii bɔni nwi-nwu lɛkɔkɔ mmɔ kemmo na ɔta-mu uwi kayaa maatɛ na Unwoti anumi mmɔ. 17Na nnɔmii bɔkladi bɔni nwi ɔkpane ɔmmɔ lɛkɔkɔ ni, ɔbla-mu utu ukyuli ɔni na ɔɔbla sɛɛn bɔbla ɔdi ɔmmɔ teete kɔdianu kɔtu kawɔlɔkɔ ku kɔdianu kɔnu lɛnimigya ku kɔdianu ɔgba lɛnimigya na kesii kani na úsusu kɔtɔ bukpi ebuo ɔmmɔ ubugya mmɔ kani. 18Na nnɔmii bɔkladi ni, uti-mu ususu ukyuli ɔmmɔ lili ɔtina ka Unwoti údie likpidi kɔtu bɔni biala na nwuna lɛlɔ.
19“Ɔmmɔ kama ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔbla likpidi lili buvele akpala uti ɔbla lɛlɔ bɔbla sɛɛn ɔdi ɔmmɔ ute ukyuli ɔmmɔ. Na ɔmmɔ kama na ɔdu akpala bɔkyula ebuo ɔmmɔ 20na uti ubunku edula ebi akpala ammɔ na ɔkyula ƒui na lɛkpabi lɛlɔ uti ɔbla sɛɛn bɔbla ɔdi ɔmmɔ ute ukyuli ɔmmɔ ɔwɔlɔ na ɔbla sɛɛn.
21“Nsu si ukyuli ɔmmɔ ɔdi ɔwabane na ulákɛ ala ammɔ ni, na uti koƒonu kɔgyani kunwi uboku na beti bakɔliku katɔ batina-mi aani likpidi kɔtu bɔni budie akpala ubunku ɔlaaƒɔ lɛɛƒɛɛ inyɔ na basala-nwu ku nnɔ ute edula ebi akpala ku nnɔ ɔsii unwi 22ku babloduma inyɔ iye bamangbɛ inyɔ bani na ɔdubɔkana bɔkɛ na unwi unye ute likpidi lili buvele akpala na ɔkladi unye ute bɔkyula ƒui akpala.
23“Na si emeyi maane édu ni, na beti akpala ammɔ beboku na ɔkpane ɔmmɔ uti ɔbla-nwu lɛlɔ bɔbla sɛɛn ɔdi ɔmmɔ na Unwoti Adi Kevo kayakun kenye mmɔ na Unwoti anumi. 24Na ɔkpane ɔmmɔ uti kɔtɔ bukpi akpala koƒonu kɔgyani kɔmmɔ ku nnɔ ɔsii ɔmmɔ ɔkɔliku katɔ ɔtina-mi aani katɔ bɔkɔliku kudu bubo akpala. 25Na ɔmmɔ kama ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔdu kɔtɔ bukpi akpala koƒonu kɔmmɔ na uti ubugya ɔmmɔ ɔdi utu ukyuli ɔmmɔ kɔdianu kɔtu ku kɔdianu kɔnu lɛnimigya ku kɔdianu ɔgba lɛnimigya. 26Na ɔkpane ɔƒɛ nnɔ bɔmmɔ bɔdi uwi anwu ɔlati kɔmiinu kɔnu lɛkɔkɔ. 27Na uti nwuna kɔdianu lɛnimi lideedi lɛni nsiaku lɛnimigya utu nnɔ bɔni nwi-nwu kɔmiinu lɛkɔkɔ mmɔ na ɔta-mu uwi kayaa maatɛ na Unwoti anumi mmɔ. 28Na uti nnɔ bɔmmɔ bɔdi utu ukyuli ɔni baabla sɛɛn mmɔ kɔdianu kɔtu ku nwuna kɔdianu lɛnimigya ku nwuna kɔdianu ɔgba lɛnimigya na kesii kani na bétu-nwu kɔtɔ bukpi ebuo ɔmmɔ ubugya kani. 29Na bɔkladi bɔni nébu buwi-nwu lɛkɔkɔ ni, ɔkpane ɔmmɔ uti ususu ukyuli ɔni na baabla ɔdi ɔmmɔ teete kalɛ na Unwoti udie kɔtu bɔni biala na nwuna lɛlɔ. 30Na ɔmmɔ kama na uti nwuna babloduma iye bamangbɛ bakɔdi bani na ɔ́kɛ mmɔ ɔkpa. 31Na lɛla lɛni na ɔ́kɛ ni, uti unwi ɔbla likpidi lili buvele akpala na uti unyɔdi ɔbla akpala bɔkyula úbunku edula ebi akpala ammɔ. Ulu ɔmɛni lɛlɔ na ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔsia na ɔbla lɛlɔ bɔbla sɛɛn ɔdi ɔmmɔ ute ukyuli ɔmmɔ.”
32Ala amɛni ndi ɔda bubo bute ukyuli ɔni na ɔlɛgyie ɔni mɔɔví ɔda-nwu, nsu kɔnu kuledu-nwu akpala ammɔ lɛlɔ ute nwuna lɛlɔ bɔbla sɛɛn ɔdi ɔmmɔ.
Ala Ani Butili Kuyi Kɔ́ƒɔ Bɔbla Sɛɛn
33Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ku Aaron ɔnini, 34“Si bítéduo Kanaan kalɔ kani lɛ́su líse ka mete-mii na biti binwini bina kadikɔ mmɔ kemmo na bɛ́nu ka lɛ́ya na butili kuyi kɔƒɔ ɔtɔ ɔdi kemmo ni, 35na kaduli ɔlati ɔmmɔ usie na utásu ɔkpane ka lɛla lɛdi lɛ́lɛ lɛsia kaduli lɛwoduku lɛlɔ aani butili kuyi. 36Na asa na ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔdubusie utánu lɛla lɛni lɛdi ni, ɔlɛka bada lɛla biala nkya ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ kemmo bedie asa na usie mmɔ kalɛ na ulatina aani lɛla biala nse ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ kemmo liiise sɛɛn. Na ɔmmɔ kama ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔdubusie kaduli kammɔ kemmo utánu lɛla lɛni na lɛdi. 37Ɔmmɔ ɔsu ɔdubɔsia anumi ɔnu lɛla lɛni nsia awodu ammɔ lɛlɔ. Na si mmɔ kánu kéduo na úgyie iye use evete awɔdi ni, 38na ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔvi ɔlɛ ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ kemmo na ɔkalɛ-nwu unyene emeyi maatɛ. 39Na limeyi maatɛdi lɛlɔ ni, ɔsɔ ɔdubusie na utásia ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ anu ɔnu si butili bɔmmɔ bɔ́sɔ búsie kama búbu na awodu ammɔ lɛlɔ. 40Na si use lɛni ni, ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔsu na bamami atabi ani náƒɔ butili bɔmmɔ bedie na balɛku-nya ɔma kemmo betébo bakya kesii kani muusé lɛlɔ. 41Ɔmmɔ kama badubo ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ kemmo awodu ƒui lɛlɔ bukpeyi na beti lɛti lɛmmɔ betéwiakun kesii kani muusé lɛlɔ mmɔ. 42Na ɔmmɔ kama na beti atabi abambadi ku lɛti lɛbambadi baklibi ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ kemmo.
43“Na si ɔni na básɔku kaduli kammɔ báklibi na lɛla lɛmmɔ lɛ́sɔ líbasia lɛwoduku lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, 44na ɔkpane ɔsɔ usie na utásia kaduli kammɔ anu. Na si ɔ́nu na sɔsɔ na lɛla lɛmmɔ lɛ́sɔ lígyingya lɛ́ƒɔ awodu ammɔ lɛlɔ ni, na ɔdi ɔlɛ ɔni muubile ala ɔsu kaduli kammɔ keesé lɛlɔ. 45Na ɔlɛka baƒɛ ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ na babuma nwuna lɛti ku atabi ku egyii ani ƒui béti bébi ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ na betébo-nya bewiakun ɔma ɔmmɔ kɔmadɔ kesii kani muusé lɛlɔ mmɔ.
46“Ukyuli ɔni ndubusie kaduli kammɔ na uwi ɔni na bákalɛ-ka bényene mmɔ ɔdubuse lɛlɔ limeyi limodi utálɛ useyi uwi. 47Na ukyuli biala madi iye matɛ kaduli kammɔ kemmo ɔlɛka ɔƒɔ nwuna adala.
48“Nsu si ɔkpane ɔmmɔ úbanu kaduli kammɔ na butili bɔmmɔ bɔ́sɔ bútegyingya bútaƒɔ kaduli kani awodu básɔku bákwa mmɔ lɛlɔ ni, ɔkpane ɔdubute kati ka kaduli kammɔ kabla sɛɛn, ɔsika butili bɔmmɔ bɔ́sa. 49Asa na wabla-ka sɛɛn ɔdi ɔmmɔ ni, ɔlɛka uti baasɛ inyɔ ku kegyikɛ ku lɛduni ligyiedi ku hisope. 50Na ɔdubɔdu aasɛ unwi na kayaa na ketubui ku ntu bɔbuni bɔmmɔ eli. 51Na uti kegyikɛ kammɔ ku hisope ku lɛduni ligyiedi lɛmmɔ ku aasɛ ku ngba ku ngba ɔmmɔ ɔkya udie aasɛ ɔni na ɔ́du ubugya ku ntu bɔni nwi ketubui kemmo mmɔ na ɔkuna uwi kaduli kammɔ kemmo maatɛ. 52Lɛni na ɔdubuti aasɛ ubugya ku ntu bɔni nwi libui kemmo mmɔ ku aasɛ ku ngba ku ngba ku sida kegyikɛ ku hisope ku lɛduni ligyiedi lɛmmɔ ɔbla kaduli kammɔ sɛɛn bɔbla ɔdi ɔmmɔ. 53Ɔmmɔ kama ɔdubɔlɛ ɔma ɔmmɔ kemmo na utányonu aasɛ ɔmmɔ na uveyi ɔtɔlɔ utéduo alakpi akɔ. Lɛni na ɔdubudie bɔsɔ biala na kɔduli kammɔ lɛlɔ na kɔbla sɛɛn.”
54Ɔmmɔ ndi ɔda bubo bute ɔlɛgyie ɔni mɔɔví 55ku butili na adala iye lɛtɔ lɛlɔ 56ku eƒula lidu lidu ku lɛlɔ ekpo bugyie 57ku kalɛ na banu bati si lɛla lɛdi lise sɛɛn iye liiise sɛɛn lɛlɔ.
Ammɔ ndi ɔda bubo bɔni nkɛnku lɛlɛ lɛni mɔɔví ku butili lɛlɔ.

Sexual Uncleanness
1The Lord told Moses and Aaron 2to say to the community of Israel:
Any man with an infected penis is unclean, 3whether it is stopped up or keeps dripping. 4Anything that he rests on or sits on is also unclean, 5-7and if you touch either these or him, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
8If you are spit on by the man, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening. 9-10Any saddle or seat on which the man sits is unclean. And if you touch or carry either of these, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening. 11If the man touches you without first washing his hands, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening. 12Any clay pot that he touches must be destroyed, and any wooden bowl that he touches must be washed.
13Seven days after the man gets well, he will be considered clean, if he washes his clothes and takes a bath in spring water. 14On the eighth day he must bring either two doves or two pigeons to the front of my sacred tent and give them to a priest. 15The priest will offer one of the birds as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me, then I will consider the man completely clean.
16Any man who has a flow of semen must take a bath, but he still remains unclean until evening. 17If the semen touches anything made of cloth or leather, these must be washed, but they still remain unclean until evening. 18After having sex, both the man and the woman must take a bath, but they still remain unclean until evening.
19When a woman has her monthly period, she remains unclean for seven days, and if you touch her, you must take a bath, but you remain unclean until evening. 20-23Anything that she rests on or sits on is also unclean, and if you touch either of these, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening. 24Any man who has sex with her during this time becomes unclean for seven days, and anything he rests on is also unclean.
25Any woman who has a flow of blood outside her regular monthly period is unclean until it stops, just as she is during her monthly period. 26Anything that she rests on or sits on during this time is also unclean, just as it would be during her period. 27If you touch either of these, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
28Seven days after the woman gets well, she will be considered clean. 29On the eighth day, she must bring either two doves or two pigeons to the front of my sacred tent and give them to a priest. 30He will offer one of the birds as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me; then I will consider the woman completely clean.
31When any of you are unclean, you must stay away from the rest of the community of Israel. Otherwise, my sacred tent will become unclean, and the whole nation will die.
32-33These are the things you men must do if you become unclean because of an infected penis or if you have a flow of semen. And these are the things you women must do when you become unclean either because of your monthly period or an unusual flow of blood. This is also what you men must do if you have sex with a woman who is unclean.
translation_text:
Ɔda Bubo Si Ntu Buuwi Ukyuli Lɛlɔ Lɛlɔ
1Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ku Aaron ɔnini, 2“Bɛkɔ lɛsa na bɛsu Israelƒuɔ bɛnini, ‘Si ɔlɛ ntu udu ɔdi ɔɔlɛ́ ɔnana kanɔkɔ ni, ntu bɔmmɔ buusé lɛlɔ. 3Na si bɔɔyu ƒui iye bɔɔyu teekulo muedi ni, ɔ́ya na ukyuli ɔmmɔ uuuse sɛɛn.
4“ ‘Atɛla biala lɛlɔ na ɔnana ɔni ntu buuwi-nwu mmɔ watɛ adubuse lɛlɔ na lɛla biala lɛlɔ na ɔnana ɔmmɔ wayu welie lɛnɔ lɛdubuse lɛlɔ. 5Na ukyuli biala metuku ɔnana ɔmmɔ atɛla ɔlɛka ɔƒɔ nwuna adala na ɔkpi ntu na ɔmu ɔdubuse lɛlɔ utédu useyi uwi. 6Na ukyuli biala mayu melie lɛla biala lɛni lɛlɔ na ɔnana ɔmmɔ ɔ́yu úlie ni, ɔlɛka ɔƒɔ nwuna adala na ɔkpi, nsu ɔmu ɔdubuse lɛlɔ utédu useyi uwi.
7“ ‘Na ukyuli biala metuku ukyuli ɔni ntu bɔɔlɛ́-nwu lɛlɔ mmɔ ɔlɛka ɔƒɔ nwuna adala na ɔkpi, na ɔmu ɔdubuse lɛlɔ utédu useyi uwi.
8“ ‘Na si ukyuli ɔni ntu bɔɔlɛ́-nwu lɛlɔ mmɔ útuo lisuo úwi ukyuli ɔni nse sɛɛn ni, ukyuli ɔmmɔ ɔlɛka ɔƒɔ nwuna adala na ɔkpi na ɔmu ɔdubuse lɛlɔ utédu useyi uwi.
9“ ‘Na lɛla biala lɛlɔ ukyuli ɔmmɔ welie na ɔpɔnkɔ lɛlɔ lɛdubuse lɛlɔ. 10Na ukyuli biala metuku ala ani nkya kesii kani na úlie mmɔ kalɔ ɔdi ɔdubuse lɛlɔ utédu useyi uwi. Na si ukyuli ɔdi úti ala ani lɛlɔ na úlie mmɔ adi ɔlɛka ɔƒɔ nwuna adala na ɔkpi na ɔdubuse lɛlɔ utédu useyi uwi.
11“ ‘Ukyuli biala na ɔnana ɔni ntu bɔɔlɛ́-nwu lɛlɔ mmɔ wetuku na útaƒɔ kɔnu asa na utuku-nwu ɔlɛka ɔƒɔ nwuna adala na ɔkpi na ɔmu ɔdubuse lɛlɔ utédu useyi uwi.
12“ ‘Na ketubui kani na ɔnana ɔni ntu bɔɔlɛ́-nwu lɛlɔ wetuku ɔlɛka babwɛ-ka. Na ugyii lɛla ani bɔƒɔ na ɔlɛka baƒɔ-ni kaduɛ.
13“ ‘Si ɔlɛ ɔmmɔ ɔ́ba ɔnana ɔmmɔ ni, ɔka emeyi maatɛ ɔtɔ anumi asa na lɛlɔ bɔbla sɛɛn ɔdi limeyi lɛmmɔ lidu. Na ɔlɛka ɔƒɔ nwuna adala na ɔkpi ntu bɔni bédu ɔwɔdi na ɔdubɔbla sɛɛn. 14Na limeyi maanedi lɛlɔ ɔdubɔwia babloduma iye bamangbɛ inyɔ na uti usieku Unwoti anumi na Unwoti Adi Kevo mmɔ utéte ɔkpane. 15Na ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔdubuti baasɛ bammɔ akɔ unwi ɔbla likpidi bɔkyiɛ akpala na uti ɔkladi ɔbla akpala bɔkyula. Lɛni na ɔdubɔbla na udie Unwoti udie bɔƒiɔ biala na ukyuli ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ.
16“ ‘Si lɛlɔ líbo ɔnana ɔdi ni, ɔlɛka ɔkpi na ɔmu ɔdubuse lɛlɔ utédu useyi uwi asa na ɔbla sɛɛn. 17Na si kɔdi iye ebuo ɔku biala na ntu bɔmmɔ búwi ɔlɛka ɔƒɔ ala ammɔ na amu adubuse lɛlɔ etédu useyi uwi. 18Na si ɔnana ɔdi ku ulekudi bátɛ ni, ɔlɛka bana inyɔ ƒui bakpi na bamu badubuse lɛlɔ utédu useyi uwi.
19“ ‘Na si uleku ɔ́lɛ ɔtɔ ni, emeyi maatɛ kemmo ƒui na uuuse sɛɛn. Na ukyuli biala metuku-nwu lɛnɔ uuuse sɛɛn na ɔɔɔdubo buse sɛɛn wetédu useyi uwi.
20“ ‘Na lɛla biala lɛlɔ na welie iye watɛ na nwuna ɔtɔ bɔlɛ uwi lɛdubuse lɛlɔ. 21Na ukyuli biala metuku uleku ɔmmɔ lɛla lɛdi na nwuna katɛnkɔ ɔlɛka ɔkpi na ɔƒɔ nwuna adala na useyi uwi asa na ɔdubɔbla sɛɛn. 22Na ukyuli biala metuku lɛla biala lɛlɔ na welie ɔlɛka ɔƒɔ nwuna adala na ɔkpi na useyi uwi asa na ɔdubɔbla sɛɛn. 23Nwuna atɛla na adi o-o, kesi kesii na úlie na ɔdi útuku ala ammɔ o-o ni, ukyuli ɔmmɔ ɔdubuse lɛlɔ utédu useyi uwi.
24“ ‘Si uleku ɔ́lɛ ɔtɔ na anwu ku ɔnana ɔdi bátɛ na uleku ɔmmɔ ɔtɔ bɔlɛ bútuku ɔnana ɔmmɔ ni, ɔnana ɔmmɔ ɔdubuse lɛlɔ emeyi maatɛ. Na atɛla biala lɛlɔ watɛ lɛnɔ adubuse lɛlɔ.
25“ ‘Si uleku ɔtɔ bɔlɛ butulo kalɛ na ɔɔyɔ́ bɔlɛ ni, iye uwi bamba ɔdi kemmo na ubugya uuwi-nwu ni, ɔdubuse lɛlɔ aani kalɛ kani na si ɔ́lɛ ɔtɔ na uusé lɛlɔ emeyi bumomo bɔni na ubugya ɔmmɔ uuwi-nwu. 26Na atɛla biala lɛlɔ watɛ iye lɛla biala lɛlɔ welie na nwuna ubugya buwi bɔmmɔ kemmo ni, adubuse lɛlɔ aani kalɛ kani na si ɔ́lɛ ɔtɔ na ala ammɔ eesé lɛlɔ. 27Na ukyuli biala meti kɔnu metuku ala ammɔ adi ɔdubuse lɛlɔ. Na ɔlɛka ɔƒɔ nwuna adala na ɔkpi na ɔmu ɔdubuse lɛlɔ utédu useyi uwi.
28“ ‘Na uleku ɔni na ubugya uuwi mmɔ si nwuna ɔlɛ ɔ́ba-nwu ni, ɔlɛka ɔka emeyi maatɛ ɔsiku uwi ɔni na ubugya ɔmmɔ ukulo na ɔmmɔ kama ɔdubɔbla sɛɛn. 29Na limeyi maanedi lɛlɔ ɔlɛka ɔwia babloduma iye bamangbɛ inyɔ na uti-ma usienku ɔkpane na Unwoti Adi Kevo anumi. 30Na ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔdubuti baasɛ bammɔ unwi ɔbla likpidi lili buvele akpala na uti ɔkladi ɔbla akpala bɔkyula. Na lɛni na ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔbla akpala ammɔ na Unwoti udie kɔtu bɔni biala na uleku ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ.
31“ ‘Ɔdi ka aya na Israelƒuɔ bada lɛlɔ bedie ala ani muusé lɛlɔ kudɔ kalɛ na beléteese lɛlɔ na bekpi na ɔmmɔ ɔsu ka badubɔya na mina keliekɔ kani nkya-ma akɔ keteese lɛlɔ ɔsu.’ ”
32Ɔda bubo bɔmɛni ndanku ɔnana ɔni na ntu bɔdi bɔɔyu-nwu lɛlɔ iye lɛlɔ líbo-nwu na ɔ́ya na uusé lɛlɔ, 33ku uleku ɔni nálɛ ɔtɔ iye ɔnana ku uleku ɔni na ntu bɔdi buuwi-ma iye ɔnana ɔni na anwu ku uleku ɔni nálɛ ɔtɔ na uusé lɛlɔ bátɛnku lɛlɔ.

english_text:
The Great Day of Forgiveness
1-2 Two of Aaron's sons had already lost their lives for disobeying the Lord, so the Lord told Moses to say to Aaron:
I, the Lord, appear in a cloud over the place of mercy on the sacred chest, which is behind the inside curtain of the sacred tent. And I warn you not to go there except at the proper time. Otherwise, you will die!
3 Before entering this most holy place, you must offer a bull as a sacrifice for your sins and a ram as a sacrifice to please me. 4You will take a bath and put on the sacred linen clothes, including the underwear, the robe, the sash, and the turban. 5Then the community of Israel will bring you a ram and two goats, both of them males. The goats are to be used as sacrifices for sin, and the ram is to be used as a sacrifice to please me.
6Aaron, you must offer the bull as a sacrifice of forgiveness for your own sins and for the sins of your family. 7Then you will lead the two goats into my presence at the front of the sacred tent, 8where I will show you which goat will be sacrificed to me and which one will be sent into the desert to the demon Azazel. 9After you offer the first goat as a sacrifice for sin, 10the other one must be presented to me alive, before you send it into the desert to take away the sins of the people.
11You must offer the bull as a sacrifice to ask forgiveness for your own sins and for the sins of your family. 12Then you will take a fire pan of live coals from the bronze altar, together with two handfuls of finely ground incense, into the most holy place. 13There you will present them to me by placing the incense on the coals, so that the place of mercy will be covered with a cloud of smoke. Do this, or you will die right there! 14Next, use a finger to sprinkle some of the blood on the place of mercy, which is on the lid of the sacred chest; then sprinkle blood seven times in front of the chest.
15 Aaron, you must next sacrifice the goat for the sins of the people, and you must sprinkle its blood inside the most holy place, just as you did with the blood of the bull. 16By doing this, you will take away the sins that make both the most holy place and the people of Israel unclean. Do the same for the sacred tent, which is here among the people. 17Only you are allowed in the sacred tent from the time you enter until the time you come out. 18After leaving the tent, you will purify the bronze altar by smearing each of its four corners with some of the blood from the bull and from the goat. 19Use a finger to sprinkle the altar seven times with the blood, and it will be completely clean from the sins of the people.
20After you have purified the most holy place, the sacred tent, and the bronze altar, you must bring the live goat to the front of the tent. 21 There you will lay your hands on its head, while confessing every sin the people have committed, and you will appoint someone to lead the goat into the desert, so that it can take away their sins. 22Finally, this goat that carries the heavy burden of Israel's sins must be released deep in the desert.
23-24 Aaron, after this you must go inside the sacred tent, take a bath, put on your regular priestly clothes, and leave there the clothes you put on before entering the most holy place. Then you will come out and offer sacrifices to please me and sacrifices for your sins and for the sins of the people. 25The fat from these sacrifices for sin must be sent up in smoke on the bronze altar.
26The one who led the goat into the desert and sent it off to the demon Azazel must take a bath and wash his clothes before coming back into camp. 27 The remains of the bull and the goat whose blood was taken into the most holy place must be taken outside the camp and burned. 28And whoever does this must take a bath and change clothes before coming back into camp.
The Lord told Moses to say to the people:
29 On the tenth day of the seventh month of each year, you must go without eating to show sorrow for your sins, and no one, including foreigners who live among you, is allowed to work. 30This is the day on which the sacrifice for the forgiveness of your sins will be made in my presence, 31and from now on, it must be celebrated each year. Go without eating and make this a day of complete rest just like the Sabbath. 32The high priest must offer the sacrifices for cleansing from sin, while wearing the sacred linen clothes. 33He will offer these sacrifices for the most holy place, the sacred tent, the bronze altar, all the priests, and for the whole community. 34You must celebrate this day each year—it is the Great Day of Forgiveness for all the sins of the people of Israel.
Moses did exactly as the Lord had commanded.
translation_text:
Likpidi Kɔtu Bɔni Budie Limeyi Buni
1Na Aaron bebi bananabi inyɔ bani nékpi na kakpakɔ mmɔ ka bátabla Unwoti lɛyɔla kukpi kama ni, Unwoti ɔ́tɛmi úte Mose. 2Ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Ya na ƒ'ɔnwani Aaron ɔti anii utata kalɛ kalɛ uwi ɔni na ɔɔyɔ́ na ubalɛ-mi lɛlɔ na Katɔma Kedee kemmo kesii kani na likpidi kɔtu bɔni budie libila libi Bunyimi Adaka lɛlɔ na kakpakɔ bule kɔdi kɔmmɔ kama, si ɔɔɔdi lɛni ɔdubo bukpi, ɔsika ami Unwoti mɔɔdá taalɛ libila lɛmmɔ katɔ na liƒlukutu kemmo.
3“Ulu ɔni lɛlɔ na ɔdubɔsia uduo Unwoti Adi Kevo kammɔ kaduli ndi ɔmɛni, si úsela ni, ɔlɛka uti ɔmantɛ akɔ ɔgyani ɔkɔdi ku koƒonu kɔgyani na uti akɔ ɔmmɔ ɔbla likpidi lili buvele akpala, na uti koƒonu kɔgyani kɔmmɔ ɔbla akpala bɔkyula ƒui ɔdi. 4Ɔdi ka ɔkya nwuna awu kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ gyɔlɔɔ ɔmmɔ ɔsia awuku kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ ani na ɔdubɔkya use kalɔ na ama-nwu ɔlɔna lɛlɔ mmɔ lɛlɔ. Na ɔkya awu ɔtɔdi akɔnkɔ bune ɔmmɔ ɔsia-nwu lɛlɔ, na uti kavobi lɛduni kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ lɛmmɔ ɔbala kavobi, na uti dukuu kabwa kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ kammɔ ubi. Lɛwu lɛmɛni lɛdi lɛwu kedee, anwuɔsu ɔlɛka ɔkpi ntu asa na ɔkya-ni. 5Na ɔƒɔ betukpa inyɔ ku koƒonu kɔgyani kunwi ɔsiku Israelƒuɔ bammɔ kudɔ. Na uti betukpa inyɔ bammɔ ɔbla likpidi lili buvele akpala na uti ɔmantɛ akɔ ɔmmɔ ɔbla bɔkyula akpala.
6“Aaron ɔdubuti akɔ ɔmmɔ ɔbla nwuna likpidi lili buvele akpala na Unwoti udie likpidi kɔtu bɔni biala na anwu ku nwuna kaduli bekyuli lɛlɔ. 7Na uti betukpa inyɔ bammɔ uboku Unwoti na Kevo Kasakɔ kayakun. 8Na ɔdubɔtu egulabi ɔnu na betukpa bammɔ lɛlɔ na ɔnu lɛni ndi Unwoti ɔdi ku ɔni ndi bukeli ketukpa lɛdi. 9Na ketukpa kani na Unwoti ligulabi lɛ́tina ni, Aaron ɔdubɔdu-ka ɔbla likpidi lili buvele akpala. 10Na bukeli ketukpa kani na ligulabi linyɔdi lɛ́tina ni, badubuti-ka beboku Unwoti anumi ngba ngba na babla likpidi kɔtu bɔni budie ɔdi na bekyuli bammɔ ƒui lɛlɔ na babɔku-ka na ukeli usie ketele kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo aani bukeli ketukpa.
11“Ɔmmɔ kama Aaron ɔdububoku ɔmantɛ akɔ ɔni nnye ute nwuna ekpidi na ɔdubuti ɔbla likpidi kɔtu bɔni budie akpala na anwu ku nwuna kaduli bekyuli lili. Na ɔdubɔdu ebuo ɔmmɔ ute anwu ɔlati ekpidi bɔkyiɛ akpala. 12Ɔmmɔ kama ɔdubuti oloƒui bɔkyula libui lɛni na ɔdubuyile ku agyabi bɔsiku Unwoti lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ku oloƒui ɔni bákɔ kaduɛ akɔkɔ anyɔ na uti uduoku kakpakɔ bule kɔdi kɔmmɔ kama. 13Na uti oloƒui ɔmmɔ uwi ogya ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ na Unwoti anumi mmɔ na uyɔ ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔƒɔ likpidi kɔtu bɔni budie libila lɛni na Bunyimi Adaka ɔmmɔ katɔ mmɔ ƒui suu na ɔbɛla libila lɛmmɔ kalɛ na ulekpi. 14Na ɔdubuti akɔ ɔni na ɔ́du mmɔ ubugya ɔdi na uti nwuna lɛnimi ɔkya ubugya ɔmmɔ kemmo na ɔkuna ubugya ɔmmɔ ɔdi uwi likpidi kɔtu bɔni budie libila lɛmmɔ anumi. Na ɔmmɔ kama ɔsɔ uti lɛnimi ɔkya ubugya ɔmmɔ kemmo na ɔkuna ubugya ɔmmɔ libila lɛmmɔ lɛtɔtɔ maatɛ.
15“Ɔmmɔ kama ni, ɔdubɔlɛ utádu likpidi lili buvele akpala ketukpa kammɔ na Israelƒuɔ lili, na uti ebuo ɔmmɔ ubugya uduoku kakpakɔ bule kɔdi kɔmmɔ kama na ɔblaku-nwu kalɛ kani na ɔ́blaku ebuo udeedi ubugya. Ɔdubɔkuna ubugya ɔmmɔ ɔdi uwi libila lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ku nina anumi. 16Lɛni na ɔdubɔbla na udie likpidi kɔtu bɔni bɔni nkɛnku Katɔma Kedee kammɔ lɛlɔ ala bɔbla na Israelƒuɔ ala ani muusé lɛlɔ bɔbla ku kalɛ na bénwini kama bákya Unwoti ɔsu ina bi ekpidi na bábla. Lɛni kani na ɔdubɔbla ute Kasakɔ Kevo kani nkya-ma ntɛ na bana ɔbladu ɔni muusé lɛlɔ mmɔ ɔsu. 17Uwi ɔni na Aaron úduo Katɔma Kedee kammɔ kemmo utábla likpidi kɔtu bɔni budie ɔdi ɔmmɔ ni, utalɛka ukyuli ɔdi ɔkya Kasakɔ Kevo kammɔ kemmo útédu ka ɔ́wɔlɔ ɔdi ɔmmɔ bɔbla na anwu ɔlati ku nwuna kaduli bekyuli ku Israel kadi bekyuli ƒui lili na ɔ́vi ɔ́lɛ mmɔ.
18“Ɔmmɔ kama ɔdubɔlɛ ubo Unwoti lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ kudɔ na uti akɔ ɔmmɔ ubugya ku ketukpa kammɔ ubugya ɔdi ususu bebuo ese ani nlɛ lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ƒui na ɔbla-ni ɔdi ɔmmɔ kalɛ kani na ɔ́bla Kevo kammɔ. 19Na uti nwuna lɛnimi ɔkya ubugya ɔmmɔ kemmo na ɔkuna-nwu uwi lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ maatɛ na ɔbla-ni sɛsɛɛ ɔsiku Israelƒuɔ ala ani muusé lɛlɔ bɔbla kudɔ.
20“Si Aaron ɔ́wɔlɔ sɛɛn bɔbla akpala ɔdi ɔmmɔ bɔbla bute Katɔma Kedee kammɔ ku Kevo Kasakɔ kammɔ ku lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ ni, mmɔ na ɔdubuti ketukpa kani ku ngba mmɔ uboku. 21Na ɔdubuti nwuna enu anyɔ ɔsia ese ɔmmɔ kuli na ɔka Israelƒuɔ ekpidi lidu lidu udie ɔsu na bana ulikplu ala bɔbla ku kalɛ na baalɛ́ bana Unwoti kama ku bana ekpidi lidu bamba lɛni ƒui na baabla. Na ekpidi ammɔ ƒui adubɔsia ese ɔmmɔ kuli. Na ɔkɛnku ukyuli ɔni na báalɛ lɛnimi bése lɛlɔ ni, na ɔbɔku ese ɔmmɔ utákya alakpi akɔ na ketele kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo. 22Na ese ɔmmɔ ndubuti Israelƒuɔ bammɔ ekpidi ƒui utákya ketele kemmo kesii kani na ukyuli ɔmmɔ úsela utányonu-nwu ɔkya na ukyuli ɔdi uuubo mmɔ.
23“Ɔmmɔ kama na Aaron uduo Kevo Kasakɔ mmɔ na udie nwuna lɛwu gyɔlɔɔ lɛni na ɔ́kya úduoku Katɔma Kedee kemmo mmɔ use mmɔ. 24Na ɔdubusie kesii kani na kese sɛsɛɛ na utákpi ntu na uti nwuna lɛkpa adala geen ɔkya na ɔlɛ ubo ubabla akpala bɔkyula ƒui ute ɛlɔ ku Israel kadi bekyuli ƒui na Unwoti udie likpidi kɔtu bɔni biala na bana lɛlɔ. 25Na ɔkyula lɛmwi lɛmmɔ ƒui lɛnɔ na lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ aani likpidi lili buvele akpala.
26“Na ɔnana ɔni ndubutiku bukeli ketukpa kammɔ utákya alakpi akɔ na ketele kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo mmɔ lɛnɔ ɔlɛka ɔƒɔ nwuna adala ƒui na ɔkpi ntu asa na ɔsɔ unwini utéduo bana keliekɔ mmɔ. 27Na ɔmantɛ akɔ ku ese ɔni ndi likpidi lili buvele akpala bebuo bani ubugya na béti béduoku Katɔma Kedee kemmo mmɔ, na bátábla likpidi kɔtu bɔni budie akpala mmɔ ni, ɔlɛka balɛku-ma bana keliekɔ mmɔ batákyula ƒui na bana kakyakɔ kama ku bana lɛku ku lɛna lɛmmɔ ku ala ani na béwilimi-ma nƒɔ kemmo ƒui. 28Na ukyuli ɔni makyula bebuo bammɔ ɔdubɔƒɔ nwuna lɛwu na ɔkpi ntu asa na unwini usie bana keliekɔ.
29“Na bunyimi bɔni lɛlɔ na bɛdubo butaadi ɔ́si ɔƒɛni úsela uwi ƒui ndi ka kɔbuli maatɛdi limeyi leevudi biala lɛlɔ ni, ɔlɛka bikisi lɛlɔ na bilie kɔka na bilabla kabla kadi amii ku kadi bamba bekyuli bani nkya-mii akɔ na limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ. 30Ɔsika limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ na badubo likpidi kɔtu bɔni budie ɔdi bɔbla na bina lɛlɔ na bɛbla sɛɛn bɛsiku bina ekpidi ƒui kudɔ. 31Na limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛdi lɛnwunameyi lite-mii na ɔdi ka bikisi lɛlɔ na bilie kɔka. Na ɔmɛni ɔdi bunyimi bɔni ndubunye bute uwi ƒui. 32Ɔkpane ɔni báƒuna na béwi-nwu lili nnɔmii bése-nwu likpo ka unye ɔti kabla kenye aani ɔkpane unengudi kalɛ ndubo likpidi kɔtu bɔni budie ɔdi ɔmɛni bɔbla na ɔlɛka ɔkya ɔkpane lɛwu gyɔlɔɔ kedee lɛmmɔ 33asa na ɔbla ɔdi ɔmmɔ ɔkɛnku Katɔma Kedee kammɔ ku Kasakɔ Kevo kammɔ ku lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ablala kalɛ na lɛla biala lise sɛɛn ku bakpane bammɔ ku Israel kadi bekyuli ƒui.
34“Na bunyimi bɔmɛni bɔdubuse bute-mii uwi ƒui. Na ɔlɛka babla likpidi kɔtu bɔni budie akpala ɔdi ɔmɛni kunwi na lɛkwa kemmo ute Israelƒuɔ ƒui ekpidi lili.”
Na bábla básia kalɛ kani na Unwoti úbo Mose ɔda.

english_text:
Where To Offer Sacrifices
1The Lord told Moses 2to tell Aaron, his sons, and everyone else in Israel:
3-4Whenever you kill any of your cattle, sheep, or goats as sacrifices to me, you must do it at the entrance to the sacred tent. If you don't, you will be guilty of pouring out blood, and you will no longer belong to the community of Israel. 5And so, when you sacrifice an animal to ask my blessing, it must not be done out in a field, 6but in front of the sacred tent. Then a priest can splatter its blood against the bronze altar and send its fat up in smoke with a smell that pleases me. 7Don't ever turn from me again and offer sacrifices to goat-demons. This law will never change.
8Remember! No one in Israel, including foreigners, is to offer a sacrifice anywhere 9except at the entrance to the sacred tent. If you do, you will no longer belong to my people.
Do Not Eat Blood
The Lord said:
10 I will turn against any of my people who eat blood. This also includes any foreigners living among you. 11 Life is in the blood, and I have given you the blood of animals to sacrifice in place of your own. 12That's also why I have forbidden you to eat blood. 13Even if you should hunt and kill a bird or an animal, you must drain out the blood and cover it with soil.
14The life of every living creature is in its blood. That's why I have forbidden you to eat blood and why I have warned you that anyone who does will no longer belong to my people.
15If you happen to find a dead animal and eat it, you must take a bath and wash your clothes, but you are still unclean until evening. 16If you don't take a bath, you will suffer for what you did wrong.
translation_text:
Ubugya Kalɔ Buwi
1Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini 2“Tasu Aaron ku nwuna bebi bananabi ku Israelƒuɔ bananabi ƒui anini, ‘Lɛni na Unwoti uubó-mii ɔda ka 3ɔnana biala na ɔ́si Israel kaba kemmo ɔni madu ɔmantɛ akɔ iye koƒonu ubi iye ese ɔdi na kaduli kemmo iye bina kakyakɔ kama 4na úteboku-nwu Unwoti anumi na Kasakɔ Kevo mmɔ ni, ukyuli ɔmmɔ úwi ubugya kalɔ. Na ɔkɛnku ɔmmɔ ɔsu ɔlɛka bedie-nwu lɛti basiku mina bekyuli akɔ. 5Na lɛla lɛni na ɔmɛni ɔdanku ndi ka akpala ani na Israelƒuɔ bátaabla na kesi kesii ni, beti-nya beboku ɔkpane na Unwoti anumi ɔƒɛni amu na Kevo Kasakɔ kayakun kenye na beti babla unwi bɔbla akpala. 6Na ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔkuna ubugya ɔmmɔ uwi Unwoti lɛkpabi lɛni nlɛ Kevo Kasakɔ kayakun kenye mmɔ lɛlɔ na ɔkyula lɛmwi lɛmmɔ na uyɔ ɔmmɔ ɔnyi ƒɛƒɛɛ ɔyɔ-mi kaƒɔ. 7Na básɔ batabla akpala adi betete bese udu baƒiɔ bani na bakɛ basiaku aani kalɛ na bayalɛ baabla. Na ɔda bubo bɔmɛni buse bute amii ku bina kaba ɔ́si ɔƒɛni úsela uwi ƒui.’
8“Na bɛsu Israelƒuɔ ku kadi bamba bekyuli bani nli-mii akɔ ka si ɔdi ɔ́sɔ ɔ́bla akpala bɔkyula adi iye úti etela adi úsienku kesii bamba kadi 9na úteti akpala ammɔ úteboku Kevo Kasakɔ kayakun kenye mɛni na mina anumi ni, badubɔda ukyuli ɔmmɔ bedie mina bekyuli akɔ.
10“ ‘Ɔƒɛni lɛnɔ ukyuli biala na ɔ́si Israel kaba kemmo iye ɔƒɔ ɔni nli-mii akɔ na ɔdi ɔ́di ubugya ni, ndubuti mina lɛnimi lɛlɛ ukyuli ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ na lɛda-nwu lidie mina bekyuli akɔ. 11Ɔsika lɛla lidiedi biala ngba ndi nwuna ubugya, na líti ubugya ɔmmɔ líte-mii ka biti bidie likpidi kɔtu bɔni biala na bina ekpidi lili. Na ubugya ndi lɛla lɛni muudie likpidi kayu na ukyuli lɛlɔ. 12Anwuɔsu na lɛ́su Israelƒuɔ ku baƒɔ bani nkya-mii akɔ ka ɔdi biala utadi ubugya.
13“ ‘Anwuɔsu si Israelni ɔdi iye ɔƒɔ ɔni ɔkya-mii akɔ ɔdi úsie kabuikɔ na útádu ebuo iye aasɛ ɔdi ka bakun-nwu ni, ukulo-nwu ɔkwɛ na ubugya ɔmmɔ uwi kalɔ na uku lɛti ubi ubugya ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ, 14ɔsika lɛla lidiedi biala ngba ndi nwuna ubugya. Ɔmɛni ɔsu na lɛ́su Israelƒuɔ nnini, “Bina akɔ ɔdi utadi lɛla lidiedi biala ubugya, ɔsika lɛla lidiedi biala ngba ndi nwuna ubugya. Na ukyuli biala madi ubugya ɔmmɔ ni, ɔlɛka bidie-nwu bina akɔ.”
15“ ‘Na si ukyuli ɔdi ɔ́kun ebuo ukpine lɛna iye ɔ́kun lɛna lɛni na eƒiebuo bamba náduli-nwu kɔkɛ kɔkɛ ɔ́va na ɔdi Israelni iye ɔƒɔ ni, ɔlɛka ɔƒɔ nwuna adala na ɔkpi ntu na ulie utédu useyi uwi asa na nwuna lɛlɔ lɛdubɔbla sɛɛn. 16Nsu si úni na útaƒɔ nwuna adala na útakpi ntu ni, anwu ɔlati nwuna etila na adi.’ ”

english_text:
Forbidden Sex
1The Lord told Moses 2to tell the people of Israel:
I am the Lord your God! 3So don't follow the customs of Egypt where you used to live or those of Canaan where I am bringing you. 4I am the Lord your God, and you must obey my teachings. 5 Obey them and you will live. I am the Lord.
6Don't have sex with any of your close relatives, 7especially your own mother. This would disgrace your father. 8 And don't disgrace him by having sex with any of his other wives. 9 Don't have sex with your sister or stepsister, whether you grew up together or not. 10Don't disgrace yourself by having sex with your granddaughter 11or half sister 12-13 or a sister of your father or mother. 14Don't disgrace your uncle by having sex with his wife. 15 Don't have sex with your daughter-in-law 16 or sister-in-law. 17 And don't have sex with the daughter or granddaughter of any woman that you have earlier had sex with. You will be having sex with her closest relatives, and that would make you unclean. 18As long as your wife is alive, don't cause trouble for her by taking one of her sisters as a second wife.
19 When a woman is having her monthly period, she is unclean, so don't have sex with her.
20 Don't have sex with another man's wife—that would make you unclean.
21 Don't sacrifice your children on the altar fires to the god Molech. I am the Lord your God, and that would disgrace me.
22 It is disgusting for a man to have sex with another man.
23 Anyone who has sex with an animal is unclean.
24Don't make yourselves unclean by any of these disgusting practices of those nations that I am forcing out of the land for you. They made themselves 25and the land so unclean, that I punished the land because of their sins, and I made it vomit them up. 26-27Now don't do these sickening things that make the land filthy. Instead, obey my laws and teachings. 28Then the land won't become sick of you and vomit you up, just as it did them. 29-30If any of you do these vulgar, disgusting things, you will be unclean and no longer belong to my people. I am the Lord your God, and I forbid you to follow their sickening way of life.
translation_text:
Ɔda Bubo Na Ɔnana Ku Uleku Bɔtɛ Lɛlɔ
1Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, 2“Kɔ lɛsa te Israelƒuɔ na ásu-ma anini, ‘Ami ndi Unwoti bina Katɔti. 3Ɔdi biala ɔda udu na bitabla likyulikpi ala ani udu na baabla na Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ uwi ɔni bɛ́kya mmɔ na bɛ́nu. Na bitabla likyulikpi ala ani na baabla na Kanaan kalɔ kani lɛlɔ na bísela bitélie mmɔ. Na ɔdi lɛnɔ utasiaku bana ɔbladu kama. 4Ɔlɛka bɛsia mina bunyimi ƒui anu na bɛdi mina ɔda bubo ƒui lɛlɔ. Ami ndi Unwoti bina Katɔti. 5Bɛsia mina bunyimi ƒui anu kaduɛ na bɛdi mina ɔda bubo lɛlɔ, ɔsika ukyuli biala ɔni mɔɔdi ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, ɔda bubo ulu ɔmmɔ ɔdubute-nwu ngba. Ami ndi Unwoti.
6“ ‘Ukyuli ɔdi ku uleku ɔni na bede na kɔnwa kemmo batatɛnku lɛlɔ. Ami ndi Unwoti.
7“ ‘Tedie ɔbu na ƒ'ɔti lɛlɔ na awɔ ku ƒ'ini bitaatɛnku lɛlɔ. Ƒ'ini na ɔdi, awɔ ku-nwu bitasala lɛlɔ ɔnana ku uleku.
8“ ‘Tatɛnku ƒ'ɔti ulekudi ɔdi, ɔmmɔ ɔdubudie ɔbu na nwuna lɛlɔ.
9“ ‘Útalɛka ukyuli ɔdi ku ɔnwani ulekubi bani nási bawɔne benwi kudɔ batɛ ina kaduli mmɔ na báwɔ-nwu iye kesii bamba.
10“ ‘Útalɛka ukyuli ɔdi ku nwuna uwɔ batɛ, ɔsika kɔƒa na kɔdi-ɔ.
11“ ‘Útalɛka ukyuli ɔdi ku ɔti ulekudi ubidi ulekubi batɛ, ɔsika ƒula ɔnwani na ɔdi.
12“ ‘Útalɛka ukyuli ɔdi ku ɔti ɔnwani ulekubi batɛ, ɔsika ƒula ɔti ɔnwani geen na ɔdi.
13“ ‘Útalɛka ukyuli ɔdi ku uni ɔnwani batɛ, ɔsika ƒula uni kani na ɔdi.
14“ ‘Tedie ɔbu na ƒ'ɔti ɔnwani ɔnanabi lɛlɔ na awɔ ku ulekudi bɛtɛ, ɔsika úlieku ƒ'ɔti ulekudi kani na ɔdi.
15“ ‘Útalɛka ukyuli ɔdi ku nwuna ubi ule batɛ, ɔsika ƒula ubidi ɔnanabi ulekudi na ɔdi.
16“ ‘Útalɛka ukyuli ɔdi ku ɔnwani ulekudi batɛ, ɔsika adubudie ɔbu ƒ'ɔnwani lɛlɔ.
17“ ‘Útalɛka ukyuli ɔdi ɔtɛnku ubi ku uni iye ɔtɛnku uleku ɔmmɔ uwɔ ulekubi ɔdi, ɔsika nwuna lɛlɔ bekyuli geen na badi. Na ɔmmɔ ɔdi likyulikpi ala bɔbla.
18“ ‘Útalɛka ukyuli ɔdi uti ulekudi ɔnwani ulekubi na ɔtɛnku-nwu na benwini bagyulo uwi ɔni na ɔnwani udeedi ɔni na uti mmɔ uli ngba.
19“ ‘Útalɛka ukyuli ɔdi ku uleku ɔni náƒɛ kɔnu batɛ uwi ɔni na ubugya ɔmmɔ útekulo tɔ na uuuse sɛɛn mmɔ.
20“ ‘Útalɛka ukyuli ɔdi ɔtɛnku nwuna ukyulikpana ulekudi na ubile lɛlɔ na ɔmmɔ ɔsu.
21“ ‘Útalɛka ukyuli ɔdi uti ubidi iye uwɔ ute na beti bakpa bete Molek baƒiɔ na ɔya na balabu Katɔti lɛnyi na liteese lɛlɔ, ɔsika ami ndi Unwoti.
22“ ‘Útalɛka ɔnana ku ɔnana batɛ aani kalɛ na uleku ku ɔnana baatɛ. Ɔmɛni ɔdi lɛla lɛni muusé Unwoti lɛlɔ.
23“ ‘Útalɛka ukyuli ɔdi ku ebuo batɛ na ɔya na nwuna lɛlɔ liteese lɛlɔ. Na útalɛka uleku ɔnyonu lɛlɔ ute ebuo na ɔtɛnku-nwu, ɔsika ɔdi kekuma lɛla lɛni bekisi geen.
24“ ‘Na ɔdi biala utabla ala ani muusé lɛlɔ mɛni udu, ɔsika ana udu na kadi bekyuli bani na ndubo bɔbɔku budie bina anumi bábla bébile lɛlɔ na beesé lɛlɔ. 25Kalɔ kammɔ muedi bébile-ka, anwuɔsu mina lɛtuni líbo-ka lɛlɔ na lɛ́bɔku lɛla biala lídie aani kalɛ na ukyuli ɔɔdala lɛla biala teedie. 26Nsu amii amu ni, bɛdi mina ɔda bubo ku bunyimi ƒui lɛlɔ amii ku baƒɔ bani ƒui nkya-mii akɔ na bitabla ala ani muusé lɛlɔ mɛni udu.
27“ ‘Ala amɛni udu na bekyuli bani nágyu batɔ bélie kalɔ kamɛni kemmo bábla na bébile kalɔ kammɔ na keesé lɛlɔ. 28Anwuɔsu si amii lɛnɔ bíbile kalɔ kammɔ ni, ndubo-mii bɔbɔku budie kalɛ na lɛ́bɔku-ma aani kalɛ na ukyuli ɔɔdala lɛla biala teedie kaƒɔ kemmo.
29“ ‘Na ukyuli ɔni mabla ala ani muusé lɛlɔ mɛni udu ni, ɔlɛka bada-nwu bedie nwuna badi akɔ. 30Ɔmɛni ɔsu bɛnu ka bɛ́di mina litemi lɛlɔ kalɛ na ɔdi ulabla ala ani bekyuli bani nélie mɛni bátaabla na beesé lɛlɔ mmɔ na bitasiaku bana ɔdi ala bɔbla kama na bibile lɛlɔ na biteese lɛlɔ bana kalɛ. Ami ndi Unwoti bina Katɔti.’ ”

english_text:
Moral and Religious Laws
1The Lord told Moses 2 to say to the community of Israel:
I am the Lord your God. I am holy, and you must be holy too! 3-4 Respect your father and your mother, honor the Sabbath, and don't make idols or images. I am the Lord your God.
5When you offer a sacrifice to ask my blessing, be sure to follow my instructions. 6You may eat the meat either on the day of the sacrifice or on the next day, but you must burn anything left over on the third day. 7If you eat any of it on the third day, the sacrifice will be disgusting to me, and I will reject it. 8In fact, you will be punished for not respecting what I say is holy, and you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
9 When you harvest your grain, always leave some of it standing along the edges of your fields and don't pick up what falls on the ground. 10Don't strip your grapevines clean or gather the grapes that fall off the vines. Leave them for the poor and for those foreigners who live among you. I am the Lord your God.
11 Do not steal or tell lies or cheat others.
12 Do not misuse my name by making promises you don't intend to keep. I am the Lord your God.
13 Do not steal anything or cheat anyone, and don't fail to pay your workers at the end of each day.
14 I am the Lord your God, and I command you not to make fun of the deaf or to cause a blind person to stumble.
15 Be fair, no matter who is on trial—don't favor either the poor or the rich.
16Don't be a gossip, but never hesitate to speak up in court, especially if your testimony can save someone's life.
17 Don't hold grudges. On the other hand, it's wrong not to correct someone who needs correcting. 18 Don't be angry or try to take revenge. I am the Lord, and I command you to love others as much as you love yourself.
19 Breed your livestock animals only with animals of the same kind, and don't plant two kinds of seed in the same field or wear clothes made of different kinds of material.
20If a man has sex with a slave woman who is promised in marriage to someone else, he must pay a fine, but they are not to be put to death. After all, she was still a slave at the time. 21-22The man must bring a ram to the entrance of the sacred tent and give it to a priest, who will then offer it as a sacrifice to me, so the man's sins will be forgiven.
23After you enter the land, you will plant fruit trees, but you are not to eat any fruit from them for the first three years. 24In the fourth year the fruit must be set apart, as an expression of thanks 25to me, the Lord God. Do this, and in the fifth year, those trees will produce an abundant harvest of fruit for you to eat.
26 Don't eat the blood of any animal.
Don't practice any kind of witchcraft.
27-28 I forbid you to shave any part of your head or beard or to cut and tattoo yourself as a way of worshiping the dead.
29 Don't let your daughters serve as temple prostitutes—this would bring disgrace both to them and the land.
30 I command you to respect the Sabbath and the place where I am worshiped.
31 Don't make yourselves disgusting to me by going to people who claim they can talk to the dead.
32I command you to show respect for older people and to obey me with fear and trembling.
33 Don't mistreat any foreigners who live in your land. 34Instead, treat them as well as you treat your own people and love them as much as you love yourself. Remember, you were once foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.
35-36 Use honest scales and don't cheat when you weigh or measure anything.
I am the Lord your God. I rescued you from Egypt, 37and I command you to obey my laws.
translation_text:
Ɔda Bubo Na Lɛƒiɔkpa Lɛlɔ
1Unwoti ɔsu Mose ɔnini, 2“Su Israel kadi bekyuli ƒui anini, ‘Bɛbla lɛlɔ kedee, ɔsika ami Unwoti bina Katɔti nse kedee.
3“ ‘Ɔdi biala uti ɔbu ute ɔti ku uni. Na bɛdi mina Lɛnwunameyi lɛlɔ kaduɛ. Ami ndi Unwoti bina Katɔti.
4“ ‘Ɔdi utesie utatákpa baƒiɔ badi iye ɔvɔ baƒiɔ badi use lɛlɔ. Ami ndi Unwoti bina Katɔti.
5“ ‘Na si bina ɔdi ɔɔbla unwi bɔbla akpala ute-mi ni, ɔnu ka akpala ammɔ adubɔyɔ-mi kaƒɔ. 6Bibo kuƒi ka bɛkun lɛna lɛni bíti bɛɛbla akpala ammɔ bite-mi limeyi lɛmmɔ ku kadi kégye. Nsu lɛna lɛni mebu limeyi lɛtɛdi lɛlɔ ni, bɛkyula-ni. 7Si bɛ́kun lɛdi limeyi lɛtɛdi ni, ala ammɔ eeese sɛɛn, anwuɔsu lɛɛɛdubo akpala ammɔ bɔƒɔ bute-mii. 8Na ukyuli ɔni makun lɛna lɛmmɔ ɔdubɔkɛ nwuna kɔtu bɔni. Ɔsika úbile Unwoti lɛla lɛni na ɔ́bla kedee. Na ɔlɛka bedie ukyuli ɔmmɔ udu bina akɔ.
9“ ‘Ɔƒɛni si bísie bina mmo bɛnii bitáƒɛ bina edula ni, bitaƒɛ-nya ƒui kede kede. Mmomu bibu adi bɛkya bina mmo amadɔ iye bitaƒɛ edula wɛlɛ wɛlɛ ani nkya bina mmo mmɔ. 10Ɔdi utasia kama utetéde nwuna adingyii ani na úude úbavi na utala ebi ani nánu ewi kalɔ. Mmomu ɔda-nya uwi bawabane ku baƒɔ. Ami ndi Unwoti bina Katɔti.
11“ ‘Ɔdi uteyu.
“ ‘Na ɔdi utanyi ɔkɔ.
“ ‘Na bitataanyi ɔkɔ taatɔlɔ lɛlɔ.
12“ ‘Ɔdi utakpali-mi lɛnyi keeke na ubile ami bina Katɔti lɛnyi. Ami ndi Unwoti.
13“ ‘Ɔdi utanya nwuna ɔkpana utakya iye uyu-nwu na ulu ɔdi lɛlɔ.
“ ‘Teni ƒula kabla ɔblane nwuna kayu bɔƒɔ na kadi kegye kasia egulabi ammɔ lɛlɔ.
14“ ‘Ɔdi utewida ɔmumu iye eti lɛla lɛdi etile ɔnumbwɛne ulu mmomu bɛyia bina Katɔti. Ami ndi Unwoti.
15“ ‘Bitatɛ litemi likpidi na bɛnya ɔwabane ɔdi bɛkya iye binye ɔlakɛne ɔdi kama mmomu bɛtɛ bina bakpana litemi ulu lɛlɔ.
16“ ‘Bitataalɔ bina bakpana anyikpi taavi.
“ ‘Na ɔdi utabla lɛla lɛni maya na nwuna ɔkpanadi ngba buduo ɔgbankpi kemmo. Ami ndi Unwoti.
17“ ‘Ɔdi uteti ɔnwani litemi utakya kayi kemmo na uteekisi-nwu. Dɔnku ƒula ɔkpana ulu lɛlɔ nwaa kalɛ na nwuna likpidi lɛdi lilasia-a lɛlɔ.
18“ ‘Tedie likpidi kasi iye ukyuli litemi litakya-a kayi kemmo ku kɔnyi. Mmomu yɔ ƒula ukyulikpana aani ƒula kalɛ.
19“ ‘Bɛdi mina ɔda bubo lɛlɔ kaduɛ.
“ ‘Bitaya na bebuo lidu bun bun inyɔ bakɔ lɛlɔ.
“ ‘Bitava edula ebi lidu inyɔ bitasala na kemo kenwi kemmo.
“ ‘Bitakya lɛwu lɛni na bédi ku unwo lɛbuli udu bun bun.
20“ ‘Si ɔnana ɔdi ɔ́tɛnku ulekubi kabla ɔblane ɔni na béevele béte ukyuli ɔdi, nsu útalɛ tɔ ɔkpa na kesii kani na ɔkya iye bátaƒɔ-nwu tɔ lili kayu ni, ɔlɛka bani-ma kɔtɔ kɔni námanku. Nsu batadu-ma, ɔsika bátaƒɔ-nwu tɔ lili kayu na ɔkɛ bɔnwuna. 21Nsu ɔnana ɔmmɔ anwu ɔlɛka uti koƒonu kɔgyani ubabla kɔtɔ bukpi akpala ute Unwoti na Kasakɔ Kevo kayakun. 22Na ɔkpane ɔdubuti kɔtɔ bukpi ebuo ɔmmɔ na ɔbla likpidi kɔtu bɔni budie akpala ute Unwoti na ɔnana ɔmmɔ likpidi lili. Na Unwoti ɔdubuti nwuna likpidi lɛni ɔ́bla mmɔ ɔ́kyiɛ-nwu.
23“ ‘Si bitéduo kalɔ kammɔ kemmo na bɛ́va egyiibi ni, ɔdi utede egyiibi ammɔ adi utadi na akwa atɛ edeedi kemmo si ése kalɔ ku bɔnwu. Na bɛnu egyiibi ammɔ aani lɛla lɛni baládi. 24Na lɛkwa linedi kemmo bɛnu egyiibi ammɔ aani egyiibi kedee. Na egyiibi ammɔ adubɔbla bumwi akpala ete Unwoti. 25Nsu lɛkwa lɛlɔndi bɛkana na bɛdi egyiibi ammɔ adi kalɛ na egyiibi ammɔ adubutaanwu ebi pii teete-mi. Ɔsika Ami ndi bina Unwoti Katɔti.
26“ ‘Ukyuli ɔdi biala utadi lɛna lɛni na ubugya ɔmu ɔkya-ni kemmo.
“ ‘Bitebo like iye bɛbla evo ala.
27“ ‘Ukyuli ɔdi utekulo nwuna lili linwini iye nwuna ukwi na ɔdi ɔdi bɔbla ɔsu.
28“ ‘Ukyuli ɔdi utakpɛ nwuna lɛlɔ akpanabi na ukpine ɔdi ɔsu iye uti lɛla lɛdi use lɛlɔ likpo. Ami ndi Unwoti.
29“ ‘Ukyuli ɔdi utedie ɔbu ubidi ulekubi lɛlɔ na uti lɛlɔ ɔbla ɔyalɛ amu lɛyalɛ ala adubɔƒɔ kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ na uboku kɔnyi ku ulikplu ala bɔbla.
30“ ‘Na bɛdi mina lɛnwunameyi lɛlɔ na biti ɔbu bite mina Kevo Kasakɔ. Ami ndi Unwoti.
31“ ‘Ɔdi utatálɔ ayu iye bekpine badi uteye lɛla lɛdi utenu ɔmmɔ ɔdububile-mii na biteese lɛlɔ. Ami ndi Unwoti bina Katɔti.
32“ ‘Si bɛ́nu benengu bani náabi lɛlɔ ni, bɛta binye na bite bina batɔnkune ɔbu na biti ɔbu geen bite ami bina Katɔti. Ami ndi Unwoti.
33“ ‘Si ɔƒɔ ɔdi ulie-ɔ kudɔ na ƒula kalɔ lɛlɔ ni, tabla-nwu ukpidi ɔdi.
34“ ‘Ɔƒɔ ɔni nkya-a kudɔ ni, nu-nwu aani ƒula lɛlɔ ukyuli kani na ayɔ-nwu aani ƒula lɛlɔ kalɛ, ɔsika amii lɛnɔ bɛ́bla baƒɔ na Egyipte kalɔ dii. Ami ndi Unwoti bina Katɔti.
35“ ‘Bɛkɔku ala bune ku bɔbɛbɛ ku bɔkuku ku bumomo ƒui ku akɔkula ani na bálɛ ugyii bése na ámanku.
36“ ‘Biti akyami akɔkula ku unu akɔkula ani námanku bitaakɔku ala. Ami ndi Unwoti bina Katɔti ɔni nákpanku-mii ɔ́lɛku Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ.
37“ ‘Na bɛdi mina ɔda bubo ku ala ani ƒui na línyimi líte-mii lɛlɔ kaduɛ. Ami ndi Unwoti.’ ”

english_text:
Penalties for Disobeying God's Laws
1The Lord told Moses 2to say to the community of Israel:
Death by stoning is the penalty for any citizens or foreigners in the country who sacrifice their children to the god Molech. 3They have disgraced both the place where I am worshiped and my holy name, and so I will turn against them and no longer let them belong to my people. 4Some of you may let them get away with human sacrifice, 5but not me. If any of you worship Molech, I will turn against you and your entire family, and I will no longer let you belong to my people.
6I will be your enemy if you go to someone who claims to speak with the dead, and I will destroy you from among my people. 7Dedicate yourselves to me and be holy because I am the Lord your God. 8I have chosen you as my people, and I expect you to obey my laws.
9 If you curse your father or mother, you will be put to death, and it will be your own fault.
10 If any of you men have sex with another man's wife, both you and the woman will be put to death.
11 Having sex with one of your father's wives disgraces him. So both you and the woman will be put to death, just as you deserve. 12 It isn't natural to have sex with your daughter-in-law, and both of you will be put to death, just as you deserve. 13 It's disgusting for men to have sex with one another, and those who do will be put to death, just as they deserve. 14 It isn't natural for a man to marry both a woman and her daughter, and so all three of them will be burned to death. 15-16 If any of you have sex with an animal, both you and the animal will be put to death, just as you deserve.
17 If you marry one of your sisters, you will be punished, and the two of you will be disgraced by being openly forced out of the community. 18 If you have sex with a woman during her monthly period, both you and the woman will be cut off from the people of Israel. 19 The sisters of your father and mother are your own relatives, and you will be punished for having sex with any of them. 20If you have sex with your uncle's wife, neither you nor she will ever have any children. 21 And if you marry your sister-in-law, neither of you will ever have any children.
22Obey my laws and teachings. Or else the land I am giving you will become sick of you and throw you out. 23The nations I am chasing out did these disgusting things, and I hated them for it, so don't follow their example. 24I am the Lord your God, and I have promised you their land that is rich with milk and honey. I have chosen you to be different from other people. 25That's why you must make a difference between animals and birds that I have said are clean and unclean—this will keep you from becoming disgusting to me. 26I am the Lord, the holy God. You have been chosen to be my people, and so you must be holy too.
27If you claim to receive messages from the dead, you will be put to death by stoning, just as you deserve.
translation_text:
Ɔda Bubo Na Bekyuli Buti Bɔkpa Bute Baƒiɔ Ku Lɛyalɛ Ala Lɛlɔ
1Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnii, 2“Su Israel kadi bekyuli ƒui anini, ‘Ɔnana biala na ɔdi Israelni iye baƒɔ bani nkya-mii akɔ na ɔdi úti ubidi ɔdi úte ɔnii bakpa bete Molek baƒiɔ ni, ɔlɛka bebo-nwu atabi badu. 3Ndubuti mina lɛnumi lɛlɛ ukyuli ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ na likulo-nwu lidie nwuna badi akɔ, ɔsika ubidi ɔni úti úte Molek mmɔ ɔ́ya na mina Adi Kevo keesé lɛlɔ na úbile-mi lɛnyi kedee. 4Na si úbebo úte ka bíni na bítadu ukyuli ɔni néti ubidi ɔ́kpa úte Molek baƒiɔ bammɔ ni, 5na ami Unwoti ɔlati ndubuti mina lɛnumi lɛlɛ ukyuli ɔmmɔ ku nwuna kaduli bekyuli lɛlɔ na likulo-ma lidie bina akɔ. Ndubukulo ukyuli ɔmmɔ lidie-mii akɔ ku bani ƒui nsiaku-nwu na béti lɛlɔ bénwini aani bayalɛ na básiaku Molek baƒiɔ bammɔ.
6“ ‘Ukyuli ɔni ndubusie bekyuli bani muubó like iye baakpali bekpine teeye ala teenu kudɔ na ama ku bekyuli bammɔ baabla lɛyalɛ ala ni, ndubo mina anumi budie bɔlɛ ukyuli ɔmmɔ. Na ndubɔda-nwu lidie nwuna badi akɔ.
7“ ‘Bidie lɛlɔ sɛsɛɛ na bɛbla lɛlɔ kedee, ɔsika ami ndi Unwoti bina Katɔti 8Bɛdi mina ɔda bubo ƒui lɛlɔ na bɛbla bɛsiaku-mu lɛlɔ, ɔsika ami ndi Unwoti ɔni mɔɔbla-mii kedee.
9“ ‘Si ukyuli ɔdi úwida uni iye ɔti ɔlɛka badu ukyuli ɔmmɔ. Na nwuna ubugya ɔdubɔsia anwu ɔlati lili ka úwida ɔti iye uni ɔsu.
10“ ‘Si ukyuli ɔdi ku nwuna ɔkpana ulekudi bátɛ ni, ɔlɛka badu bana inyɔ ƒui.
11“ ‘Si ɔnana ɔdi ku ɔti ulekudi bátɛ ni, ɔlɛka badu bana inyɔ bani nátɛ mmɔ, ɔsika ubi ɔmmɔ údie ɔbu na ɔti lɛlɔ. Na bana ubugya ɔdubɔsia ama alati lili.
12“ ‘Si ukyuli ɔdi ku ubidi ule bátɛ ni, ɔlɛka badu-ma na bana ubugya ɔdubɔsia-ma lili, ɔsika bábla likisila.
13“ ‘Si ɔnana ku ɔnana batɛ aani kalɛ na uleku ku ɔnana baatɛ ni, ɔlɛka badu-ma na bana ubugya ɔdubɔsia-ma lili.
14“ ‘Si ɔnana ɔdi úti ubi ku uni ni, ɔlɛka bakyula-ma na likpidi lɛmmɔ udu lɛyii udu na lilakya-mii akɔ.
15“ ‘Si ɔnana ɔdi ku ebuo bátɛ ni, ɔlɛka badu ɔnana ɔmmɔ ku ebuo ɔmmɔ ƒui.
16“ ‘Si uleku ɔdi ɔ́ni úde ebuo ɔdi ku kasusu ka batɛ ni, ɔlɛka badu uleku ɔmmɔ ku ebuo ɔmmɔ ƒui na bana ubugya ɔdubɔsia-ma lili.
17“ ‘Si ɔnana ɔdi úti ɔnwani ulekubi, ɔti ubidi na ɔdi o-o, uni ubidi na ɔdi o-o ni, ɔdi kɔƒa ala bɔbla na ɔlɛka bedie-ma bana badi akɔ.
18“ ‘Si ɔnana ɔdi ku uleku ɔni náƒɛ kɔnu iye ɔ́lɛ ɔtɔ bátɛ ni, údie-nwu kasɔngya na ɔ́nu-nwu uwi ɔni na uuuse sɛɛn, anwuɔsu ɔlɛka bedie-ma bana badi akɔ.
19“ ‘Ukyuli ɔdi ku uni ɔnwani ulekubi iye ɔti ɔnwani ulekubi batatɛ, ɔsika ɔmmɔ ɔdubudie ɔbu na ƒula ɔtɔ iye kaduli bekyuli lɛlɔ na ɔlɛka bani bana inyɔ ƒui kɔtu.
20“ ‘Si ɔnana ɔdi ku ɔti ɔnwani uleku bátɛ ni, údie ɔbu na ɔti ɔnwani lɛlɔ na bana inyɔ bebo lɛtuni, na bɔdubukpi na bana kaba kadi kelelie-ma kama.
21“ ‘Si ɔnana ɔdi úƒie ɔnwani ulekudi ɔƒɔ úti ni, bábla lɛla lɛni muusé lɛlɔ, na badubulie tawɔ tawɔ.
22“ ‘Anwuɔsu bɛnu ka bɛ́di mina ɔda bubo lɛlɔ na bɛsiaku-mu siin kalɛ na kalɔ kani na líte-mii na bísela bulie keletuo-mii keledie aani kalɛ na ukyuli ɔɔdala teedie lɛla biala. 23Kadi bani bekyuli na ndubo bɔbɔku bɔlɛku kalɔ kani kemmo na bísela bulie mɛni ni, bitasiaku bana ɔbladu ukpidi kama, ɔsika ala ani muusé-mi lɛlɔ na nkisi mɛni udu na bátaabla. 24Nsu lɛ́su-mii nnini, “Bɛdubuti bekyuli bammɔ kalɔ, na ami ndubo-ka buti bute-mii na kenwini bina kadikɔ. Kalɔ kani egyiibi ntu mɔɔyu emini aani uwɔ na kana lɛlɔ bebuo baayu anyi ntu pii.” Ami ndi Unwoti bina Katɔti ɔni nédie-mii úse sɛsɛɛ úte lɛlɔ ɔ́siku kadi bamba bekyuli kudɔ.
25“ ‘Anwuɔsu bɛnu kaduɛ na bise bebuo bani nse sɛɛn ku bani neeese sɛɛn likpo. Na ɔdi biala ɔnu kaduɛ na utakun ebuo iye aasɛ iye bebweyi bani mɔɔkpɛ́ kalɔ na lɛ́su ka beeese sɛɛn mmɔ ɔdi na ubile lɛlɔ. 26Bɛbla lɛlɔ kedee bite-mi, ɔsika ami Unwoti nse kedee na ami náƒuna-mii lɛ́lɛku kadi bamba bekyuli akɔ na líti-mii lɛ́bla mina bekyuli.
27“ ‘Si ɔnana iye uleku ɔdi ɔkya-mii akɔ na uubó like iye uuye bekpine ala teenu ni, ɔlɛka bibo-nwu atabi bɛdu. Na bana ubugya ɔdubɔsia ama alati lili.’ ”

english_text:
Instructions for Priests
1The Lord gave Moses these instructions for Aaron's sons, the priests:
Touching a dead body will make you unclean. So don't go near a dead relative, 2except your mother, father, son, daughter, brother, 3or an unmarried sister, who has no husband to take care of her. 4Don't make yourself unclean by attending the funeral of someone related to you by marriage. 5 Don't shave any part of your head or trim your beard or cut yourself to show that you are mourning. 6I am the Lord your God, and I have chosen you alone to offer sacrifices of food to me on the altar. That's why you must keep yourselves holy. 7Don't marry a divorced woman or a woman who has served as a temple prostitute. You are holy, 8because I am holy. And so, you must be treated with proper respect, since you offer food sacrifices to me, the God of holiness.
9If any of you priests has a daughter who disgraces you by serving as a temple prostitute, she must be burned to death.
10If you are the high priest, you must not mess up your hair or tear your clothes in order to mourn for the dead. 11Don't make yourself unclean by going near a dead body, not even that of your own father or mother. 12If you leave the sacred place to attend a funeral, both you and the sacred place become unclean, because you are the high priest.
13If you are the high priest, you must marry only a virgin 14from your own tribe. Don't marry a divorced woman or any other woman who has already had sex, including a temple prostitute. 15In this way, your descendants will be qualified to serve me. Remember—I am the Lord, and I have chosen you.
16The Lord told Moses 17-18to say to Aaron:
No descendant of yours can ever serve as my priest if he is blind or lame, if his face is disfigured, if one leg is shorter than the other, 19if either a foot or a hand is paralyzed, 20if he is a hunchback or a dwarf, if an eye or his skin is diseased, or if his testicles have been damaged. 21These men may not serve as my priests and burn sacrifices to me. 22They may eat the food offerings presented to me, 23but they may not enter the sacred place or serve me at the altar. Remember—I am the Lord, the one who makes a priest holy.
24Moses told all of this to Aaron, his sons, and the people of Israel.
translation_text:
Bakpane Ɔda Bubo Litemi
1Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, “Su Aaron bebi bani ndi bakpane anini, ‘Ɔdi biala utaƒuƒwɛ nwuna lɛlɔ bekyuli bani nékpi iye ɔni ude ukpine biala kalɛ kalɛ na ɔya na ɔsɔ na nwuna lɛlɔ lilabla sɛɛn, 2ntu nwuna lɛlɔ ukyuli geen aani, uni iye ɔti iye ubidi ulekubi iye ɔnanabi iye ɔnwani ɔnanabi, 3iye ɔnwani ulekubi ɔni nételie tɔ kɔgya na ɔkya-nwu kalɔ, bana kukpi kemmo kani na ɔdubɔkana na ubile lɛlɔ lɛni. 4Útalɛka ubile lɛlɔ na anwu ku ulekudi lɛlɔ bekyuli kɔna kɔdi kukpi ɔsu.
5“ ‘Na bakpane betekpeyi bana eli iye ukwi amadɔ iye bekulo bana ɔlɔna kesii kadi na kukpi kɔdi ɔsu. 6Ɔlɛka babla lɛlɔ kedee bete Katɔti na balabla lɛla lɛdi belebile bana Katɔti lɛnyi, ɔsika ama muuti akpala ani na bákyula teete Unwoti ani ndi Katɔti adila. Anwuɔsu ɔlɛka babla kedee.
7“ ‘Útalɛka bakpane beti beleku bani nébile lɛlɔ na badi bayalɛ iye beti beleku bani nányonu bana bagya, ɔsika bakpane badi bekyuli kedee bete bana Katɔti. 8Ɔlɛka bekyuli banu bakpane ka badi bekyuli kedee, ɔsika ama muuti bina Katɔti adila teete-nwu. Biti-ma ka badi bekyuli kedee, ɔsika ami Unwoti ɔni nédie-mii líse sɛsɛɛ ka bise kedee nse kedee.
9“ ‘Na si ɔkpane ɔdi ubidi ulekubi úbile lɛlɔ na úti lɛlɔ ɔ́bla ɔyalɛ ni, úwi ɔti anumi kalɔ, anwuɔsu ɔlɛka bakya-nwu ogya kemmo bakyula.
10“ ‘Ɔkpane unengudi ɔni na béwi-nwu lili nnɔmii bése-nwu likpo na nwuna banwani akɔ ka ɔkya ɔkpane lɛwu lɛmmɔ utalɛ ka ɔnyonu nwuna kuli linwini uwi kalɛ kalɛ iye ɔni nwuna awu ɔbwɛ ka kekwa kada-nwu ɔsu. 11Útalɛ ka uduo kesii kani na ukpine ɔtɛ na ubile lɛlɔ na ulése sɛɛn ina ɔti iye uni na ɔdi, 12iye ɔvi ɔlɛ Unwoti Adi Kevo kammɔ kemmo uteesie kekwa kalɔ na ɔya na ubile lɛlɔ ku Kevo kammɔ, ɔsika bédie-nwu bése sɛsɛɛ béte Unwoti na nnɔmii lili buwi bɔmmɔ ɔsu.
13“ ‘Ugblebi adagyaa na ɔlɛka uti. 14Na ɔɔɔdi ukpinele iye uleku ɔni béti bányonu iye uleku ɔyalɛ. Ɔnu ka adagyaa ɔni na ɔdubo buti mmɔ ɔ́si nwuna kaba kemmo 15kalɛ na nwuna bebi balásɔ na bana kenyekɔ. Ami ndi Unwoti ɔni náƒuna-nwu úse sɛsɛɛ ka ɔbla kedee.’ ”
16Amu na Unwoti úbo Mose ɔda ɔnini, 17“Su Aaron anini, ‘Nu ka ƒula bawɔ bani na bana likpo lɛdi lɛsɔ ɔdi uláni uléde ɔnii uuti akpala adi ɔkpa ute-mi. Ɔda bubo bɔmɛni buse bute ƒula bawɔ úsela uwi ƒui. 18Ɔnana biala na anumi ábwɛ-nwu iye ɔ́ƒɛ uwi kalɔ iye nwuna kakɛ kadi kásɔ uteti akpala utakpa utete-mi. 19Na naaawia ukyuli ɔni na kɔnu iye ɔgba ɔ́gogolo-nwu ka uti akpala ute-mi, 20iye ubo keƒu iye use klukwii iye lɛnumi linwi lɛɛɛdia-nwu iye ɔlɔna ɔlɛ ɔdi uukpóku-nwu iye agobɛɛ ébie-nwu. 21Ɔkpane Aaron uwɔ biala na nwuna kakɛ kadi kásɔ utabla akpala bɔkyula ɔdi utete-mi. 22Ukyuli ɔmɛni udu ɔkana na ɔdi adila kedee ku ani nse kedee ƒui ani béti bákpa béte-mi mmɔ adi, 23nsu ka nwuna kakɛ kadi kásɔ ɔsu ni, utakpɛ utede kakpakɔ bule kɔdi kɔmmɔ iye lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ na waya na mina Kevo kammɔ kese lɛlɔ. Ami ndi Unwoti ɔni mɔɔbla ala ammɔ ƒui kedee.’ ”
24Etemila amɛni na Mose ɔ́su Aaron ku nwuna bebi ku Israelƒuɔ.

english_text:
The Offerings Are Holy
1The Lord told Moses 2to say to Aaron and his sons:
I am the Lord God, and I demand that you honor my holy name by showing proper respect for the offerings brought to me by the people of Israel. 3If any of you are unclean when you accept an offering for me, I will no longer let you serve as a priest. 4None of you may take part in the sacred meals while you have a skin disease or an infected penis, or after you have been near a dead body or have had a flow of semen, 5or if you have touched an unclean creature of any sort, including an unclean person. 6-7Once you are unclean, you must take a bath, but you still cannot eat any of the sacred food until evening. 8I command you not to eat anything that is killed by a wild animal or dies a natural death. This would make you unclean. 9Obey me, or you will die on duty for disgracing the place of worship. Remember—I am the Lord, the one who makes a priest holy.
10Only you priests and your families may eat the food offerings; these are too sacred for any of your servants. 11However, any slave that you own, including those born into your household, may eat this food. 12If your daughter marries someone who isn't a priest, she can no longer have any of this food. 13But if she returns to your home, either widowed or divorced, and has no children, she may join in the meal. Only members of a priestly family can eat this food, 14and anyone else who accidentally does so, must pay for the food plus a fine of 20 percent.
15I warn you not to treat lightly the offerings that are brought by the people of Israel. 16Don't let them become guilty of eating this sacred food. Remember—I am the Lord, the one who makes these offerings holy.
Acceptable Sacrifices
17The Lord told Moses 18to tell Aaron and his sons and everyone else the rules for offering sacrifices. He said:
The animals that are to be completely burned on the altar 19-20 must have nothing wrong with them, or else I won't accept them. Bulls or rams or goats are the animals to be used for these sacrifices.
21When you offer a sacrifice to ask my blessing, there must be nothing wrong with the animal. This is true, whether the sacrifice is part of a promise or something you do voluntarily. 22Don't offer an animal that is blind or injured or that has an infection or a skin disease. 23If one of your cattle or lambs has a leg that is longer or shorter than the others, you may offer it voluntarily, but not as part of a promise. 24As long as you live in this land, don't offer an animal with injured testicles. 25And don't bring me animals you bought from a foreigner. I won't accept them, because they are no better than one that has something wrong with it.
26The Lord told Moses to say:
27Newborn cattle, sheep, or goats must remain with their mothers for seven days, but on the eighth day, you may send them up in smoke to me, and I will accept the offering. 28Don't sacrifice a newborn animal and its mother on the same day.
29When you offer a sacrifice to give thanks to me, you must do it in a way that is acceptable. 30Eat all of the meat that same day and don't save any for the next day. I am the Lord your God!
31Obey my laws and teachings—I am the Lord. 32-33I demand respect from the people of Israel, so don't disgrace my holy name. Remember—I am the one who chose you to be priests and rescued all of you from Egypt, so that I would be your Lord.
translation_text:
Kalɛ Akpala Ammɔ Ɔlɛka Abla Kedee
1Katɔti úbo Mose ɔda ɔnini, 2“Su Aaron ku nwuna bebi anii beti ɔbu geen bete ala kedee ani na Israelƒuɔ béboku na bábla-nya sɛsɛɛ béte-mi kalɛ na belebile-mi lɛnyi kedee. Ami ndi Unwoti.
3“Su-ma anini, ‘Ɔ́si ɔƒɛni úsela ni, bina bawɔ bani na ɔdi ɔ́sɔ ɔsu na beeese kedee batani betede etela ani na Israelƒuɔ béboku-mi na bábla-nya sɛsɛɛ béte Unwoti si ɔɔɔdi lɛni badubɔyila ukyuli ɔmmɔ udu. Ami ndi Unwoti.
4“ ‘Si ɔlɔna ɔlɛgyie uukpóku Aaron bawɔ ɔdi iye ɔdi ubo kanɔkɔ ɔlɛ ni, utalɛka ɔdi akpala adila adi útédu ka nwuna lɛlɔ lɛ́bla sɛɛn. Nwuna lɛlɔ lɛdubuse lɛlɔ lɛnɔ si útuku lɛla lɛni nétuku ukpine na liisé lɛlɔ iye si útuku ɔnana ɔni na lɛlɔ líbo-nwu, 5iye útuku bebuo udu ɔni neeese sɛɛn ɔdi iye ukyuli ɔni neeese sɛɛn ɔ́ya na ɔkpane ɔmmɔ uusé lɛlɔ ni, ɔɔɔdi ka ɔdi adila ammɔ adi. 6Ukyuli ɔni nétuku ala amɛni ɔdi ɔdubuse lɛlɔ utédu useyi uwi na útalɛka ɔdi adila kedee ammɔ adi útédu ka ɔ́kpi ntu. 7Na ɔƒɛ bɔnu kama asa na ɔdubɔbla sɛɛn na ɔkana na ɔdi adila kedee ammɔ, ɔsika anwu ɔdi adidi na adi. 8Utakun ebuo ukpine iye ebuo ɔni beƒiebuo nádu-nwu báva na ɔya na uteese lɛlɔ. Ami ndi Unwoti.
9“ ‘Bakpane ƒui ɔlɛka badi ɔda bubo bɔni líti muute-ma mɛni lɛlɔ kalɛ na baláƒiɔ na bekpi si bátanu ala ammɔ bátabu. Ami ndi Unwoti ɔni nédie-ma úse sɛsɛɛ líte lɛlɔ ka bese kedee.
10“ ‘Ɔƒɔ iye ukyuli ɔni naaadi ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔtɔ ukyuli iye ɔɔbla kabla teete ɔkpane ɔdi utadi adila kedee ammɔ. 11Nsu ukyuli uyedi ɔni na ɔkpane ɔmmɔ úti nwuna egulabi úye iye báwɔ-nwu na ɔkpane kaduli ɔkana na ɔdi nwuna adila. 12Ɔkpane ubi ulekubi ɔni nlieku ɔnana ɔni na útasi ɔkpane kaba kemmo utadi adila kedee ammɔ. 13Nsu si ɔdi ukpinele iye ɔ́lɛ kɔgya na uuubo bebi badi na ɔ́sɔ únwini úsie ulie ɔti kesii aani nwuna ligblebi uwi ni, ubo kuƒi ka ɔdi adila ammɔ adi biala. Ukyuli keeke ɔdi biala uuubo kuƒi ka ɔdi adila ammɔ. 14Si ukyuli ɔni nátasi ɔkpane kaba kemmo útati na ɔ́di adila ammɔ adi ni, ɔlɛka ɔƒɔ adila ani na ɔ́di mmɔ kayu na ɔ́sɔ uti adila ammɔ kuye bɔƒɔ lɛkpa lɛlɔndi ubunku kayu kammɔ lɛlɔ ute ɔkpane ɔmmɔ. 15Akpala etela ani na Israelƒuɔ bammɔ béboku Unwoti ni, bakpane bammɔ batabla na eteese lɛlɔ 16na baya na ukyuli ɔni na útalɛka ɔdi adila ammɔ adi ɔdi nya na ɔƒiɔ na uti kɔtu bɔni uboku lɛlɔ. Ami ndi Unwoti ɔni nábla akpala ammɔ kedee.’ ”
Akpala Ani Nátamanku
17Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, 18“Bo Aaron ku nwuna bebi bananabi ku Israelƒuɔ bammɔ ƒui ɔda anini, ‘Si Israelni ɔdi iye ɔƒɔ ɔni nli Israelƒuɔ akɔ úti etela adi úboku ka babla akpala bɔkyula ƒui ɔdi uti udie lili na kenye kani na úse ɔsu iye kaƒɔ ƒaa akpala ni, 19ɔlɛka uti koƒonu kɔgyani iye ketukpa kani nátasɔ ɔsiku nwuna bebuo akɔ uboku kalɛ na Unwoti ɔƒɔ akpala ammɔ ka ámanku na nwuna lili. 20Ɔdi uteboku ebuo ɔni násɔ, ɔsika Unwoti ɔɔɔdubo-nwu bɔƒɔ bute-nwu.
21“ ‘Si ɔdi úti ebuo ɔ́siku nwuna bebuo akɔ ɔduboku ubabla unwi bɔbla akpala na kenye kani na úse ka udie lili iye kaƒɔ ƒaa akpala ni, uboku ebuo ɔni nátasɔ kalɛ na Unwoti ɔƒɔ ute-nwu. 22Ɔdi uteboku ebuo ɔni na anumi ábwɛ-nwu iye ulesie kaduɛ iye ebuo ɔlɛne udu biala ɔnii beti basia lɛkpabi lɛlɔ bakyula bete Unwoti. 23Si ɔdi ɔnii ɔɔbla kaƒɔ ƒaa akpala ni, ɔkana na uboku ɔmantɛ akɔ ɔgyani iye uledi iye koƒonu kɔni na ɔ́si-nwu bɔwɔ kemmo na kesii kadi kásɔ, nsu ɔɔɔdia uuute lili budie na kenye kani na ɔdi úse ɔsu. 24Ɔdi uteti ebuo ɔni na nwuna agobɛɛ ábwɛ iye ása iye békulo-nya bédie uteboku ɔnii ubakpa ute Unwoti. Kuƒi kuuubo na ƒula kalɔ lɛlɔ mɛni ka abla lɛni, 25na bitaƒɔ ɔmmɔ udu bitasiku ɔƒɔ ɔdi lɛnɔ kudɔ ka biti bɛkpa aani lɛdila bite Katɔti. Unwoti ɔɔɔdubo-ma bɔƒɔ, ɔsika bétedu na bɔsɔ bɔkya-ma lɛlɔ.’ ”
26Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, 27“Si ebuo ɔdi ɔ́wɔ ɔmantɛ akɔ ubi iye koƒonu ubi ni, ɔlɛka ɔkya uni kudɔ emeyi maatɛ na ɔmmɔ kama ɔ́si limeyi maanedi úsela ni, Unwoti ɔdubɔƒɔ-nwu aani akpala bɔkyula ebuo. 28Ɔdi utadu ɔmantɛ akɔ iye koƒonu ku ubidi limeyi linwi lɛlɔ.
29“Si ɔdi ébo ka ababla linugya akpala ni, bla akpala ammɔ kalɛ na Unwoti ɔƒɔ-nya ute-ɔ. 30Ɔlɛka badi adila ammɔ limeyi lɛmmɔ kani na lɛla lɛdi litebu utédu kadi bugye. Ami ndi Unwoti.
31“Bɛda mina ɔda bubo kaduɛ na bɛsiaku-mu kama. Ami ndi Unwoti. 32Bitebile-mi lɛnyi kedee. Ɔlɛka amii Israelƒuɔ bɛnu-mi bɛti ka nse kedee. Ami ndi Unwoti ɔni náƒuna-mii sɛsɛɛ ka bise-mi kedee, 33na lɛ́kpanku-mii lɛ́siku Egyipte líboku ka lɛbla bina Katɔti. Ami ndi Unwoti.”

english_text:
Religious Festivals
1The Lord told Moses 2to say to the community of Israel:
I have chosen certain times for you to come together and worship me.
3 You have six days when you can do your work, but the seventh day of each week is holy because it belongs to me. No matter where you live, you must rest on the Sabbath and come together for worship. This law will never change.
Passover and the Festival of Thin Bread
(Numbers 28.16-25)
The Lord said:
4-5 Passover is another time when you must come together to worship me, and it must be celebrated on the evening of the fourteenth day of the first month of each year.
6 The Festival of Thin Bread begins on the fifteenth day of that same month; it lasts seven days, and during this time you must honor me by eating bread made without yeast. 7On the first day of this festival you must rest from your work and come together for worship. 8Each day of this festival you must offer sacrifices. Then on the final day you must once again rest from your work and come together for worship.
Offering the First Part of the Harvest
9The Lord told Moses 10to say to the community of Israel:
After you enter the land I am giving you, the first bundle of wheat from each crop must be given to me. So bring it to a priest 11on the day after the Sabbath. He will lift it up in dedication to me, and I will accept you. 12You must also offer a sacrifice to please me. So bring the priest a one-year-old lamb that has nothing wrong with it 13and two kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil. Then he will place these on the bronze altar and send them up in smoke with a smell that pleases me. Together with these, you must bring a liter of wine as a drink offering. 14I am your God, and I forbid you to eat any new grain or anything made from it until you have brought these offerings. This law will never change.
The Harvest Festival
(Numbers 28.26-31)
The Lord said:
15 Seven weeks after you offer this bundle of grain, each family must bring another offering of new grain. 16Do this exactly 50 days later, which is the day following the seventh Sabbath. 17Bring two loaves of bread to be lifted up in dedication to me. Each loaf is to be made with yeast and with two kilograms of the finest flour from the first part of your harvest.
18At this same time, the entire community of Israel must bring seven lambs that are a year old, a young bull, and two rams. These animals must have nothing wrong with them, and they must be offered as a sacrifice to please me. You must also offer the proper grain and wine sacrifices with each animal. 19Offer a goat as a sacrifice for sin, and two rams a year old as a sacrifice to ask my blessing. 20The priest will lift up the rams together with the bread in dedication to me. These offerings are holy and are my gift to the priest. 21This is a day of celebration and worship, a time of rest from your work. You and your descendants must obey this law.
22 When you harvest your grain, always leave some of it standing around the edges of your fields and don't pick up what falls on the ground. Leave it for the poor and for those foreigners who live among you. I am the Lord your God!
The Festival of Trumpets
(Numbers 29.1-6)
23The Lord told Moses 24-25to say to the people of Israel:
The first day of the seventh month must be a day of complete rest. Then at the sound of the trumpets, you will come together to worship and to offer sacrifices on the altar.
The Great Day of Forgiveness
(Numbers 29.7-11)
26 The Lord God said to Moses:
27The tenth day of the seventh month is the Great Day of Forgiveness. It is a solemn day of worship; everyone must go without eating to show sorrow for their sins, and sacrifices must be burned. 28No one is to work on that day—it is the Great Day of Forgiveness, when sacrifices will be offered to me, so that I will forgive your sins. 29I will destroy anyone who refuses to go without eating. 30-31None of my people are ever to do any work on that day—not now or in the future. And I will wipe out those who do! 32This is a time of complete rest just like the Sabbath, and everyone must go without eating from the evening of the ninth to the evening of the tenth.
The Festival of Shelters
(Numbers 29.12-40)
33 The Lord told Moses 34to say to the community of Israel:
Beginning on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, and continuing for seven days, everyone must celebrate the Festival of Shelters in honor of me. 35No one is to do any work on the first day of the festival—it is a time when everyone must come together for worship. 36For seven days, sacrifices must be offered on the altar. The eighth day is also to be a day of complete rest, as well as a time of offering sacrifices on the altar and of coming together for worship.
37I have chosen these festivals as times when my people must come together for worship and when animals, grain, and wine are to be offered on the proper days. 38These festivals must be celebrated in addition to the Sabbaths and the times when you offer special gifts or sacrifices to keep a promise or as a voluntary offering.
39Remember to begin the Festival of Shelters on the fifteenth day of the seventh month after you have harvested your crops. Celebrate this festival for seven days in honor of me and don't do any work on the first day or on the day following the festival. 40Pick the best fruit from your trees and cut leafy branches to use during the time of this joyous celebration in my honor. 41I command you and all of your descendants to celebrate this festival during the seventh month of each year. 42For seven days every Israelite must live in a shelter, 43so future generations will know that I made their ancestors live in shelters when I brought them out of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.
44This is how Moses instructed the people of Israel to celebrate the Lord's festivals.
translation_text:
Emeyi Buni Bɔdi
1Amu na Unwoti ɔ́sɔ ɔsu Mose ɔnini, 2“Kɔ lɛsa na asu Israelƒuɔ anini, ‘Unwoti emeyi ani na údie úse ka Israelƒuɔ badubo butaasa ndi amɛni.
Lɛnwunameyi
3“ ‘Emeyi aku na bɛdubuti bɛbla bina kabla, nsu limeyi maatɛdi ni, lɛdi bɔsa kedee limeyi lite-mii. Na ɔdi utalɛka ɔbla kabla kadi na kesi kesii na bilie, ɔsika ɔdi Lɛnwunameyi ute Unwoti.
Kukpi Lili Bɔvia Limeyi Bɔdi
4“ ‘Emeyi amɛni na Unwoti údie úse ka bitaadi úte bɔsa kedee na ɔlɛka akɔ-nya lɛsa ete-ma si uwi ɔmmɔ údu. 5Kɔbuli kudeedi kɔni ndi Abib limeyi leevu-linedi lɛlɔ useyi uwi si ɔƒɛ úsela kanukɔ ni, na bise kalɔ bitaadi Unwoti Kukpi Lili Bɔvia Limeyi. 6Na kadi kegye kɔbuli kɔmmɔ kani limeyi leevu-lɛlɔndi lɛlɔ ni, Bodobodo Ɔni Néteƒu Limeyi bɔdi buusé kalɔ na bɛdubɔdi bodobodo ɔmmɔ emeyi maatɛ. 7Na limeyi lideedi lɛni na emeyi bɔdi bɔmɛni búse kalɔ ni, bɛsa bɔsa kedee na mina lɛnyi lɛlɔ na ɔdi utabla limeyi ndi limeyi kabla kadi. 8Nsu na emeyi maatɛ ammɔ ƒui kemmo ni, na bitaabla akpala bɔkyula teete Unwoti. Na limeyi maatɛdi lɛlɔ ni, bɛsa bɔsa kedee na mina lɛnyi lɛlɔ na ɔdi utabla limeyi ndi limeyi kabla kadi.’ ”
Edula Edeedi
9Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, 10“Kɔ lɛsa na asu Israelƒuɔ anini, ‘Si bísie bítéduo kalɔ kani na líti muute-mii kemmo na bɛ́ƒɛ bina edula edeedi ni, na biti-nya bisienku ɔkpane. 11Na ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔkɔliku-nya katɔ ɔtina Unwoti na ubo-nya kudu na badubɔƒɔ-nya bete-mii. Na ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔbla akpala ammɔ lɛnwunameyi kadi kegye. 12Ɔƒɛni na limeyi lɛni na ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔɔbla akpala ammɔ ni, na biti koƒonu kɔgyani kɔni na bɔsɔ bɔdi buuubo-ku lɛlɔ na ɔ́ɔkɛ lɛkwa na uti ɔbla akpala bɔkyula ute Unwoti. 13Na biti edula ebi lɛkyami linwi lɛni béti bákɔ ɔlaaƒɔ na uukeye na biti nnɔ bɛsala-nwu kemmo na biti bɛbla akpala bɔkyula ammɔ bite Unwoti úbunku ntɛ akpala ɔsii unwi. Na akpala ammɔ ɔnyi ƒɛƒɛɛ ɔdubɔyɔ Unwoti kaƒɔ. 14Ɔdi utadi bodobodo biala iye edula ebi ani na béƒi iye awɔdi úti útédu limeyi lɛni bíti akpala ammɔ bíbabla akpala bíte bina Katɔti. Na ɔda bubo bɔmɛni buse bute amii ku bina bawɔ ƒui na kesi kesii na bɛdubulie.
Edula Bɔƒɛ Limeyi Bɔdi
15“ ‘Bɛka kwasida maatɛ ɔ́si lɛnwunameyi lɛni lɛlɔ na bíti bina edula ebi aboyo bíbakɔliku katɔ bɛ́tina Unwoti bíbo-nya kudu mmɔ. 16Na bɛka emeyi liti útédu lɛnwunameyi maatɛdi kadi kegye na biti edula ebi awɔdi ammɔ bɛbla akpala bite Unwoti. 17Na kesi kesii na bilie ni, kaduli biala basiku bodobodo inyɔ inyɔ ɔni na béƒi ku ɔlaaƒɔ ɔni muukeye na bɔnyii bɔkya-nwu kemmo biboku bibakɔliku katɔ bɛtina Unwoti bibo kudu aani edula ebi edeedi akpala. 18Na biti baƒonu bebi maatɛ bani na ɔdi biala ɔ́ƒɔ lɛkwa linwi na bɔsɔ bɔdi buuubo-ma lɛlɔ ku ɔmantɛ akɔ unwi ku baƒonu bagyani inyɔ bibunku bodobodo ɔmmɔ. Ala amɛni na bɛdubuti bɛkyula ƒui úbunku edula ebi ku nwuna lɛlɔ ntɛ aani akpala bɔkyula na ana uyɔ ɔnyi ƒɛƒɛɛ ɔyɔ Unwoti kaƒɔ. 19Bɛdu ketukpa bɛbla likpidi lili buvele akpala na bɛdu baƒonu inyɔ bani na báaƒɔ lɛkwa linwi linwi biti bɛbla unwi bɔbla akpala.
20“ ‘Na ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔdubuti baƒonu inyɔ bammɔ ɔkɔliku katɔ ɔtina Unwoti ubo kudu ku edula ebi edeedi bodobodo ɔmmɔ. Na adi Unwoti akpala kedee ani ndi ɔkpane ɔmmɔ adi.
21“ ‘Na limeyi lɛmmɔ kani lɛlɔ ni, kɔ lɛsa na bɛsa bɔsa kedee na mina lɛnyi lɛlɔ na ɔdi utabla limeyi ndi limeyi kabla kadi. Ɔda bubo bɔmɛni buse bute amii ku bina bawɔ na kesi kesii na bɛdubulie.
22“ ‘Na si bɛɛƒɛ bina edula ni, bitaƒɛ ana ƒui mmomu bibu adi bɛkya bina mmo amadɔ iye bibu adi bise bina kakpa kemmo bite bawabane ku baƒɔ bani nnkya-mii akɔ. Ami ndi bina Unwoti Katɔti.’ ”
Kɔkpɛɛ Bɔvwi Limeyi Bɔdi
