In fact, this was the greatest Passover celebration in Israel's history! 19All these things happened in the eighteenth year of Josiah's rule in Judah.
Josiah Dies in Battle
(2 Kings 23.28-30)
20Some time later, King Neco of Egypt led his army to the city of Carchemish on the Euphrates River. And Josiah led his troops north to meet the Egyptians in battle.
21Neco sent the following message to Josiah:
I'm not attacking you, king of Judah! We're not even at war. But God has told me to quickly attack my enemy. God is on my side, so if you try to stop me, he will punish you.
22But Josiah ignored Neco's warning, even though it came from God! Instead, he disguised himself and marched into battle against Neco in the valley near Megiddo.
23During the battle an Egyptian soldier shot Josiah with an arrow. Josiah told his servants, “Get me out of here! I've been hit.” 24They carried Josiah out of his chariot, then put him in the other chariot he had there and took him back to Jerusalem, where he soon died. He was buried beside his ancestors, and everyone in Judah and Jerusalem mourned his death.
25Jeremiah the prophet wrote a funeral song in honor of Josiah. And since then, anyone in Judah who mourns the death of Josiah sings that song. It is included in the collection of funeral songs.
26Everything else Josiah did while he was king, including how he faithfully obeyed the Lord, 27is written in The History of the Kings of Israel and Judah.
translation_text:
Bádi Kukpi Lili Bɔvia Limeyi
1Na uwi ɔmmɔ ni, Yosia úbo ɔda ka badi Kukpi Lili Bɔvia Limeyi na Yerusalem na beti babu Unwoti. Anwuɔsu na kɔbuli kudeedi limeyi leevu-linedi lɛlɔ ni, bádu baƒonu bakɔdi béte limeyi lɛmmɔ bɔdi.
2Amu na limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, Yosia ɔ́sia bakpane bammɔ anu kaduɛ kalɛ na ɔdi biala ɔti lɛla lɛni na ɔdubo bɔbla na kakpakɔ mmɔ. 3Na Lewiƒuɔ bani mɔɔbla Unwoti kabla na baatina bekyuli Unwoti ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ etemila ni, ɔ́lɔ-ma ɔ́sala na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Bɛsɔ bɛɛɛdubo Katɔti Bunyimi Adaka ɔmmɔ buteeti taavinku ekpo ƒui ɔƒɛni amu. Mmomu ɔdubuse Katɔti kakpakɔ kani na Ɔga Salomo ɔni ndi Dawid ubidi ɔ́tu mɛni kemmo kesii kani na amii ku nwuna kadi bekyuli Israelƒuɔ bɛdubo nwuna kabla butaabla. 4Anwuɔsu bɛklibi lɛlɔ na bitátaabla bina kabla kani na Ɔga Dawid ku Salomo béte-mii ka bitaabla ɔkɛnku bina adua ammɔ kenye.
5“Bile lɛlɔ bɛkya kasala akpa akpa kemmo na binye kunyekɔ kɔni na bíle bíte lɛlɔ kalɛ na si atɔƒi ammɔ bekyuli bébo kakpakɔ na bana ɔdi biala ɔkɛ kebunku ɔsiku bina ɔdi kudɔ. 6Na si uwi ɔni na bekyuli bammɔ béti bana lɛkpa koƒonu ubi béboku ni, na bɛdu-ku na bɛwawa-ku bite ka bakpa bete Unwoti. Bɛnu kaduɛ kalɛ na bekyuli bammɔ badi limeyi lɛmmɔ basiaku ulu ɔni lɛlɔ na Unwoti úbo Mose ɔda. Na bɛbla lɛlɔ bɔbla sɛɛn ɔdi ɔmmɔ kalɛ na bilásɔ na Unwoti anumi na biteese-nwu lɛlɔ.”
7Yosia úte bekyuli bammɔ baƒonu ku bese mpim avlaatɛ ku ɔmantɛ bakɔ mpim ɛtɛ ɔ́siku anwu ɔlati bebuo akɔ ka beti bakpa. 8Yosia benengu bammɔ lɛnɔ béte bakpane ku Lewiƒuɔ bammɔ bebuo badi ku kaƒɔ ƒaa básiku bana bebuo akɔ ka beti bakpa. Na Hilkia ku Sekaria ku Yehiel bani ndi benengu bani mɔɔnu kakpakɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ lɛnɔ béte bakpane ku Lewiƒuɔ bammɔ baƒonu ku baƒonu bakɔdi mpim inyɔ ku eti leevu-anyɔ. Na béte ɔmantɛ bakɔ eti aku banii beti bakpa na Kukpi Lili Bɔvia Limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ. 9Na Konania ku nwuna banwani inyɔ bani ndi Semaia ku Netanel ku Hasabia ku Yeiel ku Yosabad ni, ama ndi Lewiƒuɔ benengu. Na ama béte Lewiƒuɔ bakladi baƒonu ku bese mpim ɛlɔ ku ɔmantɛ bakɔ eti leevu ka beti babla akpala.
10Amu ka uwi údu ka badi Kukpi Lili Bɔvia limeyi lɛmmɔ ni, bakpane ku Lewiƒuɔ bammɔ bésie béténye bana kunyekɔ aani kalɛ na Yosia ɔ́su-ma. 11Na Lewiƒuɔ bammɔ bádu Lɛkpa baƒonubi bammɔ na bédie-ma lɛku na béti ubugya ɔmmɔ ɔdi béte bakpane bammɔ na bákuna béwi lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ. 12Lewiƒuɔ bammɔ bédie bebuo bammɔ kɔdikɔ kɔdikɔ kɔni na badubuti babla bɔkyula ƒui ɔdi aani kalɛ na Mose ɔda bubo bɔɔtina bése bekyuli bani néboku bebuo bammɔ. Na lɛni kani na bábla ku ɔmantɛ bakɔ bammɔ lɛnɔ. 13Bákyula akpala ammɔ na lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ, na béƒulo lɛna lɛkladi na ebui lidu lidu kemmo úte etela ɔdi bamba lɛnɔ bɔbla na bábabala béti lɛna lɛmmɔ béte bekyuli bammɔ kalɛ na bakun.
14Anwuɔsu limeyi limodi lɛmmɔ ƒui ni, bakpane bammɔ bátakɛ kɔnu kɔdi, mmomu benye baabla akpala na baakyula bebuo bammɔ lɛmwi na lɛkpabi lɛlɔ. Na uwi ɔni na bekyuli bammɔ ƒui ɔdi biala ɔ́wɔlɔ ni, Lewiƒuɔ bánwa Kukpi Lili Bɔvia adila ammɔ béte lɛlɔ ku bakpane bammɔ.
15Na uwi ɔni na baadi limeyi lɛmmɔ ni, Lewiƒuɔ badi bánwa adila ammɔ béte lɛnu bediene ku bagyumanane bammɔ kalɛ na Lewiƒuɔ lɛnu bediene bammɔ ɔdi ulágyu nwuna kenyekɔ kani na béte-nwu ka unye aani kalɛ na Dawid ku Asaƒ ku Heman ku Yedutum ɔni ndi kenye udiene ute ɔga ɔmmɔ bátina. Na bagyumanane bani na benye kakpakɔ kɔyakun lɛban kenye muedi ɔdi útalɛ ka ɔdi ɔgyu nwuna kenyekɔ.
16Anwuɔsu na limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, bádi kukpi Lili Bɔvia Limeyi lɛmmɔ béti bákɔliku Unwoti katɔ na bákyula akpala na lɛkpabi lɛlɔ béte-nwu aani kalɛ Yosia úbo ɔda. 17Na bekyuli bani nébo kakpakɔ mmɔ bésie anumi na bádi Bodobodo Ɔni Néteƒu Limeyi bɔdi emeyi maatɛ.
18Yerusalem ɔma ku lɛma lɛni na Yuda ku Israel kalɔ ƒui bekyuli bébo mmɔ. Na ka ɔ́si Kenye Udiene Samuel uwi ƒui ni, bátadi Kukpi Lili Bɔvia Limeyi lɛmɛni lɛni kudii. Na geen ni, ɔ́si uwi ɔni na bése kalɔ ku limeyi lɛmɛni bɔdi ni, ɔmɛni ndi limeyi linengudi ƒui lɛni na bádi dii na Israel! 19Na ala amɛni ƒui álɛ na lɛkwa leevu-maanedi kemmo na Yosia Yuda lɛga bɔdi kemmo.
Yosia Úkpi Na Kekpokɔ
20Amu na uwi ɔdi kama ni, Egyipteƒuɔ Ɔga Neko ɔ́tɔnku nwuna bekpone úsienku Karkemis ɔma unengudi kemmo na Euƒrate Ketu kɔtu. Na Yosia lɛnɔ útiku nwuna bekpone útásiaku kalɔ kammɔ katɔ kakɛ kalɛ na utásiaku Egyipteƒuɔ bammɔ na kekpokɔ.
21Mmɔ na Neko ɔ́kya Yosia ɔtu ɔnini, “Ɔɔɔdi awɔ Yuda Ɔga na líbo mbekpoku! Na ami ku awɔ bútakɛ lɛla lɛdi na buukpó. Katɔti násu-mi ɔnii mbekpoku mina ukisine na unye-mi kama lɛnɔ sɔsɔ. Anwuɔsu si awɔ ákali ka enye ada-mi ni, Unwoti ɔdubo-ɔ kɔtu bɔni.”
22Nsu ɔmɛni ƒui ni, Yosia útenu Neko litemi ina ka Katɔti náya na ɔ́su-nwu kenye kammɔ! Mmomu úti ala adi na ɔ́bɛla nwuna anumi kalɛ na balanu-nwu baláti na úsie útásiaku-nwu ka bekpo na kesii kani baalɔ banii Medigo Ɔkwalɛ.
23Ka benye kekpo kammɔ lɛlɔ ni, Egyipteni ukpone ɔdi úbo kataminta lɛtula ɔ́lɛ Yosia. Mmɔ kani na Yosia ɔ́su nwuna bekpone akɔ unwi ɔnini, “Babla na ada-mi edie mɛni, ɔsika lɛtula lɛdi lɛ́kɛ-mi.” 24Anwuɔsu báda Yosia bédie kɛɛkɛ ɔmmɔ kemmo bátákya ɔbambadi ɔdi kemmo na béti-nwu bátɔlɔku mmɔ bésienku Yerusalem kesii kani na uwi ɔ́sɔ útetu asa na úkpi. Báva-nwu na kesii kani na nwuna bati kuuku batɛ na ukyuli biala na Yuda ku Yerusalem mmɔ úwulo-nwu geen.
25Amu na Kenye Udiene Yeremia údie ɔkwanu ɔdi úti ɔ́kɔliku-nwu lɛnyi katɔ. Na ɔ́si uwi ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, ukyuli biala muuwulo Yosia kukpi ni, uudie ɔkwanu ɔmmɔ. Na bénweni ɔnu ɔmmɔ bákya lɛkwanu ɔku kemmo.
26Na lɛla bamba biala na Yosia ɔ́sɔ ɔ́bla na nwuna lɛgadi kemmo ku kalɛ na ɔ́siaku Unwoti kama siin ni, 27bénweni-ni bákya Israel ku Yuda ala alɛdi ɔku kemmo.

english_text:
King Jehoahaz of Judah
(2 Kings 23.30-35)
1After the death of Josiah, the people of Judah crowned his son Jehoahaz their new king. 2He was 23 years old at the time, and he ruled only 3 months from Jerusalem. 3King Neco of Egypt captured Jehoahaz and forced Judah to pay 3.4 tons of silver and 34 kilograms of gold as taxes. 4 Then Neco appointed Jehoahaz's brother Eliakim king of Judah and changed his name to Jehoiakim. He led Jehoahaz away to Egypt as his prisoner.
King Jehoiakim of Judah
(2 Kings 23.36—24.7)
5 Jehoiakim was 25 years old when he was appointed king, and he ruled 11 years from Jerusalem. Jehoiakim disobeyed the Lord his God by doing evil.
6 During Jehoiakim's rule, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia invaded Judah. He arrested Jehoiakim and put him in chains, and he sent him to the capital city of Babylon. 7Nebuchadnezzar also carried off many of the valuable things in the Lord's temple, and he put them in his palace in Babylon.
8Everything else Jehoiakim did while he was king, including all the disgusting and evil things, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel and Judah. His son Jehoiachin then became king.
King Jehoiachin of Judah
(2 Kings 24.8-17)
9Jehoiachin was 18 years old when he became king of Judah, and he ruled only 3 months and 10 days from Jerusalem. Jehoiachin also disobeyed the Lord by doing evil. 10 In the spring of the year, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia had Jehoiachin arrested and taken to Babylon, along with more of the valuable items in the temple. Then Nebuchadnezzar appointed Zedekiah king of Judah.
King Zedekiah of Judah
(2 Kings 24.18-20; Jeremiah 52.1-3)
11 Zedekiah was 21 years old when he was appointed king of Judah, and he ruled from Jerusalem for 11 years. 12He disobeyed the Lord his God and refused to change his ways, even after a warning from Jeremiah, the Lord's prophet.
13 King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia had forced Zedekiah to promise in God's name that he would be loyal. Zedekiah was stubborn and refused to turn back to the Lord God of Israel, so he rebelled against Nebuchadnezzar. 14The people of Judah and even the priests who were their leaders became more unfaithful. They followed the disgusting example of the nations around them and made the Lord's holy temple unfit for worship. 15But the Lord God felt sorry for his people, and instead of destroying the temple, he sent prophets who warned the people over and over about their sins. 16But the people only laughed and insulted these prophets. They ignored what the Lord God was trying to tell them, until he finally became so angry that nothing could stop him from punishing Judah and Jerusalem.
Jerusalem Is Destroyed
(2 Kings 25.1-21; Jeremiah 52.3-30)
17 The Lord sent King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia to attack Jerusalem. Nebuchadnezzar killed the young men who were in the temple, and he showed no mercy to anyone, whether man or woman, young or old. God let him kill everyone in the city. 18Nebuchadnezzar carried off everything that was left in the temple; he robbed the treasury and the personal storerooms of the king and his officials. He took everything back to Babylon.
19 Nebuchadnezzar's troops burned down the temple and destroyed every important building in the city. Then they broke down the city wall. 20The survivors were taken to Babylonia as prisoners, where they were slaves of the king and his sons, until Persia became a powerful nation.
21 Judah was an empty desert, and it stayed that way for 70 years, to make up for all the years it was not allowed to rest. These things happened just as Jeremiah the Lord's prophet had said.
Cyrus Lets the Jews Return Home
(Ezra 1.1-4)
22In the first year that Cyrus was king of Persia, the Lord had Cyrus send a message to all parts of his kingdom. This happened just as Jeremiah the Lord's prophet had promised. 23 The message said:
I am King Cyrus of Persia.
The Lord God of heaven has made me the ruler of every nation on earth. He has also chosen me to build a temple for him in Jerusalem, which is in Judah. The Lord God will watch over any of his people who want to go back to Judah.
translation_text:
Yehoahas Ɔ́di Lɛga Na Yuda
1Ka Yosia úkpi kama ni, Yudaƒuɔ bése ubidi ɔnanabi Yehoahas Yudaƒuɔ ɔga na Yerusalem. 2Na akwa aavlanyɔ-atɛ na ɔ́ƒɔ na uwi ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ. Na Yerusalem mmɔ na úlie ɔ́di lɛga abuli atɛ. 3Egyipteƒuɔ Ɔga Neko úƒie Yehoahas na únye Yudaƒuɔ lɛlɔ na beeyi lɛlɔ bɔdi kayu kani ndi sika ɔƒualadi aani antabi aƒo bonwu aavlene unu ku sika ugyiedi antabi akyami aavlanyɔ-atɛ unu teete-nwu. 4Na Ɔga Neko ɔ́ƒuna Yehoahas ɔnwani Eliakim úse lɛga na Yuda na ɔ́vumana-nwu lɛnyi ɔnii Yehoiakim. Na Yehoahas anwu ni, úti-nwu ɔ́tɔlɔku úsienku Egyipte aani ɔtɔntɛne kalɛ.
Yehoiakim Ɔ́di Lɛga Na Yuda
5Akwa aavlanyɔ-alɔ na Yehoiakim ɔ́ƒɔ asa na báƒuna-nwu ka ɔdi lɛga. Na úlie Yerusalem mmɔ ɔ́di lɛga akwa leevu-unwi. Yehoiakim útadi Unwoti nwuna Katɔti litemi lɛlɔ mmomu ɔ́bla atu ɔkplu na ɔ́bla ala ekpidi.
6Uwi ɔni na Yehoiakim ɔɔdi lɛga ni, Babilon Ɔga Nebukadnesar úkpo Yuda na úƒie Yehoiakim na úbo-nwu kɔgba na úti-nwu úmene Babilon ɔma unengudi kemmo. 7Nebukadnesar úti ala abuni bamba ani na áƒɔ kuye geen lɛnɔ na kakpakɔ kammɔ kemmo ɔ́tɔlɔku útése nwuna ɔga kesii na Babilon.
8Na ala bamba ani na Yehoiakim ɔ́sɔ ɔ́bla uwi ɔni na ɔɔdi lɛga ku ala ekpidi ani na ɔ́bla ku ani muusé lɛlɔ ƒui ni, bénweni-nya bákya Israel ku Yudaƒuɔ ala alɛdi ɔku kemmo. Na ɔmmɔ kama bése ubidi Yekonia lɛga.
Yekonia Ɔ́di Yuda Lɛga
9Akwa leevu-maane na Yekonia ɔ́ƒɔ asa na bése-nwu Yudaƒuɔ ɔga. Na úlie Yerusalem mmɔ ɔ́di lɛga abuli atɛ ku emeyi leevu. Anwu lɛnɔ útadi Unwoti litemi lɛlɔ na ala ekpidi ani na ɔ́bla ɔsu. 10Uwi ɔni na ketudi keesé kalɔ ni, Babilon Ɔga Nebukadnesar ɔ́ya na béƒie Yekonia na úti-nwu úsienku Babilon na ɔ́sɔ útiku ala abambadi ani lɛnɔ náƒɔ kuye geen ɔ́siku kakpakɔ kammɔ kemmo. Ɔmmɔ kama Nebukadnesar ɔ́ƒuna Sedekia ka unwini Yudaƒuɔ ɔga.
Sedekia Ɔ́di Lɛga Na Yuda
11Sedekia ɔ́kɛ akwa aavlanyɔ-unwi asa na ɔ́di lɛga. Na ɔ́di lɛga lɛmmɔ na Yerusalem akwa leevu-unwi. 12Ɔ́bla likpidi na Unwoti nwuna Katɔti anumi na úni ka uboku lɛlɔ kalɔ ina ka Katɔti Kenye Udiene Yeremia ɔ́dɔnku-nwu geen.
13Amu na Sedekia ɔ́ta únye Ɔga Nebukadnesar lɛlɔ ina ka ɔ́kpali Unwoti lɛnyi na úse ɔga ɔmmɔ kenye ka ɔdubɔdi nwuna litemi lɛlɔ siin. Nsu Sedekia ɔ́bla atu ɔkplu na úni ka ɔvumana kayi na unwini ubo Unwoti Israel Katɔti kudɔ. Na ɔ́ta únye Nebukadnesar lɛlɔ. 14Yuda kadi bekyuli ku bana bakpane bani ndi bana batɔnkune ƒui muedi béni ka badi Unwoti litemi lɛlɔ siin. Na bakɛ basiaku kadi bekyuli bani ablala muusé Katɔti lɛlɔ mmɔ ɔbladu kama na báya na Unwoti kakpakɔ kedee kammɔ keesé lɛlɔ na kásɔ kátamanku ka bakpa na mmɔ. 15Nsu Unwoti Katɔti kadi bekyuli bammɔ lɛlɔ lɛ́kywi-nwu kaƒɔ na ɔni na ɔkyula kakpakɔ kammɔ na kayii udu ni, bɔtala mmomu na ɔ́tala nwuna kenye bediene na bábadɔnku-ma kɔlɛ kɔlɛ na bana ekpidi ɔsu. 16Nsu bɔma kani na bekyuli bamɛni báma kenye bediene bammɔ na bédumi-ma na béni ala ani ƒui na Katɔti ɔɔwia ka ɔsu-ma. Na ɔkɛnku ɔmɛni ɔsu kɔnyi kúbakɔ Unwoti Katɔti kɔ́vili útédu ka ɔni Yuda ku Yerusalem kɔtu.
Bákyula Yerusalem
17Unwoti ɔ́tala Babilon Ɔga Nebukadnesar ka utékpo Yerusalem. Na úsie útádu bakloƒu bani nkya kakpakɔ kammɔ kemmo na útanu ɔdi kɔnyana. Uleku o-o, ɔnana o-o, unengu o-o, ɔnamu o-o ni, Katɔti ɔ́ya na ɔ́du bana ƒui na ɔma unengudi ɔmmɔ kemmo. 18Na úti Katɔti kakpakɔ kemmo ala enengudi ku ebliidi ani nse mmɔ ƒui ɔ́tɔlɔku úsienku Babilon ku ɔga ɔmmɔ ku nwuna benengu akɛla ani nse kakpakɔ mmɔ. 19Ɔmmɔ kama bátu ogya bákya Katɔti kakpakɔ kammɔ na báƒɛ Yerusalem awodu ammɔ béwi kalɔ, na bákyula baga kesii kammɔ ƒui na bébile ala ani náƒɔ kuye mmɔ ƒui.
20Bekyuli bani ƒui na bátadu na kuwii kenye ni, ɔga ɔmmɔ ɔ́ya na béƒie-ma bátɔlɔku, na bénwini anwu ku nwuna bebi kabla bablane úti útédu uwi ɔni na Persia lɛgakadikɔ kébo kaadi lɛlɔ. 21Na uwi ɔni na ɔgbankpi ɔmɛni úbo kalɔ kammɔ ƒui lɛlɔ na basɔ balátuma-ka ni, kalɔ kammɔ kákɛ kana bɔnwuna lɛkwa aani lɛnwunameyi kalɛ útédu akwa liti ku aavlanyɔ ani na Unwoti ɔ́sia nwuna kenye údie Yeremia lɛlɔ ɔ́su úse.
22Ɔmɛni kama na Persia kalɔ Ɔga Kores lɛga bɔdi lɛkwa lideedi kemmo ni, Unwoti úti ɔ́sia-nwu kayi ka ute bɔti bɔdi na nwuna kalɛkɛ lɛlɔ ƒui kalɛ na Yeremia kenye kani na ɔ́su kebo-nwu kemmo na ɔ́ya na bénweni lɛla lɛmɛni bése.
23“Lɛni na ami Ɔga Kores mɔɔsu,
“ ‘Unwoti Katɔti Ɔyikune úti kayawi lɛga kɔdikɔ ƒui ɔ́kya-mi kalɔ, na ɔ́ƒuna-mi ka lɛtu kakpakɔ lite-nwu na Yerusalem na Yuda kalɔ lɛlɔ. Anwuɔsu nwuna kadi bekyuli akɔ ɔdi biala na ɔkya-mii akɔ ni, nwuna Katɔti ɔsiaku-nwu na unwini usie mmɔ.’ ”

english_text:
Cyrus Lets the Jews Return Home
1 Years ago the Lord sent Jeremiah with a message about a promise for the people of Israel. Then in the first year that Cyrus was king of Persia, the Lord kept his promise by telling Cyrus to send this official message to all parts of his kingdom:
2-3 I am King Cyrus of Persia.
The Lord God of heaven, who is also the God of Israel, has made me the ruler of all nations on earth. And he has chosen me to build a temple for him in Jerusalem, which is in Judah. The Lord God will watch over and encourage any of his people who want to go back to Jerusalem and help build the temple.
4Everyone else must provide what is needed. They must give money, supplies, and animals, as well as gifts for rebuilding God's temple.
5Many people felt that the Lord God wanted them to help rebuild his temple, and they made plans to go to Jerusalem. Among them were priests, Levites, and leaders of the tribes of Judah and Benjamin. 6The others helped by giving silver articles, gold, personal possessions, cattle, and other valuable gifts, as well as offerings for the temple.
7King Cyrus gave back the things that Nebuchadnezzar had taken from the Lord's temple in Jerusalem and had put in the temple of his own gods. 8Cyrus placed Mithredath, his chief treasurer, in charge of these things. Mithredath counted them and gave a list to Sheshbazzar, the governor of Judah. 9-10Included among them were: 30 large gold dishes; 1,000 large silver dishes; 29 other dishes; 30 gold bowls; 410 silver bowls; and 1,000 other articles.
11Altogether, there were 5,400 gold and silver dishes, bowls, and other articles. Sheshbazzar took them with him when he and the others returned to Jerusalem from Babylonia.
translation_text:
Kores Úbunku Bekyuli Bani Kekpo Kéƒie-ma Na Bénwini Bébo Ɔma
1Na Persia kalɔ Ɔga Kores lɛga bɔdi lɛkwa lideedi kemmo ni, Unwoti úti ɔ́sia-nwu kayi ka ute bɔti bɔdi na nwuna kalɛkɛ lɛlɔ ƒui kalɛ na Yeremia kenye kani na ɔ́su kebo-nwu kemmo na ɔ́ya na bénweni lɛla lɛmmɔ bése.
2Na ɔda ɔni na úbo ndi ɔmɛni.
Lɛni na ami Ɔga Kores mɔɔsu. Unwoti Katɔti Ɔyikune úti kayawi lɛga kɔdikɔ ƒui ɔ́kya-mi kalɔ na ɔ́ƒuna-mi ka lɛtu kakpakɔ lite-nwu na Yerusalem na Yuda kalɔ lɛlɔ. 3Nwuna kadi bekyuli akɔ ɔdi biala na ɔkya-mii akɔ ni, nwuna Katɔti ɔsiaku-nwu na unwini usie Yerusalem na utátu Unwoti ɔni ndi Israel Katɔti ɔni nli Yerusalem kakpakɔ kammɔ. 4Na kalɔ biala kemmo na Katɔti kadi bekyuli bamɛni akɔ bani nébu ɔdi ɔkya ni, kalɔ kammɔ bekyuli bete-ma sika ɔƒualadi ku ugyiedi ku ala bamba ku bebuo ku kaƒɔ ƒaa etela ute Katɔti kakpakɔ kamɛni bɔtu na Yerusalem.
5Amu na Yuda ku Benyamin adua batɔnkune ku bakpane ku Lewiƒuɔ ku bani ƒui na Katɔti útuku-ma kayi báklibi lɛlɔ ka basɔ benwini batátu Unwoti kakpakɔ na Yerusalem. 6Na bana liku bekyuli béte-ma sika ɔƒualadi ku ugyiedi ku ala ku bebuo ku ala abuni abambadi úbunku kaƒɔ ƒaa etela ani na béte-ma.
7Na Ɔga Kores ɔ́sɔku akyami ku lɛɛƒɛɛ lɛni na Ɔga Nebukadnesar úti ɔ́tɔlɔku Yerusalem kakpakɔ mmɔ, na úti-nya útése nwuna baƒiɔ kakpakɔ ɔtɔ mmɔ úte-ma. 8Na Persiaƒuɔ Ɔga Kores úti kabla kammɔ ƒui ɔ́kya Sesbasar ɔni ndi bana egulabi lɛlɔ ɔnune enu kemmo, na únweni ala ani ƒui béte-ma ɔ́kya ɔku kemmo.
9Na anya ndi sika ugyiedi akyami 30
ku sika ɔƒualadi akyami 1,000
ku akyami bamba 29.
10Sika ugyiedi akyami wɛlɛ wɛlɛ 30
ku sika ɔƒualadi akyami wɛlɛ wɛlɛ 410
ku kanwakɔ akyami bamba 1,000.
11Na ala ammɔ bumomo ƒui adi ala 5,400. Na ala amɛni na Sesbasar úti ɔ́da uwi ɔni na anwu ku bekyuli bani kekpo kéƒie-ma bási Babilon bésie Yerusalem.

english_text:
A List of People Who Returned from Exile
(Nehemiah 7.4-73)
1King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia had captured many of the people of Judah and had taken them as prisoners to Babylonia. Now they were on their way back to Jerusalem and to their own towns everywhere in Judah.
2-20Zerubbabel, Joshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Reelaiah, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum, and Baanah were in charge of the ones who were coming back. And here is a list of how many returned from each family group: 2,172 from Parosh; 372 from Shephatiah; 775 from Arah; 2,812 descendants of Jeshua and Joab from Pahath Moab; 1,254 from Elam; 945 from Zattu; 760 from Zaccai; 642 from Bani; 623 from Bebai; 1,222 from Azgad; 666 from Adonikam; 2,056 from Bigvai; 454 from Adin; 98 from Ater, also known as Hezekiah; 323 from Bezai; 112 from Jorah; 223 from Hashum; and 95 from Gibbar.
21-35Here is how many people returned whose ancestors had come from the following towns: 123 from Bethlehem; 56 from Netophah; 128 from Anathoth; 42 from Azmaveth; 743 from Kiriatharim, Chephirah, and Beeroth; 621 from Ramah and Geba; 122 from Michmas; 223 from Bethel and Ai; 52 from Nebo; 156 from Magbish; 1,254 from the other Elam; 320 from Harim; 725 from Lod, Hadid, and Ono; 345 from Jericho; and 3,630 from Senaah.
36-39Here is a list of how many returned from each family of priests: 973 descendants of Jeshua from the family of Jedaiah; 1,052 from the family of Immer; 1,247 from the family of Pashhur; and 1,017 from the family of Harim.
40-42And here is a list of how many returned from the families of Levites: 74 descendants of Hodaviah from the families of Jeshua and Kadmiel; 128 descendants of Asaph from the temple musicians; and 139 descendants of Shallum, Ater, Talmon, Akkub, Hatita, and Shobai from the temple guards.
43-54Here is a list of the families of temple workers whose descendants returned: Ziha, Hasupha, Tabbaoth, Keros, Siaha, Padon, Lebanah, Hagabah, Akkub, Hagab, Shamlai, Hanan, Giddel, Gahar, Reaiah, Rezin, Nekoda, Gazzam, Uzza, Paseah, Besai, Asnah, Meunim, Nephisim, Bakbuk, Hakupha, Harhur, Bazluth, Mehida, Harsha, Barkos, Sisera, Temah, Neziah, and Hatipha.
55-57Here is a list of Solomon's servants whose descendants returned: Sotai, Hassophereth, Peruda, Jaalah, Darkon, Giddel, Shephatiah, Hattil, Pochereth Hazzebaim, and Ami.
58A total of 392 descendants of temple workers and of Solomon's servants returned.
59-60There were 652 who returned from the families of Delaiah, Tobiah, and Nekoda, though they could not prove that they were Israelites. They had lived in the Babylonian towns of Tel-Melah, Tel-Harsha, Cherub, Addan, and Immer.
61-62The families of Habaiah, Hakkoz, and Barzillai could not prove that they were priests. The ancestor of the family of Barzillai had married the daughter of Barzillai from Gilead and had taken his wife's family name. But the records of these three families could not be found, and none of them were allowed to serve as priests. 63 In fact, the governor told them, “You cannot eat the food offered to God until we find out if you really are priests.”
64-67There were 42,360 who returned, in addition to 7,337 servants and 200 musicians, both women and men. They brought with them 736 horses, 245 mules, 435 camels, and 6,720 donkeys.
68When the people came to where the Lord's temple had been in Jerusalem, some of the family leaders gave gifts so it could be rebuilt in the same place. 69They gave all they could, and it came to a total of 500 kilograms of gold, 500 kilograms of silver, and 100 robes for the priests.
70 Everyone returned to the towns from which their families had come, including the priests, the Levites, the musicians, the temple guards, and the workers.
translation_text:
Bekyuli Bani Kekpo Kéƒie Básɔ Bénwini
1Na bamɛni ndi bekyuli bani na Ɔga Nebukadnesar úƒie na kekpo kenye, úsienku Babilon, nsu básɔ bénwini bébo Yerusalem ku Yuda kalɛkɛ. Na ɔdi biala únwini úsie nwuna ɔma. 2Na bana batɔnkune ndi Serubabel ku Yesua ku Nehemia ku Seraia ku Reelaia ku Mordekai ku Bilsan ku Mispar ku Bigwai ku Rehum ku Baana.
Na Israelƒuɔ lɛtɔ ku bana bumomo bani nénwini bébo anyi ndubo mɛni.
3Paros bebi 2,172,
4Seƒatia bebi 372,
5Arah bebi 775,
6Pahat-Moab bebi ku Yesua ku Yoab bebi 2,812,
7Elam bebi 1,254,
8Satu bebi 945,
9Sakai bebi 760,
10Bani bebi 642,
11Bebai bebi 623,
12Asgad bebi 1,222,
13Adonikam bebi 666,
14Bigwai bebi 2,056,
15Adin bebi 454,
16Ater bebi ku Hesekia bebi badi 98,
17Besai bebi 323,
18Yora bebi 112,
19Hasum bebi 223,
20Gibar bebi 95,
21Banana bani nkya Betlehem badi 123,
22Netoƒa bebi 56,
23Anatot bebi 128,
24Asmawet bebi 42,
25Kiriat-Yearim ku Keƒira ku Beerot bebi 743,
26Rama ku Geba bebi 621,
27Mikmas bebi 122,
28bananabi bani nkya Betel ku Ai badi 223,
29Nebo bebi 52,
30Magbis bebi 156,
31Elam ɔbambadi bebi 1,254,
32Harim bebi 320,
33Lod ku Hadid ku Ono bebi 725,
34Yeriko bebi 345,
35Senaa bebi 3,630.
36Na bakpane bammɔ ndi bamɛni.
Yedaia bebi bani nási Yesua kaduli 973,
37Imer bebi 1,052,
38Pashur bebi 1,247,
39Harima bebi 1,017.
40Na Lewiƒuɔ bebi bani nási Yesua ku Kadmiel ku Hodawia 74.
41Lɛnu batune ndi Asaƒ bebi 128.
42Kakpakɔ bagyumanane bebi bani nási Salum ku Ater ku Talmon ku Akub ku Hatita ku Sobai 139.
43Kakpakɔ kabla bablane bani nédie kaba lɛnɔ ndi Siha ku Hasuƒa ku Tabaot 44ku Keros ku Siaha ku Padon 45ku Lebana ku Hagaba ku Akub 46ku Hagaba ku Samlai ku Hanan 47ku Gidel ku Gahar ku Reaia 48ku Resin ku Nekoda ku Gasam 49ku Usa ku Pasea ku Besai 50ku Asna ku Meuniƒuɔ ku Neƒisiƒuɔ 51ku Bakbuk ku Hakuƒa ku Harhur 52ku Baslit ku Mehida ku Harsa 53ku Barkos ku Sisera ku Tama 54ku Nesia ku Hatiƒa.
55Salomo kabla bablane bebi ndi bani nási Sotai ku Soƒeret ku Perdua 56ku Yaala ku Darkon ku Gidel 57ku Seƒatia ku Hatil ku Pokeret-Hasebaim ku Ami.
58Kakpakɔ kabla bablane ku Salomo kabla bablane bebi badi 392.
59Bani nási Tel-Mela ku Tel-Harsa ku Kerub ku Adan ku Imer lɛma ni, bátakana bana kasikɔ bɔ́tina na Israel. 60Ama ndi Delaia bebi ku Tobia bebi ku Nekoda bebi. Na bana bumomo bɔdi 652.
61Na bakpane badi bási Habaia ku Hakos ku Barsilai ɔni néti Gileadni Barsilai ulekubi na mmɔ ɔ́kɛ nwuna lɛnyi.
62Na bamɛni báwia bana anyi na kaba kasikɔ anyi kemmo, nsu bátanu-nya. Ɔmmɔ ɔsu báda-ma bédie bakpane akɔ. Ɔsika bánu-ma aani bekyuli bani muusé lɛlɔ. 63Na kalɔ lɛlɔ ɔnune úbo-ma ɔda ka ɔdi biala utadi adila ani nse kedee ntulo útédu ka bákɛ ɔkpane ɔni mɔɔbla kabla na ɔɔda ala ani baalɔ Urim ku Tumim.
64Na bekyuli bammɔ ƒui bumomo bɔdi 42,360. 65Na bana banana ku beleku kabla bablane bumomo bɔdi 7,337 bebunku bekyuli bumomo budeedi kemmo. Na bebo lɛnu batune banana ku beleku 200. 66Na bebo bapɔnkɔ 736 ku bebuo ala betine benengudi 245. 67Na bebo baƒlumu 435 ku bebuo ala betine beblidi 6,720.
68Uwi ɔni na bekyuli bammɔ béduo Katɔti Kaduli na Yerusalem ni, lɛtɔ lɛmmɔ benengu badi béyi akpala ka badubuti ku kaƒɔ ƒaa bebunku Katɔti kaduli kammɔ bɔtu. 69Na bekyuli bammɔ béyi ala kalɛ na badubɔkana na béti babla kabla kammɔ. Na ala ani na béyi bumomo bɔdi sika ugyiedi ebi 61,000 ku sika ɔƒualadi ebi 5,000 ku bakpane lɛwu 100.
70Na bakpane ku Lewiƒuɔ ku lɛnu batune ku kɔyakun bagyumanane ku kakpakɔ kabla bablane bétélie bana lɛma kemmo. Na bekyuli badi bene lɛnɔ bétélieku-ma. Na Israelƒuɔ bakladi ni, ama lɛnɔ bétélie bana lɛma kemmo.

english_text:
The First Offering on the New Altar
1During the seventh month of the year, the Israelites who had settled in their towns went to Jerusalem. 2 The priest Joshua son of Jozadak, together with the other priests, and Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and his relatives rebuilt the altar of Israel's God. Then they were able to offer sacrifices there by following the instructions God had given to Moses, the man of God. 3 And they built the altar where it had stood before, even though they were afraid of the people who were already living around there. Then every morning and evening they burned sacrifices and offerings to the Lord.
4 The people followed the rules for celebrating the Festival of Shelters and offered the proper sacrifices each day. 5 They offered sacrifices to please the Lord, sacrifices at each New Moon Festival, and sacrifices at the rest of the Lord's festivals. Every offering the people had brought voluntarily was also presented to the Lord.
6Although work on the temple itself had not yet begun, the people started offering sacrifices on the Lord's altar on the first day of the seventh month of that year.
The Rebuilding of the Temple Begins
7King Cyrus of Persia had said the Israelites could have cedar trees brought from Lebanon to Joppa by sea. So they sent grain, wine, and olive oil to the cities of Tyre and Sidon as payment for these trees, and they gave money to the stoneworkers and carpenters.
8During the second month of the second year after the people had returned from Babylonia, they started rebuilding the Lord's temple. Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, Joshua son of Jozadak, the priests, the Levites, and everyone else who had returned started working. Every Levite over 20 years of age was put in charge of some part of the work. 9The Levites in charge of the whole project were Joshua and his sons and relatives and Kadmiel and his sons from the family of Hodaviah. The family of Henadad worked along with them.
10 When the builders had finished laying the foundation of the temple, the priests put on their robes and blew trumpets in honor of the Lord, while the Levites from the family of Asaph praised God with cymbals. All of them followed the instructions given years before by King David. 11 They praised the Lord and gave thanks as they took turns singing:
“The Lord is good!
His faithful love for Israel
will last forever.”
Everyone started shouting and praising the Lord because work on the foundation of the temple had begun. 12 Many of the older priests and Levites and the heads of families wept bitterly because they remembered seeing the first temple years before. But others were so happy that they celebrated with joyful shouts. 13Their shouting and crying were so noisy that it all sounded alike and could be heard a long way off.
translation_text:
Básɔku Kakpakɔ Bátu
1Uwi ɔni na kɔbuli maatɛdi kúdu na Israelni biala ɔ́ɔkɛ nwuna keliekɔ na nwuna ɔma ni, bana ƒui bábasala lisu aani kadi kenwi bekyuli na Yerusalem. 2Amu na Yosadak ubidi Yesua ku nwuna bakpane ku Sealtiel ku nwuna bekyuli badi bése kalɔ baatú Israelƒuɔ Katɔti lɛkpabi lɛni lɛlɔ badubo akpala butaakyula aani kalɛ na bénweni bákya Mose ɔni ndi Katɔti ukyuli ɔda bubo ɔku kemmo. 3Ina ka bákya bátaayia bekyuli bani nkya-ma amadɔ mmɔ ni, básɔku lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ bátu na nina ɔka ɔkukudi lɛlɔ, na baabla ɔtanta ku useyi uwi akpala teete Unwoti. 4Na kalɛ na bénweni bákya ɔda bubo ɔku kemmo ni, bádi Kevo Kemmo Bulie Emeyi, na bábla bɔkyula akpala bumomo bɔni na bénweni bése béte limeyi biala.
5Ɔmmɔ kama ni, bábla bɔkyula akpala ku kɔbuli kɔwɔdi akpala ku akpala ani na ese ete Unwoti emeyi bɔdi. Na básɔ bábla akpala bamba ani ndi kaƒɔ ƒaa etela ani na bekyuli bammɔ béboku. 6Na limeyi lideedi na kɔbuli maatɛdi kɔmmɔ kemmo ni, bése kalɔ baabla bɔkyula akpala teete Unwoti. Ina ka béteseku kalɔ ku Unwoti kakpakɔ bɔtu tɔ.
Béseku Unwoti Kakpakɔ Bɔtu Kalɔ
7Ɔmmɔ kama béti egulabi adi béte lɛtɔ batune ku banwine badi. Na béti adila ku ntu ku nnɔ ka beti besienku Sidonƒuɔ ku Tiroƒuɔ kalɛ na beti sida kugyiikɛ basia ɛpu lɛlɔ basiku Lebanon beboku Yopa. Na Persiaƒuɔ Ɔga Kores úte kuƒi kɔmɛni.
8Na kɔbuli kunyɔdi na lɛkwa linyɔdi kemmo ni, uwi ɔni na béduo Unwoti kaduli na Yerusalem kama ni, Sealtiel ubidi Serubabel ku Yosadak ubidi Yesua ku bana banwani bakladi ku bakpane ku Lewiƒuɔ ku bani kekpo kéƒie-ma na bénwini bébo Yerusalem bése kalɔ ku kabla. Na Lewiƒuɔ bani ƒui nákɛ akwa aavlanyɔ ku kama béti-ma bábla kabla kammɔ lɛlɔ banune. 9Na Yesua ku nwuna bebi ku nwuna banwani Kadmiel ku nwuna bebi ku Hodawia kaba bebi ku Henadad bebi ku Lewiƒuɔ béti lɛlɔ básala na bakya baanu bekyuli bani nkya mɔɔtú Katɔti ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ.
10Na si batune bammɔ bákya atabi ani beeti teese Unwoti kakpakɔ ɔtɔ kalɔ bɔtu ni, na bakpane bammɔ bakya bana bakpane lɛwu na beti bana kɔkpɛɛ bada. Na Lewiƒuɔ bani nási Asaƒ kaba kemmo beti bana agyala na bemwi Unwoti aani kalɛ na Ɔga Dawid úbo-ma ɔda ɔ́vi. 11Na beedie lɛnu teemwi Unwoti na baagyá-nwu enu banini,
Unwoti ɔdia geen.
Na nwuna bɔyɔ
bɔni na ubo ute Israel
buse búsela uwi ƒui.
Na bekyuli bammɔ ƒui bébo kudu momoomo bémwi Unwoti ka bákya Unwoti kakpakɔ kowodu ɔka kalɔ ɔsu. 12Nsu Lewiƒuɔ ku bakpane ku lɛtɔ benengu bani na badaku anumi busie pii na bánu kakpakɔ kedeedi bɔtu béwulo momoomo ka bánu ka bése kalɔ baatú kakpakɔ kammɔ. Na badi lɛnɔ beebó kudu ku lɛlɔyɔ. 13Na ukyuli biala ɔdi ɔsɔ ulenu buwulo ku lɛlɔyɔ kudu kavumana kadi taati. Ɔsika kudu kɔmmɔ kɔ́kɔ katɔ geen na beenú-ku na ɔgyu kakaaka ƒui.

english_text:
Foreigners
Want To Help Rebuild the Temple
1The enemies of the tribes of Judah and Benjamin heard that the people had come back to rebuild the temple of the Lord God of Israel. 2 So they went to Zerubbabel and to the family leaders and said, “Let us help! Ever since King Esarhaddon of Assyria brought us here, we have worshiped your God and offered sacrifices to him.”
3But Zerubbabel, Joshua, and the family leaders answered, “You cannot take part in building a temple for the Lord our God! We will build it ourselves, just as King Cyrus of Persia commanded us.”
4Then the neighboring people began to do everything possible to frighten the Jews and to make them stop building. 5During the time that Cyrus was king and even until Darius became king, they kept bribing government officials to slow down the work.
Trouble Rebuilding Jerusalem
6 In the first year that Xerxes was king, the neighboring people brought written charges against the people of Judah and Jerusalem.
7Later, Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel, and their advisors got together and wrote a letter to Artaxerxes when he was king of Persia. It was written in Aramaic and had to be translated.
8-10 A letter was also written to Artaxerxes about Jerusalem by Governor Rehum, Secretary Shimshai, and their advisors, including the judges, the governors, the officials, and the local leaders. They were joined in writing this letter by people from Erech and Babylonia, the Elamites from Susa, and people from other foreign nations that the great and famous Ashurbanipal had forced to settle in Samaria and other parts of Western Province.
11This letter said:
Your Majesty King Artaxerxes, we are your servants from everywhere in Western Province, and we send you our greetings.
12You should know that the Jews who left your country have moved back to Jerusalem and are now rebuilding that rebellious city. In fact, they have almost finished rebuilding the walls and repairing the foundations. 13You should also know that if the walls are completed and the city is rebuilt, the Jews won't pay any kind of taxes, and there will be less money in your treasury.
14We are telling you this, because you have done so much for us, and we want everyone to respect you. 15If you look up the official records of your ancestors, you will find that Jerusalem has constantly rebelled and has led others to rebel against kings and provinces. That's why the city was destroyed in the first place. 16If Jerusalem is rebuilt and its walls completed, you will no longer have control over Western Province.
17King Artaxerxes answered:
Greetings to Governor Rehum, Secretary Shimshai, and to your advisors in Samaria and other parts of Western Province.
18After your letter was translated and read to me, 19I had the old records checked. It is true that for years Jerusalem has rebelled and caused trouble for other kings and nations. 20And powerful kings have ruled Western Province from Jerusalem and have collected all kinds of taxes.
21I want you to command the people to stop rebuilding the city until I give further notice. 22Do this at once, so that no harm will come to the kingdom.
23As soon as this letter was read, Governor Rehum, Secretary Shimshai, and their advisors went to Jerusalem and forced everyone to stop rebuilding the city.
Work on the Temple Starts Again
24 The Jews were forced to stop work on the temple and were not able to do any more building until the year after Darius became king of Persia.
translation_text:
Bekyuli Bénye Bétile Kakpakɔ Kammɔ Bɔtu
1Uwi ɔni na bekisine bani nási Yuda ku Benyamin bénu ka bekyuli bani kekpo kéƒie-ma bénwini bébo mmɔ bakya baatú kakpakɔ bete Unwoti ɔni ndi Israelƒuɔ Katɔti ni, 2bésie Serubabel ku Israelƒuɔ lɛtɔ benengu kudɔ na básu-ma banini, “Bɛya na bubebunku-mii na bɔtu kakpakɔ kammɔ. Ɔsika Katɔti ɔni bɛɛbu ni, anwu kani na abu lɛnɔ bɔɔbu. Na búuse kalɔ bɔɔbla akpala teete-nwu ɔ́si uwi ɔni na Asiriaƒuɔ Ɔga Esarhadon ɔ́ya na bubo bɔ́kya-nwu kudɔ.”
3Amu na Serubabel ku Yesua ku Israel lɛtɔ benengu bammɔ bédie kenye banini, “Biiibo kuƒi ka bibebunku-bu na ɔtɔ ɔni bɔɔtu bute bula Katɔti kemmo. Abu kani bɔdu bɔkana na bɔtu ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ bute Unwoti ɔni ndi Israelƒuɔ Katɔti aani kalɛ na Persiaƒuɔ Ɔga Kores úbo-bu ɔda.”
4Ɔmmɔ kama bekyuli bani na belie bede-ma bákya ɔkplu ka baƒɛ Yudaƒuɔ enu. Na baya liƒu liduo-ma kemmo na bada ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ bɔtu baya. 5Na báwia egulabi béte bekyuli badi kalɛ benye betile kabla kammɔ. Na bétile-ma ulu lɛni laa ɔ́si Persiaƒuɔ Ɔga Kores lɛga bɔdi uwi útédu Ɔga Dario uwi.
6Uwi ɔni na Ɔga Ahasweros úse kalɔ ɔɔdi lɛga ni, bekyuli badi bátáda Yudaƒuɔ ku Yerusalemƒuɔ kenye bátina-nwu.
7Na ɔ́si uwi ɔni na Ɔga Artasasta ɔɔdi lɛga na Persia kalɔ lɛlɔ ni, Bislam ku Mitradat ku Tabeel ku nwuna bekyuli badi bénweni ɔku béte Artasasta. Na bénweni ɔku ɔmmɔ na Siria kunweni kemmo na bédie-nwu kalɔ na Siria lɛdi kemmo.
8Na Rehum ɔni ndi bekpone ɔtɔnkune ku Simsai ɔni ndi unwenine bénweni ɔku bémene Artasasta na báda Yerusalem kenye banini,
9“Ɔmɛni ɔ́si Rehum bekpone ɔtɔnkune ku Simsai ku bana bakpana ku litemi batɛne Dina ku Aƒarsatka ku Tarpela ku Aƒarsa ku Arkewa ku Babel ku Susan ku Deha ku Elam 10ku bekyuli bani na Asnapar ɔni náƒɔ lɛnyi mmɔ ɔ́bɔku, na úti-ma útákya Samaria ku bakladi bani nkya ketu ɔvi kudɔ.”
11Na ɔku ɔni na béti bémene Ɔga Artasasta kemmo etemila ndi amɛni.
“Ɔ́si ƒula kabla bablane banana bani nkya ketu ɔvi kudɔ.
12“Bɔɔyɔ́ ka ɔga ɔti ka Yudaƒuɔ bani nási ƒula kudɔ na bébo-bu kudɔ, bésie bákya Yerusalem na básɔku likyulikpi ku atuɔkplu ɔma unengudi ɔmmɔ baatú. Na básɔku nwuna awodu lɛnɔ baatú. Na benye baaklibi ekpo ekpo ani na ébie lɛnɔ.
13“Na bɔɔyá na asɔ ati ka, si básɔku ɔma unengudi ɔmmɔ bátu ku nwuna awodu ni, bekyuli bammɔ basɔ baaadubo kuyii kɔni na ékulo éte-ma bɔƒɔ. Na ɔma kavumi kadubo bɔbwɛ.
14“Ɔsika bula ƒui bubo kuƒi ka bɔnu ka ƒula lɛgadi liisié anumi. Na bulayɔ ka ala amɛni udu ataalɛ. Ɔmmɔ ɔsu bɔɔyɔ́ ka 15ebo ɔda na bawia ƒula bati kuuku kɔkunkɛ kemmo banu. Si ábla lɛni ni, adubɔnu bɔti ka ɔma unengudi ɔmɛni ni, ɔdi atuɔkplu ɔma. Na ɔ́si kukuuku ƒui ni, ɔɔta teenye bagadine lɛlɔ. Na bekyuli bammɔ bɔda bubo ɔkplu. Na ɔmmɔ ɔsu ɔlɛka bayila ɔma ɔmmɔ udu.
16“Anwuɔsu bɔɔnu ka si áya na básɔku ɔma unengudi ɔmmɔ ku ana awodu bátu ni, bula ɔga ɔbune, asɔ alakana ɔvi ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ bɔnu.”
17Amu na ɔga ɔmmɔ údie kakunkɛ kani bénweni-nwu kenye na úti úmene ɔnii,
“Rehum ɔni ndi bekpone unengu ku ɔku unwenine Simsai ku nwuna bekyuli bakladi bani nli Samaria ku ketu ɔvi ƒui bɔɔkya-mii kenye.
18“Ɔku ɔni na bíti bímene-bu mmɔ ni, báka na bédie-nwu kalɔ na mina anumi. 19Líbo ɔda na báwia bati kuuku kɔkunkɛ kemmo na bɔ́nu bɔ́ti ka ɔma unengudi ɔmɛni ɔ́si kuuku ƒui ni, bébo atuɔkplu na báata teenye bagadine lɛlɔ. 20Na Yerusalem ɔdi kalɔ kani na baga bani na bebo ɔkplu báadi-ka lɛlɔ dii. Na bátaaƒɔ kuyii teete-ma.
21“Anwuɔsu bibo bekyuli bammɔ ɔda na bada kabla kammɔ baya, kalɛ na basɔ balátu ɔma ɔmmɔ utédu ka básɔ béte kuƒi. 22Na bɛnu kaduɛ kalɛ na beledie litemi lɛmɛni atu na likpidi lɛdi lilebo-mi lɛlɔ.”
23Ka báka Ɔga Artasasta ɔku ɔmmɔ béte Rehum ku ɔku unwenine Simsai ku bakladi pɛ, kani na bésie Yudaƒuɔ bani nkya Yerusalem na bénye-ma lɛlɔ ka bada kabla kammɔ baya.
24Ɔmmɔ ɔsu Katɔti kaduli bɔtu na Yerusalem údi únye útédu lɛkwa linyɔdi lɛni lɛlɔ na Ɔga Dario ulie liboku lɛlɔ.

english_text:
1 Then the Lord God of Israel told the prophets Haggai and Zechariah to speak in his name to the people of Judah and Jerusalem. And they did. 2 So Zerubbabel the governor and Joshua the priest urged the people to start working on the temple again, and God's prophets encouraged them.
3Governor Tattenai of Western Province and his assistant Shethar Bozenai got together with some of their officials. Then they went to Jerusalem and said to the people, “Who told you to rebuild this temple? 4Give us the names of the workers!”
5But God was looking after the Jewish leaders. So the governor and his group decided not to make the people stop working on the temple until they could report to Darius and get his advice.
6Governor Tattenai, Shethar Bozenai, and their advisors sent a report to Darius, 7which said:
King Darius, we wish you the best! 8We went to Judah, where the temple of the great God is being built with huge stones and wooden beams set in the walls. Everyone is working hard, and the building is going up quickly.
9We asked those in charge to tell us who gave them permission to rebuild the temple. 10We also asked for the names of their leaders, so that we could write them down for you.
11They claimed to be servants of the God who rules heaven and earth. And they said they were rebuilding the temple that was built many years ago by one of Israel's greatest kings.
12 We were told that their people had made God angry, and he let them be captured by Nebuchadnezzar, the Babylonian king who took them away as captives to Babylonia. Nebuchadnezzar tore down their temple, 13-15 took its gold and silver articles, and put them in the temple of his own god in Babylon.
They also said that during the first year Cyrus was king of Babylonia, he gave orders for God's temple to be rebuilt in Jerusalem where it had stood before. So Cyrus appointed Sheshbazzar governor of Judah and sent these gold and silver articles for him to put in the temple. 16Sheshbazzar then went to Jerusalem and laid the foundation for the temple, and the work is still going on.
17Your Majesty, please order someone to look up the old records in Babylonia and find out if King Cyrus really did give orders to rebuild God's temple in Jerusalem. We will do whatever you think we should.
translation_text:
Katɔti Kaduli Bɔtu Bɔ́sɔ Búse Kalɔ
1Uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, Kenye Udiene Hagai ku Sakaria ɔni ndi Ido ubidi bése kalɔ baatɛmi teete Yudaƒuɔ bani nli Yerusalem. 2Amu na Sealtiel ubidi Serubabel ku Yosadak ubidi Yesua bénu bana etemila ani baasu mmɔ, na básɔ bése kalɔ báatu Unwoti kakpakɔ na Yerusalem. Na kenye bediene inyɔ bammɔ béte-ma kebunku.
3Uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo kani ni, kalɔ lɛlɔ ɔdine Tatenai ɔni mɔɔnu ketu ɔvi bekyuli lɛlɔ ku Setar-Bosnai ku nwuna kabla bablane bébo Yerusalem na béye-ma banini, “Ɔma néte-mii kuƒi ka bɛtu kakpakɔ kamɛni ku nwuna awodu?” 4Na béye-ma lɛnɔ bekyuli bani ƒui nkya muute-ma kebunku na kakpakɔ kammɔ bɔtu anyi. 5Nsu Unwoti anumi asia Yudaƒuɔ benengu bammɔ lɛlɔ, na bátaya na bada bɔtu baya utédu ka béte Ɔga Dario bɔti. Na báƒɔ nwuna kenye budie na kakunkɛ lɛlɔ. 6Na kenye kamɛni na kalɔ lɛlɔ ɔdine Tatenai ɔni mɔɔnu ketu ɔvi bekyuli lɛlɔ ku Setar-Bosnai ku nwuna kabla bablane béti bémene ɔga ɔmmɔ na kakunkɛ lɛlɔ.
7“Ɔga Dario, keyi kayɔku-ɔ na ƒula lɛga lɛni na aadi kemmo.
8“Bula ɔbune, bɔɔyɔ́ ka bute-ɔ bɔti ka bútésie bɔ́vi Yuda kalɛkɛ, na bɔ́nu ka básɔku Unwoti Ɔyikune kakpakɔ baatú. Na bákɔliku atabi ebendi ku kugyiikɛ básia awodu lɛlɔ. Na si ánu adubɔti ka baabla kabla kammɔ kaduɛ na keesíe anumi.
9“Amu na búye batɔnkune bammɔ bɔnii basu-bu ukyuli ɔni néte-ma ɔyikun ka basɔku kakpakɔ kammɔ ku ana awodu batu. 10Na bɔ́sɔ búye-ma bana anyi kalɛ na bɔkɛ benengu bammɔ anyi na buti anyi ammɔ bumene-ɔ.
11“Amu na bédie kenye banini, ‘Bɔdi Katɔti ɔni nédie katɔ ku kalɔ kabla bablane. Na Unwoti kakpakɔ kani na Israelƒuɔ ɔga ɔdi ɔni mbo ɔyikun ɔ́tu dii ni, bɔ́sɔku ka bɔɔtú. 12Nsu ka bula bati kuuku bákya Katɔti ɔni nédie katɔ ku kalɔ kɔnyi ɔsu ni, ɔ́ya na Ɔga Nebukadnesar ɔni ndi Babilonƒuɔ ɔga na ɔdi Kaldeani úbegyingya kakpakɔ kamɛni na ɔ́yila-ka udu. Na úti bula bekyuli útákya Babilonƒuɔ kalɔ.
13“ ‘Nsu na lɛkwa lideedi lɛni na Ɔga Kores ɔɔdi lɛga na Babilon ni, Ɔga Kores ɔmɛni úte kakunkɛ na úbo ɔda ka bɔsɔku Katɔti kakpakɔ bɔtu. 14Na ɔga ɔmɛni muedi ni, ɔ́mami sika ugyiedi ku ɔƒualadi ɔni béti bámana Babilonƒuɔ kakpakɔ ɔtɔ ka beti batu Katɔti kaduli. Na sika ugyiedi ku ɔƒualadi ɔmmɔ na Nebukadnesar úti ɔ́siku Yerusalem kakpakɔ na úti útése Babilonƒuɔ kakpakɔ. Na Ɔga Kores úti sika ala ammɔ úte ɔnana ɔni baalɔ bani Sesbasar. Ɔsika anwu na údie aban ɔgadine ka utaanu Yuda kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ. 15Na Ɔga Kores ɔmmɔ ɔ́su-nwu ka ɔsɔku sika ala ammɔ utése Yerusalem kakpakɔ na ɔsɔku-ka ɔtu. Na kesii kani na bátu-ka kudeedi mmɔ. 16Anwuɔsu Sesbasar ɔmmɔ úbo na úbeseku ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ kalɔ ku bɔtu. Na ɔ́si uwi ɔmmɔ úbedu ɔƒɛni ni, ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ kabla kammɔ kenye kpakplaa, nsu bútawɔlɔ tɔ bɔtu.’
17“Ɔƒɛni ni, Ɔga Ɔbune, ya na bekyuli beduo kɔkunkɛ kɔni nse ɔga kaduli na Babilon na bawia si Ɔga Kores úbo ɔda dii ka basɔku Yerusalem kakpakɔ kammɔ batu. Na ete-bu bɔti na aya bɔti ƒula kasusu lɛnɔ na litemi lɛmɛni lɛlɔ.”

english_text:
King Cyrus' Order Is Rediscovered
1King Darius ordered someone to go through the old records kept in Babylonia. 2Finally, a scroll was found in Ecbatana, the capital of Media Province, and it said:
This official record will show 3that in the first year Cyrus was king, he gave orders to rebuild God's temple in Jerusalem, so that sacrifices and offerings could be presented there. It is to be built 27 meters high and 27 meters wide, 4with one row of wooden beams for each three rows of large stones. The royal treasury will pay for everything. 5Then the gold and silver things that Nebuchadnezzar took from the temple and brought to Babylonia are to be returned to their proper places.
King Darius Orders the Work To Continue
6King Darius sent this message:
Governor Tattenai of Western Province and Shethar Bozenai, you and your advisors must stay away from the temple. 7Let the Jewish governor and leaders rebuild it where it stood before. And stop slowing them down!
8Starting at once, I am ordering you to help the leaders by paying their expenses from the tax money collected in Western Province. 9And don't fail to let the priests in Jerusalem have whatever they need each day so they can offer sacrifices to the God of heaven. Give them young bulls, rams, sheep, as well as wheat, salt, wine, and olive oil. 10I want them to be able to offer pleasing sacrifices to God and to pray for me and my family.
11If any of you don't obey this order, a wooden beam will be taken from your house and sharpened on one end. Then it will be driven through your body, and your house will be torn down and turned into a garbage dump. 12I ask the God who is worshiped in Jerusalem to destroy any king or nation who tries either to change what I have said or to tear down his temple. I, Darius, give these orders, and I expect them to be followed carefully.
The Temple Is Dedicated
13Governor Tattenai, Shethar Bozenai, and their advisors carefully obeyed King Darius. 14 With great success the Jewish leaders continued working on the temple, while Haggai and Zechariah encouraged them by their preaching. And so, the temple was completed at the command of the God of Israel and by the orders of kings Cyrus, Darius, and Artaxerxes of Persia. 15On the third day of the month of Adar in the sixth year of the rule of Darius, the temple was finished.
16The people of Israel, the priests, the Levites, and everyone else who had returned from exile were happy and celebrated as they dedicated God's temple. 17One hundred bulls, two hundred rams, and four hundred lambs were offered as sacrifices at the dedication. Also twelve goats were sacrificed as sin offerings for the twelve tribes of Israel. 18Then the priests and Levites were assigned their duties in God's temple in Jerusalem, according to the instructions Moses had written.
The Passover
19 Everyone who had returned from exile celebrated Passover on the fourteenth day of the first month. 20The priests and Levites had gone through a ceremony to make themselves acceptable to lead in worship. Then some of them killed Passover lambs for those who had returned, including the other priests and themselves.
21The sacrifices were eaten by the Israelites who had returned and by the neighboring people who had given up the sinful customs of other nations in order to worship the Lord God of Israel. 22For seven days they celebrated the Festival of Thin Bread. Everyone was happy because the Lord God of Israel had made sure that the king of Assyria would be kind to them and help them build the temple.
translation_text:
Bánu Ɔga Kores Kakunkɛ Kani Na Únweni
1Anwuɔsu Ɔga Dario úbo ɔda na báwia kuuku lɛku lɛbɛladi lɛni nse egulabi kesekɔ na Babilon mmɔ kemmo bánu. 2Nsu ɔma kagyumanakɔ kpakplaa kani nkya ɔma unengudi ɔni baalɔ banii Ahmeta na Media kalɛkɛ na bátánu kakunkɛ kammɔ. Na bénweni bákya banini,
3“Na Ɔga Kores lɛga bɔdi lɛkwa lideedi kemmo ni, úbo ɔda ka basɔku Yerusalem kakpakɔ batu aani kesii kani na bataabla akpala.
“Na kakpakɔ kammɔ bɔkuku bɔdi lɛgba bɔka liti ku aavlene na nwuna bɔbɛbɛ lɛnɔ bɔbla lɛni kani. 4Na nwuna awodu ni, beti ligyii basia atabi atɛ lɛlɔ. Na kayu biala na kadanku kabla kammɔ lɛlɔ ni, na bedie basiku ɔga kavumi kemmo. 5Lɛnɔ ni, sika ugyiedi ku ɔƒualadi ɔni na Ɔga Nebukadnesar úti ɔ́siku Yerusalem kakpakɔ na úti úbese Babilon ni, basɔku besienku Yerusalem na beti bese kesii kani béti-nwu.”
Ɔga Dario Úbo Ɔda Ka Kabla Kammɔ Kesie Anumi
6Amu na Ɔga Dario úti kakunkɛ kamɛni úmene.
“Amii Tatenai ketu ɔvi kalɔ lɛlɔ ɔnune ku Setar-Bosnai ku bina kabla benengu bani nkya ketu ɔvi, bɛtɔlɔ kakpakɔ kammɔ kudɔ biteesie. 7Na bitebile kabla kammɔ anumi busie. Na bɛya na Yudaƒuɔ benengu basɔku Katɔti kakpakɔ batu na kesii kani na báka-ka bɔtu kudeedi.
8“Na ɔƒɛni ni, muubó-mii ɔda na lɛla lɛni na ɔlɛka bɛbla bite Yudaƒuɔ benengu bamɛni na ɔtɔ ɔmɛni bɔtu kemmo.
“Kayu kani ƒui na bekyuli bamɛni badubo bubo ni, ɔdi ka baƒɔ-ka basiku ɔga kavumi kani na bekyuli bani nkya ketu ɔvi béeyi taabakya-ka kemmo, kalɛ na kabla kammɔ kelédi kelenye. 9Na lɛla biala na Yerusalem bakpane badubo bɔwia aani ɔmantɛ bakɔ iye edula ebi iye mma iye nnɔ iye ntɛ ka beteeti taabla limeyi ndi limeyi akpala na Katɔti ɔni nkya Katɔ kakpakɔ ni, na beteete-ma na beteni ɔdi bute. 10Bɛbla ala amɛni kalɛ na babla akpala ani na maƒɔ Katɔti ɔni nkya katɔ anu, na bataakpali Katɔ teete ɔga ɔmmɔ ku bebi kadia.
11“Na ɔni nsɔ nsia ni, muubó ɔda ka ukyuli biala na wavumana lɛla lɛni na lɛ́lɛ ugyii mɛni ni, nwuna lɛsa na badubo ɔta bɔni budie na baƒala-nwu ugyii ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ. Na likpidi lɛni na ɔ́bla ɔsu ni, badubɔgyingya nwuna ɔtɔ umodi ɔmmɔ balɛ lisu aani alakpi. 12Na mɔɔkpali Katɔti ɔni náya na nwuna lɛnyi lɛ́kɛ keliekɔ na mmɔ ka ɔtu ɔga biala iye bekyuli bani mata menye lɛla lɛmɛni lɛlɔ iye bakali ka babwɛ kakpakɔ kammɔ na Yerusalem udie ntɛ bɔmmɔ.
“Ami Dario nébo ɔda lɛni. Bɛnu ka bɛ́sia anu na bɛ́di-mu lɛlɔ ulu lɛlɔ siin.”
Bátu Kakpakɔ Báwɔlɔ Na Béti-ka Bákya Katɔti Lɛkɔkɔ
13Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Ɔga Dario ɔda bubo bɔni na úti úmene aban ɔgadine Tatenai ɔni mɔɔnu bani nkya Euƒrate Ketu ɔvi lɛlɔ ku Setar-Bosnai ku bana bebunkune ɔsu ni, básia anu na bábla lɛla biala ulu lɛlɔ. 14Anwuɔsu Yudaƒuɔ benengu bésie anumi ku bana bɔtu kabla kammɔ na bálɛ lili geen ɔkɛnku kenye udiene Hagai ku Sakaria ɔni ndi Ido kaba kemmo ubi etemila kenye budie teete-ma ɔsu. Na báwɔlɔ kakpakɔ kammɔ bɔtu aani kalɛ na Israel Katɔti ɔ́tina ku Ɔga Kores ku Dario ku Artasasta bani ndi Persiaƒuɔ baga ɔda ɔni na bébo-ma ɔsu. 15Báwɔlɔ kakpakɔ kammɔ bɔtu na Yudaƒuɔ kɔbuli kɔni baalɔ Ada kuna limeyi lɛtɛdi lɛlɔ na Ɔga Dario lɛga bɔdi lɛkwa lɛkundi kemmo.
16Amu na Yudaƒuɔ ku bakpane ku Lewiƒuɔ bammɔ ƒui bádi kakpakɔ kammɔ buti taakya Katɔti lɛkɔkɔ limeyi ku lɛlɔyɔ. 17Na kakpakɔ buti taakya Katɔti lɛkɔkɔ limeyi lɛmɛni bɔdi kemmo ni, béte ɔmantɛ bɔkɔ eti anyɔ ku baƒonu bagyani eti ene ku baƒonu bagyani bakɔdi eti maane ka beti babla likpidi buti taakyiɛ buvele akpala na Israel kadi bekyuli ƒui lili. Na béte betukpa leevu-inyɔ na Israelƒuɔ adua leevu-anyɔ ammɔ kenye. 18Na báya na bakpane bammɔ ku Lewiƒuɔ bammɔ bénye bana kunyekɔ na bana esu esu kenye na Yerusalem ka babla kabla bete Katɔti aani kalɛ na bénweni bákya Mose Ɔku kemmo.
Kukpi Lili Bɔvia Lɛlɔ Litemi
19Na Yudaƒuɔ kɔbuli kudeedi limeyi leevu-linedi lɛlɔ ni, bekyuli bani na béƒie bátɔlɔku mmɔ bádi Kukpi Lili Bɔvia Limeyi. 20Na bakpane ku Lewiƒuɔ bammɔ békisi lɛlɔ na bábla lɛlɔ bɔbla sɛɛn ɔdi ɔmmɔ. Na Lewiƒuɔ bammɔ bádu Kukpi Lili Bɔvia koƒonu ubi béte bekyuli beƒiedi bammɔ ƒui ku bana banwani ku bakpane ku ama alati lɛnɔ bana lɛlɔ. 21Ɔmmɔ ɔsu bekyuli beƒiedi bani nénwini bébo mmɔ ƒui bádi, úbunku kadi bamba bekyuli bani náda lɛlɔ bámami bana banwani ku bana ablala ƒui lɛlɔ ka basiaku Israel Katɔti kama. 22Na emeyi maatɛ na béti bádi Bodobodo Ɔni Néteƒu Limeyi ku lɛlɔyɔ, ɔsika Katɔti ɔ́ya na lɛlɔyɔ lɛ́ƒɔ-ma lɛlɔ kemmo ɔkɛnku kalɛ na ɔ́ya na Asiriaƒuɔ ɔga ɔ́vumana nwuna ɔbladu na úbunku na bátu Katɔti ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ béte Israel Katɔti ɔsu.

english_text:
Ezra Comes to Jerusalem
1-6Much later, when Artaxerxes was king of Persia, Ezra came to Jerusalem from Babylonia. Ezra was the son of Seraiah and the grandson of Azariah. His other ancestors were Hilkiah, Shallum, Zadok, Ahitub, Amariah, Azariah, Meraioth, Zerahiah, Uzzi, Bukki, Abishua, Phinehas, Eleazar, and Aaron, the high priest.
Ezra was an expert in the Law that the Lord God of Israel had given to Moses, and the Lord made sure that the king gave Ezra everything he asked for.
7Other Jews, including priests, Levites, musicians, the temple guards, and servants, came to Jerusalem with Ezra. This happened during the seventh year that Artaxerxes was king.
8-9God helped Ezra, and he arrived in Jerusalem on the first day of the fifth month of that seventh year, after leaving Babylonia on the first day of the first month. 10Ezra had spent his entire life studying and obeying the Law of the Lord and teaching it to others.
Artaxerxes Gives a Letter to Ezra
11Ezra was a priest and an expert in the laws and commands that the Lord had given to Israel. One day King Artaxerxes gave Ezra a letter which said:
12 Greetings from the great King Artaxerxes to Ezra the priest and expert in the teachings of the God of heaven.
13-14Any of the people of Israel or their priests or Levites in my kingdom may go with you to Jerusalem if they want to. My seven advisors and I agree that you may go to Jerusalem and Judah to find out if the laws of your God are being obeyed.
15When you go, take the silver and gold that I and my advisors are freely giving to the God of Israel, whose temple is in Jerusalem. 16Take the silver and gold that you collect from everywhere in Babylonia. Also take the gifts that your own people and priests have so willingly contributed for the temple of your God in Jerusalem.
17Use the money carefully to buy the best bulls, rams, lambs, grain, and wine. Then sacrifice them on the altar at God's temple in Jerusalem. 18If any silver or gold is left, you and your people may use it for whatever pleases your God. 19Give your God the other articles that have been contributed for use in his temple. 20If you need to get anything else for the temple, you may have the money you need from the royal treasury.
21Ezra, you are a priest and an expert in the laws of the God of heaven, and I order all treasurers in Western Province to do their very best to help you. 22They will be allowed to give as much as 3.4 tons of silver, 10 tons of wheat, 2,000 liters of wine, 2,000 liters of olive oil, and all the salt you need.
23They must provide whatever the God of heaven demands for his temple, so that he won't be angry with me and with the kings who rule after me. 24We want you to know that no priests, Levites, musicians, guards, temple servants, or any other temple workers will have to pay any kind of taxes.
25Ezra, use the wisdom God has given you and choose officials and leaders to govern the people of Western Province. These leaders should know God's laws and have them taught to anyone who doesn't know them. 26Everyone who fails to obey God's Law or the king's law will be punished without pity. They will either be executed or put in prison or forced to leave their country, or have all they own taken away.
Ezra Praises God
27Because King Artaxerxes was so kind, Ezra said:
Praise the Lord God of our ancestors! He made sure that the king honored the Lord's temple in Jerusalem. 28God has told the king, his advisors, and his powerful officials to treat me with kindness. The Lord God has helped me, and I have been able to bring many Jewish leaders back to Jerusalem.
translation_text:
Esra Úsie Yerusalem
1Na ala amɛni kama ni, uwi ɔni na Ɔga Artasasta ɔɔdi lɛga na Persia ni, okloƒu ɔdi ɔkya na baalɔ banii Esra. Na nwuna ɔti ndi Seraia ɔni ɔti ndi Asaria ɔni ɔti ndi Hilkia 2ɔni ɔti ndi Salum ɔni ɔti ndi Sadok ɔni ɔti ndi Ahitub ɔni ɔti ndi 3Amaria ɔni ɔti ndi Asaria ɔni ɔti ndi Meraiot 4ɔni ɔti ndi Serahia ɔni ɔti ndi Usi ɔni ɔti ndi Buki 5ɔni ɔti ndi Abisua ɔni ɔti ndi Pinehas ɔni ɔti Eleasar ɔni ɔti ndi Aaron ɔni ndi Ɔkpane Unengudi.
6Na Esra ɔmɛni lɛnɔ ɔ́si Babilon úbo. Na ɔdi ala ɔtinane ɔni ngyi Mose ɔda bubo etemila ani Israelƒuɔ Katɔti úti úte-ma kaduɛ. Na lɛla biala na úye ɔga ɔmmɔ ni, uuti-ni teete-nwu, ɔsika nwuna Unwoti Katɔti ɔsiku-nwu geen. 7Na Israelƒuɔ badi bani ndi bakpane ku Lewiƒuɔ ku lɛnu batune ku kayakun bagyumanane ku Kakpakɔ kabla bablane badi básiaku-nwu bébo Yerusalem mmɔ na lɛkwa maatɛdi lɛni na Ɔga Artasasta úlie liboku lɛlɔ mmɔ kemmo.
8Na Esra úduo Yerusalem na kɔbuli kɔlɔndi na ɔga ɔmmɔ lɛga bɔdi lɛkwa maatɛdi kemmo. 9Úse nwuna ulu busie kalɔ ɔ́siku Babilon na limeyi lideedi na kɔbuli kudeedi kemmo, na útéduo Yerusalem limeyi lideedi na kɔbuli kɔlɔndi kemmo, ɔsika nwuna Katɔti ndanku-nwu geen ɔkɛ ku nwuna lɛƒɔndia. 10Ɔsika Esra úti lɛlɔ úte Unwoti ɔda bubo bɔtɛya ku kalɛ na badi-mu lɛlɔ, na ɔɔtina ala ammɔ na Israel.
Ɔga Artasasta Únweni Ɔku Úte Esra
11Na ɔku ɔni na Ɔga Artasasta únweni úte Esra ɔni ndi ala ɔtinane ku ɔkpane ku okloƒu ɔni ngyi Unwoti ɔda bubo ku ala ani ƒui na únyimi úte Israelƒuɔ kemmo kaduɛ na búdie mɛni.
12Ɔmɛni ɔ́si baga ƒui Ɔga Artasasta kudɔ na líti muute Ɔkpane Esra ɔni ndi Katɔ ƒui Katɔti ɔda bubo ala ɔtinane.
Mɔɔkya-a kenye.
13Ɔƒɛni muubó ɔda ka Israelni biala na ulie mina kalɔ lɛlɔ ku bakpane ku Lewiƒuɔ lɛnɔ ka si ɔdi ɔɔyɔ́ ka ɔsiaku Esra uteesie Yerusalem ni, kuƒi kɔtɛ. 14Ami ɔga ku mina benengu maatɛ mɔɔtala-a ka teesie Yerusalem ku Yuda na atávi mmɔ bene ƒui na anu kalɛ ƒula Katɔti ɔda bubo ɔku ɔni nkya-a enu kemmo lɛlɔ bɔdi buse na mmɔ. 15Lɛnɔ ni, si ésela na eti sika ɔƒualadi ku ugyiedi ɔni na ɔga ku nwuna benengu béte-ɔ, na eti esienku Israelƒuɔ Katɔti ɔni keliekɔ ndi Yerusalem mmɔ. 16Lɛnɔ ni, na eti sika ugyiedi ku ɔƒualadi ɔni ƒui na adubɔkɛ na Babilon kalɛkɛ ku kaƒɔ ƒaa etela ani ƒui na Israelƒuɔ ku bakpane bani nkya mmɔ badubute-ɔ ka eti etébunku bana Katɔti kakpakɔ kani nkya Yerusalem bɔtu. 17Na ada egulabi ani búti búte-ɔ mmɔ kaduɛ. Na eti eye ɔmantɛ bakɔ ku bakɔ bakɔdi ku baƒonu bakɔdi ku kakpa ku ntɛ na eti abla akpala na Katɔti kakpakɔ lɛkpabi lɛni nkya Yerusalem mmɔ lɛlɔ.
18Na sika ɔƒualadi ku ugyiedi ɔni mebu ni, akana na awɔ ku ƒula banwani biti bɛbla lɛla na biala bɛɛyɔ́ na lɛkɛnku ƒula Katɔti lɛƒɔyɔ lɛlɔ. 19Na eti akyami ani búti búte-ɔ ka beti bataabla Kakpakɔ kammɔ ala ete Katɔti. 20Na lɛla bamba biala na aawia ka abla na Kakpakɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ ni, na edie asiku ɔga egulabi kavumi kammɔ kemmo.
21Ami Ɔga Artasasta muubó ketu ɔvi egulabi badane bammɔ ƒui ɔda ka lɛla biala na Ɔkpane Esra ɔni ndi Katɔti ɔda bubo ala ɔtinane ɔɔwia ɔsiku-mii kudɔ 22ɔ́si sika ɔƒualadi antabi aƒo bonwu avlaatɛ unu ku kakpa akyami eti leevu ku ntɛ lɛsii eti leevu ku nnɔ lɛsii eti leevu ku mma bumomo kalɛ biala na ɔɔwia ni, bite-nwu. 23Na bɛsia anu kaduɛ na bite lɛla biala na Unwoti ɔni nkya Katɔ ɔ́su úse ka beti babla nwuna kakpakɔ lɛlɔ kabla siin lɛni kani, kalɛ na ulákɛ kɔnyi ulakya-mi iye ukyuli ɔni melie-mi kenye. 24Na mɔɔyá na bɛti ka ukyuli biala uuubo kenyekɔ kadi na ɔƒɔ kuyii ɔsiku bakpane iye Lewiƒuɔ iye kabla bablane iye ukyuli biala ɔni mɔɔbla kabla kadi na kakpakɔ kammɔ kemmo kudɔ.
25Na awɔ, Esra, ti lɛnunda lɛni na ƒula Katɔti úte-ɔ na awia litemi batɛne bani ngyi ƒula Katɔti ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ala na bataatɛ ketu ɔvi badi bammɔ litemi. Na bani na baaagyi ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ lɛnɔ ni, na atina-ma ala. 26Na ukyuli ɔni na uládi ƒula Katɔti ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ iye ɔga ɔda bubo lɛlɔ ni, ɔlɛka badu-nwu iye babɔku-nwu balɛku kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ iye beti kɔnu basia nwuna akɛla ƒui lɛlɔ iye bakya-nwu ɔtɔ kɔnakunwi.
27Amu na Esra úmwi Katɔti ɔnini, “Bemwi Unwoti bula bati kuuku Katɔti ɔni néti lɛla lɛmɛni ɔ́kya ɔga kayi kemmo kalɛ na ɔsia ulu ɔmɛni lɛlɔ na úti ɔbu úte Unwoti kakpakɔ na Yerusalem. 28Na ɔ́bla-mi lɛƒɔndia na ɔga ɔmmɔ ku nwuna kasusu bakyane ku nwuna benengu bayikune bammɔ ƒui anumi. Na ɔkɛnku ɔmmɔ ɔsu na líse kayi na lítiku Israel batɔnkune na básiaku-mi na bɔ́kɔ búsie Yerusalem.”

Ɔtɔ Benengu Bamɛni Básiaku Esra
1Bekyuli bani anyi ndubo mɛni ndi lɛtɔ benengu bani anyi na bénweni bébunku bani ƒui násiaku Esra bási Babilon bénwini bébo Yerusalem na Ɔga Artasasta lɛga bɔdi uwi.
2Pinehas kaba ni, Gersom,
Itamar kaba ni, Daniel,
Dawid kaba ni, Hatus, 3na ɔ́si Sekania kaba kemmo.
Paros kaba ni, Sakaria, na bana banana bumomo bɔdi 150.
4Pahat-Moab kaba ni, Serahia ubidi Eliehoenai, na bana banana 200 nsiaku-nwu.
5Na Sekania kaba ni, Yahasiel ubidi, na bana banana 300 nsiaku-nwu.
6Na Adin kaba ni, Yonatan ubidi Ebed, na bana banana 50 nsiaku-nwu.
7Na Elam kaba ni, Atalia ubidi Yesaia, na banana 70 nsiaku-nwu.
8Na Seƒatia kaba ni, Mikael ubidi Sebadia, na banana 80 nsiaku-nwu.
9Na Yoab kaba ni, Yehiel ubidi Obadia, na bana banana 218 nsiaku-nwu.
10Na Bani kaba ni, Yosiƒia ubidi Selomit na bana banana 160 nsiaku-nwu.
11Na Bebai kaba ni, Bebai ubidi Sakaria, na bana banana 28 nsiaku-nwu.
12Na Asgad kaba ni, Hakatan ubidi Yahona, na banana 110 nsiaku-nwu.
13Na Adonikam kaba kekplodi ni, bana anyii mɛni, Eliƒelet ku Yeiel ku Semaia, na bana banana 60 nsiaku-ma.
14Na Bigwai kaba ni, Utai ku Sabud, na bana banana 70 nsiaku-ma.
Kalɛ Na Bénwini Bésie Yerusalem
15Amu na ami Esra lɛ́ya na bekyuli bani ƒui nsiaku-mi mmɔ bédi bénye ketu kani mɔɔgbá taavi Ahawa ɔma kemmo mmɔ. Na bɔ́kya mmɔ emeyi atɛ sɔɔn. Na mmɔ na lɛ́nu ka bakpane bakya bekyuli bammɔ akɔ. Nsu Lewiƒuɔ beeebo-ma kemmo. 16Amu na lɛ́tala na bátálɔ batɔnkune bani ndi Elieser ku Ariel ku Semaia ku Elnatan ku Yarib ku Elnatan ku Natan ku Sakaria ku Mesulam ku ala batinane inyɔ bani ndi Yoiarib ku Elnatan béboku-mi. 17Na lɛ́tala-ma lɛ́kya Ido ɔni ndi Kasiƒia ɔtɔnkune kudɔ. Na lɛ́su-ma lɛla lɛni na badubusie batásu Ido ku nwuna banwani ku kakpakɔ kabla bablane bani nkya Kasiƒia ɔma kemmo mmɔ kalɛ na bawia bekyuli badi bemene-bu na bababla kabla na Katɔti kakpakɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ.
18Na ka bula Katɔti kɔnu kɔsia-bu lɛlɔ ɔsu ni, bákpanku ɔbune Serebia ɔni na ɔ́si Lewi ubidi Mahli ɔni ɔti ndi Israel kaba kemmo ku nwuna banwani ku nwuna bebi leevu-maane béboku. 19Na Hasabia ku Yesaia bani nási Merari kaba kemmo ku bana badi aavlanyɔ lɛnɔ básiaku-ma bébo. 20Na úbunku bammɔ ni, bekyuli bani na Dawid ku nwuna benengu bédie bése ka bataabla kakpakɔ kammɔ kabla teebunku Lewiƒuɔ na bana bumomo bɔdi 220 ni, bákpanku ama lɛnɔ béboku. Na bénweni bana ƒui anyi bákya ɔku kemmo.
21Amu uwi ɔni na búdu Ahawa Ketu kudɔ ni, mmɔ na líbo ɔda na ɔ́ya na búnyimi kenye kalɛ na buboku lɛlɔ kalɔ na Katɔti anumi na buvele-nwu ka ɔgyumana abu ku bula bebi ku bula ala ani ƒui na bɔdanku kalɛ na bula ulu busie bɔbla buɛɛ. 22Kɔƒa kuukpó-mi ka lɛsu ɔga ɔmmɔ na ute-mi bekpone ku bapɔnkɔ beliene na bagyumana-bu balɛku bula bekisine enu kemmo, ɔsika lɛ́su ɔga ɔmmɔ nnini, “Bula Katɔti kɔnyana bɔnu ɔdanku ukyuli biala ɔni mɔɔsia-nwu anu. Na nwuna kɔnyi kɔɔsiaku ukyuli biala menwini kama makya-nwu.” 23Anwuɔsu búnyimi kenye na búti etemila ammɔ bɔ́va Katɔti anumi na únu bula bɔkpali.
24Amu na lídie bakpane benengu leevu-inyɔ na Serebia ku Hasabia bebunku-ma ku bana banwani leevu líbunku-ma lɛlɔ. 25Na lɛ́kɔku sika ugyiedi ku ɔƒualadi ku akyami ani na ɔga ku nwuna kasusu bakyane ku benengu bamba ku Israelƒuɔ ƒui béyi ka béti bebunku Katɔti kakpakɔ kammɔ kabla. Na líti-nya líte bakpane bammɔ. 26Na ala ani na líti líte-ma ndi sika ɔƒualadi ebi antabi aƒo bonwu 250 unu ku sika ɔƒualadi ala kɔlɛmii antabi aƒo avlaatɛ unu. 27Na líte-ma sika ugyiedi antabi akyami bonwu aavlanyɔ ani kuye ndubɔbla sika ugyiedi ebi apim unwi.
28Amu na lɛ́su-ma nnii, “Amii ku sika ugyiedi ku ɔƒualadi ɔmmɔ ƒui ni, bɛdi ala ani bédie bese sɛsɛɛ béte Unwoti. Na sika ɔƒualadi ku ugyiedi ɔmmɔ ni, adi kaƒɔ ƒaa etela akpala ete Katɔti ɔni ndi bina bati kuuku Katɔti. 29Bɛgyumana ala ammɔ kaduɛ utédu ka bɛ́kɔku-nya na Unwoti kaduli kani nkya Yerusalem. Na bakpane benengu ku Lewiƒuɔ ku Israelƒuɔ lɛtɔ benengu bammɔ anumi.” 30Mmɔ ni, bakpane ku Lewiƒuɔ bammɔ báƒɔ sika ugyiedi ku ɔƒualadi ɔni bákɔku bánu mmɔ ku ala akladi ani na ɔdi ka beti besienku Katɔti Kaduli na Yerusalem mmɔ.
31Na limeyi leevu-linyɔdi na kɔbuli kudeedi kemmo ni, bɔ́ta bɔ́si Ahawa Ketudɔ na búti anumi bɔ́tina Yerusalem na Katɔti ɔdanku-bu. Na ɔ́gyumana-bu ɔ́lɛku bula bekisine ƒui enu kemmo na ulu lɛlɔ. 32Ɔmmɔ ɔsu bútéduo Yerusalem na bɔ́nwuna emeyi atɛ na mmɔ.
33Na limeyi linedi lɛlɔ ni, búti sika ɔƒualadi ku ugyiedi ɔni bɔ́kɔku ku ala akladi ƒui búsienku Katɔti kaduli na bútákɔku-nya búte Uria ubidi Meremot ɔni ndi ɔkpane ku Pinehas ubidi Eleasar ɔni muubunku-nwu. Na Lewiƒuɔ bani ndi Yesua ubidi Yosabad ku Binui ubidi Noadia lɛnɔ bénye mmɔ ɔdi. 34Na bákɔku lɛla biala na nina bɔkɔku ku bumomo kenye na bénweni bákya ɔku kemmo bése uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo.
35Na bekyuli bani ƒui na kekpo kéƒie na ami ku-ma búnwini búbo mmɔ ni, bábla bɔkyula akpala béte Israel Katɔti. Na bada ɔmantɛ bakɔ leevu-inyɔ ku baƒonu bagyani liti ku aavlene-ɛku ku baƒonu bagyani bakɔdi liti ku aavlanyɔ-maatɛ. Na béti betukpa leevu-inyɔ bábla likpidi butitakyiɛ buvele akpala. Na ala amɛni ƒui na básala bábla bɔkyula akpala ammɔ béte Katɔti. 36Na béti ɔga kɔkunkɛ kɔni ndanku ɔda ɔni na úbo béte aban bagadine ku kɔlɛkɛ kɔni na Euƒrate Ketu ɔvi lɛlɔ badine benengu bammɔ na bénu kalɔ na béte kebunku na Katɔti ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ bɔtu kemmo.

english_text:
Ezra Condemns Mixed Marriages
1Later the Jewish leaders came to me and said:
Many Israelites, including priests and Levites, are living just like the people around them. They are even guilty of some of the horrible sins of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Jebusites, the Ammonites, the Moabites, the Egyptians, and the Amorites.
2Some Israelite men have married foreign women and have let their sons do the same thing. Our own officials and leaders were the first to commit this disgusting sin, and now God's holy people are mixed with foreigners.
3This news made me so angry that I ripped my clothes and tore hair from my head and beard. Then I just sat in shock 4until the time for the evening sacrifice. Many of our people were greatly concerned and gathered around me, because the God of Israel had warned us to stay away from foreigners.
Ezra's Prayer
5At the time of the evening sacrifice, I was still sitting there in sorrow with my clothes all torn. So I got down on my knees, then lifted my arms, 6and prayed:
I am much too ashamed to face you, Lord God. Our sins and our guilt have swept over us like a flood that reaches up to the heavens. 7Since the time of our ancestors, all of us have sinned. That's why we, our kings, and our priests have often been defeated by other kings. They have killed some of us and made slaves of others; they have taken our possessions and made us ashamed, just as we are today.
8But for now, Lord God, you have shown great kindness to us. You made us truly happy by letting some of us settle in this sacred place and by helping us in our time of slavery. 9We are slaves, but you have never turned your back on us. You love us, and because of you, the kings of Persia have helped us. It's as though you have given us new life! You let us rebuild your temple and live safely in Judah and Jerusalem.
10Our God, what can we say now? Even after all this, we have disobeyed the commands 11that were given to us by your servants the prophets. They said the land you are giving us is full of sinful and wicked people, who never stop doing disgusting things. 12 And we were warned not to let our daughters and sons marry their sons and daughters.
Your prophets also told us never to help those foreigners or even let them live in peace. You wanted us to become strong and to enjoy the good things in the land, then someday to leave it to our children forever.
13You punished us because of our terrible sins. But you did not punish us nearly as much as we deserve, and you have brought some of us back home. 14Why should we disobey your commands again by letting our sons and daughters marry these foreigners who do such disgusting things? That would make you angry enough to destroy us all! 15Lord God of Israel, you have been more than fair by letting a few of us survive. But once again, our sins have made us ashamed to face you.
translation_text:
Esra Ɔ́kpali Katɔti Na Yudaƒuɔ Ku Kadi Bamba Lɛlɔ Buti Lɛlɔ
1Uwi ɔni na báwɔlɔ ala ammɔ ƒui bɔbla ni, Yudaƒuɔ benengu badi bábasu ami Esra banini, “Israelƒuɔ ku Lewiƒuɔ ku bakpane bani nli mɛni lɛnɔ bebunku bekyuli bani nátamami lɛlɔ bétedie bekyuli bani lɛma nkya bula amadɔ aani Kanaanƒuɔ ku Hitiƒuɔ ku Perisiƒuɔ ku Yebusiƒuɔ ku Amonƒuɔ ku Moabƒuɔ ku Egyipteƒuɔ ku Amoriƒuɔ ala bɔbla ani muusé lɛlɔ mmɔ kudɔ. 2Na Yudaƒuɔ ku bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ béeti lɛlɔ. Ɔmmɔ ɔsu Katɔti bekyuli kedee bénwini bekyuli bani néti lɛlɔ básala ku kadi bamba bekyuli. Na benengu bammɔ ku bakutine bammɔ geen ntɔnku udu buɛ ɔmmɔ bɔbla na bálɛ litemi geen lɛmmɔ kama.”
3Amu ka línu ɔmɛni ni, lɛ́ni mina awu lɛ́bwɛ na lɛ́gyɔ mina lili linwini ku ukwi! Na lɛ́yu lílie kalɔ ku bɔyia geen ku kɔnyana. 4Na bekyuli bani ƒui mbo bɔyia bete Israel Katɔti litemi báni béde-mi, na bekyuli bani kekpo kéƒie na báka bunwini bubo litemi lɛlɔ tadi ku ɔbladu buɛ ɔmɛni ɔsu. Kɔnyana ku bɔyia bɔmɛni kemmo na lɛ́ƒɔ mmɔ bulie útédu useyi akpala bɔbla uwi.
5Uwi ɔni na useyi akpala bɔbla uwi údu ni, lɛ́ta na kesii kani na lɛ́yu líwi mmɔ. Nsu na mmu nkya lɛwu lɛni nábuɛ mmɔ. Na lɛ́lɛ akɔnkɔ na lɛ́talaku mina enu katɔ na lɛ́kpali Unwoti Katɔti. 6Na lɛ́su-nwu nnini,
“O mina Katɔti, kɔƒa kuukpó-mi ka lɛtalaku mina anumi katɔ muedi na ƒula anumi. Ɔsika bula ekpidi áakuku etulo-bu na ákuku laa na éedu katɔ. 7Na ɔ́si bula bati kuuku uwi úbedu ɔƒɛni ni, abu bani ndi ƒula bekyuli bɔ́bla likpidi bonwu geen. Na ɔ́si bula ekpidi ɔsu ni, bula baga ku bula bakpane béduo baga babambadi enu kemmo. Na bádu badi na béƒie badi ala báƒɔ, na béƒie badi lɛnɔ bátɔlɔku, na búduo kɔƒa kubendi kemmo aani kalɛ bɔmu buse ɔmwi.
8“Na ɔƒɛni uwi klukui kama mɛni ni, O Unwoti ɔni ndi bula Katɔti, ánu-bu kɔnyana na áya na bula ɛlɛɛ badi búbu, na bɔ́kɛ kakyakɔ kabuni aani ƒula kɔtɔma kedee. Awɔ náya na bula anumi ásɔ ékeye na bɔ́kɛ bɔnwuna bɔ́siku bekyuli bamba lɛlɔ bɔdi kalɔ. 9Ina ka bɔdi bekyuli bamba kabla bablane ni, awɔ Katɔti átanyonu-bu átakya bekyuli bamba lɛlɔ bɔdi lɛbibo lɛmmɔ kemmo. Mmomu ánu-bu ku lɛƒɔndia na Persiaƒuɔ baga anumi na éte-bu ngba bɔwɔdi kalɛ na bɔsɔku Katɔti kakpakɔ bɔtu na bɔtalaku atɔnku ammɔ. Na awɔ nátu bɔgyumana awodu ɔ́mana-bu na Yuda ku Yerusalem.
10“Nsu ɔƒɛni ni, O Katɔti, bi na bɔdubɔsu na ala ani ƒui nálɛ mɛni lɛlɔ? Bula ƒui bútabu ƒula ɔda bubo 11bɔni na éti ásiaku ƒula kabla bablane bani ndi ƒula kenye bediene lɛlɔ anini, ‘Kalɔ kani kemmo na bísela buduo na biti-ka binwini bina kadi mɛni ni, bekyuli bani nákya-ka kemmo bébile-ka ku bana likyulikpi ala bɔbla na ala ani muusé lɛlɔ áƒɔ-ka ƒui tɛɛ ɔ́si ɔvi unwi úsie ɔkladi. 12Ɔmmɔ ɔsu biteti bina bebi belekubi bitete-ma na beti iye bɛya na bina bakloƒu beti bana belekubi. Na bitawia ulu ɔdi na amii ku ama bɛbla unwi na ulu ɔdi lɛlɔ. Na bɛdubɔkɛ ɔlɔkplu na bɛdi ala abuni ani nkya kalɔ kammɔ kemmo na bise bina bebi ku bawɔ kama úsela uwi ƒui.’
13“Ala ani nálɛku-bu ƒui ni, ɔkɛnku bula likyulikpi ku alaekpidi bonwu ani na bɔ́bla ɔsu na úbo-nwu kemmo lɛni. Nsu awɔ bula Katɔti átani-bu kɔtu kɔni námanku bula ekpidi na áya na bula akɔ badi búbu bulie ngba. 14Na bi ɔsu na ɔlɛka bɔsɔ budie ƒula ɔda bubo atu lɛnɔ na abu ku bekyuli bekpidi bamɛni buteeti lɛlɔ? Si bɔ́bla lɛni ni, adubuti kɔnyi akya-bu geen na ayila-bu udu ƒui ɔni na ina ukyuli unwi pɛ ulelie ngba. 15O Unwoti, Israel Katɔti, ese siin! Na ɔmmɔ ɔsu na bula ɛlɛɛ bamɛni búbu bɔkya ngba ɔmwi. Aanu-bu nnye ƒula anumi ku bula bɔsɔ ina ka nka bula akɔ ɔdi ulakana-a anumi bɔda bɔlɛ.”

english_text:
The Plan for Ending Mixed Marriages
1While Ezra was down on his knees in front of God's temple, praying with tears in his eyes and confessing the sins of the people of Israel, a large number of men, women, and children gathered around him and cried bitterly.
2Shecaniah son of Jehiel from the family of Elam said:
Ezra, we have disobeyed God by marrying these foreign women. But there is still hope for the people of Israel, 3if we follow your advice and the advice of others who truly respect the laws of God. We must promise God that we will divorce our foreign wives and send them away, together with their children.
4Ezra, it's up to you to do something! We will support whatever you do. So be brave!
5Ezra stood up and made the chief priests, the Levites, and everyone else in Israel swear that they would follow the advice of Shecaniah. 6Then Ezra left God's temple and went to spend the night in the living quarters of Jehohanan son of Eliashib. He felt sorry because of what the people had done, and he did not eat or drink a thing.
7-8The officials and leaders sent a message to all who had returned from Babylonia and were now living in Jerusalem and Judah. This message told them to meet in Jerusalem within three days, or else they would lose everything they owned and would no longer be considered part of the people that had returned from Babylonia.
9Three days later, on the twentieth day of the ninth month, everyone from Judah and Benjamin came to Jerusalem and sat in the temple courtyard. It was a serious meeting, and they sat there, trembling in the rain.
10Ezra the priest stood up and said:
You have broken God's Law by marrying foreign women, and you have made the whole nation guilty! 11Now you must confess your sins to the Lord God of your ancestors and obey him. Divorce your foreign wives and don't have anything to do with the rest of the foreigners who live around here.
12Everyone in the crowd shouted:
You're right! We will do what you say. 13But there are so many of us, and we can't just stay out here in this downpour. A lot of us have sinned by marrying foreign women, and the matter can't be settled in only a day or two.
14Why can't our officials stay on in Jerusalem and take care of this for us? Let everyone who has sinned in this way meet here at a certain time with leaders and judges from their own towns. If we take care of this problem, God will surely stop being so terribly angry with us.
15Jonathan son of Asahel and Jahzeiah son of Tikvah were the only ones who objected, except for the two Levites, Meshullam and Shabbethai.
16Everyone else who had returned from exile agreed with the plan. So Ezra the priest chose men who were heads of the families, and he listed their names. They started looking into the matter on the first day of the tenth month, 17and they did not finish until the first day of the first month of the next year.
The Men Who Had Foreign Wives
18-19Here is a list of the priests who had agreed to divorce their foreign wives and to sacrifice a ram as a sin offering:
Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib, and Gedaliah from the family of Joshua son of Jozadak and his brothers; 20Hanani and Zebadiah from the family of Immer; 21Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel, and Uzziah from the family of Harim; 22Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad, and Elasah from the family of Pashhur.
23Those Levites who had foreign wives were: Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah (also known as Kelita), Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.
24Eliashib, the musician, had a foreign wife.
These temple guards had foreign wives:
Shallum, Telem, and Uri.
25Here is a list of the others from Israel who had foreign wives:
Ramiah, Izziah, Malchijah, Mijamin, Eleazar, Hashabiah, and Benaiah from the family of Parosh;
26Mattaniah, Zechariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth, and Elijah from the family of Elam;
27Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad, and Aziza from the family of Zattu;
28Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai from the family of Bebai;
29Meshullam, Malluch, Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal, and Jeremoth from the family of Bani;
30Adna, Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui, and Manasseh from the family of Pahath Moab;
31-32Eliezer, Isshijah, Malchijah, Shemaiah, Shimeon, Benjamin, Malluch, and Shemariah from the family of Harim;
33Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, and Shimei from the family of Hashum;
34-37Maadai, Amram, Uel, Benaiah, Bedeiah, Cheluhi, Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Mattenai, and Jaasu from the family of Bani;
38-42Shimei, Shelemiah, Nathan, Adaiah, Machnadebai, Shashai, Sharai, Azarel, Shelemiah, Shemariah, Shallum, Amariah, and Joseph from the family of Binnui;
43Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jaddai, Joel, and Benaiah from the family of Nebo.
44These men divorced their foreign wives, then sent them and their children away.
translation_text:
Bekyuli Bammɔ Bévele Ekpidi Buti Taakyiɛ
1Uwi ɔni Esra ɔkya uubó lɛlɔ taava kalɔ na uuwulo taakpali Katɔti na uudie bana alaekpidi kalɔ teevele buti taakyiɛ na Katɔti kaduli ni, bekyuli lisu pii bábaka bámana-nwu na badi beleku ku banana ku banamu na ama lɛnɔ bakya beewulo momoomo. 2Amu na Yehiel ubidi Sekania ɔni nási Elam kaba kemmo ɔ́kpɛ úde Esra na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Bɔ́lɛ bula Katɔti kama. Ɔsika búsie bɔkya buuti kadi bamba beleku bani nlie nde-bu. Nsu ɔmɛni kama ƒui ni, bɔmu bubo lɛnunsia bute Israelƒuɔ. 3Ɔmmɔ ɔsu ni, ya na bunyimi lɛla lɛdi na Katɔti anumi na bɔbɔku beleku bamɛni ku bana bebi na batɔlɔ ɔkɛnku lɛla lɛni na awɔ ku bekyuli bani mɔɔbu Katɔti ɔda bubo bɛdubɔsu-bu. Na bɛnu ka bɔ́bla lɛla biala bɔ́siaku ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ. 4Ta, na abla lɛla lɛdi asiku litemi lɛmɛni lɛlɔ, na bɔdubunye-ɔ kama. Ɔmmɔ ɔsu kya kayi na esie lɛla lɛdi kalɔ.”
5Ɔmmɔ ɔsu Esra ɔ́ta na ɔ́ya na bakpane ku Lewiƒuɔ benengu ku Israelƒuɔ bakladi bése kenye ka badubɔbla lɛla lɛni na Sekania ɔ́su mmɔ. 6Na ɔmmɔ kama ɔ́ta ɔ́lɛ bekyuli bammɔ akɔ na Kakpakɔ anumi mmɔ, na útéduo Eliasib ubidi Yohanan kaduli na ɔtɛ mmɔ uuwulo usien umodi ɔni na útadi iye útani lɛla lɛdi na kalɛ na Israelƒuɔ bekyuli beƒiedi bani nénwini bébo mmɔ bálɛ Katɔti kama ɔsu.
7Amu na bákɔ lɛsa na Yuda ku Yerusalem kalɔ lɛlɔ básu banini, “Bekyuli bani ƒui na kekpo kéƒie-ma na básɔ bénwini bébo mmɔ ni, babasala lisu na Yerusalem. 8Na si awɔ ɔni na étebo emeyi atɛ kama ni, badubuti kɔnu basia ƒula akɛla ƒui lɛlɔ, aani kalɛ na benengu ku bakutine bényimi bése. Na badubɔda ukyuli ɔmmɔ bedie Israelƒuɔ bani kekpo kéƒie-ma akɔ.”
9Na emeyi atɛ ammɔ kemmo ni, bekyuli bani ƒui nási Yuda ku Benyamin bábasala na Yerusalem. Na limeyi aavlanyɔdi lɛlɔ na kɔbuli yaalenwidi kemmo ni, na bana ƒui báasa beli Katɔti ɔtɔ anumi kaduli kemmo. Na ɔnantu ɔni nkya mɔɔna ku lɛla lɛni na limeyi lɛmmɔ ablala adanku ɔsu ni, kɔnyana ku kayi bɔkpulu bɔ́ƒɔ ukyuli biala lɛlɔ kemmo ƒui.
10Mmɔ na ɔkpane Esra ɔ́ta únye na ɔ́su bekyuli bammɔ ɔnini, “Bɛ́lɛ Katɔti kama na bíti kadi bamba beleku na bɛ́bla likpidi bɛ́sia Israelƒuɔ ekpidi ani na bábla kama. 11Anwuɔsu ɔƒaani ni, bidie bina ekpidi kalɔ bɛtina bina Unwoti ɔni ndi bina bati kuuku Katɔti na bivele-nwu. Na bɛbla lɛla lɛni mayɔ-nwu kaƒɔ. Na bɛda lɛlɔ bɛmami kadi bamba bekyuli bani na beli bámana-mii mmɔ lɛlɔ na bɛnyonu bana beleku bammɔ.”
12Amu na bekyuli bammɔ ƒui bédie kenye ku kudu básu banini, “Lɛla lɛni na ásu lɛdi ulu! Na ɔdi ka bɔbla bɔsiaku lɛni. 13Nsu bekyuli lisu lɛmɛni líbomo lɛ́gya na ɔnantu lɛnɔ ɔɔna momoomo na bulakana-nwu akɔ bɔsɔ bunye lɛni. Na ɔni nsɔ nsia ni, bulakana litemi lɛmɛni udu bɔdaku bɔwɔlɔ na limeyi linwi iye emeyi anyɔ kemmo. Ɔsika bɔƒiɔ geen na bɔdi-bu na lɛla lɛmɛni kemmo. 14Na aya na bula bakutine basɔ bakya Yerusalem na beti kabla kamɛni basia lɛlɔ. Na ukyuli biala na uti kadi bamba uleku ni, bete-nwu uwi na ubo ubasiaku benengu ku litemi batɛne bani nási nwuna ɔma. Na bɔdubɔbla lɛni wetédu ka kaƒɔ káyɔ Katɔti na udie nwuna kɔnyi na litemi lɛmɛni lɛlɔ.” 15Na ukyuli biala útata útenye kasusu kamɛni lɛlɔ ntu Asahel ubidi Yonatan ku Tikwa ubidi Yahasia, na Mesulam ku Sabetai ɔni ndi Lewini bénye-ma kama.
