The world stands firm,
never to be shaken,
and he will judge its people
with fairness.”
11Tell the heavens and the earth
to be glad and celebrate!
Command the ocean to roar
with all its creatures
12and the fields to rejoice
with all their crops.
Then every tree in the forest
will sing joyful songs
13to the Lord.
He is coming to judge
all people on earth
with fairness and truth.
translation_text:
1Amii kadi ƒui bekyuli,
bɛtu ɔnu ɔwɔdi bite Unwoti.
2Bidie ɔnu bimwi-nwu na bɛsu bekyuli limeyi ndi limeyi
kalɛ na ɔ́ƒɔ-bu ngba.
3Bɛkɔ lɛsa bite bekyuli kalɛ na uukeye na kadi ƒui akɔ.
Na bɛsu akɔla ala budie taatina ani na ɔ́bla na bekyuli ƒui akɔ.
4Ɔsika bula Unwoti úbomo
na nwuna lɛnyi lɛ́kɔ katɔ,
anwuɔsu na ɔlɛka bumwi-nwu
na bɔyia-nwu butulo baƒiɔ ƒui.
5Ɔsika baƒiɔ bani mɔɔdi kadi bamba bekyuli ƒui lɛlɔ
badi ala avɔdi ku anwidi sɔɔn ani naaadi ku lɛla.
Nsu Unwoti nédie kayaa ala ƒui.
6Unwoti úbomo geen na nwuna bukeye bɔ́ka bɔ́mana-nwu.
Na nwuna ɔyikun uudie lɛlɔ keyi
kalɛ na ɔɔdia bɔnu na nwuna kakpakɔ
7Amii kadi ƒui bekyuli,
bidie Unwoti kenyekɔ kani muukeye bɛtina
ku kalɛ na ubo ɔyikun.
8Bimwi Unwoti lɛnyi lɛni muukeye!
Na biti etela biboku-nwu na nwuna kakpakɔ.
9Amii kalɔ lɛlɔ bekyuli ƒui biboku eli kalɔ
na bimwi Unwoti ɔni nébomo na use kedee.
Na lɛlɔ litaatɔ-mii ku liƒu na nwuna anumi.
10Na bɛsu na kadi ƒui bekyuli akɔ bɛnini,
“Unwoti Katɔti mɔɔdi lɛga.”
Na kalɔ kemodi kammɔ kenye kana lɛgba lɛlɔ kpi
na kalákunku kudii.
Ɔdubɔtɛku bekyuli ƒui litemi
na ulu siin lɛlɔ.
11Na ebiti ataada awɔ, kalɔ ku kana ala ƒui.
Na ɛpu ɔmmɔ uteedie lɛdi momoomo
ku ala ani ƒui nkya-nwu kemmo.
12Na egyii ku livo ku mmo bɔmmɔ ƒui,
bidie lɛnu ku lɛlɔyɔ bite yiiduu
ku ala ani nkya aku ammɔ kemmo ƒui.
13Bidie lɛnu na bibo kudu na Unwoti
ɔni ndubo anumi.
Ɔsika ɔdubo ubatɛku kayawi bekyuli litemi
na ulu siin lɛlɔ.
Na ɔdubɔsia nwuna litemi geen lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ
ɔtɛ litemi lɛmmɔ.

english_text:
The Lord Brings Justice
1The Lord is King!
Tell the earth to celebrate
and all islands to shout.
2Dark clouds surround him,
and his throne is supported
by justice and fairness.
3Fire leaps from his throne,
destroying his enemies,
4and his lightning is so bright
that the earth sees it
and trembles.
5Mountains melt away like wax
in the presence of the Lord
of all the earth.
6The heavens announce,
“The Lord brings justice!”
Everyone sees God's glory.
7Those who brag about
the useless idols they worship
are terribly ashamed,
and all the false gods
bow down to the Lord.
8When the people of Zion
and of the towns of Judah
hear that God brings justice,
they will celebrate.
9The Lord rules the whole earth,
and he is more glorious
than all the false gods.
10Love the Lord
and hate evil!
God protects his loyal people
and rescues them
from violence.
11If you obey and do right,
a light will show you the way
and fill you with happiness.
12You are the Lord's people!
So celebrate and praise
the only God.
translation_text:
1Unwoti ɔɔdi lɛga!
Amii kayawi bekyuli ƒui,
lɛlɔ lɛyɔ-mii.
Na amii bani nli ntuntɛ kɔlɔ ƒui, lɛlɔ lɛyɔ-mii.
2Ulɔyɔ litigbli suu lɛdi lɛ́ka lɛ́mana-nwu.
Na nwuna lɛga kadikɔ kenye kete ka ɔbla ala siin,
na ɔtɛ litemi ulu lɛlɔ.
3Ogya bonwu ɔdi ɔtɔ-nwu anumi
na ɔɔkyula nwuna bekisine ƒui taamana-nwu.
4Na nwuna kɔnyi kɔ́ya na kayaa kaabwɛ ogya teewi kayawi,
na liƒu bonwu líƒie bayawine.
5Na abi ammɔ aabwɛ na Unwoti anumi
aani kalɛ na kɔma kɔɔnani.
Na Unwoti ɔni mɔɔdi kayawi ƒui lɛlɔ anumi
na ala ammɔ aalɛ́.
6Kayaa ku kana ala eebó kudu
na kalɛ na Katɔti use siin lɛlɔ.
Na bayawine ƒui baanu kalɛ na uukeye.
7Ɔ́ya na kɔƒa kuukpó bani ƒui mɔɔkun lɛmɛnɛ
na baakpá baƒiɔ.
Amii baƒiɔ bammɔ ƒui, bɛkya lili kalɔ bite Unwoti.
8Bekyuli bani nkya Sion ku Yuda lɛma ƒui
bénu ka Unwoti ɔ́tɛ litemi ulu lɛlɔ na lɛlɔ lɛ́yɔ-ma.
9Unwoti Katɔti, awɔ mɔɔdi kayawi ƒui lɛlɔ
na ƒula lɛnyi lɛ́kɔ katɔ litulo baƒiɔ ƒui.
10Unwoti ɔɔyɔ́ bekyuli bani nkisi likpidi.
Na ɔɔgyumana bekyuli bani nsiaku-nwu kama siin.
Na uudie-ma taalɛku balalane enu kemmo.
11Bekyuli bani mɔɔdi Katɔti litemi lɛlɔ
na baabla ala ulu siin lɛlɔ ni
bana kasiakɔ keekeye na lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́-ma.
12Amii bani mɔɔbla ala ulu lɛlɔ ni,
lɛlɔ lɛyɔ-mii na Unwoti ɔni nse kedee lɛlɔ
na bɛgya-nwu enu.

english_text:
The Lord Works Miracles
1Sing a new song to the Lord!
He has worked miracles,
and with his own powerful arm,
he has won the victory.
2The Lord has shown the nations
that he has the power to save
and to bring justice.
3God has been faithful
in his love for Israel,
and his saving power is seen
everywhere on earth.
4Tell everyone on this earth
to sing happy songs
in praise of the Lord.
5Make music for him on harps.
Play beautiful melodies!
6Sound the trumpets and horns
and celebrate with joyful songs
for our Lord and King!
7Command the ocean to roar
with all its creatures,
and the earth to shout
with all its people.
8Order the rivers
to clap their hands,
and all the hills
to sing together.
9Let them worship the Lord!
He is coming to judge
everyone on the earth,
and he will be honest
and fair.
translation_text:
1Bidie ɔnu ɔwɔdi bite Unwoti
ɔsika ɔ́bla akɔla ala budie taatina.
Na anwu ɔni nse kedee údie nwuna kɔnu
na ɔ́bla ɔyikun ala na ɔ́di nwuna bekisine lɛlɔ.
2Unwoti údie ɔ́tina bekyuli ƒui ka ubo ɔyikun
na ɔƒɔ bekyuli ngba na ɔtɛ litemi ulu siin lɛlɔ.
3Ɔ́sia nwuna litemi kama siin úte Israel kadi bekyuli
na ɔɔyɔ́-ma uwi ndi uwi.
Na kayawi bekyuli ƒui bánu na kesi kesii
kalɛ ubo ɔyikun na ɔɔƒɔ́ bekyuli.
4Amii bekyuli ƒui bedie lɛlɔyɔ
ku kudu momoomo,
ku ebiti bimwi Unwoti.
5Bɛgya bina lɛbentaa ku agyala bamba
na bidie lɛnu ku kɔku minimini bite Unwoti.
6Bɛvwi kɔkpɛɛ ku ese momoomo ku lɛlɔyɔ
na Unwoti ɔni ndi bula ɔga anumi.
7Bidie lɛdi bite, ɛpu ku ala ani ƒui nkya-nwu
kemmo na bebo kudu momoomo.
Na kayawi ku kana ala ediedi ƒui
bɛkɛ lɛlɔyɔ ku kɔvanu.
8Na ntukpa ƒui bɔbla kɔku aani enukpɛ bɔgya.
Na kɔku kɔsi abi ƒui lɛlɔ
aani lɛlɔyɔ lɛnu ubasala na Unwoti anumi.
9Bidie lɛnu na bibo kudu na Unwoti ɔni ndubo anumi.
Ɔsika ɔdubo ubatɛku kayawi bekyuli litemi
na ulu siin lɛlɔ.
Na ɔdubɔsia nwuna litemi geen lɛlɔ ɔtɛ litemi lɛmmɔ.

english_text:
Our Lord Is King
1 Our Lord, you are King!
You rule from your throne
above the winged creatures,
as people tremble
and the earth shakes.
2You are praised in Zion,
and you control all nations.
3Only you are God!
And your power alone,
so great and fearsome,
is worthy of praise.
4You are our mighty King,
a lover of fairness,
who sees that justice is done
everywhere in Israel.
5Our Lord and our God,
we praise you
and kneel down to worship you,
the God of holiness!
6Moses and Aaron were two
of your priests.
Samuel was also one of those
who prayed in your name,
and you, our Lord,
answered their prayers.
7 You spoke to them
from a thick cloud,
and they obeyed your laws.
8Our Lord and our God,
you answered their prayers
and forgave their sins,
but when they did wrong,
you punished them.
9We praise you, Lord God,
and we worship you
at your sacred mountain.
Only you are God!
translation_text:
1Unwoti ɔɔdi lɛga, liƒu litaada kadi bekyuli.
Uli nwuna lɛgaboku lɛlɔ
na batu udu bani mbo avwi na baalɔ-ma kerub ntɛ
na kayawi kemodi kammɔ ƒui kaakunku.
2Unwoti, awɔ ntulo ƒui na Sion
na ƒula lɛnyi lɛ́kɔ katɔ na kadi bekyuli ƒui akɔ.
3Bɛya na ɔdi biala umwi Unwoti lɛnyi
lɛni ntulo na lɛɛda liƒu mmɔ,
ɔsika anwu kani nse kedee.
4Awɔ ndi bula ɔga unengudi
ɔni mɔɔyɔ́ ala bɔbla siin.
Áya na litemi bɔtɛ ulu lɛlɔ siin unye kpakplaa
na Israel kadi bekyuli akɔ.
5Bimwi Unwoti bula Katɔti!
Bibo na bibakya-nwu lili kalɔ na nwuna lɛgaboku anumi,
ɔsika anwu kani nse kedee.
6Bula bati kuuku Mose ku Aaron
bakya Katɔti bakpane akɔ.
Na bula Nana Samuel lɛnɔ ubunku-ma
na bákpali Unwoti na úbunku-ma.
7Unwoti ɔ́tɛmiku-ma ɔ́siku liƒlukutu
bonwu aani lɛkpa lɛdi kemmo.
Na ama bénu na bádi nwuna ɔda bubo lɛlɔ.
8O Unwoti, bula Katɔti,
uwi ɔni na ƒula kadi bekyuli bábla likpidi ni,
áni-ma kɔtu nsu ka bákpali-ɔ ni,
énu na éti bana ekpidi ákyiɛ-ma.
9Bimwi Unwoti bula Katɔti
na bɛkpa-nwu na nwuna kɔbi kedee lɛlɔ,
ɔsika Unwoti, bula Katɔti, use kedee.

english_text:
(A psalm of praise.)
The Lord Is God
1Shout praises to the Lord,
everyone on this earth.
2Be joyful and sing
as you come in
to worship the Lord!
3You know the Lord is God!
He created us,
and we belong to him;
we are his people,
the sheep in his pasture.
4Be thankful and praise the Lord
as you enter his temple.
5 The Lord is good!
His love and faithfulness
will last forever.
translation_text:
1Amii kayawi bekyuli ƒui,
bɛtu kɔgya bimwi Unwoti.
2Bitiku ebiti lɛnu
na bɛda bɛlɛ Unwoti anumi ku lɛlɔyɔ.
3Bɛnu bɛti ka Unwoti ndi Katɔti!
Anwu nábla-bu na bɔdi nwuna badi bani
na ɔɔnu lɛlɔ aani nwuna baƒonu kalɛ na kadikɔ.
4Bɛsia kakpakɔ kayakun na biduo Unwoti kudɔ
ku linugya ku bumwi lɛnu.
5Ɔsika Unwoti ɔdia, na ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.
Ɔɔsia nwuna litemi kama ulu siin lɛlɔ úsela uwi ƒui.

english_text:
(A psalm by David.)
A King and His Promises
1I will sing to you, Lord!
I will celebrate your kindness
and your justice.
2Please help me learn
to do the right thing,
and I will be honest and fair
in my own kingdom.
3I refuse to be corrupt
or to take part
in anything crooked,
4and I won't be dishonest
or deceitful.
5Anyone who spreads gossip
will be silenced;
no one who is conceited
will be my friend.
6I will find trustworthy people
to serve as my advisors;
only an honest person
will serve as an official.
7No one who cheats or lies
will have a position
in my royal court.
8Each morning I will silence
any lawbreakers I find
in the countryside
or in the city of the Lord.
translation_text:
1O Unwoti! Ndubudie ɔnu limwi-ɔ
na kalɛ na aayɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi
na aatɛ litemi ulu siin lɛlɔ ɔsu.
2Bo na ebebunku-mi.
Mmɔ na ndubɔkana lɛlɔ bɔda kaduɛ ntaabla lɛbuni
kalɛ na naaaƒiɔ-ɔ na mina kaduli.
3Na lɛɛɛdubo bɔtunaku likpidi udu biala ɔdi,
ɔsika naaayɔ nnii mina anumi aanu ɔmmɔ udu
iye lɛsala ku bekyuli bekpidi badi.
Na ami ni, ntaabla ala na anumi kemmo.
4Na lɛɛɛdubo bɔtuna
ku kenwini ku ɔkɔ ala bɔbla bɔdi.
5Ukyuli ɔni mɔɔbɛla lɛlɔ taalɔ bekyuli anyikpi ni,
ndubɔyila-nwu udu.
Na ukyuli ɔni mɔɔtina lɛlɔ na ɔɔkun lɛmɛnɛ ni,
lɛɛɛdubo bɔtunaku-nwu.
6Ndubɔsia anu na bekyuli bani mɔɔdi Katɔti litemi lɛlɔ
na kalɔ kamɛni lɛlɔ na ami ku-ma bulie.
Na bekyuli bani mɔɔbla ala ulu geen lɛlɔ ni,
ama ndubɔbla-mi kabla.
7Bekyuli bani na ɔkɔ ala bɔbla bɔkya-ma ngba kemmo ni,
baaadubo-mi kaduli bulie.
Na bekyuli bani mɔɔbla ala anumi lɛlɔ lɛnɔ
baaadubo-mi anumi bunye.
8Limeyi ndi limeyi ndubɔyila balalane udu ƒui
na kalɔ kamɛni lɛlɔ.
Na ndubɔbɔku-ma lidie Unwoti ɔma unengudi ɔmmɔ kemmo.

english_text:
(A prayer for someone who hurts and needs to ask the Lord for help.)
A Prayer in Time of Trouble
1I pray to you, Lord!
Please listen.
2Don't hide from me
in my time of trouble.
Pay attention to my prayer
and quickly give an answer.
3My days disappear like smoke,
and my bones are burning
as though in a furnace.
4I am wasting away like grass,
and my appetite is gone.
5My groaning never stops,
and my bones can be seen
through my skin.
6I am like a lonely owl
in the desert
7or a restless sparrow
alone on a roof.
8My enemies insult me all day,
and they use my name
for a curse word.
9Instead of food,
I have ashes to eat
and tears to drink,
10because you are furious
and have thrown me aside.
11My life fades like a shadow
at the end of day
and withers like grass.
12Our Lord, you are King forever
and will always be famous.
13You will show pity to Zion
because the time has come.
14We, your servants,
love each stone in the city,
and we are sad to see them
lying in the dirt.
15Our Lord, the nations
will honor you,
and all kings on earth
will praise your glory.
16You will rebuild
the city of Zion.
Your glory will be seen,
17and the prayers of the homeless
will be answered.
18Future generations must also
praise the Lord,
so write this for them:
19“From his holy temple,
the Lord looked down
at the earth.
20He listened to the groans
of prisoners,
and he rescued everyone
who was doomed to die.”
21All Jerusalem should praise
you, our Lord,
22when people from every nation
meet to worship you.
23I should still be strong,
but you, Lord, have made
an old person of me.
24You will live forever!
Years mean nothing to you.
Don't cut my life in half!
25 In the beginning, Lord,
you laid the earth's foundation
and created the heavens.
26They will all disappear
and wear out like clothes.
You change them,
as you would a coat,
but you last forever.
27You are always the same.
You are God for all time.
28Every generation of those
who serve you
will live in your presence.
translation_text:
1Nu-mi bɔkpali, O Unwoti,
na aya na mina kɔvanu kudu-ɔ kudɔ na ebebunku-mi.
2Tabɛla-mi ƒula anumi si líduo ɔgbankpi kemmo.
Mmomu se atu na enu-mi bɔkpali.
Na ababla na ebo ebebunku-mi.
3Ɔsika mina emeyi áasa áwɔlɔ
aani kalɛ na uyɔ ɔɔyii taakya.
Na mina ɔlɔna lɛnɔ ɔɔkywí
aani lɛgyavonku.
4Utu ɔɔyɔ́ lɛlɔ na mina kayi kemmo aani kalɛ livo lɛɛyɛyɛ.
Na adila bɔdi muedi búkpi-mi ɔkwɛ.
5Ɔ́si kalɛ na muudumo ɔsu ni,
mina ɔlɔna ɔ́kwii na ekubi ekubi na aanu.
6Lɛ́ta lɛ́bla aani aasɛ ɔni nkɛ anwu lɛti na lɛku kemmo.
Na bédie-mi atu aani likuku nkya kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo.
7Naaatɛ taalɛɛ uwi ɔdi, na lɛ́ta lɛ́bla aani aasɛ
ɔni nlie lɛsa lili anwu lɛti.
8Lɛnyinkpi kani na mina bekisine baalɔ-mi usien ku ɔƒɛ
teewida bekyuli ka ɔdubɔlɛku-ma aani ami.
9Ntɔ bɔni kemmo muulie búnwini mina adila ani mɔɔdi.
Na mina mmii lɛnɔ búnwini ntu bɔni mɔɔní.
10Ɔkɛnku ƒula livoƒi ku kɔnyi kɔni na éti akya-mi ɔsu ni,
ágyu-mi ébo évaakun.
11Mina ngba emeyi aasá aani kalɛ lɛdisa lɛɛƒɔ́ limeyi bukeye.
Na buse aani livo lɛni mɔɔyɛyɛ.
12Nsu ni, O Unwoti, awɔ adi ɔga úsela uwi ƒui.
Na adubɔƒɔ lɛnyi na bekyuli ƒui akɔ ɔ́si kaba útédu kaba.
13Adubɔnu Sion kɔnyana ɔƒɛni amu.
Ɔsika uwi ɔmmɔ údu na anwu na ɔdi mɛni.
14Atabi ammɔ muedi áƒɔ abu ƒula kabla bablane kuye
nsu kalɛ na bébo-nya bábwɛ bébile
na ɔtumu ɔ́ƒɔ-nya lɛlɔ ɔɔdu-bu kaƒɔ.
15Na ɔmmɔ ɔsu ni, kadi bekyuli badubo Unwoti lɛnyi butaayia.
Na kalɔ lɛlɔ baga ƒui badubo-nwu butaabu
na banu kalɛ na uukeye.
16Ɔsika Unwoti ɔdubɔsɔku Sion ɔma ɔtu
na bekyuli banu kalɛ na uukeye.
17Na ɔdubunu bawabane ƒui bɔkpali
na ɔbla ala ani beevele-nwu ute-ma.
18Binweni ɔmɛni bise kaba bekyuli bani na bátawɔ-ma tɔ,
ɔsika ɔlɛka ama lɛnɔ bebemwi Unwoti.
19Unwoti ɔ́nu ɔ́siku nwuna keliekɔ kedee kani na ulie mmɔ.
Na ɔ́nu kalɔ kammɔ ƒui.
20Na únu bekyuli bani na bákya ɔtɔ budumo
ku bani na bádu-ma kukpi kɔtɔ ƒui
kalɛ na udie-ma.
21Mmɔ na bekyuli badubo Unwoti lɛnyi kudu bubo na Sion,
na bemwi-nwu lɛnyi na Yerusalem.
22Na uwi ɔmmɔ ni, baga ku lɛga kɔdikɔ ƒui
badubɔsa lisu na bakya Unwoti lili kalɔ.
23Unwoti ɔ́ya na mina ɔyikun ɔ́yuɛ uwi ɔni na lɛ́si mɔɔkɔ́
na ɔ́ya mina ngba emeyi lɛnɔ áƒana.
24Mmɔ na lɛ́su Unwoti nnini, “Awɔ eli ngba úsela uwi ƒui,
tada-mi ngba likuku na uwi ɔni na mina emeyi étedu tɔ.
25Na kalɔ kesekɔ ni, awɔ nédie kayawi kamɛni ƒui,
na éti ƒula enu ábla kayaa.
26Ala amɛni ƒui adubɔyii udu. Nsu awɔ ni, adubulie uwi ƒui.
Ala ammɔ ƒui adubɔtɔ aani adala kuuku kalɛ.
Na adubo-nya budie buwi
aani kalɛ na baavumana ala kuuku teedie-nya atu.
27Nsu kalɛ kani na awɔ ese ni, lɛni na adubo buse.
Na ƒula akwa alása kudii.
28Ƒula bekyuli bani mɔɔbla ƒula kabla ulu lɛlɔ ni,
bana bebi badubulie-ɔ anumi.
Na agyumana bana kaba bebi lɛnɔ.”

english_text:
(By David.)
The Lord's Wonderful Love
1With all my heart
I praise the Lord,
and with all that I am
I praise his holy name!
2With all my heart
I praise the Lord!
I will never forget
how kind he has been.
3The Lord forgives our sins,
heals us when we are sick,
4and protects us from death.
His kindness and love
are a crown on our heads.
5Each day that we live,
he provides for our needs
and gives us the strength
of a young eagle.
6For all who are mistreated,
the Lord brings justice.
7He taught his Law to Moses
and showed all Israel
what he could do.
8 The Lord is merciful!
He is kind and patient,
and his love never fails.
9The Lord won't always be angry
and point out our sins;
10he doesn't punish us
as our sins deserve.
11How great is God's love for all
who worship him?
Greater than the distance
between heaven and earth!
12How far has the Lord taken
our sins from us?
Farther than the distance
from east to west!
13Just as parents are kind
to their children,
the Lord is kind
to all who worship him,
14because he knows
we are made of dust.
15We humans are like grass
or wild flowers
that quickly bloom.
16But a scorching wind blows,
and they quickly wither
to be forever forgotten.
17The Lord is always kind
to those who worship him,
and he keeps his promises
to their descendants
18who faithfully obey him.
19God has set up his kingdom
in heaven, and he rules
the whole creation.
20All of you mighty angels,
who obey God's commands,
come and praise your Lord!
21All of you thousands
who serve and obey God,
come and praise your Lord!
22All of God's creation
and all that he rules,
come and praise your Lord!
With all my heart
I praise the Lord!
translation_text:
1O Katɔti, ndubumwi-ɔ lɛnyi kedee
ku mina kayi ƒui.
2Ndubumwi Unwoti!
Na naaayiƒala ala abuni ani na ɔ́bla úte-mi.
3Anwu muuti mina alaekpidi ƒui taakyiɛ-mi.
Na ɔɔbwi-mi lɛlɛ lɛni ƒui na muuƒi.
4Anwu muudie-mi ngba na kukpi kemmo,
na ɔɔyɔ́-mi, na ɔɔnu-mi kɔnyana uwi ndi uwi.
5Uute-mi ala abuni ani
mɔɔwia na
mina ngba emeyi kemmo na eedú-mi.
Na ɔɔyá na mina ɔyikun ɔɔbla
ɔwɔdi aani kɔdigbo aasɛ kalɛ.
6Unwoti ɔɔtɛ litemi na ulu lɛlɔ siin
teete bekyuli bani na balalane baanya taakya.
7Údie nwuna kasusu ɔ́tina Mose.
Na ɔ́ya Israelƒuɔ bánu nwuna ala ebendi ani na ɔ́bla.
8Unwoti ɔɔnu kɔnyana na ɔɔbla lɛƒɔndia.
Uléti kɔnyi pla pla na ɔɔyɔ́ bekyuli geen.
9Uládɔnku ukyuli uwi ndi uwi
na uléti kɔnyi taakya ukyuli uwi ƒui.
10Ulani-bu kɔtu aani kalɛ bula ekpidi ese
iye ɔƒɔ-bu kayu kani námanku bula ɔbladu.
11Na kalɛ na kayaa kágyunku
kalɔ ni,
lɛni kani na nwuna bɔyɔ bɔni neeebo kawɔkɔ búbomo
búte bekyuli buni bani mɔɔyia-nwu ku ɔbu.
12Na kalɛ na ɔƒɛ katukɔ kágyunku ɔƒɛ kanukɔ ni,
lɛni na ɔɔda-bu ekpidi teedie teevaakun na bula lɛlɔ.
13Kalɛ na bebi lɛlɔ lɛɛbla bana bawɔne kɔnyana ni,
lɛni na Unwoti lɛnɔ bekyuli bani mɔɔyia-nwu lɛlɔ
lɛɛbla-nwu kɔnyana.
14Ɔsika ɔgyi ka lɛti na úti ɔvɔ-bu
na lɛti kani na bɔdubɔsɔ bunwini.
15Ukyuli ɔyawine anwu ni, nwuna ngba emeyi ese aani livo.
Na aalɛ́ lili taabla anwula na alakpi akɔ.
16Na si ɔƒɛƒɛɛ úkpo ɔ́vi-nya eli kani na anu ewiakun.
Na ɔdi ɔsɔ uláti-nya kalɛkɔ muedi.
17Nsu bekyuli bani mɔɔyia Unwoti ni,
ama na ɔɔyɔ́ úsela uwi ƒui.
Na nwuna lɛƒɔndia ku ala bɔbla ulu lɛlɔ siin
use ute bana bawɔ bawɔ
18bani ƒui mɔɔbla taasiaku nwuna bunyimi lɛlɔ
na baadi nwuna ɔda bubo lɛlɔ.
19Unwoti ɔlati nése nwuna lɛgaboku úse katɔ.
Na nwuna lɛga kadikɔ mɔɔdi kayawi ƒui lɛlɔ.
20Amii Katɔti batu bayikune ƒui bani muunú-nwu litemi
bibo na bibemwi Unwoti.
21Amii nwuna katɔ kabla bablane lisu
bani mɔɔbla-nwu kabla, bimwi-nwu.
22Amii ala ediedi ƒui ku bani lɛlɔ na ɔɔdi,
biti bumwi bite Unwoti.
Ami ndubumwi Unwoti ku mina kayi ƒui.

english_text:
The Lord Takes Care of His Creation
1I praise you, Lord God,
with all my heart.
You are glorious and majestic,
dressed in royal robes
2and surrounded by light.
You spread out the sky
like a tent,
3and you built your home
over the mighty ocean.
The clouds are your chariot
with the wind as its wings.
4 The winds are your messengers,
and flames of fire
are your servants.
5You built foundations
for the earth, and it
will never be shaken.
6You covered the earth
with the ocean that rose
above the mountains.
7Then your voice thundered!
And the water flowed
8down the mountains
and through the valleys
to the place you prepared.
9Now you have set boundaries,
so that the water will never
flood the earth again.
10You provide streams of water
in the hills and valleys,
11so that the donkeys
and other wild animals
can satisfy their thirst.
12Birds build their nests nearby
and sing in the trees.
13From your home above
you send rain on the hills
and water the earth.
14You let the earth produce
grass for cattle,
plants for our food,
15wine to cheer us up,
olive oil for our skin,
and grain for our health.
16Our Lord, your trees
always have water,
and so do the cedars
you planted in Lebanon.
17Birds nest in those trees,
and storks make their home
in the fir trees.
18Wild goats find a home
in the tall mountains,
and small animals can hide
between the rocks.
19You created the moon
to tell us the seasons.
The sun knows when to set,
20and you made the darkness,
so the animals in the forest
could come out at night.
21Lions roar as they hunt
for the food you provide.
22But when morning comes,
they return to their dens,
23then we go out to work
until the end of day.
24Our Lord, by your wisdom
you made so many things;
the whole earth is covered
with your living creatures.
25But what about the ocean
so big and wide?
It is alive with creatures,
large and small.
26 And there are the ships,
as well as Leviathan,
the monster you created
to splash in the sea.
27All of these depend on you
to provide them with food,
28and you feed each one
with your own hand,
until they are full.
29But when you turn away,
they are terrified;
when you end their life,
they die and rot.
30You created all of them
by your Spirit,
and you give new life
to the earth.
31Our Lord, we pray
that your glory
will last forever
and that you will be pleased
with what you have done.
32You look at the earth,
and it trembles.
You touch the mountains,
and smoke goes up.
33As long as I live,
I will sing and praise you,
the Lord God.
34I hope my thoughts
will please you,
because you are the one
who makes me glad.
35Destroy all wicked sinners
from the earth
once and for all.
With all my heart
I praise you, Lord!
I praise you!
translation_text:
1O Katɔti, ndubumwi-ɔ ku mina kayi ƒui,
ɔsika ébomo geen na eekeye ku ɔbu.
Na bukeye bɔmmɔ bɔ́ka bɔ́mana-a aani kɔdi kalɛ.
2Na kalɛ na eekeye use aani awu na akya.
Na ébimi katɔ áƒala kayaa
aani kevo kɔdi kpakplaa kalɛ.
3Na átu ƒula keliekɔ ásia ntu bɔni nƒa katɔ mmɔ lɛlɔ.
Na ábla liƒlukutu na ɔdi kɛɛkɛ ɔni lɛlɔ na eelie.
Na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ avwi lɛlɔ na eelie taavi.
4Na éti ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ábla ƒula batalane.
Na éti ogya linyemi ƒula kabla bablane.
5Awɔ nákya kalɔ kamɛni ƒui awodu ɔka kalɔ
ɔni na lɛla biala likana-ka bɔkunku.
6Áya na ntu buwi-ka anumi aani kɔdi,
na abi muedi alátina.
7Nsu ka édie lɛdi momoomo ni,
ntu bɔmmɔ búse kalɔ bɔɔgbá
8taayu abi ammɔ lɛlɔ na bútéduo kɔwɛ kemmo kesii
kani na áƒuna éte-mu.
9Ásia ubili éte-mu kesii kani na bulakana buyi bɔvia.
Na bɔsɔ buláƒɔ kalɔ ƒui lɛlɔ kudii.
10Aayá na ntukpa wɛlɛ wɛlɛ bɔni mɔɔlɛ́ kalɔ kemmo
bɔɔgbá taavi ɔkwalɛ kemmo ku abi ntɛ awɛ kemmo.
11Mmɔ na aayá na bebuo ala betine
ku bakumbweyi bamba ƒui
baaní ntu na baadú bana utukwɛ.
12Na baasɛ ƒui baatú bana ayu taakya egyii
ani nlɛ ntukpa bɔmɛni amadɔ kemmo
na beelie teedie lɛnu taasiku kɔgba kɔmmɔ akɔ.
13Aayá na ɔnantu ɔɔna teewi abi lɛlɔ.
Na kalɔ kaaƒɔ́ ntu.
14Na aayá na livo lɛɛkwɛ́ teete bebuo kalɛ na bakun.
Na edula aakwɛ́ teete bekyuli kalɛ bakɛ adila.
15Ɔɔkɛ́ ntɛ bɔni mɔɔkya-nwu kayi ebiti
ku nnɔmii bɔni mɔɔyá nwuna anumi ekeye
ku adila ani muute-nwu ɔlɔkplu.
16Na egyii enengudi kpakplaa ani na Katɔti ɔ́lɛ
na Lebanon abi lɛlɔ aakɛ́ ntu uwi ndi uwi.
17Na egyii amɛni lili na baasɛ baabla bana ayu.
Na baasɛ benengudi ama baabla bana ayu
na egyii akɔdi bamba ani nde mmɔ lɛlɔ.
18Abi enengudi ani nákuku adi kabɛkɔ
kete alakpi akɔ bese.
Na atakpɛ akɔ adi besi ku betukpɛɛ
ku atakpɛ akɔ bebweyi bamba keliekɔ.
19Awɔ nédie kɔbuli ka kutaatina abuli bɔka.
Na ɔƒɛ lɛnɔ ɔgyi uwi ɔni na ɔɔnú.
20Awɔ nábla lɛdisa kalɛ na beƒiebuo butaalɛ
taatáwia bana lɛdila usien.
21Bagyata baakwanyi si baawia bebuo badi beƒie.
Na baanu Unwoti anumi ka ute-ma lɛla lɛmi badi.
22Na si ɔƒɛ ɔ́tu ni,
beenwíni teesie teetéduo bana kɔbɛkɔ.
23Na bekyuli lɛnɔ baayu ulu teesie bana kabla lidu akɔ
na beenye bana kabla kammɔ lɛlɔ teetédu useyi uwi.
24O Unwoti ábla ala pii ɔkɛnku ƒula lɛnunda lɛlɔ.
Na áya na ƒula ala ediedi áƒɔ kalɔ kammɔ ƒui lɛlɔ.
25Édie ɛpu na ɔ́bɛbɛ uwi bonwu
na kubweyi kunengudi ku kubliidi ƒui lidu lidu pii
kɔ́ƒɔ-nwu kemmo.
26Mmɔ na lɛkɔlɔ libendi lɛɛsia taavi.
Na liƒu bebweyi bebendi lɛnɔ bakya-nwu kemmo
beesié taasɔ.
27Ƒula anumi kani na ala amɛni ƒui aanu
ka ete-nya bana lɛdila na uwi lɛlɔ.
28Na lɛla lɛni na éte-ma ni,
ani kani na baadi teemo.
29Si áda anumi édie-ma lɛlɔ blii ni, liƒu lɛɛda-ma.
Na si áda ƒula ɔƒɛƒɛɛ édie-ma lɛlɔ kemmo ni,
beekpi na basɔ benwini lɛti.
30Édie ala ƒui ɔkɛnku ƒula Kɔyu lɛlɔ.
Na aasɔku kalɔ kemodi taabla ɔwɔdi.
31Buuvele bɔnii Unwoti uteekeye uwi ƒui.
Na lɛlɔ lɛyɔ-nwu na ala ani ƒui na údie lɛlɔ.
32Unwoti úti nwuna anumi ɔ́nu kayawi na kaakunku.
Na úti kɔnu útuku abi lɛnɔ, na aalɛ́ uyɔ.
33Uwi ɔni na mmu nli ngba
mɛni ni,
ndubo lɛnu buteedie teemwi Unwoti.
34Mbo lɛnunsia ka mina kasusu
kani muuti kadubɔƒɔ-nwu anu.
Ɔsika Unwoti mɔɔyá na mɔɔkɛ́ lɛlɔyɔ.
35Buuvele ka ayila alaekpidi bablane udu na kalɔ ƒui lɛlɔ.
Na bana udu ɔsɔ utalɛ kudii.
O Katɔti, ndubumwi-ɔ ku mina kayi ƒui.
Bɛya na bumwi Unwoti.

english_text:
The Lord Can Be Trusted
1 Praise the Lord
and pray in his name!
Tell everyone
what he has done.
2Sing praises to the Lord!
Tell about his miracles.
3Celebrate and worship
his holy name
with all your heart.
4Trust the Lord
and his mighty power.
5Remember his miracles
and all his wonders
and his fair decisions.
6You belong to the family
of Abraham, his servant;
you are his chosen ones,
the descendants of Jacob.
7The Lord is our God,
bringing justice
everywhere on earth.
8He will never forget
his agreement or his promises,
not in thousands of years.
* 9 God made an eternal promise
10 to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob,
11when he said, “I'll give you
the land of Canaan.”
12At the time there were
only a few of us,
and we were homeless.
13We wandered from nation
to nation, from one country
to another.
14 God did not let anyone
mistreat our people.
Instead he protected us
by punishing rulers
15and telling them,
“Don't touch my chosen leaders
or harm my prophets!”
16 God kept crops from growing
until food was scarce
everywhere in the land.
17 But he had already sent Joseph,
sold as a slave into Egypt,
18 with chains of iron
around his legs and neck.
19Joseph remained a slave
until his own words
had come true,
and the Lord had finished
testing him.
20 Then the king of Egypt
set Joseph free
21 and put him in charge
of everything he owned.
22Joseph was in command
of the officials,
and he taught the leaders
how to use wisdom.
23 Jacob and his family
came and settled in Egypt
as foreigners.
24 They were the Lord's people,
so he let them grow stronger
than their enemies.
25They served the Lord,
and he made the Egyptians plan
hateful things against them.
26 God sent his servant Moses.
He also chose and sent Aaron
27to his people in Egypt,
and they worked miracles
and wonders there.
28 Moses and Aaron obeyed God,
and he sent darkness
to cover Egypt.
29 God turned their rivers
into streams of blood,
and the fish all died.
30 Frogs were everywhere,
even in the royal palace.
31 When God gave the command,
flies and gnats
swarmed all around.
32 In place of rain,
God sent hailstones
and flashes of lightning.
33He destroyed their grapevines
and their fig trees,
and he made splinters
of all the other trees.
34 God gave the command,
and more grasshoppers came
than could be counted.
35They ate every green plant
and all the crops that grew
in the land of Egypt.
36 Then God took the life
of every first-born son.
37 When God led Israel from Egypt,
they took silver and gold,
and no one was left behind.
38The Egyptians were afraid
and gladly let them go.
39 God hid them under a cloud
and guided them by fire
during the night.
40 When they asked for food,
he sent more birds
than they could eat.
41 God even split open a rock,
and streams of water
gushed into the desert.
42God never forgot
his sacred promise
to his servant Abraham.
43When the Lord rescued
his chosen people from Egypt,
they celebrated with songs.
44 The Lord gave them the land
and everything else
the nations had worked for.
45He did this so that his people
would obey all his laws.
Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_text:
1Bɛgya Unwoti enu.
Na bitaakpali-nwu lɛnyi.
Bɛsu kadi bekyuli ƒui ala ani na ɔ́bla.
2Bidie bumwi lɛnu bite-nwu,
na bibo nwuna akɔla ala budie taatina kudu.
3Amii bani ƒui mɔɔwia Unwoti ni,
lɛlɔ lɛyɔ-mii na bimwi-nwu lɛnyi kedee
na bɛkɔliku-nwu katɔ.
4Biti bina anu bɛsia Unwoti
ku nwuna ɔyikun lɛlɔ na bitaanu-nwu anumi uwi biala.
5Binyimo nwuna akɔla ala budie taatina ani na ɔ́bla
ku kalɛ na ɔ́tɛ litemi na ulu siin lɛlɔ.
6Nwuna kabla ɔblane Abraham kaba bebi na bɛdi.
Na bɛdi-nwu bekyuli baƒunadi bani ndi Yakob bebi.
7Unwoti ndi bula Katɔti.
Na anwu mɔɔtɛku kayawi ƒui litemi.
8Nwuna anu asia lɛla lɛni na únyimi lɛlɔ uwi ƒui.
Na nwuna linyese lise lite kaba mpim mpim bekyuli.
9Bunyimi bɔmmɔ na únyimiku Abraham na úse kenye
ɔnii bɔdubɔkya anwu ku Isak lɛnɔ ntɛ.
10Bunyimi bɔmɛni kani na ɔ́lɛ ugyii úte Yakob
ka amu ndi ɔda bubo ute anwu ku Israel kadi bekyuli
úsela uwi ƒui kemmo.
11Ɔ́su ɔnini, “Amii na ndubuti Kanaan kalɔ ƒui lite
na kana ƒui kenwini bina kadikɔ.”
12Na uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, beeemomo.
Na lɛnɔ ni, baƒɔ na badi na kalɔ kammɔ kemmo.
13Na busie kani bakɛ beesié taavi kadi bamba bekyuli akɔ
ɔ́si lɛga kadikɔ úsie lɛga kadikɔ.
14Na ɔ́gyumana-ma ɔni na ukyuli ina unwi útanya-ma útakya.
Mmomu ɔ́tɛmiku baga baga bammɔ kpakplaa na ama ɔsu.
15Na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Ɔdi biala utetuku mina kadi bekyuli
bani na lɛ́ƒuna.
Na ɔdi utabla mina kenye bediene badi likpidi lɛdi.”
16Na ɔ́ya na kɔka kúbo Kanaan kalɔ kammɔ ƒui lɛlɔ
na adila ása-ma ƒui.
17Nsu ɔ́tala ukyuli na ɔtɔ-ma anumi na Egyipte.
Na anwu ndi Yoseƒ
ɔni béti béye ka unwini bekyuli bamba kabla ɔblane.
18Bebo-nwu kɔgba
na bákya-nwu abuala lɛgba ku limɔ.
19Ɔ́kya kɔgba kɔmmɔ kemmo
útédu ka Egyipteƒuɔ Ɔga Ƒarao kɔna
kɔni kalɔ na údie úbo-nwu kemmo.
20Egyipteƒuɔ ɔga ɔmmɔ ɔ́ya na bédie-nwu abuala ammɔ
na ɔ́ya bányonu-nwu na ɔ́kɛ bɔnwuna.
21Ɔga ɔmmɔ úti Yoseƒ ɔ́bla ukyuli ɔni mɔɔnu nwuna akɛla ƒui
ku kalɔ kammɔ ƒui lɛlɔ.
22Na úte-nwu ɔyikun ka ɔdi batɔnkune bammɔ lɛlɔ
na ɔtina benengu bammɔ lɛnunda ala.
23Na Yakob útélie Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ mmɔ
aani ɔƒɔ kalɛ na kalɛkɛ kani baalɔ banii Ham.
24Na mmɔ ni, Unwoti ɔ́ya na Israelƒuɔ báwɔ na bémomo geen
na bákɛ ɔyikun kaduɛ bétulo bana bekisine.
25Ɔ́ya Egyipteƒuɔ beekisi nwuna kadi bekyuli.
Na bákya kɔkwɛ kukpidi bana lɛlɔ.
26Ɔmmɔ ɔsu Unwoti ɔ́tala Mose nwuna kabla ɔblane
ku Aaron ɔni na ɔ́ƒuna.
27Na bábla Katɔti akɔla ala budie taatina lidu lidu
bátina-ma na Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ mmɔ.
28Katɔti ɔ́ya na lɛdisa lɛ́ƒɔ kalɔ kammɔ ƒui.
Nsu Egyipteƒuɔ bétenu-nwu litemi.
29Ɔ́ya na ntukpa bɔni nkya mmɔ ƒui búnwini ubugya,
na kɔbɛ kɔmmɔ ƒui lɛnɔ kúkpi.
30Na bapɔtɔlɔ báƒɔ kalɔ kammɔ ƒui lɛlɔ.
Na Egyipte ɔga kaduli muedi bapɔtɔlɔ báƒɔ-ka kemmo
ku nwuna katɛnkɔ ƒui.
31Unwoti údie lɛdi na bebweyi lidu lidu bani muuveyi
na baata báƒɔ bana kalɔ ƒui lɛlɔ.
32Na ɔnantu bɔna kenye ni,
Unwoti ɔ́ya na etubankɛ aayu aani ɔnantu.
Na kayaa kaabwɛ ogya teebewi kalɔ kammɔ ƒui lɛlɔ.
33Na ɔ́ya na bana adingyii mmo bɔni bése ƒui búbie
na egyii bamba ƒui lɛnɔ áƒɛ éwi kalɔ.
34Na Unwoti údie lɛdi
na ɔ́ya na baalɔlɔ báyu esu esu na bébile bana edula.
35Na bebweyi bamɛni báyalɛ evete ƒui na bébile edula ani ƒui
nkya kalɔ kammɔ kemmo.
36Na ɔ́ya na Egyipteƒuɔ bebi bananabi bedeedi
bani ƒui nkya kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ ƒui békpi.
37Na ɔ́kpanku Israelƒuɔ ɔ́lɛku kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ,
Na béti Egyipteƒuɔ sika ugyiedi ku ɔƒualadi ƒui bátɔlɔku.
Na ɔlɛne ɔdi uuubo-ma akɔ.
38Ebiti áda Egyipteƒuɔ geen ka Israelƒuɔ bátɔlɔ-ma kalɔ lɛlɔ.
Ɔsika bana lɛlɔ lɛ́da-ma liƒu.
39Katɔti ɔ́ya ulɔyɔ liƒlukutu bonwu lɛdi
lɛ́ka lɛ́mana-ma ka bakɛ.
Na ogya bonwu ɔdi lɛnɔ ɔɔda usien
na anwu na baanu teesie.
40Belusiene bamɛni béye Unwoti adila
na úte-ma baasɛ ku bodobodo ɔ́siku katɔ na bádi bémo.
41Ɔ́ya na atakpɛ ébimi na ntu bɔ́lɛ-nwu kemmo na báni.
Na ntu bɔmmɔ bɔɔgbá aani ketu
na káƒɔ kalɔ kakwiidi kammɔ kemmo.
42Ɔsika únyimo linyese kedee
lɛni na úse úte Abraham ɔni ndi nwuna kabla ɔblane.
43Ɔmmɔ ɔsu na ɔ́tɔnku nwuna bekyuli baƒunadi
ɔ́lɛku kalɔ kammɔ kemmo
na beedie lɛlɔyɔ lɛnu ka bakɛ ulu.
44Na úti bekyuli bamba kɔlɔ úte-ma.
Na mmo bɔni kadi bamba bekyuli bése
ku bana akɛla ƒui énwini bana ɔdi.
45Ɔ́bla ɔmɛni úte-ma kalɛ na basia anu
na badi nwuna etemila ku ɔda bubo lɛlɔ.
Bɛya na bumwi Unwoti.

english_text:
A Nation Asks for Forgiveness
1 We will celebrate
and praise you, Lord!
You are good to us,
and your love never fails.
2No one can praise you enough
for all the mighty things
you have done.
3You bless those people
who are honest and fair
in everything they do.
4Remember me, Lord,
when you show kindness
by saving your people.
5Let me prosper with the rest
of your chosen ones,
as they celebrate with pride
because they belong to you.
6We and our ancestors
have sinned terribly.
7 When they were in Egypt,
they paid no attention
to your marvelous deeds
or your wonderful love.
And they turned against you
at the Red Sea.
8But you were true to your name,
and you rescued them to prove
how mighty you are.
9 You said to the Red Sea,
“Dry up!”
Then you led your people across
on land as dry as a desert.
10You saved all of them
11and drowned every one
of their enemies.
12 Then your people trusted you
and sang your praises.
13But they soon forgot
what you had done
and rejected your advice.
14 They became greedy for food
and tested you there
in the desert.
15So you gave them
what they wanted,
but later you destroyed them
with a horrible disease.
16 Everyone in camp was jealous
of Moses and of Aaron,
your chosen priest.
17Dathan and Abiram rebelled,
and the earth opened up
and swallowed them.
18Then fire broke out
and destroyed all
of their followers.
19 At Horeb your people
made and worshiped the statue
20of a bull, instead of you,
their glorious God.
21You worked powerful miracles
to save them from Egypt,
but they forgot about you
22and the fearsome things
you did at the Red Sea.
23You were angry and started
to destroy them,
but Moses, your chosen leader,
begged you not to do it.
24 They would not trust
you, Lord,
and they did not like
the promised land.
25They would not obey you,
and they grumbled
in their tents.
26So you threatened them
by saying, “I'll kill you
out here in the desert!
27 I'll scatter your children
everywhere in the world.”
28 Your people became followers
of a god named Baal Peor,
and they ate sacrifices
offered to the dead.
29They did such terrible things
that you punished them
with a deadly disease.
30But Phinehas helped them,
and the sickness stopped.
31Now he will always
be highly honored.
32 At Meribah Spring
they turned against you
and made you furious.
33Then Moses got into trouble
for speaking in anger.
34 Our Lord, they disobeyed you
by refusing to destroy
the nations.
35Instead they were friendly
with those foreigners
and followed their customs.
36Then they fell into the trap
of worshiping idols.
37 They sacrificed their sons
and their daughters to demons
38 and to the gods of Canaan.
Then they poured out the blood
of these innocent children
and made the land filthy.
39By doing such gruesome things,
they also became filthy.
40 Finally, Lord, you were angry
and terribly disgusted
with your people.
41So you put them in the power
of nations that hated them.
42They were mistreated and abused
by their enemies,
43but you saved them
time after time.
They were determined to rebel,
and their sins caused
their downfall.
44You answered their prayers
when they were in trouble.
45You kept your agreement
and were so merciful
46that their enemies
had pity on them.
47 Save us, Lord God!
Bring us back
from among the nations.
Let us celebrate and shout
in praise of your holy name.
48 Lord God of Israel,
you deserve to be praised
forever and ever.
Let everyone say, “Amen!
Shout praises to the Lord!”
translation_text:
1Bɛya na bumwi Unwoti.
Bɛgya Unwoti enu, ɔsika ɔdia
na ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.
2Ukyuli ɔdi ulakana na wedie kenye
na Unwoti ala enengudi ani na ɔ́bla lɛlɔ.
Na ɔdi lɛnɔ ulakana na wemwi-nwu lɛnɔ
na wedu wawɔlɔ.
3Lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ bekyuli bani mɔɔbla ala ulu lɛlɔ.
Na baabla ala ani nse siin uwi biala kemmo.
4Unwoti, tayiƒala-mi
uwi ɔni na adubɔbla lɛbuni ete bekyuli bani na áƒuna.
Nyimo-mi uwi ɔni na adubɔƒɔ-ma.
5Ya na ami lɛnɔ makɛ ebiti
na kɔsia kɔni na ƒula badi
bani na áƒuna badubɔkɛ kemmo.
Na lɛlɔ lɛni ndubɔyɔ ƒula kadi bekyuli ni,
ami lɛnɔ lɛlɔ lɛmmɔ lɛyɔ-mi.
6Bɔ́bla alaekpidi bɔ́ƒiɔ-ɔ
aani kalɛ na bula bati kuuku báƒiɔ-ɔ kalɛ kani.
Bɔ́bla likyulikpi ku kalala.
7Uwi ɔni na bula bati kuuku bákya Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ ni,
bétenu ƒula akɔla ala budie taatina kalɔ.
Na bétenyimo ƒula lɛƒɔndia pii lɛni na ábla-ma lɛnɔ.
Mmomu báta bénye-ɔ lɛlɔ na Ɛpugyie ɔmmɔ kudɔ.
8Nsu na ƒula lɛnyi ɔsu ni,
áƒɔ-ma ngba kalɛ na bekyuli banu ƒula ɔyikun bati.
9Údie lɛdi na Ɛpugyie ɔmmɔ ɔ́kwii kɔnakunwi.
Na ɔkpanku-ma na bávi-nwu kemmo
aani kalɔ kakwiidi lɛlɔ na bakɛ.
10Na údie-ma ɔ́lɛku bana bekisine enu kemmo.
Na bekisine bammɔ bátadi-ma lɛlɔ.
11Na ntu bɔmmɔ bɔ́sɔ búbasala
na búti bana bekisine bani nsiaku-ma mmɔ ƒui.
Na bana akɔ ina unwi muedi útalɛ-nwu kemmo.
12Mmɔ na báƒɔ linyese lɛni na Unwoti úse-ma úse mmɔ bádi.
Na bémwi-nwu.
13Nsu útaƒɔ uwi ɔdi asa na báyiƒala ala ani na Unwoti ɔ́bla.
Na bétenye bátanu-nwu anumi
na banu lɛla lɛni na ɔdubo-ma bɔsu.
14Mmomu ala ani mɔɔda-ma ɔkwɛ kama kani na basia
na kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo mmɔ.
Na mmɔ kani na bákɔku Katɔti bánu.
15Anwuɔsu úte-ma lɛla lɛni na béye-nwu.
Nsu ɔ́ya na ɔlɛ ukpidi ɔdi úbeduo-ma akɔ.
16Na kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo
kesii kani na báda bana keliekɔ mmɔ ni,
bekyuli bammɔ béti lɛnungyie likpidi básiaku Mose
ku Aaron bani na Unwoti ɔ́ƒuna sɛsɛɛ úse
úte nwuna kabla kedee.
17Kalɔ kébimi na kébweli Datan
ku Abiram ku nwuna kaduli bekyuli lɛnɔ.
18Ogya ɔ́bwɛ úbayu bekyuli bani ƒui nsiaku Abiram kama
na ɔ́kyula balalane bammɔ ƒui.
19Na béti sika ugyiedi ɔdi bábla ɔmantɛ akɔ ubi ɔdi udu
na Sinai kɔbi kaƒɔna na baakpá-nwu.
20Na kalɛ na ɔlɛka bakpa Unwoti ɔni muukeye ni,
bávumana nwuna bukeye bɔmmɔ
béte ɔmantɛ akɔ ɔni mɔɔkun livo.
21Na báyiƒala Katɔti ɔni nédie-ma
22ku ɔyikun kpakplaa ɔ́lɛku Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ
ku akɔla ala budie taatina enengudi
ani na ɔ́bla na mmɔ ku Ɛpugyie kudɔ.
23Anwuɔsu uwi ɔni na ɔ́bla kasusu
ka ɔyila-nwuna bekyuli
udu ni,
Mose ɔni ndi nwuna kabla ɔblane ɔƒunadi
unye ɔda-ma na úvele Katɔti
ka nwuna kɔnyi kɔyɔ-nwu na ɔda-ma bɔkyula ɔya.
24Ka bátaƒɔ Katɔti linyese bátadi ɔsu ni,
kalɔ kammɔ kátada-ma ebiti.
25Na bakya bana adi nvo kemmo baabla unyeƒi na ɔmɛni lɛlɔ
ɔni na bétenu Unwoti lɛdi na badi-ni lɛlɔ.
26Ɔmmɔ ɔsu Unwoti úbo-ma lɛnimi enwu
na ɔsu-ma ka si bátanu
kaduɛ ni,
ɔdubɔyila-ma udu ƒui na kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo mmɔ.
27Na ɔdubo bana kaba bebi bugyingya
bɔkya kadi bamba bekyuli akɔ.
Na bekpi na kalɔ kammɔ kemmo.
28Na Peor mmɔ ni, muna kadi bekyuli
béti bana lɛlɔ bátámana baƒiɔ bani baalɔ banii Baal lɛlɔ.
Na baadú bebuo taakpa lɛla lɛni neeebo ngba.
29Na bákya Unwoti kɔnyi na bana ɔbladu ɔmɛni ɔsu.
Na ɔmmɔ ɔsu ɔlɛ buɛ ɔdi ubeduo-ma akɔ.
30Nsu Pinehas ɔ́ta na ɔ́ni bani nábla udu ukpidi ɔmmɔ kɔtu.
Na ɔlɛ buɛ ɔmmɔ kenye káyɔ.
31Na Pinehas kayi buse bɔmɛni bɔdi lɛla lɛni
na Israel kadi bekyuli beenyimo uwi biala
ka ɔdi lɛbuni geen.
Na ɔdi lɛla lɛni naaadubo bɔyii kudii.
32Na Meriba kɔtu mmɔ
na Israel kadi bekyuli bákya Unwoti kɔnyi.
Na ɔkɛnku ɔmmɔ ɔsu na Mose ɔ́kɛ nwuna ɔgbankpi.
33Israelƒuɔ ala ani na bábla áya na livo líƒi Mose
na ɔ́su lɛla lɛni na útalɛka ɔsu na Unwoti lɛlɔ.
34Israelƒuɔ bétékpo kadi kadi bekyuli
nsu béni na bátayila-ma udu aani kalɛ na Katɔti ɔ́su-ma.
35Mmomu básalaku-ma na basiaku bana ɔbladu kama
na baabla lɛla linwi.
36Na Katɔti bekyuli bébenwini baƒiɔ bakpane.
Na ɔmmɔ geen náya na Katɔti ɔ́yila-ma udu.
37Na beeƒie ama alati bebi bananabi ku belekubi muedi
taadu teeti taakpa Kanaan baƒiɔ.
38Bebi bani naaagyi lɛla lɛdi ubugya na beewi kalɔ.
Na báya na kalɔ kammɔ ƒui keesé lɛlɔ.
39Na bana ɔbladu ɔmmɔ ɔsu ama alati lɛnɔ beesé lɛlɔ.
Na ɔmɛni ɔ́tina ka bálɛ Katɔti kama.
40Ɔmɛni ɔ́ya na Unwoti Katɔti kɔnyi kɔ́kɔ katɔ
kúbu na nwuna bekyuli lɛlɔ
na bana lɛlɔ lɛsɔ liláda-nwu kubiti.
41Na Katɔti údie-ma atu
na kadi bamba bekyuli bada-ma beesusu kalɛ biala na baayɔ́.
Na bana bekisine mmomu mɔɔdi-ma lɛlɔ.
42Bana bekisine bamɛni baanya-ma taakya
uwi biala kemmo ɔni na beeebo lɛla lɛdi na babla.
43Unwoti uudie nwuna bekyuli bamɛni kɔlɛ kɔlɛ.
Nsu bɔta kani baata teenye-nwu lɛlɔ.
Na ekpidi ammɔ áya na badaku udu bɔyii ƒui.
44Nsu Unwoti uunú-ma keku
si ala étulo-ma na baakpali-nwu.
45Ɔ́si nwuna lɛƒɔndia ɔsu ni, na kaƒɔ kasɔ kaakywí-nwu.
Na únyimo bunyimi bɔni na únyimiku-ma.
46Na ɔ́ya na bana bekisine baanu-ma kɔnyana.
47Bula Unwoti Katɔti, ƒɔ-bu ngba!
Na asiku-bu kɔlɔ bamba lɛlɔ asɔku abásala.
Ya na lɛlɔ lɛyɔ-bu
na bumwi ƒula lɛnyi kedee ku kudu.
48Bimwi Unwoti ɔni ndi Israelƒuɔ Katɔti lɛnyi.
Bimwi-nwu ɔsi ɔƒɛni úsela uwi ƒui.
Bɛya na ukyuli biala ɔsu ɔnini, “Ɔsia lɛni!”
Bimwi Unwoti.

english_text:
BOOK V
(Psalms 107–150)
The Lord Is Good to His People
1 Shout praises to the Lord!
He is good to us,
and his love never fails.
2Everyone the Lord has rescued
from trouble
should praise him,
3everyone he has brought
from the east and the west,
the north and the south.
4Some of you were lost
in the scorching desert,
far from a town.
5You were hungry and thirsty
and about to give up.
6You were in serious trouble,
but you prayed to the Lord,
and he rescued you.
7At once he brought you
to a town.
8You should praise the Lord
for his love
and for the wonderful things
he does for all of us.
9To everyone who is thirsty,
he gives something to drink;
to everyone who is hungry,
he gives good things to eat.
10Some of you were prisoners
suffering in deepest darkness
and bound by chains,
11because you had rebelled
against God Most High
and refused his advice.
12You were worn out
from working like slaves,
and no one came to help.
13You were in serious trouble,
but you prayed to the Lord,
and he rescued you.
14He brought you out
of the deepest darkness
and broke your chains.
15You should praise the Lord
for his love
and for the wonderful things
he does for all of us.
16He breaks down bronze gates
and shatters iron locks.
17Some of you had foolishly
committed a lot of sins
and were in terrible pain.
18The very thought of food
was disgusting to you,
and you were almost dead.
19You were in serious trouble,
but you prayed to the Lord,
and he rescued you.
20By the power of his own word,
he healed you and saved you
from destruction.
21You should praise the Lord
for his love
and for the wonderful things
he does for all of us.
22You should celebrate
by offering sacrifices
and singing joyful songs
to tell what he has done.
23Some of you made a living
by sailing the mighty sea,
24and you saw the miracles
the Lord performed there.
25At his command a storm arose,
and waves covered the sea.
26You were tossed to the sky
and to the ocean depths,
until things looked so bad
that you lost your courage.
27You staggered like drunkards
and gave up all hope.
28You were in serious trouble,
but you prayed to the Lord,
and he rescued you.
29He made the storm stop
and the sea be quiet.
30You were happy because of this,
and he brought you to the port
where you wanted to go.
31You should praise the Lord
for his love
and for the wonderful things
he does for all of us.
32Honor the Lord
when you and your leaders
meet to worship.
33If you start doing wrong,
the Lord will turn rivers
into deserts,
34 flowing streams
into scorched land,
and fruitful fields
into beds of salt.
35But the Lord can also turn
deserts into lakes
and scorched land
into flowing streams.
36If you are hungry,
you can settle there
and build a town.
37You can plant fields
and vineyards that produce
a good harvest.
38The Lord will bless you
with many children
and with herds of cattle.
39Sometimes you may be crushed
by troubles and sorrows,
until only a few of you
are left to survive.
40But the Lord will take revenge
on those who conquer you,
and he will make them wander
across desert sands.
41When you are suffering
and in need,
he will come to your rescue,
and your families will grow
as fast as a herd of sheep.
42You will see this because
you obey the Lord,
but everyone who is wicked
will be silenced.
43Be wise! Remember this
and think about the kindness
of the Lord.
translation_text:
1Bɛgya Unwoti enu, ɔsika ɔdia
na ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.
2Na amii bani ƒui na ɔ́ƒɔ-mii ngba
na údie-mii ɔ́lɛku bina bekisine enu kemmo ni,
biti bumwi bite-nwu.
3Ɔsika anwu násɔku-mii úbasala na bina kalɔ lɛlɔ
ɔ́siku kaƒɔ na ɔƒɛ katukɔ ku kanukɔ.
Na ɔ́si katɔ kakɛ úsie kada kakɛ lɛnɔ ƒui.
4Badi bábwɛ béduo kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo bakɛ baaví
na baaagyi kesii kani na basia
beduo ɔma unengudi ɔdi kemmo na belie mmɔ.
5Kɔka ku utukwɛ kani mɔɔda-ma
ɔni na basɔ beeebo lɛnunsia lɛdi ka badubo ngba bulie.
6Mmɔ na báva bákpali Unwoti na bana lɛbibo kemmo.
Na údie-ma sɔsɔ.
7Unwoti ɔ́tɔnku-ma ɔ́siaku ulu ligeen lɛlɔ
útéduoku ɔma ɔni kemmo na bákɛ keliekɔ.
8Ɔdi ka bekyuli bamɛni ƒui bágya Unwoti enu,
ɔsika ɔ́yɔ-ma na ɔ́bla ala ebendi úte-ma.
9Bani na utukwɛ ɔɔda ni, uute-ma ntu na baaní.
Na bani na kɔka mɔɔda-ma ni,
uute ama lɛnɔ adila abuni na baadi teemo.
10Kasuudikɔ na badi beli na lɛla biala lise-ma suu.
Na badi lɛnɔ ni, béƒie-ma bákya ɔtɔ
na beebó abi na batɛ kɔgba kemmo.
11Ɔsika báta bénye Katɔti Ɔyikune Ƒui lɛlɔ
na béni nwuna bɔlɛ.
12Lɛlɔ lítu-ma na kabla kpakplaa kani na baabla ɔsu.
Na badubo bubuli ɔni na ɔdi uuubo na webunku-ma muedi.
13Mmɔ na báva bákpali Unwoti na bana lɛbibo kemmo.
Na údie-ma sɔsɔ.
14Ɔ́ya na bálɛ kasuudikɔ bonwu kani kemmo na bakya mmɔ.
Na bana kɔgba kɔ́ƒɛ kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ.
15Ɔdi ka bekyuli bamɛni ƒui bágya Unwoti enu,
ɔsika ɔ́yɔ-ma na ɔ́bla ala ebendi úte-ma.
16Kɔyakun kɔni bákalɛ ku abuala lidu ku kɔbuɛlɛ ni,
ɔ́ƒɛ-ku ƒui kede kede.
17Badi badi badɔlɔdi ɔ́si bana likyulikpi ala bɔbla ɔsu.
Na badi lɛnɔ bana ekpidi ani baabla ɔsu beebó abi pii.
18Adila adi asɔ aláda-ma ɔkwɛ
na básɔ bátagyunku kaƒiɔtɔ.
19Mmɔ na báva bákpali Unwoti na lɛbibo kemmo
na údie-ma.
20Ɔ́bɔku ɔlɛ ɔmmɔ na ɔ́ba-ma
na básɔ bétekpi.
21Ɔdi ka bekyuli bamɛni ƒui bágya Unwoti enu,
ɔsika ɔ́yɔ-ma na ɔ́bla ala ebendi úte-ma.
22Ɔlɛka babla enugya akpala bete-nwu.
Na bedie lɛlɔyɔ lɛnu bebo ala ebendi
ani na ɔ́bla kudu batina kadi ƒui.
23Badi bábla kabla na lɛkɔlɔ libendi kemmo na ɛpu anumi.
Na ɔmmɔ kemmo na bákɛ bana limeyi lɛdila.
24Bánu Unwoti ablala ebendi lidu lidu
lɛni na ɔ́bla na ntu bɔmmɔ anumi.
25Ɔsika uudie lɛdi na ntu bɔmmɔ bɔɔnwanɛ lɛlɔ
na bɔɔta ku avlɔvɔ bonwu taakɔ katɔ.
26Lɛkɔlɔ lɛmɛni lɛɛkɔ́ avlɔvɔ bonwu amɛni lɛlɔ
aani abi bonwu teesie katɔ katɔ.
Na lɛɛsɔ taabayu teeduo kalɔ kalɔ aani kɔwɛ kemmo.
Na liƒu bonwu lɛni mɔɔda-ma
ɔ́ya na báyila bana lɛnunsia biala
na ɔgbankpi ɔni kemmo béduo ɔsu.
27Na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ uubó-ma taavinku
na baagbánta aani ntɛ bekpine
ɔni na bana kɔkwɛ ƒui kɔ́sa.
28Mmɔ na báva bákpali Unwoti na bana lɛbibo kemmo
na údie-ma sɔsɔ.
29Na ɔ́ya na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ kpakplaa ɔmmɔ ɔ́da búkpo ɔ́ya
na avlɔvɔ ku lɛla biala lɛ́bla buɛɛ.
30Mmɔ ni, lɛlɔ lɛ́yɔ-ma ka lɛla biala lɛ́bla buɛɛ ɔsu.
Na ɔ́kpanku-ma úbeduo kalɛlɛkɔ buɛɛ na kesii kani baayɔ́.
31Ɔdi ka bekyuli bamɛni ƒui bágya Unwoti enu,
ɔsika ɔ́yɔ-ma na ɔ́bla ala ebendi úte-ma.
32Bɛya na bemwi-nwu na bakɔliku-nwu lɛnyi bonwu lɛmmɔ katɔ
na batɔnkune ƒui ku bekyuli ƒui akɔ.
33Unwoti ɔɔbla na ntukpa bɔɔkwii teenwini kalɔ kakwiidi.
Na ɔɔbla na abiɔ aakwii na kalɔ kammɔ kaayaki ntu.
34Na ɔɔbla kalɔ kani mɔɔdia adila lɛnɔ
na keenwíni kalɔ kagyani kani mbo mma na kaládia edula.
Ɔsika kalɔ kammɔ bekyuli badi bekyuli bekpidi.
35Lɛni kani na Unwoti ɔɔkana na kalɔ kakwiidi keenwíni ntu kalɔ.
Na kalɔ kani mɔɔyaki ntu lɛnɔ ɔɔbla na abiɔ aalɛ́ mmɔ.
36Na ɔɔyá na bekyuli bani na kɔka kɔɔda baadá bana kuliekɔ
na mmɔ na beelie taakɛ lɛlɔyɔ.
37Na baatuma mmo na baalɛ adingyii
na baakɛ́ edula pii na mmɔ.
38Na uute nwuna badi kusɛ kusɛ na baawɔ taasia kama.
Na bana bebuo lɛnɔ baláƒana kudii.
39Bekisine baakana na beekpóku Katɔti bekyuli
na banya-ma bakya lɛbibo kemmo.
40Nsu Unwoti uuti kɔnyi taakya-ma na lɛla lɛni baabla ɔsu.
Na ɔɔbɔku-ma taatákya kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo
na bakɛ baaví ɔni na baaagyi kesii kani bésela.
41Nsu bani muubó abi na baayaki ala ni,
uudie-ma taalɛku bana lɛbibo kemmo
na baasɔ taawɔ teeyile bana kɔduli aani baƒonu kalɛ.
42Na bekyuli babuni ƒui baanu ɔmɛni na ebiti aada-ma.
Na balalane ama kɔƒa ndubo-ma bukpo.
43Ukyuli biala na ɔ́da anu ni, use atu na unu etemila amɛni.
Na ɔnu ɔti kalɛ na Unwoti ɔɔyɔ́ bekyuli uwi biala.

english_text:
(A song and a psalm by David.)
With God on Our Side
1Our God, I am faithful to you
with all my heart,
and you can trust me.
I will sing
and play music for you
with all that I am.
2I will start playing my harps
before the sun rises.
3I will praise you, Lord,
for everyone to hear;
I will sing hymns to you
in every nation.
4Your love reaches higher
than the heavens,
and your loyalty extends
beyond the clouds.
5Our God, may you be honored
above the heavens;
may your glory be seen
everywhere on earth.
6Answer my prayers
and use your powerful arm
to give us victory.
Then the people you love
will be safe.
7Our God, from your holy place
you made this promise:
“I will gladly divide up
the city of Shechem
and give away Succoth Valley
piece by piece.
8The lands of Gilead
and Manasseh are mine.
Ephraim is my war helmet,
and Judah is my symbol
of royal power.
9Moab is merely my washbasin,
and Edom belongs to me.
I shout with victory
over the Philistines.”
10Our God, who will bring me
to the fortress
or lead me to Edom?
11Have you rejected us?
You don't lead our armies.
12Help us defeat our enemies!
No one else can rescue us.
13Only you give us victory
and crush our enemies.
translation_text:
1Mina kayi kélie-mi kalɔ na awɔ ɔsu, O Katɔti,
na ndubudie kɔgya ku lɛdi mini mini limwi-ɔ.
2Ndubɔta ɔtanta tutuutu ku mina kayi ƒui
na liti ɔbentaa ku agyala ntágyila ɔƒɛ.
3Unwoti, ndubɔgya-a enu na bekyuli ƒui benu.
Na ndubudie lɛnu limwi-ɔ na kadi biala bekyuli akɔ.
4Unwoti, kalɛ na aayɔ́ bekyuli uwi biala
ku kalɛ na aadi ƒula litemi lɛlɔ
úbomo geen aani kalɛ na bɔɔnu kalɛ na kayaa kébomo.
5O Katɔti, ya na bekyuli ƒui bakɔliku ƒula lɛnyi katɔ
besienku ɔgyu kakaaka.
Na banu kalɛ na eekeye na kesi kesii na kalɔ lɛlɔ.
6Unwoti, awɔ ɔlati ti ƒula kɔdianu
na ekpo ete-bu ku ƒula ɔyikun
kalɛ na ƒula bekyuli bani na aayɔ́ mmɔ bakɛ bɔƒɔ.
7Katɔti úse kenye ɔsiku nwuna kakpakɔ
Katɔma kede kemmo ɔnini,
“Lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́-mi ka lile Sekem ɔma
ku Sukot Ɔkwalɛ ɔmmɔ lite mina bekyuli.
8Ami mbo Gilead ku Manase.
Nda Eƒraim aani mina kagabwa.
Na nda Yuda aani mina ɔgagyii.
9Na Moab use aani lɛkyami lɛni kemmo
na mɔɔƒɔ mina enu.
Na Edom lɛlɔ na mɔɔnya lɛgba.
Na Ƒilistia na muunye teebo kudu ka lɛ́di lɛlɔ.”
10Na Ukyuli bamba ɔdi uuubo ɔni ndubɔtɔnku-bu
na busie butékpo lɛma linengudi
lɛni na bátu awodu kpakplaa bámana mmɔ.
Na ɔdi lɛnɔ uuubo na ɔtɔnku-bu
na butékpo Edom kalɔ lɛlɔ bekyuli.
11O Katɔti, geen geen na anii éni-bu
na aaadubo-bu bɔtɔnku na kekpokɔ
na ekpo bula bekisine ete-bu?
12Buvele kpo-ma te-bu,
ɔsika ukyuli ɔyawine kebunku keeebo kɔsia kɔdi.
13Na ɔkɛnku Katɔti lɛlɔ ni, bɔdubɔdi lɛlɔ.
Ɔsika anwu ndubɔnya bula bekisine ususu kalɔ.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader.)
A Prayer for the Lord's Help
1I praise you, God!
Don't keep silent.
2Destructive and deceitful lies
are told about me,
3and hateful things are said
for no reason.
4I had pity and prayed
for my enemies,
but their words to me
were harsh and cruel.
5For being friendly and kind,
they paid me back
with meanness and hatred.
6My enemies said,
“Find some worthless fools
to accuse him of a crime.
7Try him and find him guilty!
Consider his prayers a lie.
8 Cut his life short
and let someone else
have his job.
9Make orphans of his children
and a widow of his wife;
10make his children beg for food
and live in the slums.
11“Let the people he owes
take everything he owns.
Give it all to strangers.
12Don't let anyone be kind to him
or have pity on the children
he leaves behind.
13Bring an end to his family,
and from now on let him be
a forgotten man.
14“Don't let the Lord forgive
the sins of his parents
and his ancestors.
15Don't let the Lord forget
the sins of his family,
or let anyone remember
his family ever lived.
16He was so cruel to the poor,
homeless, and discouraged
that they died young.
17“He cursed others.
Now place a curse on him!
He never wished others well.
Wish only trouble for him!
18He cursed others more often
than he dressed himself.
Let his curses strike him deep,
just as water and olive oil
soak through to our bones.
19Let his curses surround him,
just like the belt and clothes
he wears each day.”
20Those are the cruel things
my enemies wish for me.
Let it all happen to them!
21Be true to your name, Lord God!
Show your great kindness
and rescue me.
22I am poor and helpless,
and I have lost all hope.
23I am fading away
like an evening shadow;
I am tossed aside
like a crawling insect.
24I have gone without eating,
until my knees are weak,
and my body is bony.
25 When my enemies see me,
they say cruel things
and shake their heads.
26Please help me, Lord God!
Come and save me
because of your love.
27Let others know that you alone
have saved me.
28I don't care if they curse me,
as long as you bless me.
You will make my enemies fail
when they attack,
and you will make me glad
to be your servant.
29You will cover them with shame,
just as their bodies
are covered with clothes.
30I will sing your praises
and thank you, Lord,
when your people meet.
31You help everyone in need,
and you save them from death.
translation_text:
1Katɔti, mɔɔkɔliku-ɔ lɛnyi katɔ,
anwuɔsu tetile atu na alakpete-mi.
2Ɔsika balalane ku ɔkɔ banyine báta bénye-mi lɛlɔ.
Na baasu ɔkɔ ala na mina lɛlɔ.
3Báda-mi ulu ku bana enyekpi
na beekpóku-mi ɔni na ńtabla-ma lɛla lɛdi.
4Mɔɔyɔ́-ma ku kaƒɔ nwaa na mɔɔkpali katɔ na bana lili
ina ka baláwia-mi kadia.
5Na ɔmɛni ƒui kama ni,
likpidi na béti bágya-mi enu na lɛbuni lɛni lɛ́bla-ma kenye.
Na bukisi lɛnɔ béti básiaku-mi na mina bɔyɔ kenye.
6Na baasu muedi banini,
“Ya na bekyuli bekpidi badi bada-nwu kenye ka ɔɔbla likpidi.
Na bana ɔdi ɔni-nwu uboku litemi katɛkɔ.
7Na si bátɛku-nwu litemi ni, na badu-nwu kɔtɔ.
Na bedie batina-nwu ka nwuna katɔ bɔkpali bɔdi likpidi.
8Bɛya na ukyuli bamba unye nwuna kalabla kenye
na nwuna ngba bɔda liku.
9Na nwuna bebi benwini bekpinebi
na ulekudi lɛnɔ unwini ukpinele.
10Na nwuna bebi benwini ala bevelene bani mɔɔví teevele ala.
Na bagya-ma balɛku atɔnku
ani kemmo na béte-ma na bakya kemmo.
11Na bekyuli bani na ɔda kayu ƒui beƒie lɛla biala na ubo baƒɔ.
Na baƒɔ bekpeli kabla biala na ɔ́bla úse baƒɔ.
12Na ukyuli biala utabla-nwu lɛƒɔndia lɛdi
iye ɔdi ɔnu nwuna bebi bani nénwini bekpinebi mmɔ kɔnyana.
13Na nwuna kaba kani na údie ƒui bekpi basa.
Na ɔdi ɔsɔ utenyimo nwuna lɛnyi na kaba
bekyuli bani ndubɔsia kama kemmo.
14Unwoti unyimo nwuna bati kuuku ekpidi
na uteti uni ekpidi utakyiɛ-nwu.
15Ɔya na beteebo abi uwi ƒui
na bana udu ɔyii ƒui na kalɔ kamɛni lɛlɔ.
Na ɔdi ɔsɔ uleti-ma lɛlɔ kasusu.
16“Ɔsika ukyuli ɔmɛni útabla ukyuli ɔdi lɛƒɔndia lɛdi kudii.
Mmomu ɔ́bla bawabane ku bani na ala eekpóku kalala
úti útédu ka békpi muedi.
17Ewida etemila sɔɔn nátaalɛ-nwu kenye.
Anwuɔsu ewida ammɔ ebo anwu lɛnɔ lɛlɔ.
Na ɔɔɔgyi kalɛ na beete ukyuli kusɛ kusɛ.
Anwuɔsu kusɛ kusɛ utasiaku anwu lɛnɔ.
18Bekyuli buwida bɔdi-nwu udu na ɔkya aani awu.
Ɔmmɔ ɔsu anwu ɔlati ewida eteekpoku-nwu
aani kalɛ na ntu bɔɔƒɔ́ ukyuli adala ƒui.
Na uduo-nwu ekubi kemmo
aani kalɛ na nnɔmii buuduo ukyuli ɔlɔna kemmo.
19Na ewida ammɔ enwini enyimi-nwu
aani kɔdi kalɛ na ada-nwu
aani kabuli kani ndubɔda-nwu kavobi úselaku ƒui.”
20O Unwoti, ya na ala ani ƒui na mina bekisine baawia mɛni
ebo-ma lɛlɔ lɛni kani
ku bani ƒui mɔɔsu ala ammɔ bene udu na mina lɛlɔ.
21Nsu ni, Unwoti Katɔti, ɔkɛnku ƒula lɛnyi kedee ɔsu ni,
kpo te-mi, ɔsika aayɔ́ bekyuli uwi biala.
22Ɔwabane ɔni mɔɔyaki ala uwi biala kemmo na ndi.
Na nsɔ liiibo lɛnunsia lɛdi na mina kayi kemmo.
23Na kalɛ na kɔyu kɔɔyii taakya si kadi kaayu ni,
lɛni na ami ukyuli umodi ɔmmɔ mɔɔyii taakya.
Na nse aani kebweyi blii
kani na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ úbo útáva kɔmadɔ.
24Lílie kɔka laa na mina akɔnkɔ aatɔ́-mi,
na mina ɔlɔna ɔ́kwii útálɛ ku ekubi.
25Na si bekyuli bánu-mi na baamá-mi.
Na uwi biala na bánu-mi ni,
lili kani na baakunku taama.
26O Unwoti, mina Katɔti,
bunku-mi na edie-mi ɔkɛnku ƒula bɔyɔ ɔsu.
27Ya na mina bekisine banu bati geen
ka awɔ ɔlati néti ƒula enu edie-mi.
28Si ina beewida-mi ni, lɛɛɛdubo bɔkpete.
Na si báta bénye-mi lɛlɔ ni, na aya na kɔƒa kukpo-ma.
Nsu ya na lɛlɔ lɛyɔ ƒula kabla ɔblane.
29Ya na kɔƒa kukpo mina bekisine,
na kɔƒa kɔmmɔ kɔbla aani kɔdi kɔni na benyimi.
30Ndubɔgya Unwoti enu ku kudu.
Na ndubo-nwu bumwi na nwuna kadi bekyuli akɔ.
31Ɔsika úkpo úte ɔwabane
na údie-nwu ɔ́lɛku bekyuli
bani nádu-nwu kukpi kɔtɔ enu kemmo.

english_text:
(A psalm by David.)
The Lord Gives Victory
1 The Lord said to my Lord,
“Sit at my right side,
until I make your enemies
into a footstool for you.”
2The Lord will let your power
reach out from Zion,
and you will rule
over your enemies.
3Your glorious power
will be seen on the day
you begin to rule.
You will wear the sacred robes
and shine like the morning sun
in all of your strength.
4 The Lord has made a promise
that will never be broken:
“You will be a priest forever,
just like Melchizedek.”
5The Lord is at your right side,
and when he gets angry
he will crush
the other kings.
6He will judge the nations
and crack their skulls,
leaving piles of dead bodies
all over the earth.
7He will drink from any stream
that he chooses, while winning
victory after victory.
translation_text:
1Unwoti ɔ́su mina Unwoti ɔnini,
“Sɔ lie-mi kɔdianu
wetédu uwi ɔni na meti ƒula bekisine
makya-a lɛgba kalɔ.”
2Unwoti ɔdubɔya na adi lɛga
asi Sion avia ƒula bekisine kalɔ lɛlɔ muedi.
3Na uwi ɔmmɔ ni,
adubulie ƒula lɛgaboku lɛlɔ na ada ƒula agala.
Na ama bani na ásɔku ábla ɔwɔdi aani ɔtanta amii ƒui
badubɔda balɛ ƒula keliekɔ kedee mmɔ.
4Unwoti úse kenye na uláda ulavia kenye kammɔ.
Ɔ́su ɔnini, “Adi ɔkpane úsela uwi ƒui
na Melkisedek ɔkpane bɔdi ulu lɛlɔ.”
5Unwoti unye-ɔ kɔdianu kakɛ,
na limeyi lɛni na ɔdubɔkɛ kɔnyi ni, ɔdubɔyila baga udu.
6Na ɔdubɔtɛku kayawi bekyuli ƒui litemi.
Na ɔdu kayawi lɛlɔ badine ƒui.
Na bekpine sɔɔn ndubɔƒɔ kalɔ lɛlɔ ƒui.
7Na ɔdubɔni ntu na ntukpa biala kemmo
na ɔɔyɔ́ uwi ɔni na uukpó taadi lɛlɔ.

english_text:
Praise the Lord for All He Has Done
1Shout praises to the Lord!
With all my heart
I will thank the Lord
when his people meet.
2The Lord has done
many wonderful things!
Everyone who is pleased
with God's marvelous deeds
will keep them in mind.
3Everything the Lord does
is glorious and majestic,
and his power to bring justice
will never end.
4The Lord God is famous
for his wonderful deeds,
and he is kind and merciful.
5He gives food to his worshipers
and always keeps his agreement
with them.
6He has shown his mighty power
to his people
and has given them the lands
of other nations.
7God is always honest and fair,
and his laws can be trusted.
8They are true and right
and will stand forever.
9God rescued his people,
and he will never break
his agreement with them.
He is fearsome and holy.
10 Respect and obey the Lord!
This is the first step
to wisdom and good sense.
God will always be respected.
translation_text:
1Bɛya na bumwi Unwoti.
Amii kadi ƒui bekyuli, bimwi Unwoti lɛnyi.
Ami ndubɔgya-nwu enu lɛsiku mina kayi kemmo ƒui
na kesii kani na nwuna bekyuli bása beli.
2Unwoti ablala ébomo geen.
Na bekyuli bani nwuna ablala ammɔ aayɔ́-ma kaƒɔ ni,
baawia-nya kalɔ benu.
3Nwuna lɛla biala na ɔɔbla liikeye
na uudie nwuna lɛgadi keyi.
Na nwuna ala bɔbla buse siin úsela uwi ƒui.
4Na kalɛ na nwuna ablala ammɔ ébomo ɔsu ni,
ɔ́ya na bulayiƒala-nya kudii.
Unwoti ubo lɛƒɔndia na ɔɔnu kɔnyana lɛnɔ.
5Bekyuli bani mɔɔkpali-nwu na baabu-nwu ni,
uute-ma bana lɛdila uwi biala.
Na ulayiƒala nwuna bunyimi bɔni na únyimi.
6Unwoti údie ɔ́tina nwuna bekyuli kalɛ na ubo ɔyikun
na ala ani na ɔ́bla úte-bu ɔsu.
Ɔsi kalɛ na ɔ́ya na kadi bamba bekyuli kɔlɔ ƒui
kúnwini abu kɔdi ɔsu.
7Na lɛla biala na ɔ́bla ni, bɔƒiɔ bɔdi buuubo-nwu kemmo.
Na nwuna ɔda bubo bɔdi kama kekpokɔ.
8Bɔdi litemi geen lɛni
ndubunye siin bute uwi ƒui.
9Unwoti uukpó taaƒɔ nwuna bekyuli.
Na ulalɛ bunyimi bɔni na únyimi
ku nwuna bekyuli kama kudii.
Use kedee na ɔlɛka bɔyia-nwu.
10Ukyuli ɔni mɔɔyia Unwoti uusé kalɔ taada anu.
Na bani ƒui mɔɔsia nwuna ɔda bubo anu ni,
beenú ala abuni kalɔ.
Ɔmɛni ɔsu na ɔlɛka buteemwi-nwu uwi biala kemmo.

english_text:
God Blesses His Worshipers
1Shout praises to the Lord!
The Lord blesses everyone
who worships him and gladly
obeys his teachings.
2Their descendants will have
great power in the land,
because the Lord blesses
all who do right.
3They will get rich and prosper
and will always be remembered
for their fairness.
4They will be so kind
and merciful and good,
that they will be a light
in the dark for others
who do the right thing.
5Life will go well for those
who freely lend
and are honest in business.
6They won't ever be troubled,
and the kind things they do
will never be forgotten.
7Bad news won't bother them;
they have decided
to trust the Lord.
8They are dependable
and not afraid,
and they will live to see
their enemies defeated.
9 They will always be remembered
and greatly praised,
because they were kind
and freely gave to the poor.
10When evil people see this,
they angrily bite their tongues
and disappear.
They will never get
what they really want.
translation_text:
1Bɛya na bumwi Unwoti.
Lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ ukyuli ɔni mɔɔyia Unwoti
na ɔɔdi nwuna ɔda bubo etemila ƒui lɛlɔ.
2Nwuna bawɔ badubɔkɛ ɔyikun geen
na bana kadi bekyuli akɔ.
Na kaba kani bekyuli nse siin na Katɔti anumi ni,
lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ-ma geen.
3Na badubumo ku akɛla lidu lidu na bana kaduli.
Na kalɛ baabla ala siin ɔsu badubulie kpi uwi biala.
4Na bani ƒui mɔɔbla ala ulu lɛlɔ ni,
badubɔnu bukeye na kesii kani na lɛdisa lɛkya.
Ɔsika baabla lɛƒɔndia
na baanu bekyuli kɔnyana na bese siin.
5Lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ ukyuli ɔni muuvó ala
teete bekyuli ku kaƒɔ ƒaa
na ɔɔbla nwuna ala ƒui ulu lɛlɔ.
6Ukyuli ɔni na use siin ulébo kalɔ kudii.
Mmomu bekyuli badubo-nwu butaakali uwi biala.
7Na ɔtɔtɔ ɔdi lɛnɔ ulágyu-nwu ina bi mɔɔlɛ́.
Ɔsika nwuna bɔƒɔtaadi bubo ɔkplu na Unwoti lɛlɔ.
8Kayi biala kelékpoku-nwu iye liƒu lɛdi lilada-nwu,
ɔsika ɔ́ƒɔ ɔ́di ka nwuna bekisine ƒui badubɔkya-nwu lili kalɔ.
9Uute bekyuli bani mɔɔyaki ala ku kaƒɔ ƒaa,
na uláda lɛbuni bɔbla taaya kudii.
Na bekyuli badububo-nwu kudu ka ubo ɔyikun sɔsɔ.
10Na balalane badubɔnu ɔmɛni na ɔƒɛ ɔda-ma.
Badubɔdu anyi bada na babla lɛla biala.
Nsu kɔnu kulétuku-ma lɛla lɛni baawia kudii.

english_text:
The Lord Helps People in Need
1Shout praises to the Lord!
Everyone who serves him,
come and praise his name.
2Let the name of the Lord
be praised now and forever.
3From dawn until sunset
the name of the Lord
deserves to be praised.
4The Lord is far above
all of the nations;
he is more glorious
than the heavens.
5No one can compare
with the Lord our God.
His throne is high above,
6and he looks down to see
the heavens and the earth.
7God lifts the poor and needy
from dust and ashes,
8and he lets them take part
in ruling his people.
9When a wife has no children,
he blesses her with some,
and she is happy.
Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_text:
1Bɛya na bumwi Unwoti.
Amii Unwoti kabla bablane ƒui,
bimwi-nwu lɛnyi.
2Bimwi Unwoti
ɔ́si ɔƒɛni úsela uwi ƒui kemmo.
3Na ɔ́si ɔƒɛ katukɔ útédu kanukɔ ni,
bibo Unwoti lɛnyi kudu bimwi-nwu.
4Unwoti mɔɔdi kadi ƒui bekyuli lɛlɔ.
Na nwuna bukeye bɔ́kɔ bɔ́via kayaa ƒui.
5Ɔma nse aani bula Unwoti Katɔti
ɔni nli nwuna lɛgaboku lɛlɔ na katɔ katɔ ƒui?
6Uli mmɔ
ɔɔnu katɔ ku kalɔ ala ƒui lɛlɔ.
7Anwu mɔɔda bawabane teedie bana kɔwaba kemmo.
Na bani mɔɔyaki ala ƒui ɔɔda-ma
teedie bana ala kevelekɔ.
8Na ɔɔyá na ama ku lɛlɔ badine
ku bekyuli bani náƒɔ lɛnyi ƒui baabla unwi.
9Ɔɔyá na bedinkɔ baawɔ na lɛlɔyɔ
lɛɛkya kaduli kemmo.
Bɛya na bumwi Unwoti.

english_text:
The Lord Works Wonders
1 God brought his people
out of Egypt, that land
with a strange language.
2He made Judah his holy place
and ruled over Israel.
3 When the sea looked at God,
it ran away,
and the Jordan River
flowed upstream.
4The mountains and the hills
skipped around like goats.
5Ask the sea why it ran away
or ask the Jordan
why it flowed upstream.
6Ask the mountains and the hills
why they skipped like goats!
7Earth, you will tremble,
when the Lord God of Jacob
comes near,
8 because he turns solid rock
into flowing streams
and pools of water.
translation_text:
1Uwi ɔni na Israel kadi bekyuli bávi bálɛ
Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ
kesii kani na ama Yakob kaba kemmo bebi badi baƒɔ ni,
2Katɔti ɔ́bla Yuda nwuna kakpakɔ kedee
na ɔɔdi Israelƒuɔ ƒui lɛlɔ.
3Ɛpugyie ɔ́nu ɔmɛni na ɔ́bwɛ lɛlɔ ntɛ.
Na Yordan Ketu kédi kénye na kasɔ kalagba.
4Liƒu lɛ́ƒɔ abi ammɔ ƒui lɛlɔ na aata taawɔ
aani kalɛ na bese baaƒulu
na abinkpo lɛnɔ aaƒulu aani baƒonubi.
5O Ɛpugyie, bi mɔɔlɛ́ku-ɔ
na ábwɛ lɛlɔ ntɛ lɛni?
Na Yordan, bi ɔsu na édi énye kɔnakunwi lɛni,
na ásɔ alagba?
6Na amii abi nɔɔ, bi ɔsu na bina ɔbladu use
aani kalɛ na bese baaƒulu?
Na amii abinkpo bise aani kalɛ na baƒonubi baaƒulu.
7O amii kalɔ ku kana lɛlɔ ala, lɛlɔ litaatɔ-mii ku bɔyia
ka Unwoti ɔni ndi Yakob Katɔti ɔ́da ɔ́lɛ ɔsu.
8Anwu mɔɔyá na ntu bɔɔbwɛ taalɛ atakpɛ kemmo.
Na agyasu eenwíni abiɔ ani mɔɔyu.

english_text:
The Lord Deserves To Be Praised
1We don't deserve praise!
The Lord alone deserves
all of the praise,
because of his love
and faithfulness.
2 Why should the nations ask,
“Where is your God?”
3Our God is in the heavens,
doing as he chooses.
4 The idols of the nations
are made of silver and gold.
5They have a mouth and eyes,
but they can't speak or see.
6Their ears can't hear,
and their noses can't smell.
7Their hands have no feeling,
their legs don't move,
and they can't make a sound.
8Everyone who made the idols
and all who trust them
are just as helpless
as those useless gods.
9People of Israel,
you must trust the Lord
to help and protect you.
10Family of Aaron the priest,
you must trust the Lord
to help and protect you.
11All of you worship the Lord,
so you must trust him
to help and protect you.
12The Lord will not forget
to give us his blessing;
he will bless all of Israel
and the family of Aaron.
13 All who worship the Lord,
no matter who they are,
will receive his blessing.
14I pray that the Lord
will let your family
and your descendants
always grow strong.
15May the Lord who created
the heavens and the earth
give you his blessing.
16The Lord has kept the heavens
for himself,
but he has given the earth
to us humans.
17The dead are silent
and cannot praise the Lord,
18but we will praise him
now and forevermore.
Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_text:
1O Unwoti, awɔ na ɔdi ka bumwi, na ɔɔɔdi abu.
Awɔ kani na ɔ́manku ka buti bumwi bute,
ɔsika aayɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi
na asia ƒula litemi kama lɛnɔ.
2Bi ɔsu na ɔlɛka kadi bamba bekyuli beye-bu banii,
“Wɛ na bina Katɔti ɔkya?”
3Bula Katɔti ɔkya katɔ
na ɔɔbla lɛla lɛni mɔɔyɔ́-nwu kaƒɔ.
4Ala ani na kadi bamba bekyuli baakpá ni,
adi ala ani béti sika ugyiedi ku ɔƒualadi bávɔ
na ammɔ ƒui adi bekyuli enu kabla.
5Bávɔ-nya na ebo kenye, nsu belétemi.
Na bebo anumi, nsu balanu.
6Bebo atu, nsu belenu.
Bebo enwu, nsu balaƒɔ ala ɔnyi.
7Bebo enu, nsu beletuku lɛla lɛdi taanu.
Bebo lɛgba, nsu belesie.
Na belédie lɛdi taasiku ɔkwɛ kemmo.
8Na bekyuli bani návɔ ala ammɔ udu
bélieku ala ani na bávɔ mmɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Na lɛni kani na bani néti bana anu basia-nya
na báƒɔ-nya bádi mmɔ lɛnɔ bese.
9O Israel kadi, bise kayi na Unwoti lɛlɔ.
Anwu muubunku-mii na ɔɔgyumana-mii.
10Aaron ku bakpane kasala, bise kayi na Unwoti lɛlɔ.
Anwu muubunku-mii na ɔɔgyumana-mii.
11Amii bani mɔɔkya lili kalɔ teete Unwoti ƒui
bise kayi na Unwoti lɛlɔ.
Anwu muubunku-mii na ɔɔgyumana-mii.
12Unwoti uuti-bu lɛlɔ kasusu uwi ndi uwi
na ɔdubute-bu kusɛ kusɛ.
Ɔdubute Israel kaba bebi kusɛ kusɛ.
Na ɔdubute Aaron ku nwuna bakpane kasala kusɛ kusɛ.
13Na bani ƒui na beeti ɔbu teete Unwoti ni,
Unwoti ɔdubute-ma kusɛ kusɛ
ama bani mbo kenyekɔ
ku bani neeebo kenyekɔ na bekyuli akɔ ƒui.
14Unwoti ɔya na bɛwɔ
na bimomo amii ku bina bebi ƒui.
15Unwoti ɔni nédie katɔ ku kalɔ
ute-mii kusɛ kusɛ!
16Unwoti mɔɔdi lɛlɔ na katɔ kakaaka ƒui.
Na úti kalɔ kammɔ ɔ́kya bayawine lɛlɔ bɔnu kalɔ.
17Bekpine belemwi Unwoti.
Ama bani ƒui na bébi ala na kalɔ kemmo mmɔ
belémwi Unwoti.
18Nsu abu amu bɔdubumwi Unwoti
ka ɔsi ɔƒɛni úsela uwi ƒui.
Bɛya na bumwi Unwoti.

english_text:
When the Lord Saves You from Death
1I love you, Lord!
You answered my prayers.
2You paid attention to me,
and so I will pray to you
as long as I live.
3Death attacked from all sides,
and I was captured
by its painful chains.
But when I was really hurting,
4I prayed and said, “Lord,
please don't let me die!”
5You are kind, Lord,
so good and merciful.
6You protect ordinary people,
and when I was helpless,
you saved me
7and treated me so kindly
that I don't need
to worry anymore.
8You, Lord, have saved
my life from death,
my eyes from tears,
my feet from stumbling.
9Now I will walk at your side
in this land of the living.
10 I was faithful to you
when I was suffering,
11though in my confusion I said,
“I can't trust anyone!”
12What must I give you, Lord,
for being so good to me?
13I will pour out an offering
of wine to you,
and I will pray in your name
because you
have saved me.
14I will keep my promise to you
when your people meet.
15You are deeply concerned
when one of your loyal people
faces death.
16I worship you, Lord,
just as my mother did,
and you have rescued me
from the chains of death.
17I will offer you a sacrifice
to show how grateful I am,
and I will pray.
18I will keep my promise to you
when your people
19gather at your temple
in Jerusalem.
Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_text:
1Mɔɔyɔ́ Unwoti, ɔsika únu-mi
lɛla lɛni na muuwulo teevele-nwu.
2Na ka uusé atu na uunú-mi bɔkpali ɔsu ni,
ndubo-nwu butaakpali uwi ndi uwi.
3Kukpi ɔgbankpi abuli ényimi-mi.
Na kekpine kénwini aani liƒu kakpagyuɛ
kani ndubo-mi budie.
4Mmɔ na lɛ́kpali Unwoti lɛnyi nnii,
“O Unwoti, die-mi!”
5Unwoti ɔɔnu kɔnyana na use siin.
Bula Katɔti ɔɔnu kɔnyana.
6Bekyuli bani neeebo kablakɔ kadi ni,
Unwoti ɔɔda-ma kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Na uwi ɔni na líduo ɔgbankpi kemmo ni, anwu nédie-mi.
7Ndubɔkɛ kayi na lilie ƒaa,
ɔsika Unwoti ɔ́bla-mi lɛƒɔndia lɛni ƒui na mɔɔwia.
8Ɔsika awɔ Unwoti édie-mi ásiku kukpi kemmo.
Na áya na lɛ́da buwulo lɛ́ya.
Na áda-mi na ńtebuli.
9Na nli mɔɔdi ƒula etemila lɛlɔ geen
na bayawine akɔ.
10Lɛ́ƒɔ Katɔti lɛ́di,
anwuɔsu na mɔɔsu ka ala eekpóku-mi
na mɔɔyɔ́ likpi muedi.
11Ina uwi ɔni na kayi kaakpulu-mi
na ɔ́bla-mi dɛye dɛye ni,
lɛ́su nnini, “Ɔkɔ banyine kani na bekyuli ƒui badi.”
12Bi na ndubɔkana na lite Unwoti
na ala abuni ani ƒui na ɔ́bla úte-mi ɔsu?
13Ndubuti ɔɔƒɛɛ ku ntɛ minimini etela
mbakpa lite Unwoti
na lɛgya-nwu enu ka ɔ́ƒɔ-mi ngba ɔsu.
14Na ala ani kenye na líse ka meboku Unwoti ni,
ndubuti-nya liboku na kadi ƒui anumi.
15Kaƒɔ kalayɔ-ɔ
ka lɛla lɛdi lɛya na ƒula ukyuli kedee ɔdi ukpi.
16O Unwoti, ƒula kabla ɔblane na ndi
na mɔɔbla kabla aani mina uni kalɛ.
Áƒɛ kɔgba kɔni nda-mi.
17Ndubuti linugya etela
mbakpa lite-ɔ.
18Na ala ani kenye na líse-ɔ ni,
ndubuti-nya liboku-ɔ na kadi bekyuli anumi.
19Unwoti kaduli na ndubuti-nya liboku
na awɔ Yerusalem bekyuli anumi.
Bɛya na bumwi Unwoti.

english_text:
Come Praise the Lord
1 All of you nations,
come praise the Lord!
Let everyone praise him.
2God's love for us is wonderful;
his faithfulness never ends.
Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_text:
1Amii kadi ƒui bekyuli, bimwi Unwoti lɛnyi.
Amii bekyuli ƒui, bimwi-nwu.
2Ɔsika ɔɔbla-bu lɛƒɔndia,
na ɔɔdi nwuna litemi lɛlɔ
teete nwuna bekyuli uwi ƒui.
Bɛya na bumwi Unwoti.

english_text:
The Lord Is Always Merciful
1 Tell the Lord
how thankful you are,
because he is kind
and always merciful.
2Let Israel shout,
“God is always merciful!”
3Let the family of Aaron
the priest shout,
“God is always merciful!”
4Let every true worshiper
of the Lord shout,
“God is always merciful!”
5When I was really hurting,
I prayed to the Lord.
He answered my prayer,
and took my worries away.
6 The Lord is on my side,
and I am not afraid
of what others can do to me.
7With the Lord on my side,
I will defeat
my hateful enemies.
8It is better to trust the Lord
for protection
than to trust anyone else,
9including strong leaders.
10Nations surrounded me,
but I got rid of them
by the power of the Lord.
11They attacked from all sides,
but I got rid of them
by the power of the Lord.
12They swarmed around like bees,
but by the power of the Lord,
I got rid of them
and their fiery sting.
13Their attacks were so fierce
that I nearly fell,
but the Lord helped me.
14 My power and my strength
come from the Lord,
and he has saved me.
15From the tents of God's people
come shouts of victory:
“The Lord is powerful!
16With his mighty arm
the Lord wins victories!
The Lord is powerful!”
17And so my life is safe,
and I will live to tell
what the Lord has done.
18He punished me terribly,
but he did not let death
lay its hands on me.
19Open the gates of justice!
I will enter and tell the Lord
how thankful I am.
20Here is the gate of the Lord!
Everyone who does right
may enter this gate.
21I praise the Lord
for answering my prayers
and saving me.
22 The stone that the builders
tossed aside
has now become
the most important stone.
23The Lord has done this,
and it is amazing to us.
24This day belongs to the Lord!
Let's celebrate
and be glad today.
25 We'll ask the Lord to save us!
We'll sincerely ask the Lord
to let us win.
26 God bless the one who comes
in the name of the Lord!
We praise you from here
in the house of the Lord.
27The Lord is our God,
and he has given us light!
Start the celebration!
March with palm branches
all the way to the altar.
28The Lord is my God!
I will praise him and tell him
how thankful I am.
29Tell the Lord
how thankful you are,
because he is kind
and always merciful.
translation_text:
1Bɛgya Unwoti enu, ɔsika ɔdia
na ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.
2Israel kadi bekyuli ƒui bɛsu bɛnii
“Unwoti ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.”
3Bɛya na Aaron ku nwuna bakpane kasala basu banini
“Unwoti ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.”
4Na bekyuli bani ƒui mɔɔyia Unwoti basu banini,
“Unwoti ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.”
5Uwi ɔni na ala eekpóku-mi geen ni,
lɛ́kpali Unwoti na únu úte-mi
na údie-mi na mina lɛbibo kemmo.
6Unwoti unyeku-mi, anwuɔsu lɛɛɛdubo bɔyia.
Bi na ukyuli ɔdubɔkana-mi bɔbla?
7Unwoti unye-mi kama ka ubunku-mi
anwuɔsu bekyuli bani muukisi-mi ƒui ni,
mɔɔnu-ma aani bekyuli bani lɛlɔ na lɛ́ɛdi.
8Ɔdia ka ukyuli ukeli utátamiku Unwoti
utulo ka asia ukyuli ɔdi lɛnu.
9Ɔdia ka ekeli atátamiku Unwoti
utulo ka asia ɔyikune ɔdi lɛnu.
10Kadi ƒui bekyuli bani muukisi-mi báka bámana-mi
nsu lɛ́bɔku-ma ƒui na Unwoti lɛnyi kemmo!
11Báka bámana-mi ƒui na benye lɛƒɛnyi ƒui lɛlɔ,
nsu lɛ́bɔku-ma ƒui na Unwoti lɛnyi kemmo.
12Báka bámana-mi aani banwɛnwɛ
na bana anumi égyie na mina lɛlɔ
aani kalɛ na lɛnyɛ ogya ɔɔda.
Nsu lɛ́bɔku-ma ƒui na Unwoti lɛnyi kemmo.
13Bénye-mi lɛlɔ kpakplaa ɔni na kébu blii na badi-mi lɛlɔ.
Nsu Unwoti úbunku-mi.
14Katɔti mɔɔkya-mi ɔyikun,
na nwuna lɛnyi kani ndi mina kekpo ɔnu ɔni muudie.
Na anwu kani náƒɔ-mi ngba.
15Binu lɛlɔyɔ lɛnu lɛni nda na Katɔti bekyuli
bani nse siin mmɔ nvo kemmo
ka Unwoti ɔ́ya na bádi lɛlɔ ɔsu.
Baava banini, “Katɔti kɔnu kɔni mbo ɔyikun geen mmɔ
nádi lɛnanabi!
16Unwoti nédie nwuna kɔnu
na ɔ́tina nwuna ɔyikun geen mmɔ na ɔ́di lɛlɔ.
Unwoti ɔmmɔ ndi ɔyikune!”
17Lɛɛɛdubo bukpi, mmomu ndubulie ngba
na lɛka Unwoti ablala lɛsu bekyuli.
18Unwoti ɔ́ni-mi kɔtu kpakplaa,
nsu útaya na likpi.
19Lɛmi ƒula kakpakɔ kayakun
kani na áklibi ése éte bekyuli bani nse siin,
na lɛsia-ka kemmo liduo mbagya-a enu.
20Aanu Unwoti kakpakɔ ɔban kayakun
kani kemmo na bekyuli bani nse siin badubɔsia beduo.
21Mɔɔgyá-a enu ka énu-mi bɔkpali
na áya na lɛ́di mina bekisine lɛlɔ.
22Lɛtabi lɛni na batune béni báva ni,
ani nébenwini lɛtabi lɛni náƒɔ kuye lítulo
na atabi ƒui akɔ.
23Unwoti nábla lɛla bonwu lɛmɛni.
Na lɛ́ƒɔ-bu anu geen.
24Limeyi lɛmɛni na Unwoti údie úte-bu ka bɔdi lɛlɔ.
Bɛya bɔkɛ lɛlɔyɔ na ebiti ada-bu na limeyi lɛmmɔ ɔsu.
25Ƒɔ-bu ngba, O Unwoti, buvele bɔda-a!
Ya na bula kabla ƒui katɛ kete-bu.
26Bimwi anwu ɔni ndubo na Unwoti lɛnyi kemmo.
Kusɛ kusɛ ɔsiaku-ɔ ɔsiku Unwoti kakpakɔ mɛni.
27Unwoti ndi Katɔti ɔni náya na bula anumi ékeye ka bɔ́di lɛlɔ.
Bɛƒɛ kugyii kɔgba ku evete bɛda na bɛkɛ lisu ku ɔbu
na bɛka bɛmana lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ
bitédu kesii kani nse kedee mmɔ.
28Awɔ ndi mina Katɔti na ndubɔgya-a enu.
Na ndubɔkɔliku-ɔ lɛnyi katɔ, ɔsika awɔ ndi mina Katɔti.
29Bɛgya Unwoti enu, ɔsika ɔdia
na ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.

english_text:
In Praise of the Law of the Lord
1Our Lord, you bless everyone
who lives right
and obeys your Law.
2You bless all those
who follow your commands
from deep in their hearts
3and who never do wrong
or turn from you.
4You have ordered us always
to obey your teachings;
5I don't ever want to stray
from your laws.
6Thinking about your commands
will keep me from doing
some foolish thing.
7I will do right and praise you
by learning to respect
your perfect laws.
8I will obey all of them!
Don't turn your back on me.
9Young people can live
a clean life
by obeying your word.
10I worship you
with all my heart.
Don't let me walk away
from your commands.
11I treasure your word
above all else;
it keeps me from sinning
against you.
12I praise you, Lord!
Teach me your laws.
13With my own mouth,
I tell others the laws
that you have spoken.
14Obeying your instructions
brings as much happiness
as being rich.
15I will study your teachings
and follow your footsteps.
16I will take pleasure
in your laws
and remember your words.
17Treat me with kindness, Lord,
so that I may live
and do what you say.
18Open my mind
and let me discover
the wonders of your Law.
19I live here as a stranger.
Don't keep me from knowing
your commands.
20What I want most
and at all times
is to honor your laws.
21You punish those boastful,
worthless nobodies who turn
from your commands.
22Don't let them sneer
and insult me
for following you.
23I keep thinking about
your teachings, Lord,
even if rulers plot
against me.
24Your laws are my greatest joy!
I follow their advice.
25I am at the point of death.
Let your teachings
breathe new life into me.
26When I told you my troubles,
you answered my prayers.
Now teach me your laws.
27Help me to understand
your teachings,
and I will think about
your marvelous deeds.
28I am overcome with sorrow.
Encourage me,
as you have promised to do.
29Keep me from being deceitful,
and be kind enough
to teach me your Law.
30I am determined to be faithful
and to respect your laws.
31I follow your rules, Lord.
Don't let me be ashamed.
32I am eager to learn all
that you want me to do;
help me to understand more.
33Point out your rules, Lord,
and I won't disobey
even one of them.
34Help me to understand your Law;
I promise to obey it
with all my heart.
35Direct me by your commands!
I love to do what you say.
36Make me want to obey you,
rather than to be rich.
37Take away my foolish desires,
and let me find life
by walking with you.
38I am your servant!
Do for me what you promised
to those who worship you.
39Your wonderful teachings
protect me from the insults
that I hate so much.
40I long for your teachings.
Be true to yourself
and let me live.
41Show me your love
and save me, Lord,
as you have promised.
42Then I will have an answer
for everyone who insults me
for trusting your word.
43I rely on your laws!
Don't take away my chance
to speak your truth.
44I will keep obeying your Law
forever and ever.
45I have gained perfect freedom
by following your teachings,
46and I trust them so much
that I tell them to kings.
47I love your commands!
They bring me happiness.
48I love and respect them
and will keep them in mind.
49Don't forget your promise
to me, your servant.
I depend on it.
50When I am hurting,
I find comfort in your promise
that leads to life.
51Conceited people sneer at me,
but I obey your Law.
52I find true comfort, Lord,
because your laws have stood
the test of time.
53I get furious when evil people
turn against your Law.
54No matter where I am,
your teachings
fill me with songs.
55Even in the night
I think about you, Lord,
and I obey your Law.
56You have blessed me
because I have always followed
your teachings.
57You, Lord, are my choice,
and I will obey you.
58With all my heart
I beg you to be kind to me,
just as you have promised.
59I pay careful attention
as you lead me,
and I follow closely.
60As soon as you command,
I do what you say.
61Evil people may set a trap,
