but I obey your Law.
62Your laws are so fair
that I wake up and praise you
in the middle of the night.
63I choose as my friends
everyone who worships you
and follows your teachings.
64Our Lord, your love is seen
all over the world.
Teach me your laws.
65I am your servant, Lord,
and you have kept your promise
to treat me with kindness.
66Give me wisdom and good sense.
I trust your commands.
67Once you corrected me
for not obeying you,
but now I do obey.
68You are kindhearted,
and you do good things,
so teach me your laws.
69My reputation is being ruined
by conceited liars,
but with all my heart
I follow your teachings.
70Those liars have no sense,
but I find happiness
in your Law.
71When you corrected me,
it did me good
because it taught me
to study your laws.
72I would rather obey you
than to have a thousand pieces
of silver and gold.
73You created me
and put me together.
Make me wise enough to learn
what you have commanded.
74Your worshipers will see me,
and they will be glad
that I trust your word.
75Your decisions are correct,
and you were right
to punish me.
76I serve you, Lord.
Comfort me with your love,
just as you have promised.
77I love to obey your Law!
Have mercy and let me live.
78Put down those proud people
who hurt me with their lies,
because I have chosen
to study your teachings.
79Let your worshipers come to me,
so they will learn
to obey your rules.
80Let me truly respect your laws,
so I won't be ashamed.
81I long for you to rescue me!
Your word is my only hope.
82I am worn out from waiting
for you to keep your word.
When will you have mercy?
83My life is wasting away
like a dried-up wineskin,
but I have not forgotten
your teachings.
84I am your servant!
How long must I suffer?
When will you punish
those troublemakers?
85Those proud people reject
your teachings,
and they dig pits
for me to fall in.
86Your laws can be trusted!
Protect me from cruel liars.
87They have almost killed me,
but I have been faithful
to your teachings.
88Show that you love me
and let me live,
so that I may obey
your commands.
89Our Lord, you are eternal!
Your word will last as long
as the heavens.
90You remain faithful
in every generation,
and the earth you created
will keep standing firm.
91All things are your servants,
and the laws you made
are still in effect today.
92If I had not found happiness
in obeying your Law,
I would have died in misery.
93I won't ever forget
your teachings,
because you give me new life
when I follow them.
94I belong to you,
and I have respected your laws,
so keep me safe.
95Brutal enemies are waiting
to ambush and destroy me,
but I obey your rules.
96Nothing is completely perfect,
except your teachings.
97I deeply love your Law!
I think about it all day.
98Your laws never leave my mind,
and they make me much wiser
than my enemies.
99Thinking about your teachings
gives me better understanding
than my teachers,
100and obeying your laws
makes me wiser than those
who have lived a long time.
101I obey your word
instead of following a way
that leads to trouble.
102You have been my teacher,
and I won't reject
your instructions.
103Your teachings are sweeter
than honey.
104They give me understanding
and make me hate all lies.
105Your word is a lamp
that gives light
wherever I walk.
106Your laws are fair,
and I have given my word
to respect them all.
107I am in terrible pain!
Save me, Lord,
as you have promised.
108Accept my offerings of praise
and teach me your laws.
109I never forget your teachings,
although my life is always
in danger.
110Some merciless people
are trying to trap me,
but I never turn my back
on your teachings.
111They will always be
my most prized possession
and my source of joy.
112I have made up my mind
to obey your laws forever,
no matter what.
113I hate anyone
whose loyalty is divided,
but I love your Law.
114You are my place of safety
and my shield.
Your word is my only hope.
115All you worthless people,
get away from me!
I am determined to obey
the commands of my God.
116Be true to your word, Lord.
Keep me alive and strong;
don't let me be ashamed
because of my hope.
117Keep me safe and secure,
so that I will always
respect your laws.
118You reject all deceitful liars
because they refuse
your teachings.
119As far as you are concerned,
evil people are garbage,
and so I follow your rules.
120I tremble all over
when I think of you
and the way you judge.
121I did what was fair and right!
Don't hand me over to those
who want to mistreat me.
122Take good care of me,
your servant,
and don't let me be harmed
by those conceited people.
123My eyes are weary from waiting
to see you keep your promise
to come and save me.
124Show your love for me,
your servant,
and teach me your laws.
125I serve you,
so let me understand
your teachings.
126Do something, Lord!
They have broken your Law.
127Your laws mean more to me
than the finest gold.
128I follow all your commands,
but I hate anyone
who leads me astray.
129Your teachings are wonderful,
and I respect them all.
130Understanding your word
brings light to the minds
of ordinary people.
131I honestly want to know
everything you teach.
132Think about me and be kind,
just as you are to everyone
who loves your name.
133Keep your promise
and don't let me stumble
or let sin control my life.
134Protect me from abuse,
so I can obey your laws.
135Smile on me, your servant,
and teach me your laws.
136When anyone disobeys you,
my eyes overflow with tears.
137Our Lord, you always do right,
and your decisions are fair.
138All your teachings are true
and trustworthy.
139It upsets me greatly
when my enemies neglect
your teachings.
140Your word to me, your servant,
is like pure gold;
I treasure what you say.
141Everyone calls me a nobody,
but I remember your laws.
142You will always do right,
and your teachings are true.
143I am in deep distress,
but I love your teachings.
144Your rules are always fair.
Help me to understand them
and live.
145I pray to you, Lord!
Please answer me.
I promise to obey your laws.
146I beg you to save me,
so I can follow your rules.
147Even before sunrise,
I pray for your help,
and I put my hope
in what you have said.
148I lie awake at night,
thinking of your promises.
149Show that you love me, Lord,
and answer my prayer.
Please do the right thing
and save my life.
150People who disobey your Law
have made evil plans
and want to hurt me,
151but you are with me,
and all your commands
can be trusted.
152From studying your laws,
I found out long ago
you made them to last forever.
153I have not forgotten your Law!
Look at the trouble I am in,
and rescue me.
154Be my defender and protector!
Remember your promise
and save my life.
155Evil people won't obey you,
and so they have no hope
of being saved.
156You are merciful, Lord!
Please do the right thing
and save my life.
157I have a lot of brutal enemies,
but still I never turn
from your laws.
158Those unfaithful people
who refuse to obey you
are disgusting to me.
159Remember how I love your laws,
and show your love for me
by keeping me safe.
160All you say can be trusted;
your teachings are true
and will last forever.
161Rulers are cruel to me
for no reason.
But with all my heart
I respect your words,
162because they bring happiness
like treasures taken in war.
163I can't stand liars,
but I love your Law.
164I praise you seven times a day
because your laws are fair.
165You give peace of mind
to all who love your Law.
Nothing can make them fall.
166You are my only hope
for being saved, Lord,
and I do all you command.
167I love and obey your laws
with all my heart.
168You know everything I do.
You know I respect every law
you have given.
169Please, Lord, hear my prayer
and give me the understanding
that comes from your word.
170Listen to my concerns
and keep me safe,
just as you have promised.
171If you will teach me your laws,
I will praise you 172and sing
about your promise,
because all your teachings
are what they ought to be.
173Be ready to protect me
because I have chosen
to obey your laws.
174I am waiting for you
to save me, Lord.
Your Law makes me happy.
175Keep me alive,
so I can praise you,
and let me find help
in your teachings.
176I am your servant,
but I have wandered away
like a lost sheep.
Please come after me,
because I have not forgotten
your teachings.
translation_text:
1Lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ bekyuli bani na likpidi bɔbla
buuubo-ma keliela kemmo.
Mmomu beelie ngba
na Unwoti ɔda bubo kenye.
2Na lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ bani ƒui mɔɔsia nwuna ɔda bubo anu
na baadi-mu lɛlɔ ku bana kayi ƒui.
3Na balábla likpidi lɛdi,
mmomu baasia Unwoti kama uwi biala.
4Unwoti, awɔ néti ƒula ɔda bubo éte-bu
na ásu-bu ka bɔdi-mu lɛlɔ kaduɛ.
5Mɔɔwia kpakplaa geen
ka lɛdi ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ kaduɛ.
6Na si lɛ́kana na lɛ́di ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ ƒui kaduɛ ni,
kɔƒa kulékpo-mi.
7Ndubɔtɛya kalɛ na ƒula litemi lɛɛnu ala kemmo siin.
Na limwi-ɔ ku kayi kani nse sɛɛn.
8Ndubɔdi ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ geen
na lɛɛɛdubo-mu kama bɔlɛ kudii.
9Na ulu ɔmani lɛlɔ na okloƒu ɔdi ɔdubɔkana na ɔsia
na ɔda nwuna ngba sɛɛn?
Amu ntu ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ bɔdi kani.
10Mɔɔkya ɔkplu ka liti mina ɔyikun ƒui lɛbla ƒula kabla.
Anwuɔsu gyumana-mi kalɛ na neeenwini kama
naaakya ƒula ɔda bubo kudii.
11Lɛ́klibi ƒula litemi lɛ́kya mina kayi kemmo
kalɛ na naaabla likpidi lɛdi naaaƒiɔ-ɔ.
12Unwoti, muumwi ƒula lɛnyi.
Tina-mi ƒula ɔda bubo.
13Na ɔda bubo bɔni na éte-bu ni,
ndubɔkɔ-mu lɛsa lite bekyuli ƒui.
14Na ndubɔsia ƒula ɔda bubo kama ku ebiti
litulo kalɛ na ukyuli ɔɔsiaku lɛkɛ bonwu kama ku ebiti.
15Ndubo-mu kemmo buteeduo,
na mina anumi adubɔsia-mu lɛlɔ uwi biala.
16Lɛlɔ lɛdubo-mi butaayɔ na ɔda bubo bɔmɛni lɛlɔ.
Na lɛɛɛdubo ƒula etemila amɛni bɔyiƒala kudii.
17Da-mi kɔkɔɔkɔ ƒula kabla ɔblane
kalɛ na lɛdi ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ kaduɛ.
18Ya na mina anumi ebimi na lɛnu
etemila geen ani nkya ƒula ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ kemmo lɛti.
19Ɔƒɔ na ndi na ntebo kayawi bulie gyɔlɔɔ.
Ɔmɛni ɔsu tabɛla-mi ƒula ɔda bubo.
20Mina kayi kaada ogya
uwi biala ka mɔɔwia lɛti ƒula ɔda bubo ɔsu.
21Aadɔnku bekyuli bekpidi bani naaadaku ƒula ɔda bubo lɛda.
Na ewida aasiaku bekyuli bani naaadi ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ.
22Da-mi die bana kavinkɔ kalɛ na beléteedumi-mi
na bataakya-mi lɛlɔ lɛma.
Ɔsika nsia ƒula ɔda bubo anu uwi biala.
23Ina ka bagadine baasa lili na mina lɛlɔ ni,
lɛɛɛdubo ƒula etemila kemmo buduo bɔda bɔya.
24Ƒula ala ani na aatina-mi mɔɔyɔ́-mi kaƒɔ.
Na anya mɔɔlɛ-mi lɛnɔ.
25Aanu kalɛ na líbuli ntɛ kalɔ ɔtumu akɔ
na nsɔ liiibo ngba geen bɔdi.
Ya na ƒula litemi lɛsɔku-mi liboku ngba.
26Ka lídie mina alaekpidi kalɔ ni, ánu-mi kɔnyana.
Anwuɔsu tina-mi ƒula ulu.
27Na aya na linu ƒula ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ kalɔ.
Na ndubuduo kasusu kemmo ɔ́si ala ani na átina-mi lɛlɔ.
28Líduo kɔnyana geen.
Kya-mi ɔkplu aani kalɛ na ásu-mi ése kpakplaa ka adubɔbla.
29Na ada-mi kɔkɔɔkɔ kalɛ na naaasia ulu ukpidi ɔdi lɛlɔ.
Bla-mi lɛƒɔndia na atina-mi ƒula ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ.
30Lɛ́ƒuna ka lɛdi ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ.
Na ɔmmɔ ntɔ-mi anumi na mɔɔnu.
31Mina Unwoti, ƒula ala ani na átina-mi kama na nsia kpakplaa.
Ɔmmɔ ɔsu taya na kɔƒa kukpo-mi.
32Ndubugyele anumi lɛsia ƒula ɔda bubo kama,
ɔsika adubɔya na linu ala kalɔ libu.
33Anwuɔsu ni, Unwoti, tina-mi ƒula ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ.
Na ndubɔdi-mu lɛlɔ uwi biala.
34Die-mu kalɔ te-mi na lɛsiaku-mu kama.
Na madi-mu lɛlɔ lɛnɔ ku mina kayi ƒui.
35Tɔnku-mi siaku ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ.
Ɔsika amu ndubɔya na lɛkɛ ebiti.
36Ya na ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ bɔdi butaada-mi ɔkwɛ
teetulo kalɛ na lɛkɛ lɛkɛ.
37Da-mi na lɛda atu lidie ala keeke ani neeebo kɔsia kɔdi lɛlɔ.
Na aya na lilie ngba lɛsiaku ƒula ulu lɛlɔ.
38Muuvele nnii di ƒula linyese lɛlɔ te-mi
aani kalɛ na aabla teete ƒula kabla ɔblane biala
ɔni mɔɔbu-ɔ ku bɔyia.
39Taya na mina bekisine bakɛ-mi bedumi ku bana enyekpi.
Ɔsika adubɔtɛ ami ku-ma litemi na ulu lɛlɔ.
40Mɔɔwia kpakplaa ka lɛdi ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ.
Anwuɔsu ya-mi na lilie ngba bɔwɔdi
ɔkɛnku kalɛ na ese siin lɛlɔ.
41O Unwoti, tina-mi ka aayɔ́-mi geen uwi biala.
Na aƒɔ-mi aani kalɛ na ése-mi kenye.
42Na lɛkɛ lɛla lɛdi lɛsu bekyuli bani mɔɔtu-mi akpɛlɛ.
Ɔsika ƒula litemi lɛlɔ kani na mina anu asia.
43Ya na ntaatɛmi ƒula etemila geen uwi biala.
Ɔsika ƒula litemi bɔtɛ kani na nnye mɔɔnu ulu teete.
44Na ndubɔdi ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ
úsela uwi ƒui.
45Na ndubulie ku kayi ƒaa,
ɔsika mɔɔkya ɔkplu ka lɛdi ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ kaduɛ.
46Ndubunye baga anumi
na lidie ƒula ɔda bubo keyi lɛtina-ma
na kɔƒa kulékpo-mi.
47Ɔsika mɔɔyɔ́ ƒula litemi
na si mɔɔdi-ni lɛlɔ ni, lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́-mi.
48Mɔɔyɔ́ ƒula ɔda bubo na mɔɔbu-mu lɛnɔ.
Na ndubuduo ƒula ala ani na ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ
bɔɔtina-mi kemmo uwi biala.
49Tayiƒala ƒula kenye kani na ásu ami ƒula kabla ɔblane ése,
ɔsika kana lɛlɔ na mbo lɛnunsia.
50Na ɔmmɔ ɔɔsia-mi kɔnu si ina lɛla lɛdi liikpóku-mi.
Ɔsika ƒula linyese lɛmmɔ lɛɛsɔku-mi ngba taabla ɔwɔdi.
51Bekyuli bani na baláyia-a beenye teedumi-mi.
Nsu ɔmmɔ útaya-mi na linwini na ƒula ulu lɛlɔ.
52Unwoti, si línyimo kalɛ na aatɛ etemila ɔ́si kukuuku ƒui ni,
na mina kayi keelie kalɔ.
53Livo geen liiƒí-mi
si mɔɔnu kalɛ na belikplune baládi ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ.
54Na uwi klukui ɔni na líbo ngba bulie mɛni kemmo ni,
lɛ́nwi lɛnu lɛ́siku ƒula ɔda bubo etemila lɛlɔ.
55Unwoti, muunyimo-ɔ usien.
Na muuduo mina kasusu kemmo taanu
ɔ́siku ƒula etemila lɛlɔ.
56Na ebiti aada-mi
si mɔɔdi ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ.
57Unwoti, awɔ ndi mina kese.
Na mɔɔsu kpakplaa ka ndubɔdi ƒula litemi lɛlɔ.
58Na muuvele-ɔ ku mina kayi ƒui
ka abla ƒula linyese lɛlɔ ete-mi na abla-mi lɛƒɔndia.
59Líduo mina ngba kemmo lɛ́nu laa na lɛ́lɛ ugyii
ka ndubɔsiaku ƒula ala ani na aatina-mi kama.
60Nsɔ naaakpɛ kama,
mmomu ndubɔbabla na lɛdi ƒula etemila lɛlɔ.
61Bekisine baakywɛ-mi kɔkpagyuɛ
nsu lɛɛɛdubo ƒula ɔda bubo bɔyiƒala kudii.
62Usientɛ muedi mɔɔta teemwi-ɔ,
ɔsika aatɛ litemi ulu siin lɛlɔ.
63Na bekyuli bani na baabu-ɔ
na baadi ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ ni,
ama na mɔɔdiku kɔkpana.
64Unwoti, aayɔ́ kayawi bekyuli ƒui
ku kaƒɔ nwaa uwi biala kemmo.
Tina-mi ƒula ɔda bubo.
65O Unwoti, ádi ƒula litemi lɛlɔ
na ábla ami ƒula kabla ɔblane lɛƒɔndia.
66Ya-mi na lɛda anu na lɛti lɛla,
ɔsika ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ kani na líkpo kama.
67Lídeyi ƒula ɔda bubo ulu lɛlɔ, anwuɔsu na áni-mi kɔtu.
Na ɔƒaani ni, nda ƒula ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ kpakplaa.
68Awɔ ndi Unwoti buni na aabla lɛƒɔndia uwi biala.
Tina-mi ƒula ɔda bubo.
69Bekyuli bani mɔɔtina lɛlɔ
bakɛ baasu ɔkɔ etemila na mina lɛlɔ taavi.
Nsu ami líti mina kayi ƒui mɔɔdi ƒula etemila lɛlɔ.
70Bana kasusu kaalɛɛ aani ebuo lɛmwi na belenu lɛla lɛdi kalɔ.
Nsu ami ni, lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́-mi geen na ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ.
71Na kɔtu kɔni na áni-mi ɔ́ya na lili lɛ́dia-mi geen,
ɔsika ɔ́ya na muuduo ƒula etemila kemmo kaduɛ.
72Na ƒula ɔda bubo bubo-mi kɔsia
utulo lɛla biala ku sika ugyiedi ku ɔƒualadi ƒui.
73Awɔ néti ƒula enu ávɔ-mi na ada-mi lɛnɔ.
Ya na nteenu ala kalɔ na lɛtɛya ƒula ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ kaduɛ.
74Na bekyuli bani ƒui mɔɔbu-ɔ ni, lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ-ma si bánu-mi.
Ɔsika ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ kani na mina ánu asia.
75Ngyi ka ƒula litemi bɔtɛ buse siin.
Na ɔkɛnku kalɛ na asia ƒula litemi kama ɔsu na áni-mi kɔtu.
76Ya na mina kayi kabla buɛɛ na kalɛ na aayɔ́-mi ɔsu,
aani kalɛ na ásu ami ƒula kabla ɔblane ése.
77Nu-mi kɔnyana na aya na lilie ngba.
Ɔsika ƒula ɔda bubo bɔ́ya na mɔɔkɛ lɛlɔyɔ geen.
78Na bekyuli bani ƒui na balábu-ɔ ni, ya na kɔƒa kukpo-ma.
Ama mɔɔtina lɛlɔ na baadá-mi kenye keeke.
Na ami amu ni,
mina kasusu kadubo butaasia ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ.
79Na bekyuli bani mɔɔyia-a na baabu-ɔ ni,
bana anu enwini asia-mi lɛlɔ
ku ama bani mɔɔdi ƒula etemila lɛlɔ.
80Ya na mina kayi kasia ulu siin lɛlɔ
na ntasia ƒula litemi kama kalɛ na kɔƒa kulékpo-mi.
81Nnye mɔɔnu ulu taanɔ kpakplaa ka ebo abaƒɔ-mi,
nsu mina anu asia ƒula litemi lɛlɔ.
82Mina anumi ákpa atu na nnye mɔɔnu ulu lite ƒula linyese.
Na ɔmmɔ ɔsu na líye muedi nnini,
“Uwi ɔmani na adubo-mi kɔnu bɔsia?”
83Mina ngba bɔɔyii udu aani ntɛ lɛbo lɛni na liyɔda líƒie.
Ina amu ni, nnye mɔɔnu ulu na ńtayiƒala ƒula ɔda bubo.
84Uwi ɛlɛ na ndubunye ntaanu ulu ntédu.
Na lɛmameyi na adubɔtɛku bekyuli
bani muukpóku-mi litemi na ani-ma kɔtu?
85Bekyuli bani mɔɔtina lɛlɔ na baládi ƒula etemila lɛlɔ
benye beekú-mi kalɔ uwi biala taakywɛ-mi kɔkpagyuɛ.
86Ƒula ɔda bubo etemila ƒui adi ani lɛlɔ na ukyuli ukpo kama.
Anwuɔsu bunku-mi na ɔkɔ banyine
bani muukpóku-mi keeke ɔsu.
87Benye-mi lɛlɔ kpakplaa na kébu blii kani na badu-mi.
Nsu ɔmɛni ƒui kama ńtenwini kama ńtakya ƒula ɔda bubo.
88Ɔkɛnku ƒula bɔyɔ bɔni naaayii udu ɔsu ni,
ƒɔ-mi ngba na lilie ntaadi ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ.
89Unwoti, ƒula litemi lɛdi litemi geen
lɛni nnye kpakplaa na Katɔ Ɔga Ɔma uwi ƒui.
90Na aadi ƒula litemi lɛlɔ siin teete kaba bekyuli ƒui.
Édie kayawi na kenye kana kenyekɔ kpakplaa.
91Ƒula ala ediedi ƒui akya ábalɛ ku ɔmwi limeyi,
ɔsika ana ƒui aabla ƒula kabla.
92Na si ɔɔɔdi ɔni na ƒula ɔda bubo bɔdi mina lɛlɔyɔ ɔsu ni,
nka lɛ́ɛyii udu
na kalɛ na mina ala eekpóku-mi ɔsu.
93Lɛɛɛdubo ƒula ɔda bubo bɔda bɔnyonu kudii,
ɔsika ɔkɛnku-mu lɛlɔ na éti ada-mi na mmu nli ngba.
94Ƒɔ-mi ngba, ɔsika awɔdi na ndi
na mɔɔsia ƒula ɔda bubo kama uwi biala.
95Belikplune benye baatú-mi uwi biala ka bebile-mi ngba.
Nsu ƒula etemila lɛlɔ kani na mɔɔbla mina kasusu uwi biala.
96Na lɛ́nu ka lɛla biala ina dɛ na lɛɛdia bɔnu ni, libo kawɔlɔkɔ.
Nsu ƒula litemi ani lise lísela ƒui na liiibo kawɔlɔkɔ.
97Nu kalɛ sɔɔn na mɔɔyɔ́ ƒula litemi.
Na mɔɔbla kasusu taasiku-ni lɛlɔ uwi biala.
98Ƒula ɔda bubo nkɛnku-mi uwi biala
na bɔɔyá na mɔɔdá anu teetulo mina bekisine.
99Na muunú-mu kalɔ teetulo bani mɔɔtina-mi ala ammɔ muedi.
Ɔsika muuduo-mu kemmo uwi biala.
100Na ngyi enengula ntulo benengu geen bammɔ alati,
ɔsika nda ƒula ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ geen.
101Na muunwíni na ekpidi lilu biala kama
kalɛ na liti ƒula etemila lɛda.
102Na ala ani na ényimi ni, naaada-nya taava ɔƒɛnyi,
ɔsika lɛni na átina-mi na ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ kemmo.
103Ƒula etemila aayu-mi geen
teetulo kalɛ na uwɔ ɔɔyu kenye emini.
104Ɔkɛnku ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ ɔsu na mina kasusu kese nwaa.
Na ɔmmɔ ɔsu na nkisi likpidi ulu biala.
105Ƒula litemi lɛdi asogya ute mina lɛgba.
Na uukeye teewi mina kasiakɔ.
106Líse kenye na lɛ́su
ka ndubɔdi ƒula ɔda bubo bɔni nse siin lɛlɔ ƒui.
107Ala benye eekpóku-mi kpakplaa,
anwuɔsu die-mi O Unwoti, ɔkɛnku ƒula linyese lɛlɔ.
108Unwoti, ƒɔ mina enu ani na mɔɔgyá-a ku mina kayi ƒui
na atina-mi ƒula ɔda bubo.
109Mina ngba bɔtu ugyii kenye uwi biala na bekisine bammɔ ɔsu.
Nsu naaayiƒala ƒula ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ.
110Belikplune bákywɛ-mi kakpagyuɛ.
Nsu ńtedeyi ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ.
111Ƒula ɔda bubo bɔɔyɔ́-mi kaƒɔ na bɔdi mina kese uwi ƒui.
112Lɛ́lɛ ugyii ku mina kaƒɔ nwaa
ka ndubɔbla lɛsiaku ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ
uwi ƒui utédu kawɔlɔkɔ.
113Na bekyuli bani na bana kasusu kese inyɔ inyɔ
na ƒula lɛlɔ ni, nkisi-ma.
Na ami ni, mɔɔyɔ́ ƒula ɔda bubo.
114Awɔ ndi mina katamikukɔ ku ukyuli ɔni na ɔɔgyumana-mi.
Na ƒula linyese lɛlɔ kani na mbo lɛnunsia.
115Bɛgyu lɛgba bɛtɔlɔ-mi kudɔ amii alaekpidi bablane.
Mina Katɔti ɔda bubo lɛlɔ kani na ndubɔdi.
116Da-mi kɔkɔɔkɔ ɔkɛnku ƒula linyese lɛlɔ na lilie ngba.
Na taya na kɔƒa kukpo-mi na mina lɛnunsia ƒui kama!
117Da-mi, na makɛ bɔƒɔ!
Na ntaadi ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ uwi biala kemmo.
118Awɔ muuní bekyuli bani ƒui na baládi ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ.
Na bana ɔkɔ ala bɔbla ƒui bɔdi kɔkwɛ kukpludi
kɔni neeebo kɔsia.
119Na belikplune bammɔ ni, aanu-ma aani kebu alakpi.
Na ɔmmɔ ɔsu na ami mɔɔyɔ́ ƒula ɔda bubo.
120Ɔsika mɔɔyia-a.
Na mɔɔyia kalɛ na aatɛ litemi taasiaku.
121Lɛ́bla lɛla lɛni ndia na lɛdi ulu lɛlɔ lɛnɔ.
Anwuɔsu tanyonu-mi ete mina bekisine.
122Su-mi se kpakplaa ka adubo-mi bubunku
aani ƒula kabla ɔblane kalɛ.
Na taya na bekyuli bani mɔɔtina lɛlɔ banya-mi bakya.
123Bɔkpa na mina anumi ada
ɔni na nnye mɔɔnu ulu ka abaƒɔ-mi ngba,
na ƒula linyese lɛnɔ libo-nwu kemmo.
124Da-mi kɔkɔɔkɔ aani ƒula kabla ɔblane
ɔkɛnku kalɛ na aayɔ́-mi uwi ƒui ɔsu,
na atina-mi ƒula ɔda bubo.
125Ƒula kabla ɔblane na ndi, ya na nteenu ala kalɔ
na lɛti ƒula ɔda bubo.
126Unwoti, uwi údu ka abla lɛla lɛdi
ɔsi kalɛ na bekyuli baládi ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ ɔsu.
127Ami mɔɔyɔ́ ƒula ɔda bubo
teetulo sika ugyiedi.
128Ɔmmɔ ɔsu nkɛnku ƒula litemi lɛlɔ
na mɔɔnu mina kanyakɔ,
na naaayɔ ka lɛsia ulu ukpidi ɔdi lɛlɔ.
129Ƒula ɔda bubo ƒui bɔdia kaduɛ ɔmɔ
ɔsu na mina kɔyu lɛnɔ kunye-mu lɛlɔ geen.
130Ala ani kalɔ na ƒula etemila eedie adi bukeye,
na ɔɔyá na bekyuli bani naaagyi lɛla lɛdi baadá anu.
131Líbimi kenye líwi aani ukyuli ɔni na ɔƒɛ ɔɔdá-nwu
na kalɛ mɔɔwia ƒula litemi ɔsu.
132Nwini nu-mi na abla-mi lɛƒɔndia
aani kalɛ na aabla teete bekyuli bani mɔɔyɔ́-ɔ.
133Da-mi kalɛ na neeebuli aani kalɛ na ásu ése.
Na taya na likpidi lɛdi-mi lɛlɔ.
134Die-mi na bekyuli bani mɔɔnyá-mi taakya enu kemmo,
na lɛkana ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ bɔdi.
135Die ƒula bɔyɔ tina ami ƒula kabla ɔblane.
Na atina-mi ƒula ɔda bubo.
136Naaada buwulo taaya uwi ɔdi
na ɔni na bekyuli baládi ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ ɔsu.
137Unwoti, awɔ nse siin
na aatɛ litemi ulu lɛlɔ.
138Na ƒula ɔda bubo bɔni na éte lɛnɔ
bɔdi ulu na buse siin.
139Anumi eegyie-mi,
ɔsika mina bekisine baládi ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ.
140Ami ƒula kabla ɔblane líduo ƒula linyese kemmo
na lɛ́kɔku-mu lɛ́nu na mɔɔyɔ́-mu geen.
141Ndi ukyuli ɔni neeebo kenyekɔ kadi.
Béni-mi bése, nsu ƒula ɔda bubo amu naaada-mu teese.
142Kalɛ na aabla ala ulu lɛlɔ use siin úsela ƒui.
Na ƒula ɔda bubo bɔdi litemi geen lɛmmɔ uwi ƒui.
143Bukpoku ku bɔnɔ bɔ́ƒɔ-mi lɛlɔ ƒui.
Nsu ƒula ɔda bubo bɔɔyá na mɔɔkɛ́ lɛlɔyɔ.
144Ƒula etemila ese siin uwi biala.
Ya-mi na nteenu ala kalɔ na melie ngba.
145Unwoti, nu-mi bɔkpali,
ɔsika mina kayi kemmo ɔkwalɛ ƒui na muuwulo taasiku.
Ndubɔdi ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ.
146Awɔ na muuwulo taakpali!
Ƒɔ-mi kalɛ na makana ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ bɔdi.
147Mɔɔta ɔtanta tutuutu asa na ɔƒɛ ɔɔtu.
Na muuwulo teevele-ɔ nnii bunku-mi,
ɔsika ƒula litemi lɛlɔ na mina anu asia.
148Mina anumi ewi aanu nwaa usien umodi
na muuti kasusu na ƒula etemila lɛlɔ.
149Nu-mi bɔkpali,
ɔsika aayɔ́-mi uwi biala.
O Unwoti, da-mi ngba kɔkɔɔkɔ,
ɔsika asia ƒula litemi kama
150Bekyuli bani muukpóku-mi baaní teede-mi
ku bana kasusu kekpidi.
Na bágyunku ƒula ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ.
151Nsu ni, Unwoti, awɔ ede-mi.
Na ƒula ɔda bubo ƒui bɔdi etemila geen.
152Ɔ́si kukuuku ni,
ngyi ƒula etemila ka awɔ nése-nya ése éte uwi ƒui.
153Nu kalɛ na muubó abi na edie-mi.
Ɔsika naaayiƒala ƒula ɔda bubo.
154Kpo na edie-mi kenye,
na aƒɔ ete-mi aani kalɛ na ásu ése.
155Belikplune beeebo bɔƒɔ bɔdi.
Bɔ́gyunku-ma geen.
Ɔsika baláwia ka badi ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ uwi ɔdi.
156Kɔnyana kɔni na aanu-bu kúbomo O Unwoti.
Na ka asia ƒula litemi kama ɔsu ni, te-mi ngba.
157Mina bekisine ku bekyuli bani muukpóku-mi bemomo.
Nsu neeedeyi ƒula ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ.
158Na bekyuli bani naaadi ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ ni,
bana lɛlɔ liiƒí-mi livo.
159Kali nu kalɛ na mɔɔyɔ́ ƒula ɔda bubo.
Na ada-mi ngba kɔkɔɔkɔ, ɔsika aayɔ́-mi uwi biala.
160Ƒula ɔda bubo bɔdi litemi geen lɛni nse siin
na bunye bute uwi ƒui.
161Bagadine benye beekpóku-mi uwi biala keeke.
Nsu ami ni, ƒula litemi bɔtɛ kani na mɔɔbu
taanu mina kayi kemmo.
162Lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́-mi na ƒula etemila lɛlɔ
aani ukyuli ɔni na ɔ́kɛ lɛkɛ libendi lɛdi.
163Nkisi na líni ɔkɔ ala bɔbla.
Nsu mɔɔyɔ́ ƒula ɔda bubo.
164Maatɛ sɔɔn na mɔɔkpali-ɔ teemwi na limeyi linwi kemmo
na ƒula ɔda bubo bɔni nse siin ɔsu.
165Na bekyuli bani ƒui mɔɔyɔ́ ƒula ɔda bubo ni,
baakɛ́ keyi buɛɛ.
Na lɛla lɛdi lɛɛɛdubo bɔya na bagbanta.
166Unwoti, mina anu asia ka aƒɔ-mi,
na mɔɔdi ƒula etemila lɛlɔ.
167Mina kɔyu kɔda ƒula ɔda bubo bɔni na éte-mi,
ɔsika mɔɔyɔ́-mu teetulo lɛla biala.
168Mɔɔdi ƒula ɔda bubo ku etemila ƒui lɛlɔ,
ɔsika mina kasiakɔ ƒui ni, awɔ Unwoti agyi-mu.
169Unwoti, ya na mina keku kedu-ɔ kudɔ.
Na aya na nteenu ala kalɔ ɔkɛnku ƒula litemi lɛlɔ!
170Na aya na mina kɔtɔ bukpi budu-ɔ kudɔ.
Na edie-mi ɔkɛnku ƒula litemi lɛlɔ.
171Ndubo mina kenye bubimi na limwi-ɔ,
ka awɔ nátina-mi ƒula ɔda bubo ɔsu.
172Na ndububimi kenye na lidie ɔnu
na lɛka ƒula litemi ku ɔda bubo ƒui lɛtina ka bɔdia.
173Tani tesie kama, mmomu die ƒula kɔnu na ebunku-mi,
ɔsika ƒula ɔda bubo na lɛ́ƒuna.
174Unwoti, nnye ngya-a ka abáƒɔ-mi.
Ɔsika ƒula ɔda bubo mɔɔyɔ́-mi kaƒɔ.
175Ya na lilie ngba na memwi-ɔ.
Na aya na ƒula ɔda bubo bubunku-mi.
176Lɛ́yii ulu aani koƒonu kɔni náyii.
Wia-mi ƒula kabla ɔblane kama ulu,
ɔsika ntayiƒala ƒula ɔda bubo.

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
A Prayer for the Lord's Help
1When I am in trouble, I pray,
2“Come and save me, Lord,
from deceitful liars!”
3What punishment is fitting
for you deceitful liars?
4Your reward should be
sharp and flaming arrows!
5But I must live as a foreigner
among the people of Meshech
and in the tents of Kedar.
6I have spent too much time
living among people
who hate peace.
7I am in favor of peace,
but when I speak of it,
all they want is war.
translation_text:
1Uwi ɔni na ala
étulo-mi ni,
líwulo lɛ́kpali Unwoti Katɔti na únu úte-mi.
2Unwoti Katɔti, die-mi na ɔkɔ banyine
ku bekyuli bani mɔɔtɔ́lɔ bekyuli kudɔ.
3Bɛnu kaduɛ na lɛla lɛni na Katɔti ɔdubo-mii bɔbla lɛlɔ,
ɔsika ɔɔɔdubo-mii buse buɛɛ.
4Ukpone atula ani mbo ɔbi yayaaya ndubo-mii bɔtu.
Na ɔgya ku agyabi gbagbangba ndubo-mii bɔkyula na bɛyii udu.
5Bɔbuɛ na ɔdi ka bete-mi ka líbo nli-mi akɔ
na Mesek na buuduo Kedar nvo kemmo taalɛ.
6Bekyuli bani naaayɔ keyi buɛɛ akɔ
na líti mina lɛlɔ ḿbakya.
7Mɔɔyɔ́ ka atu ayɔ-mi
nsu si lítemi banii lɛ́tɛ kekpo lɛbɛɛ.

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
The Lord Will Protect His People
1I look to the hills!
Where will I find help?
2It will come from the Lord,
who created heaven and earth.
3The Lord is your protector,
and he won't go to sleep
or let you stumble.
4The protector of Israel
doesn't doze
or ever get drowsy.
5The Lord is your protector,
there at your right side
to shade you from the sun.
6You won't be harmed
by the sun during the day
or by the moon at night.
7The Lord will protect you
and keep you safe
from all dangers.
8The Lord will protect you
now and always
wherever you go.
translation_text:
1Nnye mɔɔnu abi lɛlɔ teemene.
Wɛ na bɔƒɔ bɔdubɔsi bubo-mi?
2Katɔti ɔni nábla katɔ ku kalɔ ni,
anwu ndububo ubaƒɔ ute-mi.
3Anwu ɔni mɔɔgyumana ukyuli ni,
ulenye ulanu-ɔ na ayii kanyankɔ.
Ɔsika ɔda-a ngba, na lɛlɛɛ liléti-nwu.
4Israel, nu! Unwoti Katɔti ɔni mɔɔgyumana-a ni,
lɛlɛɛ liléti-nwu iye ɔtɛ ɔlɛɛ uwi ɔdi.
5Anwu mɔɔnu-ɔ lɛlɔ
na ɔkɛ-ɔ kɔdianu kakɛ uute-ɔ ɔyuli.
6Ɔƒɛ uléƒi-ɔ na limeyi kemmo,
na kɔbuli lɛnɔ kulékpoku-ɔ si kɔsia.
7Unwoti Katɔti ɔdubɔgyumana-a
na udie-ɔ kɔyu na ɔgbankpi biala kemmo.
8Na ƒula busie teebo ƒui ni,
Unwoti Katɔti ɔdubɔnu-ɔ lɛlɔ ɔ́si ɔƒɛni úsela uwi ƒui kemmo.

english_text:
(A song by David for worship.)
A Song of Praise
1It made me glad when they said,
“Let's go to the house
of the Lord!”
2Jerusalem, we are standing
inside your gates.
3Jerusalem, what a strong
and beautiful city you are!
4Every tribe of the Lord
obeys him and comes to you
to praise his name.
5David's royal throne is here
where justice rules.
6Jerusalem, we pray
that you will have peace,
and that all will go well
for those who love you.
7May there be peace
inside your city walls
and in your palaces.
8Because of my friends
and my relatives,
I will pray for peace.
9And because of the house
of the Lord our God,
I will work for your good.
translation_text:
1Lɛlɔ lɛ́yɔ-mi ka básu-mi banii,
“Ya na buteesie Unwoti kaduli.”
2Na mmɔ na búubo búbedu mɛni, O Yerusalem,
bula lɛgba lɛ́kɔ líduo ƒula kayakun kenye.
3Na adi ɔma unengudi ɔni básɔku-nwu bátu
na ɔ́sala ɔdanku lɛlɔ na ɔɔdia bɔnu geen.
4Mɛni na Israel atɔƒi bekyuli bammɔ ƒui bási.
Bébo ka beti enugya bete Unwoti
aani kalɛ na úbo-ma ɔda.
5Mɛni na Dawid kaba kemmo baga básala
na baatɛku bana bekyuli litemi.
6Bivele Unwoti bɛnii keyi buɛɛ kebo Yerusalem ɔma kemmo.
Na bekyuli bani ƒui mɔɔyɔ́-ɔ ni, enu ku akɔkɔ eyi-ma.
7O Yerusalem, atu bɔyɔ bɔkya awodu
ani na áka ámana-a ƒui kemmo.
Na keyi katɛku ƒula baga na bana lɛgbanya kemmo.
8Na nnye mina bakpana ku banwa ƒui kenye
muuvele nnii, “Keyi buɛɛ kaƒɔ Yerusalem.”
9Na bula Unwoti Katɔti kaduli ɔsu ni,
muuvele nnii anumi busie bubo ɔkɛnku ƒula lɛlɔ.

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
A Prayer for Mercy
1Our Lord and our God,
I turn my eyes to you,
on your throne in heaven.
2Servants look to their master,
but we will look to you,
until you have mercy on us.
3Please have mercy, Lord!
We have been insulted
more than we can stand,
4and we can't take more abuse
from those proud,
conceited people.
translation_text:
1Unwoti Katɔti,
awɔ na lɛ́kɔliku anumi katɔ mɔɔnu ulu
teete na ƒula lɛgaboku lɛlɔ na katɔ mmɔ.
2Mɔɔnu ulu aani kalɛ na kabla bablane
beenye taanu bana ɔtɔlati anumi ka bakɛ lɛla lɛdi.
Na aani kalɛ belekubi kabla bablane lɛnɔ beenye
taanu bana beni anumi ni,
lɛni kani na abu lɛnɔ bunye bɔɔnu Unwoti anumi
wetédu ka ɔ́nu-bu kɔnyana.
3Nu-bu kɔnyana, O Unwoti, nu-bu kɔnyana,
ɔsika ala ani muukpóku-bu édu-bu ɔkwɛ ɔƒɛni amu.
4Bɔma bɔni na lɛlɔ bakɛne baamá-bu búmomo bɔ́gya.
Na lɛni kani na bani mɔɔnya-bu taamana lɛnɔ ablala étulo-bu kayi.

english_text:
(A song by David for worship.)
Thanking the Lord for Victory
1The Lord was on our side!
Let everyone in Israel say:
2“The Lord was on our side!
Otherwise, the enemy attack
3would have killed us all,
because it was furious.
4We would have been swept away
in a violent flood
5of high and roaring waves.”
6Let's praise the Lord!
He protected us from enemies
who were like wild animals,
7and we escaped like birds
from a hunter's torn net.
8The Lord made heaven and earth,
and he is the one
who sends us help.
translation_text:
1Unwoti, si ɔɔɔdi awɔ nnye éte-bu ni,
nka dɛ na ɔdubo buse?
Israelƒuɔ, bɛsu bɛnini,
2“Si ɔɔɔdi Unwoti nnye úte-bu
uwi ɔni na beekpóku-bu ni,
3nka uwi ɔni na bekisine báta ku kɔnyi mmɔ ni,
bébweli-bu ngba ngba.
4Nka ketu káda-bu kákya
na kéti-bu kátɔlɔku.
5Nka ketu kani náƒɔ ntu mmɔ
na kaatu teenwini kéti-bu ƒui kede kede.
6“Bɛya bumwi Unwoti ɔni nátanyonu-bu
útete na baduli-bu bakun.
7Búkeli aani kalɛ na aasɛ uukeli taalɛ kakpagyuɛ
kani na bákywɛ-nwu kemmo.
Kakpagyuɛ kammɔ kébie na bɔ́lɛ-ka kemmo.
8“Unwoti ɔni nédie katɔ ku kalɔ ni,
anwu nédie-bu.”

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
The Lord's People Are Safe
1Everyone who trusts the Lord
is like Mount Zion
that cannot be shaken
and will stand forever.
2Just as Jerusalem is protected
by mountains on every side,
the Lord protects his people
by holding them in his arms
now and forever.
3He won't let the wicked
rule his people
or lead them to do wrong.
4Let's ask the Lord to be kind
to everyone who is good
and completely obeys him.
5When the Lord punishes
the wicked,
he will punish everyone else
who lives an evil life.
Pray for peace in Israel!
translation_text:
1Bekyuli bani néti bana anu básia Unwoti lɛlɔ ni,
bese aani Sion Kɔbi kɔni naadubo bɔta kesii kani na kɔlɛ kudii.
Ɔsika mmɔ kani na kɔdubɔlɛ uwi biala kemmo.
2Kalɛ na abi áka ámana Yerusalem ɔma ni,
lɛni na Unwoti lɛnɔ ɔ́ka ɔ́mana nwuna bekyuli
ɔ́si ɔƒɛni úsela uwi ƒui.
3Katɔti uláya na bekyuli bekpidi
badi nwuna bekyuli kedee lɛlɔ.
Si ɔɔɔdi lɛni ni, badubɔya na Katɔti bekyuli babla likpidi.
4O Unwoti, bla lɛbuni te bekyuli babuni
ku bani kayi kemmo ablala nkɛ ulu siin lɛlɔ.
5Nsu bani nénwini básia ulu gontii lɛlɔ ni,
Unwoti ɔdubuti-ma utásalaku alaekpidi bablane
na ɔni-ma kɔtu.
Nsu Israel anwu ni, ɔkɛ atu bɔyɔ ku keyi buɛɛ.

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
Celebrating the Harvest
1It seemed like a dream
when the Lord brought us back
to the city of Zion.
2We celebrated with laughter
and joyful songs.
In foreign nations it was said,
“The Lord has worked miracles
for his people.”
3And so we celebrated
because the Lord had indeed
worked miracles for us.
4Our Lord, we ask you to bless
our people again,
and let us be like streams
in the Southern Desert.
5We cried as we went out
to plant our seeds.
Now let us celebrate
as we bring in the crops.
6We cried on the way
to plant our seeds,
but we will celebrate and shout
as we bring in the crops.
translation_text:
1Uwi ɔni na Unwoti ɔ́sɔku nwuna bekyuli
úboku Yerusalem ni,
ɔ́bla-bu aani kɔna na buugyé.
2Na lɛma ku bumwi lɛnu sɔɔn néyi-bu akpu na buudie.
Mmɔ na kadi bamba bekyuli básu banini,
“Unwoti ɔ́bla ala bonwu úte-ma.”
3Sɔsɔ na ɔdi ka Unwoti ɔ́bla ala bonwu úte-bu,
ɔmmɔ ɔsu na lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́-bu.
4Unwoti, bla-bu na ɔsɔ ɔtɛ ute-bu ubu
aani kalɛ na ɔkwalɛ ɔni nákwii ɔɔsɔ taaƒɔ́ ntu.
5Ɔsika bekyuli bani nákya edula ku lɛbibo ku keku ni,
ama mɔɔƒɛ ku ebiti ku lɛma.
6Bekyuli bani nda keku baakya edula adi ni,
badubo bunwini ku ebiti ku lɛnu bɔtu
uwi ɔni beti bana edula ani báƒɛ badububoku kaduli.

english_text:
(A song by Solomon for worship.)
Only the Lord Can Bless a Home
1Without the help of the Lord
it is useless to build a home
or to guard a city.
2It is useless to get up early
and stay up late
in order to earn a living.
God takes care of his own,
even while they sleep.
3Children are a blessing
and a gift from the Lord.
4Having a lot of children
to take care of you
in your old age
is like a warrior
with a lot of arrows.
5The more you have,
the better off you will be,
because they will protect you
when your enemies
attack you in court.
translation_text:
1Si Unwoti Katɔti kɔnu kɔɔɔkya ɔtɔ
ɔni na batune benye baatú kemmo ni,
kekeeke na beebó abi.
Na si Unwoti Katɔti útagyumana ɔma
ɔni na bagyumanane benye baanu ni,
kekeeke na belie benye baagyumana.
2Ina éyile bɔta na ékpoku lɛlɔ
ába kadi ka aawia lɛla lɛdi adi ni,
aaadubo-ɔ budu na adi na edu-ɔ ɔkwɛ.
Ɔsika bekyuli bani néti lɛlɔ béte Unwoti Katɔti ni,
Unwoti uute-ma ala uwi ɔni na batɛ balɛɛ muedi.
3Nu! Unwoti Katɔti muute bebi na baawɔ.
Na bani mɔɔlɛ́ taasi uwele kaƒɔ kemmo ni,
ɔdi nwuna lɛƒɔndia.
4Kalɛ na kɔtaminta atula
ani nkya ɔyikune ɔdi koƒo kemmo ese ete ukyuli ɔmmɔ ni,
lɛni kani na bebi lɛnɔ beekpó teete bana bawɔne.
5Anwuɔsu lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ ukyuli ɔni mbo-ma na bemomo.
Ɔsika ɔdubɔkana na unye ɔsiaku ukisine biala udu
na ɔban kenye ɔni na kɔƒa kulékpo-nwu.

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
The Lord Rewards His Faithful People
1The Lord will bless you
if you respect him
and obey his laws.
2Your fields will produce,
and you will be happy—
all will go well.
3Your wife will be as fruitful
as a grapevine,
and just as an olive tree
is rich with olives,
your home will be rich
with healthy children.
4This is how the Lord will bless
everyone who respects him.
5I pray that the Lord
will bless you from Zion
and let Jerusalem prosper
as long as you live.
6May you live long enough
to see your grandchildren.
Let's pray for peace in Israel!
translation_text:
1Ukyuli biala ɔni mɔɔyia Unwoti Katɔti ni,
lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ-nwu ka ɔɔsia ulu geen ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ɔsu.
2Ɔsika ɔdubɔdi nwuna enu kemmo kabla
na ɔdubɔbla-nwu lɛlɔyɔ sɔsɔ
ka keyi kadubɔyɔku-nwu ɔsu.
3Ulekudi ɔdubɔkya-nwu kaduli
aani kɔdingyii kɔni mɔɔnwu ebi geen.
Na nwuna bebi badubo bɔdia bɔnu geen
na baka bamana-nwu kadikɔ aani nnɔ egyii akɔdi kalɛ.
4Bɛnu bɛti geen ka ɔmɛni ndi lɛƒɔndia
lɛni na Unwoti Katɔti ɔdubɔbla ukyuli ɔni mɔɔyia-nwu.
5Unwoti Katɔti ɔdubute-mii kusɛ kusɛ bɔsiku Sion.
Na Yerusalem ɔdubo bɔdia na amii alati bɛnu
na bina ngba emeyi kemmo.
6Sɔsɔ geen ni, bɛdubɔnu bina bebi ku bawɔ.
Na atu ayɔ-mii ƒui na Yerusalem.

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
A Prayer for Protection
1Since the time I was young,
enemies have often attacked!
Let everyone in Israel say:
2“Since the time I was young,
enemies have often attacked!
But they have not defeated me,
3though my back is like a field
that has just been plowed.”
4The Lord always does right,
and he has set me free
from the ropes
of those cruel people.
5I pray that all who hate
the city of Zion
will be made ashamed
and forced to turn and run.
6May they be like grass
on the flat roof of a house,
grass that dries up
as soon as it sprouts.
7Don't let them be like wheat
gathered in bundles.
8And don't let anyone
who passes by say to them,
“The Lord bless you!
I give you my blessing
in the name of the Lord.”
translation_text:
1“Kadi bamba bekyuli békpoku-mi
ɔ́si mina lɛkloƒu uwi.”
Mɔɔwia ka amii Israel kadi bɛsu ɔmɛni bɛnini,
2“Ina ka kadi bamba bekyuli békpoku-mi ɔ́si mina lɛkloƒu uwi ni,
bátakana na badi-mi lɛlɔ.
3Béku-mi aani kalɛ na beeti lɛnwami taatu kalɔ teenwini,
nsu batakana-mi.”
4Unwoti Katɔti use siin ɔsu ni,
kɔbuli kɔni na balalane bammɔ béti banii beenyimi-mi ni,
úkulo-ku ƒui úwi kalɔ.
5Bani ƒui na muukisi Sion ni,
anumi éwi-ma kalɔ na bénwini-mi kama.
6Na bábla aani kamu kani nákwɛ lɛsa lili
na káyuɛ ka kátakɛ ntu ɔsu.
7Ɔmmɔ ɔsu ukyuli ɔni mɔɔnwa-ka ni,
ulékulo-ka na kedu ɔmukɔ.
Na ɔni muunyimi-ka lɛnɔ ulenyimi-ka na kedu ketila,
8kalɛ na bele-nwu adaku,
banii, “Katɔti kusɛ kusɛ ɔsiaku-ɔ.”

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
Trusting the Lord in Times of Trouble
1From a sea of troubles
I cry out to you, Lord.
2Won't you please listen
as I beg for mercy?
3If you kept record of our sins,
no one could last long.
4But you forgive us,
and so we will worship you.
5With all my heart,
I am waiting, Lord, for you!
I trust your promises.
6I wait for you more eagerly
than a soldier on guard duty
waits for the dawn.
Yes, I wait more eagerly
than a soldier on guard duty
waits for the dawn.
7Israel, trust the Lord!
God is always merciful
and has the power to save you.
8 Israel, the Lord will save you
from all your sins.
translation_text:
1Unwoti, mina kaƒɔ kemmo ƒui
na muuwulo taakpali-ɔ.
2Nu-mi lɛdi na ese atu na enu mina keku
kani muuwulo teevele kebunku.
3Si ásia ukyuli alaekpidi kama ni, Unwoti,
ɔma ndubɔkana ƒula litemi bɔtɛ kenye bunye?
4Nsu ni, awɔ muuti alaekpidi taakyiɛ-bu,
anwuɔsu na ɔlɛka bɔyia-a na bɔbu-ɔ.
5Awɔ Unwoti anumi kani na nnye mɔɔnu.
Na mina anu ƒui ku kayi kasia-a lɛlɔ.
6Nnye mɔɔnu-ɔ ulu kpakplaa geen
teetulo kalɛ na bekyuli bani nnye baagyumana usien
baanu ulu teete ka kadi kegye kukuuku ƒui.
7Israel kadi bekyuli ƒui, biti bina anu bɛsia Unwoti lɛlɔ.
Ɔsika Unwoti kani mbo lɛƒɔndia uwi ndi uwi,
na ɔɔƒɔ́ ukyuli ngba.
8Na anwu ɔlati ɔdubɔƒɔ Israel
ɔlɛku bana ekpidi ani ƒui na baabla kemmo.

english_text:
(A song by David for worship.)
Trust the Lord!
1I am not conceited, Lord,
and I don't waste my time
on impossible schemes.
2But I have learned to feel safe
and satisfied,
like a young child
in its mother's arms.
3People of Israel,
you must trust the Lord
now and forever.
translation_text:
1Unwoti Katɔti, likyulikpi ala bɔbla
buuubo-mi kayi kemmo.
Na mina anumi lɛnɔ alánu ala teetuloku lɛlɔ.
Na lɛɛɛsiaku ala enengudi
iye ala ani na etulo-mi kama.
2Sɔsɔ ni, nda lɛlɔ aani ubi
ɔni na uni ɔ́nyuɛ-nwu na nwuna lɛgba lɛlɔ.
Na mina kayi kese buɛɛ na mɔɔsia ala ammɔ anu.
3Lɛni na muuvele ka Israel kadi bekyuli ƒui
beti bana anu ƒui basia Unwoti Katɔti lɛlɔ
ka ɔ́si ɔƒɛni úsela uwi ƒui kemmo.

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
The Lord Is Always with His People
1Our Lord, don't forget David
and how he suffered.
2Mighty God of Jacob,
remember how he promised:
3“I won't go home
or crawl into bed
4or close my eyelids,
5until I find a home for you,
the mighty Lord God of Jacob.”
6 When we were in Ephrath,
we heard that the sacred chest
was somewhere near Jaar.
7Then we said, “Let's go
to the throne of the Lord
and worship at his feet.”
8Come to your new home, Lord,
you and the sacred chest
with all its power.
9Let victory be like robes
for the priests;
let your faithful people
celebrate and shout.
10David is your chosen one,
so don't reject him.
11 You made a solemn promise
to David, when you said,
“I, the Lord, promise
that someone in your family
will always be king.
12If they keep our agreement
and follow my teachings,
then someone in your family
will rule forever.”
13You have gladly chosen Zion
as your home, our Lord.
14You said, “This is my home!
I will live here forever.
15I will bless Zion with food,
and even the poor will eat
until they are full.
16Victory will be like robes
for the priests,
and its faithful people
will celebrate and shout.
17 I will give mighty power
to the kingdom of David.
Each of my chosen kings
will shine like a lamp
18and wear a sparkling crown.
But I will disgrace
their enemies.”
translation_text:
1Unwoti, nyimo Dawid lɛbibo
lɛni kenye na unye kpakplaa.
2Na ɔ́kpali Katɔti úse kenye úte Unwoti
ɔni ndi Yakob Katɔti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔnini,
3“Lɛɛɛdubo mina ɔtɔ buduo.
Na lɛɛɛdubo busie butátɛ lɛnɔ.
4Na lɛɛɛdubo mina anumi bubile nnii mɔɔlɛɛ
iye libo mina anumi muedi,
5úti útédu ka lɛ́ka kesii kadi bɔwia bute mina Unwoti
ɔni ndi Yakob Katɔti Ɔyikune Ƒui.”
6Búnu ka nwuna Bunyimi Adaka ɔkya Eƒrata
na bɔ́nu-nwu na Yearim alakpi akɔ.
7Na bɔ́su bɔnii bɛya na buteesie Unwoti kakpakɔ
butákpa-nwu na katɔma kedee kammɔ kemmo
na nwuna lɛgba akɔ.
8O Unwoti, ta ku ƒula Bunyimi Adaka na atina ƒula ɔyikun.
Na esie etélie ƒula keliekɔ.
9Ya na ƒula bakpane bataabla ala ani nse siin uwi biala.
Na aya na ƒula bekyuli kedee bebo kudu ku lɛlɔyɔ.
10Ɔ́si ƒula kenye kani nése éte ƒula kabla ɔblane Dawid ɔsu ni,
teni ƒula Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi ɔmmɔ.
11Ɔsika Unwoti úse kenye úte Dawid,
na ulénwini kama ulakya nwuna linyese lɛmmɔ kudii.
Ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Ƒula kaba kemmo ubi ɔdi
na ndubɔya na ɔdi lɛga na ƒula lɛga kadikɔ.
12Si ƒula bebi básia mina ɔda bubo anu kpakplaa
na bábla básia ɔda ɔni líbo-ma lɛlɔ ni,
bana bebi lɛnɔ badubo butaadi lɛga lɛmmɔ uwi biala.”
13Ɔsika Unwoti ɔ́ƒuna Sion na ɔdi-nwu lɛyɔla
ka uti mmɔ ɔbla nwuna keliekɔ.
14Mɛni na ndubulie ntaadi lɛga ɔsi ɔƒɛni úsela ƒui.
Na mɛni na ndubo bulie uwi ƒui, ɔsika mɛni kadia-mi.
15Ndubute Sion lɛla biala baawia kaduɛ.
Na ndubɔya na nwuna bawabane badi bemo.
16Na ndubɔya nwuna bakpane bataabla ala
ani nse siin uwi biala,
na lɛya nwuna bekyuli kedee bebo kudu ku lɛlɔyɔ.
17“Mɛni na ndubuse Dawid kaba kemmo ubi likpo
na ɔdi lɛga linengudi.
Na mina Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi ɔmɛni ni,
lɛ́ɛklibi-nwu líse aani bukeye ute mina bekyuli.
18Na nwuna bekisine ƒui ni,
kɔƒa kɔdubɔƒɔ-ma lɛlɔ ƒui aani awu.
Nsu anwu nwuna lɛga kadikɔ kagabwa
kadubukeye busie ɔgyu.”

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
Living Together in Peace
1It is truly wonderful
when the people of God
live together in peace.
2It is as beautiful as olive oil
poured on Aaron's head
and running down his beard
and the collar of his robe.
3It is like the dew
from Mount Hermon,
falling on Zion's mountains,
where the Lord has promised
to bless his people
with life forevermore.
translation_text:
1Bɛnu kalɛ na ɔɔdia bɔnu si banwani bábla unwi
na bása beli liku linwi.
2Use aani nnɔmii ƒɛƒɛɛ bɔni na béti béwi Ɔkpane Aaron lili,
na ɔɔsia teeduo nwuna ukwi kemmo
ku nwuna awu atu ƒui kemmo.
3Use aani amii ani mɔɔyu taasi Hermon abi lɛlɔ
teewi Sion abi lɛlɔ.
Ɔsika mmɔ na Unwoti ɔ́su úse ka wete kusɛ kusɛ ɔmmɔ,
na ɔdanku ngba bɔni naaadubo bɔsa kudii.

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
Praising the Lord at Night
1Everyone who serves the Lord,
come and offer praises.
Everyone who has gathered
in his temple tonight,
2lift your hands in prayer
toward his holy place
and praise the Lord.
3The Lord is the Creator
of heaven and earth,
and I pray that the Lord
will bless you from Zion.
translation_text:
1Amii Unwoti kabla bablane,
bɛtu kɔgya bimwi Unwoti.
Na amii bani mɔɔkpá-nwu na nwuna ɔtɔ kemmo usien ni,
2bɛkɔliku bina enu katɔ na nwuna kakpakɔ
na bimwi Unwoti Katɔti.
3Na anwu Unwoti ɔni nédie katɔ ku kalɔ ni,
ute-mii kusɛ kusɛ ɔ́siku Sion.

english_text:
In Praise of the Lord's Kindness
1Shout praises to the Lord!
You are his servants,
so praise his name.
2All who serve in the temple
of the Lord our God,
3come and shout praises.
Praise the name of the Lord!
He is kind and good.
4He chose the family of Jacob
and the people of Israel
for his very own.
5The Lord is much greater
than any other god.
6He does as he chooses
in heaven and on earth
and deep in the sea.
7The Lord makes the clouds rise
from far across the earth,
and he makes lightning
to go with the rain.
Then from his secret place
he sends out the wind.
8The Lord killed the first-born
of people and animals
in the land of Egypt.
9God used miracles and wonders
to fight the king of Egypt
and all of his officials.
10He destroyed many nations
and killed powerful kings,
11including King Sihon
of the Amorites
and King Og of Bashan.
He conquered every kingdom
in the land of Canaan
12and gave their property
to his people Israel.
13The name of the Lord
will be remembered forever,
and he will be famous
for all time to come.
14The Lord will bring justice
and show mercy to all
who serve him.
15 Idols of silver and gold
are made and worshiped
in other nations.
16They have a mouth and eyes,
but they can't speak or see.
17They are completely deaf,
and they can't breathe.
18Everyone who makes idols
and all who trust them
will end up as helpless
as their idols.
19Everyone in Israel,
come praise the Lord!
All the family of Aaron
20and all the tribe of Levi,
come praise the Lord!
All of his worshipers,
come praise the Lord.
21Praise the Lord from Zion!
He lives here in Jerusalem.
Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_text:
1Bɛya na bumwi Unwoti.
Amii Unwoti kabla bablane ƒui, bimwi Blɔti!
Bɛkɔliku-nwu lɛnyi katɔ na bimwi-nwu lɛnyi kedee.
2Amii bani muuduo nwuna ɔtɔ kemmo
ku bani muunye nwuna kaduli ƒui.
3Bimwi Unwoti, ɔsika ɔdia.
Bidie lɛnu bimwi-nwu lɛnyi, ɔsika ubo lɛƒɔndia.
4Unwoti Katɔti ɔlati náƒuna Yakob úte lɛlɔ.
Na ɔ́ƒuna Israel kadi ka babla nwuna bekyuli.
5Na ngyi ka bula Unwoti úbomo
na ɔ́ƒɔ lɛnyi útulo kalɔ benwoti bamba ƒui.
6Lɛla lɛni mɔɔyɔ́-nwu kaƒɔ ni, ani na Unwoti Katɔti ɔɔbla
na katɔ mmɔ ku kalɔ lɛlɔ
ku ɛpu kemmo ku kalɔ kemmo ƒui.
7Ɔɔyá na liƒlukutu lɛɛsí kalɔ ekpo ƒui taakɔ katɔ.
Na ɔɔyá na katɔ kaabwɛ ogya na ɔnantu ɔɔna.
Na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ɔɔsí kesii kani na ɔ́bala-nwu ɔ́kya
na uubo teebekpo.
8Anwu naya na Egyipte bebi bedeedi
bani na bekyuli ku bebuo ƒui báwɔ ƒui békpi.
9Anwu nábla akɔla ala budie taatina lidu lidu
ku ala bamba na bɛ́nu na Egyipte na Ɔga Ƒarao
ku nwuna kabla bablane ƒui anumi.
10Na ɔ́yila kadi bamba bekyuli pii bani náƒɔ kuye
ku baga benengudi udu.
11Ama badi ndi Amoriƒuɔ ɔga ɔni baalɔ Sihon
ku Basan ɔga ɔni baalɔ Og ku Kanaanƒuɔ baga ƒui.
Ɔ́yila-ma udu.
12Na bana kalɔ kénwini Israelƒuɔ bani
na ɔ́ƒuna úte lɛlɔ kadi.
13O Unwoti, ƒula lɛnyi liláyi kudii.
Na kadi ƒui bekyuli badubo butaakali ƒula ala
ani na ábla uwi biala.
14Ɔsika Unwoti ɔdubɔtɛku nwuna bekyuli litemi.
Na ka bekyuli baakywí-nwu kaƒɔ ɔsu ni,
ɔdubɔƒɔ-ma ngba.
15Ala ani na kadi bamba bekyuli baakpá ni,
adi ala ani béti sika ugyiedi ku ɔƒualadi bávɔ
na ammɔ ƒui adi bekyuli enu kabla.
16Bávɔ-nya na ebo kenye, nsu belétemi.
Na bebo anumi, nsu balánu.
17Bebo atu, nsu belenu,
na balánwuna lɛnɔ.
18Na bekyuli bani návɔ ala ammɔ udu
bélieku ala ani na bávɔ mmɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Na lɛni kani na bani néti bana anu basia-nya
na báƒɔ-nya bádi mmɔ lɛnɔ bese.
19O Israel kɔduli bekyuli ƒui, bimwi Unwoti!
Na amii Aaron kaduli bekyuli ƒui lɛnɔ, bimwi Unwoti!
20Lewi kaduli bekyuli ƒui, bimwi Unwoti.
Na amii bani ƒui mɔɔyia Unwoti, bimwi-nwu!
21Bimwi Unwoti ɔ́siku Sion.
Na bimwi-nwu amii bani nkya Yerusalem
kesii kani ndi Unwoti keliekɔ.
Bɛya na bumwi Unwoti.

english_text:
God's Love Never Fails
1 Praise the Lord! He is good.
God's love never fails.
2Praise the God of all gods.
God's love never fails.
3Praise the Lord of lords.
God's love never fails.
4Only God works great miracles.
God's love never fails.
5 With wisdom he made the sky.
God's love never fails.
6 The Lord stretched the earth
over the ocean.
God's love never fails.
7 He made the bright lights
in the sky.
God's love never fails.
8He lets the sun rule each day.
God's love never fails.
9He lets the moon and the stars
rule each night.
God's love never fails.
10 God struck down the first-born
in every Egyptian family.
God's love never fails.
11 He rescued Israel from Egypt.
God's love never fails.
12God used his great strength
and his powerful arm.
God's love never fails.
13 He split the Red Sea apart.
God's love never fails.
14The Lord brought Israel safely
through the sea.
God's love never fails.
15He destroyed the Egyptian king
and his army there.
God's love never fails.
16The Lord led his people
through the desert.
God's love never fails.
17Our God defeated mighty kings.
God's love never fails.
18And he killed famous kings.
God's love never fails.
19 One of them was Sihon,
king of the Amorites.
God's love never fails.
20 Another was King Og of Bashan.
God's love never fails.
21God took away their land.
God's love never fails.
22He gave their land to Israel,
the people who serve him.
God's love never fails.
23God saw the trouble we were in.
God's love never fails.
24He rescued us from our enemies.
God's love never fails.
25He gives food to all who live.
God's love never fails.
26Praise God in heaven!
God's love never fails.
translation_text:
1Bɛgya Unwoti enu, ɔsika ɔdia.
Ɔsika ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.
2Bɛgya benwoti ƒui Unwoti enu.
Ɔsika ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.
3Bɛgya Unwoti ɔni ntulo ƒui enu.
Ɔsika ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.
4Bɛgya anwu ɔni mɔɔbla akɔla ala budie taatina enu.
Ɔsika ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.
5Bɛgya anwu ɔni nkɛnku nwuna lɛnunda bonwu kemmo na údie katɔ ku kana ala ƒui enu.
Ɔsika ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.
6Bɛgya anwu ɔni násala ntu bɔni náƒɔ kalɔ lɛlɔ ƒui na kénwini kalɔ kakwiidi enu.
Ɔsika ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.
7Bɛgya anwu ɔni nédie ala ani muukeye ƒui ɔ́kya katɔ enu.
Ɔsika ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.
8Bɛgya anwu ɔni náya na ɔƒɛ ɔɔdi limeyi lɛlɔ enu.
Ɔsika ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.
9Bɛgya anwu ɔni náya na kɔbuli ku ayabi aadi usien lɛlɔ enu.
Ɔsika ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.
10Bɛgya anwu ɔni náya na bebi bedeedi bani na Egyipteƒuɔ báwɔ ku bana bebuo bebi bedeedi ƒui békpi enu.
Ɔsika ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.
11Ɔ́ya na Israel kadi bekyuli ƒui bávi bálɛ Egyipte kalɔ kammɔ kemmo.
Ɔsika ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.
12Údie nwuna kɔnu na ɔ́bla ɔyikun ala úte-bu.
Ɔsika ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.
13Bɛgya anwu ɔni náya na Ɛpugyie ntu bɔ́bwɛ ntɛ enu.
Ɔsika ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.
14Ɔ́ya na Israel kadi bekyuli básia ntu bɔmmɔ ntɛ.
Ɔsika ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.
15Nsu ɔ́nyina Ƒarao ku nwuna badi ƒui ama ɔ́kya ntu bɔmmɔ kemmo.
Ɔsika ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.
16Bɛgya anwu ɔni nátɔnku nwuna kadi bekyuli ɔ́siaku kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo enu.
Ɔsika ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.
17Bɛgya anwu ɔni náya na búkpo bɔ́di baga bayikune lɛlɔ enu.
Ɔsika ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.
18Ɔ́ya na baga bani náƒɔ lɛnyi békpi.
Ɔsika ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.
19Baga bammɔ akɔ ɔdi ndi Sihon ɔni ndi Amoriƒuɔ ɔga.
Ɔsika ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.
20Ɔbambadi lɛnɔ ndi Basan ɔga ɔni ndi Og.
Ɔsika ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.
21Na bana kɔlɔ ni, ɔ́ya na kúnwini bula kese.
Ɔsika ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.
22Ɔdi kese ute Israel, nwuna kabla ɔblane.
Ɔsika ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.
23Únyimo-bu uwi ɔni bɔkya lɛbibo kemmo.
Ɔsika ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.
24Na údie-bu ɔ́lɛku bula bekisine enu kemmo.
Ɔsika ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.
25Na uute nwuna ala ediedi ƒui adila na baadi.
Ɔsika ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.
26Bɛgya Katɔti ɔni nkya katɔ enu.
Ɔsika ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.

english_text:
A Prayer for Revenge
1Beside the rivers of Babylon
we thought about Jerusalem,
and we sat down and cried.
2We hung our small harps
on the willow trees.
3Our enemies had brought us here
as their prisoners;
now they wanted us to sing
and entertain them.
They insulted us and shouted,
“Sing about Zion!”
4Here in a foreign land,
how can we sing
about the Lord?
5Jerusalem, if I forget you,
let my right hand go limp.
6Let my tongue stick
to the roof of my mouth,
if I don't think about you
above all else.
7Our Lord, punish the Edomites!
On the day Jerusalem fell,
they shouted,
“Completely destroy the city!
Tear down every building!”
8 Babylon, you are doomed!
I pray the Lord's blessings
on anyone who punishes you
for what you did to us.
9May the Lord bless everyone
who beats your children
against the rocks!
translation_text:
1Uwi ɔni na búlie Babilon etukpa atu
na búnyimo Sion ni,
mmɔ na búlie búwulo keku.
2Na egyii ammɔ akɔ
na búti bula lɛbentaa bɔ́ƒala.
3Mmɔ na bekyuli bani néƒie-bu bátɔlɔku
básu-bu ka budie bula lɛnu lɛdi bute-ma.
Bula kalala bablane baasu-bu banii
“Bidie lɛlɔyɔ lɛnu lɛni bɛɛyɔ́ bɔtu na Sion mmɔ
biti bɛkya-bu ebiti!”
4Mmɔ na bɔ́su-ma ka bulakana bula Unwoti ɔnu ɔdi budie
na kesii kani naaadi bula kalɔ mɛni.
5O Yerusalem si lɛyiƒala-a ni,
mina kɔdianu kɔnu kɔsɔ kutata-mi
na kabla kɔkwɛ kɔni na kɔgyi lɛlɔ.
6Na si lɛ́yiƒala-a iye ńteti awɔ Yerusalem
ńtenwini mina lɛla lideedi lɛni mɔɔyá mɔɔkɛ́ lɛlɔyɔ ni,
unyemi ɔsɔ utata-mi na mina kenye kemmo.
7O Unwoti, nyimo lɛla lɛni na Edomƒuɔ bábla
na limeyi lɛni na Yerusalem ɔ́yu kalɔ.
Báva básu banini, “Bigyingya ɔma ɔmmɔ!
Bɛƒɛ lɛtɔ lɛmmɔ ku ana atabi ani bakya kalɔ ƒui kede kede!”
8Awɔ Babilon, ámanku ka bayila-a udu.
Lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ ukyuli ɔni medie-ɔ kasi
aani kalɛ na éti ábla-bu.
9Na lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ ukyuli ɔni mada ƒula bebi lɛgba
na waƒiɛmi-ma atabi lɛlɔ ni.

english_text:
(By David.)
Praise the Lord with All Your Heart
1With all my heart
I praise you, Lord.
In the presence of angels
I sing your praises.
2I worship at your holy temple
and praise you for your love
and your faithfulness.
You were true to your word
and made yourself more famous
than ever before.
3When I asked for your help,
you answered my prayer
and gave me courage.
4All kings on this earth
have heard your promises, Lord,
and they will praise you.
5You are so famous
that they will sing about
the things you have done.
6Though you are above us all,
you care for humble people,
and you keep a close watch
on everyone who is proud.
7I am surrounded by trouble,
but you protect me
against my angry enemies.
With your own powerful arm
you keep me safe.
8You, Lord, will always
treat me with kindness.
Your love never fails.
You have made us what we are.
Don't give up on us now!
translation_text:
1O mina Unwoti, ndubɔgya-a enu
na limwi-ɔ ku mina kayi ƒui
na lɛlɔ badine ku bayikune bamba bani náka bámana-a anumi.
2Ndububoku lɛlɔ kalɔ
na liti mina anumi lɛtina ƒula kakpakɔ kedee
na limwi-ɔ lɛnyi,
ɔsika aayɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi
na asia ƒula litemi kama.
Na édie átina ka ƒula lɛnyi ku ƒula ɔda bubo
bɔ́kɔ katɔ ƒui butulo lɛla ndi lɛla.
3Limeyi lɛni na líwulo lɛkpali-ɔ ni, énu-mi bɔkpali
na ákya-mi kayi na áya na mina kɔyu kɔ́kɛ ɔyikun.
4Kalɔ lɛlɔ baga ƒui badubumwi-ɔ lɛnyi, O Unwoti,
ɔsika bénu ƒula kenye etemila.
5Na badubudie lɛnu bete-ɔ na ala ani na ábla ɔsu.
Ɔsika eekeye geen.
6Unwoti, ina ka eli katɔ katɔ mmɔ muedi ni,
aanu bani muuboku lɛlɔ kalɔ kɔnyana.
Na bani mɔɔkɔliku lɛlɔ katɔ ni,
bana ablala lɛnɔ átabɛ-ɔ.
7Ina ka ala ani muukpóku-mi áka ámana-mi ni,
amu ada mina ngba.
Na adubudie ƒula kɔnu atina mina bekisine ƒui.
Na ƒula kɔdianu kɔnu kɔdubɔƒɔ-mi ngba.
8Na ngyi ka kasusu kani na Unwoti ubo ute-mi
kadubo-nwu kemmo lɛni.
Ɔsika aayɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.
Na buuvele ka awɔlɔ ƒula kabla
kani kalɔ na ése na bula akɔ.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader.)
The Lord Is Always Near
1You have looked deep
into my heart, Lord,
and you know all about me.
2You know when I am resting
or when I am working,
and from heaven
you discover my thoughts.
3You notice everything I do
and everywhere I go.
4Before I even speak a word,
you know what I will say,
5and with your powerful arm
you protect me
from every side.
6I can't understand all of this!
Such wonderful knowledge
is far above me.
7Where could I go to escape
from your Spirit
or from your sight?
8If I were to climb up
to the highest heavens,
you would be there.
If I were to dig down
to the world of the dead
you would also be there.
9Suppose I had wings
like the dawning day
and flew across the ocean.
10Even then your powerful arm
would guide and protect me.
11Or suppose I said, “I'll hide
in the dark until night comes
to cover me over.”
12But you see in the dark
because daylight and dark
are all the same to you.
13You are the one
who put me together
inside my mother's body,
14and I praise you because of
the wonderful way
you created me.
Everything you do is marvelous!
Of this I have no doubt.
15Nothing about me
is hidden from you!
I was secretly woven together
out of human sight,
16but with your own eyes you saw
my body being formed.
Even before I was born,
you had written in your book
everything about me.
17 Your thoughts are far beyond
my understanding,
much more than I
could ever imagine.
18I try to count your thoughts,
but they outnumber the grains
of sand on the beach.
And when I awake,
I will find you nearby.
19How I wish that you would kill
all cruel and heartless people
and protect me from them!
20They are always rebelling
and speaking evil of you.
21You know I hate anyone
who hates you, Lord,
and refuses to obey.
22They are my enemies too,
and I truly hate them.
23Look deep into my heart, God,
and find out everything
I am thinking.
24Don't let me follow evil ways,
but lead me in the way
that time has proven true.
translation_text:
1Unwoti, éduo-mi kayi ku lɛlɔ kemmo ánu ƒui
na agyi kalɛ na nse.
2Na agyi-mi ablala ku kɔvinkɔ ƒui.
Na mina lili kemmo kakali ƒui kátabɛ-ɔ
na kesii kani na eli mmɔ.
3Ákɔku mina busie taavi ku mina bɔtɛ ánu.
Na agyi mina ablala kemmo ƒui kede kede.
4O Unwoti, asa litemi lɛdi
lɛdubɔlɛ-mi kenye kemmo ni,
agyi lɛla lɛni na ndubo bɔsu kukuuku.
5Áaka ámana-mi kesi kesii
na ƒula kɔnu mɔɔgyumana-mi.
6Kalɛ na éti agyi-mi kemmo kágyu geen
ɔni utulo ami ɔlati kalɔ bunu.
7Lɛɛɛdubo bɔkana bukeli ƒula anumi busie kesii kadi.
Na naaakana lɛlɔ bɔbala ƒula anumi lɛnɔ bɔkya kesii kadi.
8Si lɛ́kɔ lísie katɔ ni, akya mmɔ.
Si ubu kemmo na líduo ńtátɛ lɛnɔ akya mmɔ.
9Si lɛ́kwɛ avwi na líveyi lísie ɔgyu kakaaka
na ɛpu ɔvi ngye muedi ni,
10mmɔ geen ƒula kɔnu kɔdubo-mi bɔkpanku.
Na ƒula kɔdianu kɔdubɔtɔnku-mi na ebunku-mi.
11Na si masu nnii lɛdisa lɛdubɔbala-mi
na ɔƒiiwi unwini usien ute-mi muedi ni,
12ɔɔɔdubo bɔtɛ, ɔsika lɛdisa lɛdi bukeye na ƒula anumi.
Na lɛdisa ku bukeye bɔdi unwi na ƒula kudɔ.
13Ɔsika awɔ návɔ-mi lɛlɔ ekpo ƒui
na ásala-nya ákya mina uni kaƒɔ kemmo.
14Ndubumwi-ɔ, ɔsika kalɛ na éti ávɔ-mi ni,
ubo liƒu.
Na ƒula ablala ébomo
na mina kayi kagyi ɔmɛni nwaa.
15Uwi ɔni na ákya aavɔ́ mina ekubi na aasála-nya
na mina uni kaƒɔ kemmo
na mɔɔlɛ lili na bɔbɛ kemmo ni,
awɔ ágyi ka nkya mmɔ.
16Mina bɔvɔ kesii kadi kátabɛ-ɔ asa na báwɔ-mi.
Na énweni mina ngba bulie emeyi bumomo ése
na ƒula ɔku kemmo
asa na mina lɛlɔ kakɛ kadi kadubuse kalɔ na kaƒɔ kemmo.
17Unwoti Katɔti, ƒula kakali káƒɔ kuye geen
na kana kemmo lɛnɔ kágyu geen na kemomo.
18Na si banii baka ƒula kasusu ni, ketulo ɛpu kɔnwinimi.
Na si lɛ́gyinya na nkɛ ni, ƒula kudɔ kani na nli.
19Sɔsɔ ni, O Katɔti Kedee, ɔdubɔda-mi kubiti
si banii ádu balalane.
Ya na bekyuli bani mbo likyulikpi banyonu-mi!
20Bekyuli bammɔ baatɛmi ala ekpidi taasiku-ɔ lɛlɔ,
na bada ƒula lɛnyi lɛnɔ na ulu ɔni nátamanaku lɛlɔ.
21O Unwoti, bekyuli bani muukisi-ɔ ni,
ami lɛnɔ muukisi-ma.
Na bani ƒui mɔɔta tenye-ɔ lɛlɔ ni,
uukpóku-mi na muukisi-ma geen.
22Naaanu-ma bɔdia munu munu,
ɔsika mɔɔnu-ma aani-mina bekisine.
23O Katɔti, awɔ ɔlati kɔku-mi
na ati kalɛ na nse.
24Sia-mi anu na si nkɛ ulu ukpidi ɔdi lɛlɔ
na eti-mi asiaku ngba ƒui ulu lɛlɔ.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader.)
A Prayer for the Lord's Help
1Rescue me from cruel
and violent enemies, Lord!
2They think up evil plans
and always cause trouble.
3 Their words bite deep
like the poisonous fangs
of a snake.
4Protect me, Lord, from cruel
and brutal enemies,
who want to destroy me.
5Those proud people have hidden
traps and nets
to catch me as I walk.
6You, Lord, are my God!
Please listen to my prayer.
7You have the power to save me,
and you keep me safe
in every battle.
8Don't let the wicked succeed
in doing what they want,
or else they might never
stop planning evil.
9They have me surrounded,
but make them the victims
of their own vicious lies.
10Dump flaming coals on them
and throw them into pits
where they can't climb out.
11Chase those cruel liars away!
Let trouble hunt them down.
12Our Lord, I know that you
defend the homeless
and see that the poor
are given justice.
13Your people will praise you
and will live with you
because they do right.
translation_text:
1O Unwoti, die-mi
na bekyuli bekpidi enu kemmo.
Na agyumana-mi na lɛlɛ kalala bablane enu kemmo.
2Likpidi bɔbla kakali kani na bekyuli bammɔ beeti.
Na baakya kekpo uwi ndi uwi.
3Bágyu bana inye beti yayaaya aani balakpi.
Na bana inye bɔɔdú bekyuli aani kɔlakpi bɔdu kalɛ.
4O Unwoti, da-mi die bekyuli bekpidi bamɛni enu kemmo.
Na agyumana-mi na lɛlɛ balalane
bani mɔɔwia ka bekpeli-mi lɛgba na bayila-mi udu mɛni kudɔ.
5Ɔsika bekyuli bekpidi bákywɛ-mi kɔkpagyuɛ bése.
Na béwi bana lɛsawu lɛnɔ bése-mi kɔvinkɔ.
6O Unwoti, mɔɔkpali-ɔ, awɔ ndi mina Katɔti.
Nu-mi bɔkpali.
7O Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui, awɔ ndi mina ɔƒɔne
ɔni mɔɔgyumana-mi kpakplaa.
Na awɔ nékpo éte-mi na kekpokɔ.
8O Unwoti, taya na kakali
kani na mina bekisine bábla mina lɛlɔ
ubo-nwu kemmo.
Amu badubɔkɛ-mi lɛlɔ ɔyikun
na benye beteekpoku-mi uwi ƒui.
9Taya na bani náka-mi bákya
na baawia-mi likpidi badi-mi lɛlɔ.
Ya na ɔgbankpi ɔni baawia ka ubo-mi lɛlɔ
unwini usie-ma kudɔ.
10Na aya na agyabi ani náƒɔ ogya ewi-ma lɛlɔ.
Na ebo-ma atákya lɛgyavonku kemmo
na ubu voo kemmo kalɛ na basɔ balálɛ kudii!
11Taya na ukyuli ɔni muubile bekyuli anyi
ɔkɛ bɔnwuna bɔdi na kalɔ kamɛni lɛlɔ.
Ya na lɛbibo lɛsiaku bekyuli bani muuti kalala kasusu.
12Unwoti, ngyi nwaa ka eekpó
teete bawabane na ɔgbankpi kemmo.
Na aanu bani mɔɔyaki ala lɛlɔ.
13Sɔsɔ geen ni, bekyuli bani nse siin badubo-ɔ enu bɔgya,
ɔsika badubo bulie na ƒula anumi uwi biala.

english_text:
(A psalm by David.)
A Prayer for the Lord's Protection
1I pray to you, Lord!
Please listen when I pray
and hurry to help me.
2 Think of my prayer
as sweet-smelling incense,
and think of my lifted hands
as an evening sacrifice.
3Help me to guard my words
whenever I say something.
4Don't let me want to do evil
or waste my time doing wrong
with wicked people.
Don't let me even taste
the good things they offer.
5Let your faithful people
correct and punish me.
My prayers condemn the deeds
of those who do wrong,
so don't let me be friends
with any of them.
6Everyone will admit
that I was right
when their rulers are thrown
down a rocky cliff,
7and their bones lie scattered
like crushed rocks
on top of a grave.
8You are my Lord and God,
and I look to you for safety.
Don't let me be harmed.
9Protect me from the traps
of those violent people,
10and make them fall
into their own traps
while you help me escape.
translation_text:
1Unwoti Katɔti, awɔ na muuwulo taakpali.
Se atu na enu-mi bɔkpali na ebo pla.
2Ya na mina katɔ bɔkpali bunwini
aani oloƒui ƒɛƒɛɛ ɔni baakyula na ƒula anumi.
Na si lɛ́kɔliku mina enu katɔ ni,
na ɔbla aani useyi uwi akpala ani na baabla teete-ɔ.
3O Unwoti, ya na lɛti mina kenye bɔda
na lɛkɔsi bɔtɛmi!
4Taya na mina kayi kasia likpidi lɛdi bɔbla lɛlɔ.
Na taya na liti lɛlɔ lɛkya bekyuli bekpidi ablala kemmo.
Na taya na bana adila adi ada-mi ɔkwɛ.
5Taya na lini ka ukyuli ɔni nse siin ɔni-mi kɔtu iye ɔdɔnku-mi.
Ɔsika ɔmmɔ ɔdubunwini lɛƒɔndia mmomu ute-mi.
Taya na lɛƒɔ bumwi bɔdi lɛsiku bekyuli bekpidi kudɔ
aani kalɛ na beewi ukyuli lili nnɔmii,
ɔsika mɔɔkpali katɔ uwi biala nnii
utatɛ utete bekyuli bani mbo likyulikpi.
6Si uwi ɔni na béƒwimi bana lɛlɔ badine
básiku atakpɛ eli bátáva kalɔ ni,
uwi ɔmmɔ na bekyuli bammɔ badubɔnu bɔti
ka mina etemila adi sɔsɔ.
7Na badubo bana ekubi bugyingya buwi kɔƒiɔtɔ atu
aani atakpɛ kɔkɛ, kalɛ kalɛ.
8Nsu mina anu asia awɔ mina Unwoti Katɔti lɛlɔ kani.
Gyumana-mi na lɛkɛ kabɛkɔ na ƒula kudɔ
kalɛ na neeeduo ɔgbankpi ɔdi kemmo.
9Kɔkpagyuɛ kɔni na mina bekisine bákywɛ-mi ƒui ni,
da-mi die-ku kemmo.
10Na aya na balalane banu beduo ama alati
bana kɔkpagyuɛ kɔmmɔ kemmo
uwi ɔni na áya-mi na lɛ́lɛ sɛɛn na bana enu kemmo.

english_text:
(A special psalm and a prayer by David when he was in the cave.)
A Prayer for Help
1 I pray to you, Lord.
I beg for mercy.
2I tell you all my worries
and my troubles,
3and whenever I feel low,
you are there to guide me.
A trap has been hidden
along my pathway.
4Even if you look,
you won't see anyone
who cares enough
to walk beside me.
There is no place to hide,
and no one who really cares.
5I pray to you, Lord!
You are my place of safety,
and you are my choice
in the land of the living.
Please answer my prayer.
I am completely helpless.
6Help! They are chasing me,
and they are too strong.
7Rescue me from this prison,
so I can praise your name.
And when your people notice
your wonderful kindness to me,
they will rush to my side.
translation_text:
1Líwulo keku lɛ́kya mina Unwoti.
Na lɛ́talaku mina lɛdi katɔ lívele-nwu ka ɔnu-mi kɔnyana.
2Lɛ́ka mina etemila ƒui lɛ́tina-nwu.
Na lɛ́da ala ani muukpóku-mi ƒui lɛ́va-nwu anumi.
3Si uwi ɔni na enu áƒɛ-mi na lɛ́yila lɛnunsia ni,
awɔ agyi ulu ɔni lɛlɔ na eti-mi asiaku.
Bekisine bábɛ bákywɛ-mi kakpagyuɛ na mina kɔvinkɔ.
4Si lɛ́nu lɛ́mana ni, mɔɔnu ka ukyuli ɔdi uuubo
na ute-mi kebunku kadi.
Ɔmmɔ ɔsu ńtakɛ katamikukɔ kadi.
Na ukyuli ɔdi lɛnɔ ɔɔɔdaku mina ngba lɛda.
5Lɛ́kpali awɔ, mina Unwoti Katɔti, na lɛ́su-ɔ nnini,
“Awɔ ndi mina katamikukɔ.
Na awɔ kani mɔɔwia na mina ngba ƒui kemmo.
6Nu-mi bɔkpali, ɔsika nkya ɔgbankpi bonwu kemmo.
Die-mi na mina bekisine enu kemmo
ama bani nsiaku-mi beekpóku-mi kpakplaa mɛni
ɔsika bebo ɔkplu betulo-mi!
7Die-mi lɛku ɔgbankpi bonwu ɔni kemmo na nkya
aani ɔtɔntɛne kalɛ na lɛkɛ bɔnwuna.
“Na ndubumwi-ɔ lɛnyi na ƒula bekyuli kedee kasalakɔ
ɔkɛnku lɛƒɔndia lɛni na ábla-mi ɔsu.”

english_text:
(A psalm by David.)
A Prayer in Time of Danger
1Listen, Lord, as I pray!
You are faithful and honest
and will answer my prayer.
2 I am your servant.
Don't try me in your court,
because no one is innocent
by your standards.
3My enemies are chasing me,
crushing me in the ground.
I am in total darkness,
like someone long dead.
4I have given up hope,
and I feel numb all over.
5I remember to think about
the many things you did
in years gone by.
6Then I lift my hands in prayer,
because my soul is a desert,
thirsty for water from you.
7Please hurry, Lord,
and answer my prayer.
I feel hopeless.
Don't turn away
and leave me here to die.
8Each morning let me learn
more about your love
because I trust you.
I come to you in prayer,
asking for your guidance.
9Please rescue me
from my enemies, Lord!
I come to you for safety.
10You are my God. Show me
what you want me to do,
and let your gentle Spirit
lead me in the right path.
11Be true to your name, Lord,
and keep my life safe.
Use your saving power
to protect me from trouble.
12I am your servant.
Show how much you love me
by destroying my enemies.
translation_text:
1Unwoti Katɔti, ka ese siin
na asia ƒula litemi kama ɔsu ni,
se atu na enu mina bɔkpali ku mina buvele.
Na aya na linu lɛla lɛdi lɛsiku-ɔ kudɔ.
2Na tatɛku ami ƒula kabla ɔblane litemi.
Ɔsika ukyuli ɔyawine biala na uli ngba
na kalɔ kamɛni lɛlɔ uuuse siin na ƒula anumi.
3Mina ukisine ɔbi ɔsiaku-mi na uukpóku-mi.
Úbo-mi ɔ́va kalɔ na ɔ́di-mi lɛlɔ.
Na úti-mi ɔ́kya lɛdisa kemmo
aani ukyuli ɔni nékpi kukuuku.
4Ɔmmɔ ɔsu enu adaku-mi bɔƒɛ
na nsɔ liiibo lɛnunsia lɛdi.
5Lɛ́kali lɛ́nu uwi ɔni návi na líduo lɛlɔ kemmo
lísie ɔgyu na lɛ́nu akɔla
ala budie taatina ani na ƒula enu ábla.
6Lɛ́kɔliku mina enu katɔ mɔɔkpali-ɔ
aani kalɔ kani lɛlɔ na ntu bɔ́kwii bɔ́sa ƒui.
7Unwoti, nu-mi bɔkpali. Mina lɛnunsia lɛ́sa.
Na téti lɛlɔ tabɛla-mi,
si ɔɔɔdi lɛni ni,
ndubo bukpi aani bamanvine bani ntɔ kalɛ.
8Teenyimene-mi ɔtanta biala ka aayɔ́-mi uwi ndi uwi.
Ɔsika ƒula lɛlɔ kani na mina anu asia.
Tina-mi mina kasiakɔ,
ɔsika awɔ kani na mɔɔkpali ku mina kɔyu ƒui.
9Die-mi lɛku mina bekisine enu kemmo O Unwoti.
Ɔsika awɔ na líkeli ḿbatamiku.
10Tina-mi kalɛ na lɛbla ƒula lɛƒɔyɔ,
ɔsika awɔ ndi mina Katɔti.
Na aya na ƒula lɛƒɔndia lɛtɔnku-mi
na lɛsia ngba ulu geen ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ.
11O Unwoti, die-mi lɛku mina lɛbibo kemmo
ɔkɛnku ƒula lɛnyi kedee lɛlɔ
ku ƒula ɔyikun ɔsu na lɛkɛ ngba bɔƒɔ.
12Ɔkɛnku kalɛ na aayɔ́-mi uwi biala ɔsu ni,
yila mina bekisine ƒui udu.
Ɔsika ƒula kabla ɔblane na ndi.

english_text:
(By David.)
A Prayer for the Nation
1I praise you, Lord!
You are my mighty rock,
and you teach me
how to fight my battles.
2You are my friend, my fortress,
where I am safe.
You are my shield,
and you made me the ruler
of our people.
3 Why do we humans mean anything
to you, our Lord?
Why do you care about us?
4We disappear like a breath;
we last no longer
than a faint shadow.
5Open the heavens like a curtain
and come down, Lord.
Touch the mountains
and make them send up smoke.
6Use your lightning as arrows
to scatter my enemies
and make them run away.
7Reach down from heaven
and set me free.
Save me from the mighty flood
8of those lying foreigners
who never tell the truth.
9In praise of you, our God,
I will sing a new song,
while playing my harp.
10By your power, kings win wars,
and your servant David is saved
from deadly swords.
11Won't you keep me safe
from those lying foreigners
who never tell the truth?
12Let's pray that our young sons
will grow like strong plants
and that our daughters
will be as lovely as columns
in the corner of a palace.
13May our barns be filled
with all kinds of crops.
May our fields be covered
with sheep by the thousands,
14and every cow have calves.
Don't let our city be captured
or any of us be taken away,
and don't let cries of sorrow
be heard in our streets.
15Our Lord and our God,
you give these blessings
to all who worship you.
translation_text:
1Muute Unwoti kusɛ kusɛ.
Anwu ndi mina Lɛtakpɛ.
Ɔsika anwu mɔɔtina-mi kalɛ na liti mina enu likpo kekpo.
Na anwu mɔɔyá na mina animi aata na mina ekpola lɛlɔ.
2Awɔ ndi mina lɛtakpɛ ku katamikukɔ
kesii kani mɔɔkɛ́ bɔƒɔ.
Ƒula lɛlɔ na mina anu asia,
ɔsika adi mina ɔgyumanane
ɔni muuboku mina bekisine eli kalɔ
teete-mi na mɔɔdi-ma lɛlɔ.
3O Unwoti, bi na abu bekyuli bayawine bɔdi bute-ɔ
ɔsu na bɔ́ƒɔ-ɔ kuye lɛni?
Na bi ɔsu na eeti-bu lɛlɔ kasusu uwi ndi uwi lɛni?
4Buse aani ɔƒɛƒɛɛ.
Na bula emeyi ese aani ɔƒɛ ɔyuli
ɔni mɔɔyii taakya kani na ɔ́sa.
5O Unwoti, bwɛ kayaa na ebeduo-bu lɛlɔ mɛni.
Na etuku abi ammɔ na uyɔ utaalɛ-nya kemmo.
6Na aya na kayaa kataabwɛ ogya
na ugyingya ƒula bekisine bammɔ ƒui.
Bo ƒula atula lɛ-ma na ayila-ma udu.
7Die ƒula kɔnu si katɔ na ada-mi edie-ma akɔ,
na lɛlɛ ketu bonwu kani náka-mi kákya mɛni kemmo
na kadi bamba bekyuli bamɛni enu akɔ.
8Ɔkɔ ala sɔɔn na bagyi bɔsu
na bana ablala ƒui ɔkɔ na adi.
9Ndubɔtu ɔnu ɔwɔdi lite-ɔ
na mina ɔbentaa lɛlɔ liti limwi
10awɔ ɔni mɔɔyá baga baadi kekpo lɛlɔ.
Awɔ muukpó teete ƒula kabla ɔblane Dawid
na aaƒɔ́-nwu na nwuna bekisine ekpola aladi-nwu lɛlɔ.
11Die-mi lɛku kadi bamba bekyuli
bani mɔɔnyi ɔkɔ uwi biala
ku ala bɔkpali muedi mɛni akɔ.
12Ya na bula bebi bakɔdi babla
aani egyii ani mbo ɔkplu.
Na bula belekubi beteekeye aani atabi
ani na béti bátu ɔga lɛgbanya
na bákwaa-nya na eekeye kalɛ.
13Ya na bula linwu liyi ku edula lidu lidu
na bula baƒonu lɛnɔ bawɔ na bemomo mpim mpim.
14Na bebuo bani mɔɔtuma teete-bu bataawɔ pii
na betebile kaƒɔ na aya kukpi kusie kama.
Na taya keku iye kɔnu kenye kɔdi kɔlɛ bula lɛblɔnu lɛlɔ!
15Na bekyuli bani na bana Unwoti ndi Katɔti ni,
lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ-ma,
ɔsika ama na kusɛ kusɛ ɔmɛni udu ɔɔsiaku.

english_text:
(By David for praise.)
The Lord Is Kind and Merciful
1I will praise you,
my God and King,
and always honor your name.
2I will praise you each day
and always honor your name.
3You are wonderful, Lord,
and you deserve all praise,
because you are much greater
than anyone can understand.
4Each generation will announce
to the next your wonderful
and powerful deeds.
5I will keep thinking about
your marvelous glory
and your mighty miracles.
6Everyone will talk about
your fearsome deeds,
and I will tell all nations
how great you are.
7They will celebrate and sing
about your matchless mercy
and your power to save.
8You are merciful, Lord!
You are kind and patient
and always loving.
9You are good to everyone,
and you take care
of all your creation.
10All creation will thank you,
and your loyal people
will praise you.
11They will tell about
your marvelous kingdom
and your power.
12Then everyone will know about
the mighty things you do
and your glorious kingdom.
13Your kingdom will never end,
and you will rule forever.
Our Lord, you keep your word
and do everything you say.
14When someone stumbles or falls,
you give a helping hand.
15Everyone depends on you,
and when the time is right,
you provide them with food.
16By your own hand you satisfy
the desires of all who live.
17Our Lord, everything you do
is kind and thoughtful,
18and you are near to everyone
whose prayers are sincere.
19You satisfy the desires
of all your worshipers,
and you come to save them
when they ask for help.
20You take care of everyone
who loves you,
but you destroy the wicked.
21I will praise you, Lord,
and everyone will respect
your holy name forever.
translation_text:
1Ndububo-ɔ lɛnyi kudu lɛkɔliku-ɔ katɔ.
Na nteemwi-ɔ lɛnyi kedee úti úsela uwi ƒui.
2Limeyi ndi limeyi ndubumwi-ɔ lɛnyi
na lɛtalaku ƒula lɛnyi katɔ uwi ndi uwi.
3Unwoti Katɔti úbomo geen, na ɔ́manku bumwi.
Na nwuna ɔyikun ni, ukyuli ɔdi ulénu-nwu kalɔ kudii.
4Ƒula ablala ɔsu ni,
badubo-ɔ bumwi ɔ́si kaba útédu kaba.
Na badubo ƒula ala enengudi lidu lidu
ani na ábla lɛsa bɔkɔ.
5Badubɔsu kalɛ na ƒula lɛgadi liikeye,
na ndubulie kalɔ na liduo lɛlɔ kemmo lɛnu
ƒula akɔla ala budie taatina lidu lidu lɛni na aabla.
6Na bekyuli badubɔsu ala enengudi ani na ábla,
na lidie ƒula ɔyikun bonwu keyi lɛtina.
7Badubo lɛbuni bonwu lɛni na ábla-bu butaasu ku lɛlɔyɔ,
na bedie agya basu kalɛ na ese siin na ebo lɛƒɔndia.
8Unwoti ubo lɛƒɔndia na ɔɔnu kɔnyana
na uléti kɔnyi pla pla,
na ɔɔyɔ́ bekyuli uwi ndi uwi.
9Unwoti Katɔti ɔdia ute ukyuli biala.
Na ala ani ƒui na údie ni, ɔɔnu ana ƒui kɔnyana.
10O Unwoti, ala ani ƒui na édie adubumwi ƒula lɛnyi.
Na ƒula bekyuli kedee ƒui badubo-ɔ lɛnyi katɔ bɔtalaku.
11Badubɔsu kalɛ na ƒula lɛga kadikɔ keekeye
ku kalɛ na ebo ɔyikun.
12Na ɔmɛni ɔdubɔya na ukyuli biala ɔnu ƒula ablala bonwu ɔti
ku kalɛ na ƒula Katɔ Ɔga Ɔma lɛgadi liikeye.
13Na ƒula lɛga kadikɔ kammɔ keeebo kawɔlɔkɔ
na awɔ kani ndubɔdi lɛga buteesie uwi ƒui.
Unwoti ɔɔdi nwuna linyese lɛlɔ
na ubo lɛƒɔndia na nwuna ablala ƒui kemmo.
14Na bekyuli bani ƒui mɔɔbla kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ ni,
Unwoti ɔɔda-ma na ɔɔkya-ma ɔyikun.
Na bani na bakya lɛbibo kemmo ni,
uukpó teete-ma.
15Ƒula ala ediedi ƒui aanu-ɔ anumi.
Na awɔ muute-ma bana lɛdila na uwi lɛlɔ.
16Awɔ muubimi ƒula enu
na lɛla biala nli ngba lɛɛkɛ́ nina lɛla lɛni na ɔɔwia.
17Unwoti use siin na ulu biala lɛlɔ,
na ubo lɛƒɔndia na nwuna ablala ƒui kemmo.
18Unwoti ude bekyuli bani mɔɔkpali-nwu
ulu lɛlɔ ku ɔbu geen.
19Bekyuli bani ƒui mɔɔyia-nwu ku ɔbu ni,
ɔɔbla bana lɛyɔla teete-ma.
Na uunú bana kɔvanu na uubo taabaƒɔ-ma si bévele-nwu.
20Na bani ƒui mɔɔyɔ́-nwu ni, ɔɔgyumana-ma.
Nsu balalane ama ni, ɔdubɔyila-ma udu.
21Ndubumwi Unwoti uwi biala.
Amii nwuna ala ediedi ƒui bimwi-nwu lɛnyi kedee
ɔ́si ɔƒɛni úsela uwi ƒui.

english_text:
Shout Praises to the Lord
1Shout praises to the Lord!
With all that I am,
I will shout his praises.
2I will sing and praise
the Lord God
as long as I live.
3You can't depend on anyone,
not even a great leader.
4Once they die and are buried,
that will be the end
of all their plans.
5The Lord God of Jacob blesses
everyone who trusts him
and depends on him.
6 God made heaven and earth;
he created the sea
and everything else.
God always keeps his word.
7He gives justice to the poor
and food to the hungry.
The Lord sets prisoners free
8and heals blind eyes.
He gives a helping hand
to everyone who falls.
The Lord loves good people
9and looks after strangers.
He defends the rights
of orphans and widows,
but destroys the wicked.
10The Lord God of Zion
will rule forever!
Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_text:
1Bɛya na bumwi Unwoti.
O Unwoti, ndubɔkpali-ɔ
limwi ku mina kɔyu ƒui!
2Uwi ɔni na mmu nli ngba mɛni ku mina ɔlɔna ni,
ndubumwi Unwoti Katɔti.
3Biteti anu bitasia bagadine lɛlɔ iye bayawine bebi badi lɛlɔ,
ɔsika ɔdi ulakana-mi bubunku.
4Si ɔdi ɔ́yula ni, ɔ́sa únwini lɛla likpine
na bɔva na badubo-nwu.
Na nwuna kasusu ku kakwɛ kawɔlɔkɔ kadi mmɔ.
5Lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ ukyuli ɔni néti nwuna anu
ɔ́sia Yakob Unwoti Katɔti lɛlɔ ka ubunku-nwu,
ɔsika úti Unwoti ɔ́bla nwuna Katɔti.
6Anwu nédie kalɔ kammɔ ƒui ku ɛpu
ku ala ani ƒui nkya-nya kemmo,
na ɔɔdi nwuna litemi lɛlɔ uwi biala.
7Anwu mɔɔtɛ litemi teete bekyuli
bani na beekpóku.
Na bani na kɔka kɔɔda ni,
uute-ma adila.
Na bani na bákya-ma ɔtɔ lɛnɔ ni,
uudie-ma na baakɛ́ bɔnwuna.
8Unwoti Katɔti uubimi banumbwɛne anumi.
Na bani na bekyuli béboku-ma kalɔ ni,
ɔɔkɔliku-ma katɔ,
na ɔɔyɔ́ bekyuli bani na bese siin.
9Ɔɔnu baƒɔ lɛlɔ, na uudie bekpinebi ku bekpinele.
Nsu balalane ama ni,
Unwoti Katɔti uubile bana ablala ku kɔkwɛ ƒui.
10Unwoti Katɔti ɔdubo lɛga bɔdi uwi ƒui.
O Sion, ƒula Unwoti ɔdubɔdi lɛga na kaba bekyuli ƒui lɛlɔ.
Bɛya na bumwi Unwoti.

english_text:
Sing and Praise the Lord
1Shout praises to the Lord!
Our God is kind,
and it is right and good
to sing praises to him.
2The Lord rebuilds Jerusalem
and brings the people of Israel
back home again.
3He renews our hopes
and heals our bodies.
4He decided how many stars
there would be in the sky
and gave each one a name.
5Our Lord is great and powerful!
He understands everything.
6The Lord helps the oppressed,
but he smears the wicked
in the dirt.
7Celebrate and sing!
Play your harps
for the Lord our God.
8He fills the sky with clouds
and sends rain to the earth,
so that the hills
will be green with grass.
9He provides food for cattle
and for the young ravens,
when they cry out.
10The Lord doesn't care about
the strength of horses
or powerful armies.
11The Lord is pleased only
with those who worship him
and trust his love.
12Everyone in Jerusalem,
come and praise
the Lord your God!
13He makes your city gates strong
and blesses your people.
14God lets you live in peace,
and he gives you
the very best wheat.
15As soon as God speaks,
the earth obeys.
16He covers the ground with snow
like a blanket of wool,
and he scatters frost
like ashes on the ground.
17God sends down hailstones
like chips of rocks.
Who can stand the cold?
18At his command the ice melts,
the wind blows,
and streams begin to flow.
19God gave his laws and teachings
to the descendants of Jacob,
the nation of Israel.
20But he has not given his laws
to any other nation.
Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_text:
1Bɛya na bumwi Unwoti!
Ɔsika ɔdia ka bumwi bula Katɔti.
Ɔdi lɛla lɛbuni, na ɔ́manku lɛnɔ.
2Unwoti Katɔti ɔ́sɔku Yerusalem ɔ́tu,
na ɔ́sala bani na béƒie bátɔlɔku ƒui
ɔ́sɔku-ma úboku ɔma.
3Bani na bana enu áƒɛ ni,
ɔ́ya na bákɛ lɛnunsia lɛwɔdi.
Na ɔ́mana-ma alɛbi ƒui na ása.
4Ɔgyi ayabi ani ƒui na udie kalɛ na emomo.
Na ubo ɔ́di biala ku nwuna lɛnyi.
5Bula Unwoti Katɔti úbomo na ubo ɔyikun geen.
Nwuna lɛnunda lɛni na ɔda ɔɔnu ala kemmo
kágyu geen, na uuubo kawɔlɔkɔ.
6Unwoti Katɔti ɔɔkɔliku bekyuli
bani muubo-ku lɛlɔ kalɔ katɔ.
Na bekyuli bani mɔɔkɔliku lɛlɔ katɔ ni,
uuboku-ma kalɔ.
7Bidie enugya lɛnu bimwi Unwoti.
Na bɛgya lɛbentaa bidie bumwi lɛnu bite bula Katɔti.
8Anwu náya na ulɔyɔ ɔ́ƒɔ kayaa ƒui.
Na ɔɔyá na ɔnantu ɔɔna teewi kalɔ,
na livo lɛɛkwɛ́ abi lɛlɔ.
9Uute beƒiebuo adila na baadi,
na ɔɔnyuɛ baasɛ bebi bani muuwulo kɔka lɛnɔ.
10Bekyuli bani néti bana anu básia bapɔnkɔ ɔyikun
iye bekpone bani nkɛ lɛgba lɛlɔ ka wedie-ma,
balayɔ Unwoti Katɔti kaƒɔ.
11Na bani mɔɔyia Katɔti
na benye baanu ulu teete nwuna bɔyɔ bɔni naaasa kudii ni,
bana lɛlɔ mɔɔda Katɔti kubiti.
12Amii Yerusalem kadi bekyuli ƒui, bimwi Unwoti Katɔti
na bɛkɔliku-nwu lɛnyi katɔ,
13ɔsika abuala na úti ɔ́kalɛ bina ɔba kenye kpakplaa.
Na úte ƒula ɔma kemmo bebi kusɛ kusɛ.
14Ɔ́ya bɛ́kɛ atu bɔyɔ ɔ́ka ɔ́mana ƒula ntɛ mmɔ.
Na anta ku kamu káƒɔ ɔma ɔmmɔ kemmo.
15Na lɛla biala na Unwoti ɔ́su ni,
liigyingya teesie kesi kesii kɔnakunwi.
16Ɔɔyá na etubankɛ aayu taaƒɔ kalɔ ƒui
na eekeye ƒututuu aani bebuo linwini.
Na nwuna kɔkɛ wɛlɛ wɛlɛ kɔɔƒɔ́ kalɔ ƒui aani ntɔ kalɛ.
17Na ɔdi ɔɔyu aani abanta bonwu bonwu.
Na ɔdi biala ulakana kɔyɔ kɔmmɔ kenye bunye.
18Ɔɔyɛɛlɛ abanta amɛni ƒui si údie lɛdi,
na eenwíni ketu taagba
si ɔƒɛƒɛɛ úkpo ɔ́vi-nya lɛlɔ.
19Unwoti úti nwuna ɔda bubo
ku ala bɔtina ƒui úte Yakob kaba kemmo bebi
bani ndi Israelƒuɔ.
20Útabla ɔmɛni útete kadi bamba bekyuli badi kudii.
Na baaagyi kalɛ na ɔɔtɛ litemi lɛnɔ.
Bɛya na bumwi Unwoti.

english_text:
Come Praise the Lord
1Shout praises to the Lord!
Shout the Lord's praises
in the highest heavens.
2All of you angels,
and all who serve him above,
come and offer praise.
3Sun and moon,
and all of you bright stars,
come and offer praise.
4Highest heavens, and the water
above the highest heavens,
come and offer praise.
5Let all things praise
the name of the Lord,
because they were created
at his command.
6He made them to last forever,
and nothing can change
what he has done.
7All creatures on earth,
you obey his commands,
so come praise the Lord!
8Sea monsters and the deep sea,
fire and hail, snow and frost,
and every stormy wind,
come praise the Lord!
9All mountains and hills,
fruit trees and cedars,
10every wild and tame animal,
all reptiles and birds,
come praise the Lord!
11Every king and every ruler,
all nations on earth,
12every man and every woman,
